Office Support Career Stream
Office Support Career Stream: Individual contributors who provide organizational related support or service (administrative or clerical) for other members within the organization. The majority of time is spent in the delivery of support services or activities, typically under supervision.


Differentiating Factors
Autonomy: Entry-level position typically requiring little to no prior experience. Works on well-defined administrative and clerical tasks. Work is routine or follows standard procedures and is closely supervised.
Organizational Impact: Works to deliver on day-to-day objectives with some impact on achievement of results for the job area, including limited disruption or expense. Delivers job responsibilities following a defined standard output or set of procedures.
Innovation and Complexity: Provides data and information when minor changes may be required based on review. Problems faced are routine and solutions clearly prescribed.
Communication and Influence: Communicates with contacts typically within immediate job area. Obtains and provides information requiring little explanation or interpretation.
Leadership and Talent Management: N/A - Job at this level are focused on self-development.


Required Knowledge and Experience

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Job Description:
Lead a team of engineers responsible for enterprise software engineering platforms and AI-enabled development capabilities.
Serve as the technical lead for GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, and related engineering systems.
Design, implement, and support enterprise-scale engineering platforms supporting 8,000+ developers and 50,000+ repositories.
Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development tools and engineering workflows.
Architect and develop automation solutions utilizing AI technologies, APIs, and platform engineering principles.
Lead enterprise modernization and migration initiatives across software delivery platforms.
Establish technical standards, governance models, and best practices for software engineering and AI-enabled development.
Develop reusable automation frameworks, templates, and self-service engineering capabilities.
Partner with engineering, security, and architecture teams to improve software delivery performance and developer productivity.
Implement and maintain DevSecOps and software supply chain security controls.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and define enterprise adoption strategies.
Define platform health, adoption, productivity, and AI utilization metrics.
Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across the software engineering organization.
Develop technical roadmaps supporting long-term engineering and AI transformation objectives.
Required Skills:
AI & Engineering Systems: Generative AI Technologies, GitHub Copilot Enterprise, AI-Assisted Software Development, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Agentic Development Workflows, AI Automation Solutions
Software Engineering Platforms: GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, CI/CD Platforms, Developer Experience (DevEx), Platform Engineering, Software Delivery Automation
Development & Automation: Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Git, Workflow Automation, Infrastructure as Code
DevSecOps & Security: Software Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps Practices, Code Scanning, Secret Scanning, Dependency Management, Security Policy Automation
Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure (Preferred), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud-Native Architectures
Preferred Qualifications:
8+ years of software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or developer productivity experience.
Experience leading technical teams and enterprise-scale engineering initiatives.
Experience administering and supporting GitHub Enterprise environments.
Experience deploying and governing GitHub Copilot Enterprise.
Experience implementing enterprise CI/CD and automation platforms.
Experience integrating AI technologies into software engineering workflows.
Experience supporting large-scale developer ecosystems.
Strong understanding of platform engineering, developer experience, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Description:
Job Purpose
The Community Mobilizer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, implementing and monitoring specialist health camps and Anganwadi Centre upgradation activities. The role involves coordination with government health departments, ICDS officials, local administration, healthcare professionals, vendors and community stakeholders to ensure effective project implementation and timely achievement of project objectives.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Specialist Health Camp Planning and Implementation
Plan and coordinate specialist health camps in consultation with the project team and district health authorities.
Coordinate with CDMO, DPM, MOIC, Block Health Officials and other relevant government departments for necessary approvals and support.
Identify suitable camp locations in consultation with local stakeholders and ensure adequate infrastructure and logistics.
Coordinate with specialist doctors, medical teams, diagnostic service providers and other healthcare professionals.
Ensure availability of medicines, medical equipment, diagnostic facilities and IEC materials during health camps.
Coordinate community mobilisation through ASHA workers, ANMs, Anganwadi workers, PRI members and local representatives.
Ensure proper patient registration, screening, consultation, investigation, referral and follow-up services.
Maintain camp-wise beneficiary records, photographs, reports and other supporting documents.
B. Anganwadi Centre Upgradation
Conduct baseline assessments and identify Anganwadi Centres requiring infrastructure and facility upgradation.
Coordinate with ICDS officials, CDPOs, supervisors and Anganwadi workers for site selection and implementation.
Assess infrastructure requirements, including painting, flooring, sanitation, drinking water, electrical fittings, furniture and child-friendly facilities.
Coordinate with vendors, contractors and suppliers for procurement and execution of approved upgradation activities.
Monitor the quality of civil works, installation of equipment and timely completion of activities.
Ensure that upgraded Anganwadi Centres are safe, child-friendly, hygienic and conducive to early childhood care and development.
Maintain before-and-after photographs, completion certificates, expenditure records and handover documents.
C. Project Coordination and Stakeholder Management
Maintain regular coordination with government departments, donor representatives and community stakeholders.
Organise review meetings, field visits and stakeholder consultations.
Address field-level implementation challenges and ensure timely resolution.
Build effective working relationships with district and block-level officials.
Ensure adherence to donor guidelines, organisational policies and approved project plans.
D. Monitoring, Documentation and Reporting
Prepare monthly work plans and activity schedules.
Monitor project progress against approved targets and deliverables.
Prepare and submit monthly progress reports (MPRs), activity reports and case studies.
Maintain beneficiary databases, camp records, attendance sheets and supporting documentation.
Track project expenditure and coordinate with the finance team for budget utilisation.
Document success stories, best practices and project outcomes.
Support donor visits, monitoring visits and project review meetings.
3. Educational Qualification
Graduate/Postgraduate in Social Work, Rural Development,
4. Experience
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in project coordination and implementation.
Experience in organising health camps, community health programmes or CSR projects.
Experience coordinating with government health departments and ICDS/Women and Child Development departments.
Experience in infrastructure development, procurement and vendor management will be an added advantage.
5. Key Skills and Competencies
Strong project planning and coordination skills.
Government liaisoning and stakeholder management.
Knowledge of community-based healthcare services.
Vendor management and infrastructure monitoring.
Report writing and documentation.
MS Office and Excel proficiency.
Good communication and team management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.

Graduate/Postgraduate
MS Office and Excel proficiency.
Good communication and team management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.

Position Title: Team Leader Operations
Department: Operations Sales Voice (Ecommerce)
Location: Bhubaneswar

Key Responsibilities
1. Team & Performance Management
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of sales advisors to meet daily/weekly/monthly sales targets.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
Monitor and improve team performance using operational KPIs
Implement performance improvement plans (PIP) for underperforming team members.

2. Operational Excellence
Ensure adherence to SLA, process policies, and compliance requirements.
Maintain daily and weekly operations dashboards and scorecards.
Ensure accurate score calculation, rating mechanisms, and parameter adherence.
Work closely with Quality, Training, and Workforce Management teams for smooth operations.
Support new process transitions and stabilize teams during pilot phases.
3. Sales Coaching & Customer Engagement
Coach advisors on effective sales communication, objection handling, and valuebased selling.
Ensure that every interaction focuses on convincing customers to complete their purchase from the cart.
Monitor call audits to identify gaps and implement targeted coaching sessions.
Drive bestpractice sharing to enhance sales effectiveness.


Educational & Experience Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory).
2-3 years of work experience in a relevant Contact Center sales voice process.
Prior experience in international/premium contact center environments, especially during new process transitions.
Minimum 1 year experience as a Team Leader in a sales voice sales program (current role).

Interested candidates may share the resume at

Description:
Job Summary
Function SummaryThe agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line. -Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring -Conduct Career Seminar of prospects-Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s) -Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits. -Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals. -Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans. -Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc -Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms. -Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion -Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty -Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need -Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA-Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.-Number MTD Active-Persistency as per grid-Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 years experience, at least 6 months in last job
Age criteria: 24 years to 35 years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Job Title: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager Mid-Market (B2B Sales)

Company: G4S Secure Solutions India
Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 – 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.

Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.
3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time)
Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM).
Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing.
Who We Are Looking For
Experience & Education:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus).
Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales.
Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience.

Skills & Competencies:
Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers.
Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures.
Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel.
(Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

Key Skills (Tags for Naukri Posting)
B2B Sales Corporate Sales Business Development Field Sales New Client Acquisition Account Management Key Account Management Lead Generation Cold Calling Salesforce Facility Management Sales Security Services CCTV Sales Commercial Sales
AboutCompany:
G4S in India: 
Founded in 1989, G4S India is the leading security solutions group in the country. The company today has more than 1,35,000 employees with 4 Hubs and a strong network of over 100+ offices spread throughout India. Besides its core business of Secure Solutions, Integrated Facilities Management Services and Electronic Security Systems, G4S also offers a range of services including; Training (29 Training Schools across India), Event Security, Executive Protection, Security Consultancy & Risk Management, Central Monitoring Services, Fire Alarm and Emergency Evacuation System, People Transport Solutions, CCTV Surveillance Solutions etc. G4S has an impressive clientele in various sectors including business process outsourcing, retail, healthcare, infrastructure, IT, banking, diplomatic missions & embassies, residential facilities, hospitality establishments, communications etc. We have a diverse range of services to meet our customers requirements and have a broad geographic footprint to meet the demand for security globally.
In 2021, G4S, a London-based global security company, was acquired by Allied Universal®, a leading security and facility services company that provides proactive security services and cutting-edge smart technology to deliver tailored, integrated security solutions. This acquisition expands Allied Universal’s footprint and infrastructure on a global and local level. Through the company’s vast network of more than 800,000 employees, we leverage global best practices in communities all over the world. With revenues of $18 billion, we are supported by efficient processes and systems that can only come with scale to help deliver our promise locally: keeping people safe so our communities can thrive. In Asia Pacific, we have an extensive network of offices and more than 192,000 employees to support our local communities and customers. We believe there is no greater purpose than serving and safeguarding customers, communities, and people in today’s world. Allied Universal is There for you™. For more information, please visit  www.g4s.com or www.aus.com

Disclaimer: Appointment to this role will be on a Fixed Term Contract (FTC). Only candidates who are comfortable with and willing to accept contractual employment should submit their applications.

Roles & Responsibilities:-
Managing and supervising day-to-day civil maintenance and repair activities within the plant premises, including buildings, and other civil infrastructure.
Planning and monitoring execution of civil repair, renovation, improvement and Mega ARC jobs as per approved scope, drawings and specifications.
Conducting regular site inspections, identifying civil defects and coordinating timely rectification to maintain the condition and usability of plant infrastructure.
Preparing and checking BOQs, estimates, material requirements and work schedules for civil maintenance and project activities.
Monitoring contractor and vendor activities, ensuring proper manpower deployment, work allocation, productivity and quality of execution.
Verifying measurements, checking work completion and coordinating preparation and submission of client and vendor bills with supporting documents.
Ensuring execution of works as per approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards and applicable construction practices.
Coordinating with plant departments, clients, vendors and internal stakeholders for work planning and timely completion of jobs.
Ensuring compliance with site safety requirements, including work permits, job safety assessments, barricading and safe execution of civil activities.
Maintaining daily progress reports, measurement records, work completion reports, site instructions and other project-related documentation.
Monitoring material consumption, workmanship and site housekeeping, and ensuring optimum utilization of resources.
Coordinating closure of civil-related complaints and audit observations within the stipulated timeline.

Preferred candidate profile
Should have relevant experience in industrial civil maintenance, repair works, project execution and contractor/vendor coordination.
AboutCompany: Tata Steel Utilities and Infrastructure Services Limited (Tata Steel UISL), established in 2004 as a spin-off from Tata Steel's Town Services Division, is India's only comprehensive urban infrastructure service provider. Drawing on Tata Steels century-long legacy, the company transformed essential services into a customer-focused, sustainable enterprise. Guided by the Tata Group’s purpose of enhancing community life, Tata Steel UISL delivers a wide range of services including EPC, power distribution, water and wastewater management, and integrated town operations. It collaborates with civic bodies, governments, and businesses to address urbanization challenges and promote accessible, high-quality urban living across India.

Job Description
Job Description: 

Objective: To develop the assigned Key accounts and to identify, acquire and manage new key accounts
Title: Sales- Team Leader
Function:Commercial
Sub function: Modern Trade
Job Responsibilities

•Totally accountable for the assigned key accounts both for growth in volumes and share.
•Monthly tracking of volume, territory sales, share and other parameters.
•To develop an Annual Customer Plan for all the accounts and get customer buy-in. To execute against the same.
•Account Management that involves developing existing key accounts through innovative consumer and trade promotions, packaging /pricing strategies and merchandising inputs. 
•Work closely with the Merchandising team to design, acquire and place merchandising material suited to the Key account.
•Develop promotions specific to the key account in coordination with marketing and implement the same
•Analyzing post activity results and create and maintain archive of successes and failures
•Negotiate, convert and secure long term deals with competition key accounts at a reasonable cost.
•Tracking new promotions in competition brands and accounts.
•Training of bartenders/waiters for suggestive selling
-
Supervises:  Market Developers and Account Developers 
Reports To:   Area Sales Manager (Key Account Manager)
Key Customers:    Knowledge about Key accounts
  Job Requirement
Qualifications: Graduation/PG
Experience: 4 to 8 years
Functional Skills:
•Planning and Organizing
•Relationship Management
•Presentation Skills
•Good communication & Coordination Skills
•Team worker
•Influencing Skills
•Strong Analytical skills
Travel:  70% traveling

Description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities
1. Patient Consultation: Provide medical consultation and clinical examination to infants, children and adolescents attending the health camp.
2. Growth & Development Assessment: Assess children's physical growth, nutritional status and developmental milestones.
3. Diagnosis & Treatment: Diagnose and manage common childhood illnesses such as fever, cough, cold, diarrhoea, respiratory infections, anaemia and other paediatric conditions.
4. Nutritional Assessment: Identify malnutrition, undernutrition and nutritional deficiencies and provide appropriate dietary guidance.
5. Immunisation Counselling: Educate parents about the importance of routine immunisation and recommend vaccination as per the national immunisation schedule.
6. Newborn & Infant Care: Provide guidance on breastfeeding, complementary feeding, newborn care and essential infant healthcare practices.
7. Prescription: Prescribe appropriate medicines and treatment based on the child's age, weight and clinical condition.
8. Early Identification: Identify developmental delays, congenital conditions and other health concerns requiring specialised medical attention.
9. Referral Services: Refer children with serious or complicated medical conditions to appropriate government or specialised healthcare facilities.
10. Parent Counselling: Educate parents and caregivers on child nutrition, hygiene, preventive healthcare and healthy child development.
11. Medical Documentation: Maintain patient consultation records, diagnosis, prescriptions, growth assessment and referral details.
Required Qualification & Experience
MBBS with MD/DNB in Paediatrics.
Valid medical registration.
Relevant experience in child healthcare and management of paediatric conditions.
Experience in community health camps will be preferred.
Computer Knowledge

The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.

Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).

Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.

Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.

Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Description:
Job Summary
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring.
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects.
Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms.
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s).
Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same.
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan.
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion.
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA.
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active.
Persistency as per grid.
Number of EC/MDRT agent.


Qualifications and Experience
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience
At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
Job Title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
Location: Gopalpur, Odisha


Job Summary
The Maintenance Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the reliable operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of production equipment within the TOPCon solar cell/module manufacturing facility. The role involves preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance, troubleshooting equipment issues, optimizing machine performance, and supporting new equipment installations to achieve maximum uptime and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities
Ensure smooth operation and maintenance of TOPCon solar cell/module manufacturing equipment.
Execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities to maximize equipment uptime.
Diagnose equipment failures and implement corrective actions for continuous improvement.
Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for troubleshooting and servicing requirements.
Maintain maintenance schedules, spare parts inventory, and equipment records.
Drive reliability improvement initiatives and reduce machine downtime.
Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards.
Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of new equipment.
Train operators on basic maintenance and machine handling practices.


Qualifications
B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Communication Engineering, Electrical Electronics Engineering

Description:
Project Role : Cloud Platform Engineer

Project Role Description : Designs, builds, tests, and deploys cloud application solutions that integrate cloud and non-cloud infrastructure. Can deploy infrastructure and platform environments, creates a proof of architecture to test architecture viability, security and performance.

Must have skills :Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Cloud Platform Engineer, a typical day involves designing and constructing cloud-based application solutions that seamlessly integrate both cloud and traditional infrastructure components. The role includes building and testing these solutions to ensure they meet performance and security standards. Additionally, the engineer deploys infrastructure and platform environments and develops proof of architecture models to validate the feasibility and robustness of proposed designs. Collaboration with various teams to align architecture with organizational goals is also a key part of the daily activities, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient.

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
- Should have Influencing and Advisory skills.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
- Lead the evaluation and implementation of new cloud technologies to enhance platform capabilities.
- Mentor and guide junior team members to foster professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
- Experience with cloud infrastructure deployment and management.
- Strong understanding of cloud security principles and best practices.
- Ability to design and validate architecture proofs focusing on performance and security.
- Skilled in integrating cloud and non-cloud systems to create cohesive solutions.
- Familiarity with automation tools and scripting for infrastructure provisioning and deployment.

Additional Information:

- The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.



Qualification
15 years full time education

Job Title: Admission Officer
Institution: Birla Global University
Department: Admissions
Experience: 6-12 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Admission Officer to manage the end-to-end admission process at Birla School of Engineering and Technology. The candidate should have strong communication, counselling, coordination and student engagement skills, preferably in the higher education sector.
Key Responsibilities
Handle admission enquiries and counsel students and parents about academic programmes.
Manage the complete admission process from enquiry to enrolment.
Follow up with prospective students and drive admission conversions.
Verify applications, eligibility and supporting documents.
Maintain admission records, databases and reports.
Coordinate with academic and administrative departments.
Support admission campaigns, education fairs and outreach activities.
Ensure compliance with institutional admission policies.
Eligibility & Skills
Graduate/Postgraduate in any relevant discipline.
6-12 years of experience in admissions, preferably in a university or engineering college.
Excellent communication, counselling and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of admission procedures and documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office and admission management systems.
Strong coordination, follow-up and team management skills.
Preferred: Candidates with experience handling admissions for engineering programmes or higher education institutions.
* Good knowledge of admission procedures, documentation and student database management.
* Proficiency in MS Office and admission management systems.
* Strong coordination, follow-up and team management abilities.
Candidates with relevant experience in educational institutions, preferably in handling admissions for engineering programmes, are encouraged to apply.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.

Location: Sambalpur and Cuttack

Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Independent Suite Setup: Independently prepare endoscopy suites and calibrate video processors, light sources, CO2 insufflators, and electrosurgical units before daily schedules.

Equipment Troubleshooting & Maintenance: Troubleshoot minor processor or scope issues during procedures and coordinate timely repairs and preventive maintenance with biomedical engineers.
Inventory & NABH Audits: Manage par levels of endoscopic consumables, maintain daily disinfection traceability logs, and ensure 100% adherence to NABH and biomedical waste protocols.

Description:
Job Description Cluster Manager
Role objective
The Cluster Manager is primarily responsible for driving sales and building the loan portfolio across assigned branches, while ensuring good customer service, quality business and disciplined branch operations.
Key responsibilities
1. Sales and portfolio growth
Set branch-wise sales priorities and follow up with the sales team on customer acquisition and loan disbursements.
Monitor branch performance, identify gaps and take corrective action to achieve business targets.
Ensure portfolio growth is supported by proper customer verification, adherence to company policies and quality lending practices.
2. Customer service and branch readiness
Ensure every operating branch opens by 9:30 a.m. Escalate any delay immediately.
Ensure at least two employees are present at each branch. Where staffing falls short, contact Pavan Kalyan immediately to arrange deputation.
Ensure customers receive prompt, courteous service and that complaints and service delays are addressed quickly.
3. Auction-loan follow-up
Follow up with customers and branch staff on loans identified for the June auction.
Ensure each affected customer receives the auction message through WhatsApp, in line with the companys communication process.
Track customer responses and repayment commitments, and ensure branch staff complete the required follow-up.
4. Branch expansion
Identify suitable premises for new branches with the assistance of Team Leaders from nearby branches.
Coordinate site visits and submit shortlisted premises for review and approval.
5. Recruitment and staffing coordination

We seek a dynamic and result-driven Sr. Sales Officer / Area Sales Executive to join our team to help us meet our customer acquisition and revenue growth targets. Looking after uPVC doors & windows Sales in the assigned area along with support in operations.

Preferred candidate profile

Qualification: MBA in Marketing
Must have Two Wheelers with a valid License
Presentable and Fluent in English, Local Language
Proactive approach
Self-driven.

Description:
Purpose of the Job:-

The purpose of the CI role is to ensure that the BHL sites are managed efficiently through proper maintenance of Equipments, management of stakeholders and OPEX control with the objective of driving higher uptime and Optimizing energy costs within company guidelines of Operations and Maintenance & Code of Conduct.







Prepare & monitor preventive maintenance (PM) Schedule; review the technician & vendor performance (Site visit, SLAs etc.).Periodically as per defined Parameters, ensure proper documentation of reports (Field service reports, log books etc.) accurately and Timely, supervise maintenance and working of Equipments like network monitoring systems, PIUs for Alarms to avoid major outage and drive better uptime and guide technicians in their work.
Conduct root cause analysis for breakdowns, analyses past PM data; review alarm status at the time of
Breakdown; guide technician on troubleshooting in order to identify causes of breakdown and ensure timely.
30% Compliance with PM Schedules, Site Audit compliance, Feedback, Higher Uptime, PIU working at Site, Accurate and timely Documentation No. of breakdowns at Site/Outages.



Conduct site visits to monitor site hygiene and safety, carry out periodic audits of log books, diesel filling
sheets and processes at site; supervise key management; monitor repair and maintenance in order to ensure that all assets are maintained in proper conditions and there is no discrepancy around rating of assets or any theft/misuse, No. of site visits, Repair & Maintenance cost.



Control energy OPEX by keeping DG on auto mode and utilizing battery back-up as planned, ensuring no overrated equipment is operated at site; monitor and analyses consumption patterns; identify discrepancies and negative trends; coordinate with technicians to take corrective actions to optimize diesel usage, monitor & document DG/battery/EB run hour and take corrective actions as required, control caretakers/landlords so that they do not interfere with operations & diesel-filling etc.
Liase with EB to ensure bills are generated and paid on time, resolve issues around line layout and bill
generation(especially meter reading), payment to avoid disconnection and any other EB related rectification and repair 20% Timely payment of EB bills No Disconnection/ penalties Diesel consumption



Engage with landlords to effectively deal with issues arising out of diesel theft, interference with equipment, usage and working, take timely feedback about rentals received etc. to pre-empt/minimize site outage due to landlord interference and protect company assets. Liase with community, local administration, police, EB officials etc
Create database of site history and issues to share experiences with team and proactively address
Potential problems. Follow up with internal stakeholders (legal/estate/Operations/ Infra/ Supply/ Purchase/Deployment/ Quality/ etc.) for tracking of equipment, work order, services etc. respond to & escalate unresolved issues to ensure timely closure of work orders and site support as required



Monitor details of equipments and their maintenance schedule, monitor vendor SLAs, cross verify FSRs filled by vendors with technician reports and site visit, coordinate with vendors in case of issues on site for timely service, give feedback to management for levy of penalties on default, resolve any escalated issues/ guide technicians on vendor management in order to ensure that all contractual obligations and SLA clauses are met by vendors and maintain asset lifespan.





B Tech/ Diploma in electrical/ Telecom/Mechanical /Automobile engineering with experience of 2-3 years in the Telecom sector (preferably).
Should possess good working knowledge of electrical equipments & past people management experience is preferred
Good knowledge of MS Office.
Equipment and Maintenance Knowledge Equipment Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of electrical equipment (PIU, SMPS, AC, Battery Bank, power plant, PCM, EB meter, panels etc.) and DG set.
Site Installation Demonstrates adequate knowledge of installation & commissioning procedures for equipment as well as cables, load connections, wires, required voltages etc. in order to ensure proper site setup and working.
Works in partnership with others, is flexible and willing to support others while achieving common goals.
Shows willingness to learn new methods by self-learning and learning by doing.
Identifies new ideas, solutions, in dealing with situations, suggesting new ways of doing things.
Execution Excellence- Strategic Agility Planning & Analysis.
Develop Responsible Teams & Build Collaborative Relationships People Development

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision. Works with property leadership team to identify and address employee and organizational development needs. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills. Conducts needs assessments, designs and develops training programs and facilitates the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision.
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Managing Training Budgets
- Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.
- Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property financial goals.
- Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the ficial performance in areas of responsibility.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (eg, greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment & invitation to return).

- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the ficial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Designation: Assistant Manager Civil

Department: Civil / Project Execution
Industry: Infrastructure / EPC / Construction
Reporting To: Project Manager / Construction Manager
Job Location: Manipur, Noney Market

Job Purpose

To manage and supervise civil construction activities at project sites, ensuring timely execution, quality standards, safety compliance and optimum utilization of manpower, materials and machinery in accordance with project specifications and approved drawings.

Roles & Responsibilities

1. Project Execution & Site Management

Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities at project sites.

Ensure execution of work as per approved drawings, specifications and project schedules.

Coordinate activities related to railway tunnels, hydro tunnels, bridges and other infrastructure projects.

Monitor daily progress and ensure achievement of project milestones.

Identify site-related challenges and take corrective measures.

2. Planning & Coordination

Coordinate with Project Managers, Planning, Billing, Procurement, Stores and other departments.

Prepare daily, weekly and monthly work progress reports.

Ensure timely availability of manpower, materials and equipment.

Monitor project schedules and highlight delays or deviations.

3. Quality Control

Ensure civil works comply with approved quality standards and technical specifications.

Coordinate inspections and quality checks at different stages of construction.

Ensure proper implementation of quality control procedures.

Maintain site records, inspection reports and relevant documentation.

4. Manpower & Resource Management

Allocate and supervise manpower, contractors and subcontractors.

Monitor workforce productivity and site performance.

Ensure optimum utilization of construction materials, machinery and resources.

Maintain discipline and coordination among site teams.

5. Safety & Compliance

Ensure implementation of safety policies and site safety procedures.

Coordinate with the Safety Department to maintain a safe working environment.

Ensure compliance with statutory requirements and company policies.

Report unsafe practices, incidents and site hazards.

6. Documentation & Reporting

Maintain daily progress reports, site measurement records and work registers.

Coordinate with the Billing Department for quantity verification and RA bills.

Maintain records of material consumption and work completion.

Submit periodic project updates to senior management.

Educational Qualification

B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Civil Engineering.

Relevant technical certifications will be an added advantage.

6- 8 years of relevant experience in civil construction / infrastructure / EPC projects.

Experience in railway tunnels, hydro tunnels, underground construction or heavy civil infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Experience in site execution, contractor management and project coordination is essential.

Required Skills & Competencies

Strong knowledge of civil construction methods and engineering drawings.

Project planning and execution skills.

Manpower and contractor management.

Knowledge of quality control and safety standards.

Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

Strong communication and coordination skills.

Proficiency in MS Office and AutoCAD.

Ability to work independently at project locations.

Description:
Job description

Roles and Responsibilities
The organization does fuelling and defueling of aircrafts at various airports throughout the country. The new recruits will be thoroughly trained in all operations and procedures which they will be required to perform in the course of their job and in all actions that are to be taken in the event of an emergency.
Since the activity of fueling & de-fueling is done with the aid of Mobilized machinery/ equipment the person concerned should be able to drive an LMV/HTV vehicle comfortably.

Carry out into plane service including refueling and defueling (Receive refueling instructions from Shift Manager)
Conduct Quality Control checks on the fuel on mobile facilities and necessary documentation
Issue and sign fuel delivery receipts with respect to fuel supplies
Conduct in-situ field tests
Carry Sampling of Jet A-1 and forward the same to laboratories
Perform verification of in-use pressure gauges, hydrometers, etc.
Conduct periodic preventive maintenance on all equipment
Conduct minor maintenance and operations checks/works on the equipment
Coordination with customers/ DGCA Officials/ BSSPL officials in conducting Audits & inspections
Give timely, safe, and courteous into plane services to the airline customers
Sales/ stock accounting to be made at the end of each shift
Tank Lorry/ pipeline receipts of product and related stock accounting
Other Admin/ operations related works

Desired Candidate Profile
Candidates who have completed their B.E. / B. Tech./Diploma may only apply.
Candidates should mandatorily have a Light Motor(LMV), minimum 3 years old driving license.
Candidates with Heavy Vehicle License and/or experience in Service/ Automobile Industry/ ground handling agencies at the airport will be preferred.
Candidate should be a team player and should have the ability to handle a team cordially.
Candidates Should be ready to work in round the clock Shift pattern
Candidates should have good command over English Language
Candidate should have good working knowledge of MS Office
Candidate should be ready to work at PAN India location.

Description:
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
Home
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.
Job Summery
Location:
Manipur, India
Qualification:
Diploma or BE in EEE/ECE
Experience:
0 to 1 Year or willing to work as service technician.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking proactive, target-oriented Admission Officers to drive student recruitment, brand visibility, and institutional outreach across key educational hubs in Northeast India-specifically Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, and Nagaland. The role entails end-to-end admission generation through active lead nurturing, building strong networks with educational consultants and institutions, and executing grassroots brand-building initiatives.


Key Responsibilities
Lead Calling Admissions Generation: Proactively call on prospective student leads, provide comprehensive academic counseling, nurture inquiries through systematic follow-ups, and convert leads into confirmed admissions.
Admission Consultant Network: Identify, onboard, and collaborate closely with education consultants and admission agencies across the designated territory to expand sourcing pipelines and drive partner-led admissions.
Brand Building Strategic Outreach: Formulate and execute field strategies to elevate institutional brand awareness, foster regional goodwill, and establish strong localized networks for ongoing business development.
School Institutional Engagement: Plan and conduct structured visits to schools, junior colleges, coaching centers, and educational hubs to host career seminars, workshops, and interaction sessions.
Stakeholder Relationship Management: Build and nurture productive working partnerships with school principals, academic counselors,community influencers, and key local education facilitators.
Fairs Spot-Admission Drives: Represent the institution at major regional education fairs, youth events, and spot-admission venues across assigned clusters.
Pipeline Management Market Intelligence: Maintain rigorous daily outreach logs, monitor student conversion metrics, and report on regional competitor activities and emerging trends.


Type of Employment
Contractual


Preferred Skills Qualifications
Bachelors degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
1 to 3+ years of proven experience in field outreach, education marketing, student recruitment, or academic counseling.
Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, negotiation, and counseling capabilities in English and Hindi.
Self-motivated with strong closing ability and a track record of meeting or exceeding admission targets.

The university integrates academic learning with practical skill-building to prepare students for employability across diverse sectors. With a mission to bridge the gap between education and workforce needs, Medhavi Skills University emphasizes experiential learning, innovation, and partnerships with industry to deliver future-ready talent.

Description:
Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.
