Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
About the company

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising
the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market economy to
mid-market to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel
over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price
point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.
We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:
Itsy (1000–1500)
Treebo and Treebo Premium (1500–3000)
Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10
across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the companys strategic vision of
democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure
highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing
the operations and enabling sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio
across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect
balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a business development mindset.

Key Responsibilities
1) Operational Excellence Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to
brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service
quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners
to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and
timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery
mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the
assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures
before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed
properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to
achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your
portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the
segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association

What Are We Looking For
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and
business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities; Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
Job Description
Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training & drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

Experience in managing and developing high-performing teams.

Responsible for achieving the targets for Annuity Business through NPS & open market in the assigned region.

Actual sales generated vs plan
Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports
Actual activity vs targeted activity
Accuracy of competitor information;
up to date data
KEY RELATIONSHIPS:
Internal:
Business Heads
MLI HR & Sales Training Team
MLI Operations Team
External:
Top Clients
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS and EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/Master of Business Administration preferably in Sales, Marketing or Finance

Description:
About the Role:

The NRI Relationship Manager will be responsible for nurturing NRI client relationships through continuous client engagements and risk profiling. The NRI RM will be responsible for identification of potential customers and providing them customized solutions as per their requirements. The position entails client management and acquisition with a key focus on expanding the Asset under Management. Key capabilities include working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams to design, collaborate with multiple stakeholders and provide tailored investment products aligned to customer needs. The center of all client engagements will be to ensure superior customer experience.

Key Skills

Client relationship management: Strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain high trust and long term relationship with clients
Communication: Excellent verbal and communication skills for conveying complex concepts clearly
Sales and Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in sales, with the ability to meet and exceed targets. 
Financial Acumen: In-depth understanding of banking products, services, and financial markets. Ability to analyse financial statements and provide sound financial advice. 
Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address needs and challenges. 

Key Responsibilities

Provide financial solutions to the NRI customers while maintaining high service standards
Maintain complete customer profile including the risk profile, demographics and assets in the bank
Maintain relationships with the existing customers through mailers and phone calls and share insights on the fluctuations in interest rates, exchange rates and various product offerings
Enrich relationships and garner higher wallet share through customer engagement activities
Deepen the existing relationships by cross selling the Bank's products and services/ third party investment products
Review the inflows and outflows in the mapped NRI accounts and also proactively track NRI visits to India
Identify potential customers who can be sold tailored products to enhance product penetration
Acquire new customers by converting referral leads generated through existing clients, NRI brokers, stock brokers, expats of shipping companies and overseas branches
Achieve targets as assigned by the organization on a monthly basis
Record and track all engagement activities through the CRM system
Comply with KYC/SEBI rules, regulations, and legislation governing the Bank

Qualifications:

Optimal qualification for success on the job is:
Graduation from a recognized institute
AMFI and NCFM certifications

Role Proficiencies:

For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following:
Knowledge of banking products and services
Ability to manage complex client situations
Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language
Ability to multitask, adaptive and responsive towards evolving customer and organization asks.
Good networking and relationship building skills
AboutCompany: At Axis Bank, we go much beyond addressing the financial needs of our customers. We give them reasons to strengthen their trust in us, at every step. This belief has paid us rich dividends, bringing with it steady growth, rapid expansion and an opportunity for you to propel your career further.

Description:
About the Role:

The Branch Head (BH) is responsible for coordinating and overseeing all branch operations and implementing strategies to increase productivity and performance levels in order to achieve the branchs financial targets. They are responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of the branch and its compliance with the rules and regulations. They should maintain good relations with the key account holders of the Bank to ensure deepening of accounts and thus generating revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure efficient daily operation of a branch, including lending, product sales and customer service in accordance with the banks objectives
Prepare the plan for the growth of branch business in consultation with the Cluster Head
Implement the plan through the Branch team so as to achieve the top line goals
Establish and strengthen relations with key customers (e.g. top 10%) to generate sustained business.
Review daily/ periodic reports (e.g. overdrawn accounts, temporary overdrafts, cash retention limit, office accounts, etc.) and take proactive action to ensure profitable and ethical business.
Ensure audit related deliverables, both internal and external are met as per the prescribed norms
Ensure compliance with due processes and guidelines
Create a performance oriented environment leading to high employee motivation and productivity
Ensure that all staff are adequately trained on the products of the bank, sales processes and various policies of the bank
Resolve, report any disruptions (e.g. strike or local disturbance) and take appropriate action to ensure that the branch operations are run smoothly.
Liaison with the cluster office and other branch offices to ensure the smooth management of operations and the achievement of overall business goals.
Ensure proper upkeep of branch premises and assets including safety and security

Qualifications:

Optimal qualification for success on the job is:
Graduate/ MBA (Marketing) preferred from a recognized institute
NCFM and AMFI Certifications
10-15 years of experience in the BFSI sector

Role Proficiencies:

For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following:
Knowledge of banking products and services
Knowledge of regulatory guidelines and norms
Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language
Ability to manage complex client situations
Ability to manage risk and uncertainty for self and team within a dynamic priority-setting environment
Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines

Position: Territory Manager (TM)
Location: Pondicherry
Territory Coverage: Pondicherry, Cuddalore, Villupuram, and Kallakurichi
CTC: 12 - 13 LPA
Contact : Annamalai - 7305116024
Industry Preference: Mobile Handsets / Consumer Electronics
Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Territory Manager to drive sales growth, channel expansion, and distributor performance across the assigned territory. The candidate should possess strong experience in Channel Distribution Sales within the mobile handset or consumer electronics industry and be capable of managing distributors, retailers, and market development initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Achieve primary and secondary sales targets within the assigned territory.
Manage and develop distributor relationships to ensure business growth.
Increase market share and visibility of products across retail outlets.
Drive channel sales through distributors, wholesalers, and retail partners.
Identify new business opportunities and expand the dealer network.
Monitor competitor activities, pricing, promotions, and market trends.
Ensure effective implementation of sales and trade marketing programs.
Conduct regular market visits and retailer engagement activities.
Manage inventory levels and ensure product availability across channels.
Prepare sales forecasts, reports, and business reviews.
Coordinate with internal teams for product launches and promotional campaigns.
Ensure adherence to company policies and sales processes.
Candidate Profile
Education
Graduate in any discipline.
MBA (Sales/Marketing) preferred.
Experience
5 to 10 years of experience in Sales & Distribution.
Minimum 3 years of experience in Mobile Handset, Smartphone, Telecom, or Consumer Electronics industry.
Proven experience in Channel Distribution Sales management.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Executive Associate Partner to lead our office operations in Axis Max Life Insurance Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in agency channel management and sales, with excellent leadership and communication skills.

Roles and Responsibility


Develop and implement effective business strategies to drive sales growth through the agency channel.

Manage and motivate a team of agents to achieve their sales targets and expand the customer base.

Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including insurance companies and customers.

Analyze market trends and competitor activity to identify new business opportunities.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and launch new products and services.

Proven experience in agency channel management and sales, with a minimum of 5 years of experience.

Strong knowledge of the insurance industry and its regulations.

Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to analyze market trends and develop strategic plans.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

Experience working with cross-functional teams and building strong relationships with stakeholders.

Description:
What you ll do:
Lead and manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of both MV Switchgear portfolios.
"- - Define and execute R&D strategies for component development across MV Switchgear aligned with business objectives and product technology roadmaps.
- Manage resources, budgets, and timelines, ensuring effective prioritization and delivery of component projects across both product lines.
- Supervise VCB design activities for MV Switchgear, including interrupters, linkages, and insulation systems for AIS and GIS environments.
- Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components (mechanical endurance, TRV, dielectric, internal arc, environmental cycling, etc.).
- Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
- Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
- Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
- Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
- Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
- Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
- Collaborate with suppliers and R&D institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
- Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team, fostering expertise in both MV Switchgear component engineering and building succession pipelines.
- Ability to recruit, recognize and cultivate high performers and expose them in order to create a robust second line of management.
- Assessment criteria of subordinates is performance that leads to planned results.
- Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
- Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
- Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
- Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations.
- Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve the optimum cost efficiency.
- Develop, coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible."

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the design, development, and implementation of innovative electrical solutions for automotive applications. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading projects from concept through to completion, ensuring that all engineering deliverables meet quality, reliability, and performance standards.

Title: Zonal Sales Manager
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, paint protection filmCeramic CoatingWindow TintsSun filmsPPF, B2BDealer DevelopmentFranchisee DevelopmentNetwork DevelopmentNetwork ExpansionChannel SalesBusiness ExpansionZonal SalesDistribution Network, About company, Ceramic Pro (a brand under Saboo Automotive Private Limited) is a global leader in advanced nano-ceramic coatings and automotive surface protection solutions.
Description:
We are looking for a highly driven Zonal Sales Manager to drive zonal sales, channel expansion and the development of our premium franchise and dealer network across key national hubs.

This is a field-intensive Individual Contributor (IC) and managerial role, involving direct sales responsibilities and leadership of a team of 2 to 3 members.

Employment Type: Full-Time | Hybrid | 6 Days (MondaySaturday)

1. Mandatory Industry & Product Experience

Candidates must have 5 to 10 years of core and zonal sales experience within South 2 zone comprising of the states Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep, specifically in the Automotive Detailing Industry, with direct sales/channel exposure to the following product categories:
Ceramic Coatings
Graphene Coatings
Paint Protection Films (PPF)
Automotive Window Films / Window Tints / Sun Films

Strict Eligibility Criteria: Experience in general automotive sales, automobile dealerships, car accessories, auto components or unrelated automotive products will NOT be considered relevant unless accompanied by direct sales experience in the automotive detailing products mentioned above.

Candidates without relevant automotive detailing industry experience are requested NOT to apply.

2. Sales & Channel Management
Proven experience in channel/distribution sales, territory management and dealer/franchise network development.
Ability to drive business growth, develop customer relationships and achieve zonal sales targets.
Experience in managing and leading a team of 2 to 3 members while independently driving sales closures.

3. Travel & Territory Requirements
Willingness to travel extensively, with an expected 15 to 20 travel days per month across assigned zonal hubs and territories.
Travel expenses will be covered as per the Company's Travel Allowance Policy.
The role will primarily be territory-focused, involving dealer/customer meetings, business development, relationship management and sales closures.
Occasional visits to Hyderabad may be required for business reviews, meetings, training or other organizational requirements. Wherever possible, such visits will be communicated in advance.

4. Location & Initial Training
Permanent relocation to Hyderabad is NOT required.
Selected candidates must be willing to undergo an initial 15 to 30-day training period at our Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad office.
The training duration will be mutually discussed and agreed upon during the interview process.

5. Language Proficiency
Fluency in English, Hindi and the relevant local language(s) is mandatory.
Strong professional communication skills are essential for interacting with dealers, distributors, customers and stakeholders in the premium automobile segment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Revenue Growth
Own end-to-end sales and revenue generation for Ceramic Pro and Kavaca across the SOUTH 2 Zone: Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep.
Develop sales strategies, identify business opportunities, strengthen existing accounts and drive consistent revenue growth aligned with company objectives.

2. Network Expansion & Development
Identify, evaluate, onboard and develop a strong network of detailing studios, PPF installers, car dealerships and franchise partners.
Expand market presence, improve product penetration and build a sustainable partner network.

3. Partnership & Relationship Management
Build and maintain long-term relationships with franchisees, automotive detailers, workshops, dealerships and car enthusiast communities.
Understand partner requirements, strengthen engagement, resolve operational challenges and maximize sales potential.

4. Product Knowledge & Technical Awareness
Educate partners on the applications, benefits and fundamentals of Ceramic Pro's ceramic coatings and Kavaca's PPF products.
Coordinate with technical teams to ensure adequate product knowledge, application awareness, quality standards and consistent customer experience.

5. Sales Target Achievement
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets through territory planning, partner engagement, lead conversion and business development.
Track sales performance, identify gaps, implement corrective actions and drive revenue growth.

6. Market Intelligence & Business Development
Monitor regional market trends, customer preferences, competitor activities, pricing and emerging business opportunities.
Identify potential franchise locations and sales channels, and recommend strategies to strengthen brand visibility, competitive positioning and market share.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with technical, marketing, operations and customer support teams to facilitate partner onboarding, product training, promotional activities and ongoing business support.
Ensure effective coordination to address partner requirements, resolve business challenges and execute sales and network expansion initiatives.

Company Overview
Saboo Automotive Pvt. Ltd. is a well-established and trusted name in the automotive industry. One of our fastest-growing verticals is the premium vehicle protection segment, where we proudly represent two globally renowned brands:
Ceramic Pro: The global pioneer in advanced nanoceramic surface protection coatings, present in over 55 countries with a network of 2,500+ professionals.
Kavaca: Premium paint protection films (PPF) and advanced window films engineered for superior performance.
With an existing network of 60+ express centers (franchises) across India, we are entering an exciting phase of aggressive expansion.

Learn more at https://ceramicpro.co.in/
AboutCompany:
Ceramic Pro (a brand under Saboo Automotive Private Limited) is a global leader in advanced nano-ceramic coatings and automotive surface protection solutions.

With operations in over 55 countries and a network of 2,500+ detailing professionals, Ceramic Pro offers premium products including ceramic coatings, paint protection films, and window films. The brand is known for innovation, quality, and setting new benchmarks in automotive care.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Design, configure, implement, and maintain healthcare integration solutions connecting company products with Electronic Health Records (EHRs), Patient Administration Systems (PAS), Laboratory Systems, National Platforms, and other healthcare applications.
Develop and support interfaces using healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR, APIs, and related technologies.
Engage directly with stakeholders, hospital ICT teams, clinical users, and third-party suppliers to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
Lead technical integration activities throughout the project lifecycle, from discovery and design through testing, go-live, and post-implementation support.
Collaborate with internal Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Customer Success teams across multiple geographies to ensure successful customer outcomes.
Perform interface testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure data quality, reliability, and interoperability.
Investigate and resolve integration issues relating to connectivity, messaging, data transformation, and workflow processes.
Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including interface specifications, solution designs, test plans, and support procedures.
Support customer upgrades, migrations, and enhancement projects as required.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across T-Pro's implementation and integration practices.
Build strong working relationships with healthcare customers and provide a high standard of technical support and customer service.
Assist with product testing and validation activities where required.
Required Skills and Experience
3+ years experience in systems integration, interface development, or technical implementation roles.
Experience working within healthcare environments or with healthcare software solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR, SMART on FHIR, APIs, and web services.
Experience working with integration engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect) or similar platforms.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL.
Experience troubleshooting technical issues across distributed systems and multiple stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects within agreed timelines.
Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a proactive, customer-focused approach.
Ability and willingness to work primarily in Irish business hours (GMT/BST) to support customer projects, meetings, go-live activities, and operational requirements.
A commitment to continuous improvement and a collaborative approach to working across teams.

Description:
FACTORY HEAD

Role Purpose
The Factory Head will have full responsibility for the Cuddalore (Tamil Nadu) manufacturing facility, leading all plant operations to deliver safe, compliant, cost-effective and quality production from continuous extraction processes. The role owns plant P&L-linked targets, people leadership and statutory compliance, and drives operational excellence and capacity growth.
Key Responsibilities
Plant Operations & Production
Lead end-to-end plant operations: production, maintenance, utilities, quality, warehouse and dispatch.
Ensure uninterrupted, optimised running of continuous extraction processes to meet production plans, yield and throughput targets.
Drive process optimisation, debottlenecking and capacity enhancement; reduce solvent losses, energy and conversion costs.
Quality, Safety, Health & Environment
Build and sustain a strong safety culture; ensure zero-incident operations, with particular attention to solvent handling, pressure systems and process safety.
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, Pollution Control Board norms, hazardous chemicals rules and all applicable statutory and environmental regulations.
Maintain quality systems and ensure adherence to product specifications, customer requirements and audit readiness (ISO and other certifications).
Cost, Budget & Performance
Prepare and manage the plant budget; control manufacturing cost, raw material consumption and inventory.
Track and review KPIs: yield, OEE, downtime, cost per unit, safety and quality metrics.
Projects & Technology
Lead expansion, debottlenecking and new-process commissioning projects from planning through stabilisation.
Work with R&D, technical and corporate teams on scale-up, technology transfer and continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, TPM).
People & Stakeholder Management
Lead, mentor and develop the plant leadership team and workforce; build succession depth.
Maintain cordial industrial relations and engagement with employees, contractors, unions (if any), local authorities and the community.
Coordinate with Corporate, Supply Chain, Sales and Procurement to align plant output with business needs.
Candidate Profile
Education
B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering (mandatory). M.Tech or MBA is an added advantage.
Experience
Around 20 years of experience in chemical process industries, with a significant tenure as Plant Head / Factory Head / Site Head.
Hands-on experience in extraction processes and in continuous process manufacturing.
Industry background restricted to Agrochemicals or Extraction industries. Candidates from other sectors will not be considered.
Skills & Competencies
Strong command of process engineering, plant operations and troubleshooting in continuous extraction.
Proven track record in process safety, statutory compliance and environmental management.
Experience in capex projects, expansion and commissioning.
Cost and P&L orientation, with strong analytical and decision-making ability.
Leadership, team building and stakeholder management at senior level.

Description:
(i) To advise the concerned departments in planning and organizing measures necessary for Safe Work Practices for all employees thus prevent personal injuries.
(ii) To implement Work Permit System across the Plant and create awareness on importance adhering to Safe Work Practices.
(iii) To carry our Safety Audit periodically and evaluate the effectiveness of the action taken or proposed to be taken to prevent personal injuries.
(iv) To ensure availability of personal protective equipment and usage appropriately.
(v) To advise on matters relating to carrying out of plant safety inspections.
(vi) To carry out plant safety inspections in order to observe the physical conditions of work and the work practices and procedures followed by workers and to render advise on measures to be adopted for removing the unsafe physical conditions and preventing unsafe actions by workers.
(vii) To render assistance on matters relating to reporting and investigation of industrial accidents and occupational diseases.
(viii) To encourage reporting of Near Miss and Potential hazard and address all those observations to prevent incident/accident.
(ix) To render assistance for the cases of industrial diseases contracted and in respect of dangerous occurrences reportable under rule 106 of the Pondicherry Factories Rules, 1964.
(x) To render assistance on the maintenance of such records as are necessary relating to accidents, dangerous occurrences and industrial diseases.
(xi) To conduct safety committee meeting periodically and address all such observation.
(xii) To organize in association with the concerned departments, campaigns, competitions, contests and other activities which will develop and maintain the interest of the workers in establishing and maintaining safe conditions of work and procedure; and
(xiii) to design and conduct either independently or in collaboration with the training department, suitable training and educational programs for the prevention of personal injuries and for the propagation of safety awareness.
xiv) To work for obtaining the certification of EOHS, ESG and GreenCo.
The Safety Officer will be responsible for ensuring the safety and health of all employees within the organization. This role includes developing, implementing, and overseeing safety programs and policies to maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. The Safety Officer will conduct regular safety inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential hazards in the workplace. This position requires the development and delivery of safety training programs to enhance employee awareness and compliance. The Safety Officer will also investigate accidents and incidents, prepare reports, and recommend corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

About the Role:
The role involves coordinating activities related to new product introductions within the organization. It emphasizes ensuring that components are ready for production and managing the overall process of product rollouts. The position will require active engagement with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions from development to manufacturing.

About the Team:
You will be working with a dynamic and collaborative cross-functional team consisting of members from engineering, production, and quality assurance. The team is focused on driving innovation and efficiency in product development, ensuring that all members actively contribute their expertise to achieve common goals.

You are Responsible for:
Coordinating all aspects of new product introduction activities and ensuring that all parts are ready on time. Conducting production tryouts and addressing any manufacturing line issues that arise during the process. Securing necessary approvals at each stage of the product rollout and working in collaboration with the cross-functional team to resolve any challenges encountered.

To succeed in this role - you should have the following:
A strong background in electronics products such as Sensors, ECUs, DC-DC converters, Ignition coil and Rectifier and regulator. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving abilities to quickly address manufacturing issues and the capability to adapt to changing project requirements. Experience in coordinating product introduction activities will be highly beneficial.
Job Title: Senior Engineer - NPI

Company Name: India Nippon Electricals


The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating new product introduction activities in the organization. This includes ensuring part readiness for production, conducting production tryouts to validate processes, obtaining necessary approvals, and effectively resolving any manufacturing line issues in collaboration with the cross-functional team (CFT). The role requires a strong focus on detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate new product introduction activities to ensure timely and efficient rollout.
- Ensure all parts are ready for production and meet quality standards.
- Conduct production tryouts to assess the manufacturing process and product functionality.
- Obtain necessary approvals from relevant stakeholders at each phase of the product introduction.
- Work closely with the cross-functional team to resolve any issues that arise on the manufacturing line.
- Monitor and report on the progress of new product initiatives and provide updates as required.
- Collaborate with engineering and quality assurance teams to ensure adherence to specifications.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong knowledge of electronics products, including Sensors, Electronic Control Units (ECU), DC-DC converters, and regulators (RR).
- Excellent project management skills to oversee multiple product introductions simultaneously.
- Strong problem-solving abilities to address manufacturing line issues effectively.
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes and standards in the electronics industry.
- Proficient in using tools for project tracking, data analysis, and reporting.
- Effective communication skills to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Attention to detail and a systematic approach to tasks and responsibilities.

This role is crucial for ensuring that new products are introduced successfully and efficiently into production, maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Firmware Development: Design, write, and test low-level firmware in Embedded C for bare-metal architectures and Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS).
Peripheral Drivers: Develop and maintain low-level drivers and Board Support Packages (BSP) for timers, ADC/DAC, DMA, GPIO, and external Flash/EEPROM.
Wired Protocols: Implement, configure, and troubleshoot wired serial and fieldbus interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN / RS-485.
Hardware Bring-Up: Lab Debugging: Bring up prototype boards and troubleshoot firmware-hardware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
Hardware Collaboration: Review hardware schematics, pinout mappings, and semiconductor datasheets in close collaboration with hardware design engineers.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE):
Experience: Minimum 3 years of hands-on professional experience in embedded firmware development.
Core Programming: Proficient in software development skills (C/C++/Python/...)
Target Microcontrollers: Demonstrated hands-on experience with at least one major MCU family: STMicroelectronics (STM32), NXP (LPC, Kinetis, S32K), or Renesas (RA, RX, RL78).
Communication Interfaces: Direct experience configuring and debugging wired buses: UART/USART, SPI, I2C, and CAN.
OS &Execution Models: Practical understanding of RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS tasks, queues, semaphores, mutexes) and bare-metal superloops.
Lab Instrumentation:
Hands-on experience using in-circuit debuggers (J-Link, ST-Link, E2) and diagnostic
tools (logic analyzers, digital oscilloscopes).
Education:
Bachelor degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE),
Electrical & Electronics Engineering, (EEE),
Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

Description:
Role Description: Customer Service Executive Title: Customer Service Executive Level: Executive Reports to: Sales Manager Section: Sales Vehicle Finance Department: Sales Job Purpose: Customer Service Executive are responsible for managing expectations and developing business solutions for their organizations. They are in charge of creating effective business plans to generate more revenue, increase brand loyalty and improve customer satisfaction
Key Accountabilities:
Lead Generation
Generates lead for deals through interactions with DSE or through channel partners/open market
Customer Relationship Management
End to end customer relationship management including explaining product offerings and resolving sales queries
Cross-selling product offerings to customers
Educates customer with information to build their understanding of issues and capabilities
Goes beyond their day to day work to assist customers in a positive manner
Dealer Relationship Management
Maintaining relationship with assigned dealer
Deal Processing
Collecting all pre-sanction and post sanction documents and performing accurate data entries (RSPM, SAGE etc)
Internal Stakeholder Management
Interact with operations and credit team in order to ensure smooth processing of loan applications
KPIs:
Units Disbursed
st EMI Resolution
RC Collection
Qualification: Any Graduate Experience :
years work experience only in Vehicle Sales
Skills & Competencies
Functional Competencies
Communication Skill
Negotiation Skill
Market/Industry Knowledge
Analytical Skill
Product Knowledge
Behavioural Competencies
Execution Excellence
Customer Centricity
Hiring Parameters:
Should be comfortable to move in the market
Should have learning attitude
Should have bike and license
Should have good knowledge of RTO
Should have product knowledge

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.
Ensure timely closure of Stop Advice Notes.
Monitor and ensure shift-wise NC closure.
Coordinate new product introduction / new product activities with the CFT.
Key Technical Responsibilities
The role also requires strong capability in PCBA manufacturing and final assembly, including single-piece flow and batch production, SOP/CP/PFMEA, quality problem-solving tools, line efficiency improvement, assembly rejection/rework control, defect analysis, FPY improvement, 5S/Kaizen, PCB Gerber data, through-hole and selective soldering, and electronic product manufacturing processes.
As a Senior Engineer in the Manufacturing department, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization, and implementation of manufacturing processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance production efficiency, ensure quality compliance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing principles, tools, and technologies, as well as strong leadership capabilities to mentor junior engineers and coordinate team efforts.

Description:
Position CSM

SCOPE OF WORK
The DTC ( Direct-to-Customer) business aims to leverage 50 million homes opportunity in India by providing simplified services and great and consistent customer experience. Catchment Sales Manager in DTC is a frontline sales role responsible for managing a retail outlet as well as driving broadband business in a dedicated catchment with a team size of 7-12 executives through customer service, market activations, network expansion and stakeholder management.


Manage store operations SOPs, handle customer queries and escalations
Drive postpaid business for catchment through walk-in and walkout models
¢ Online Lead Management from Integrated Lead management system
¢ Ensure network expansion and timely installations by coordinating with market planning, marketing and Home Delivery Org
¢ Performance Tracking and governance large off roll team (7 -12)
¢ Understand market demographics and increase market visibility through BTL activities as per customer segments
¢ Drive broadband business, maintain good relationships with residential and market association to drive rollout and generate business
¢ Increase upselling and cross-selling to new and existing customers in catchment


¢ Build a culture of serve to grow in stores
¢ Ensure robust planning to start strong
¢ Drive discipline in store and cash compliance
¢ Simplify communication for the field executives to understand
¢ Keep team motivated through team connects, rituals and R&R
¢ Building strong relationships with internal as well as external stakeholders and resourcefulness
¢ Partner Management (in LCO towns)


¢ Broadband and network knowledge
¢ Inventory management
¢ Analytical Mindset & basic MS office
¢ Drive for results and Execution Excellence
¢ Ownership
¢ Influencing
¢ Build and maintain relationships

Job Title: Business Development Manager (School Marketing)
Location: nagaland, jammu & kashmir and ladakh
Qualification: Graduate / Master's
Experience: 2-5 years
Industry: Education
About Us
K12 Techno Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading education service provider in India, offering a dynamic suite of academic support, services and solutions to schools. K12 enables schools to leverage its expertise, technology and services to deliver a global approach towards education.
About School
ORCHIDS The International School is a leading chain of progressive schools in India, committed to providing quality education that fosters the holistic development of students.

Key Responsibilities
Business Development: Drive student admissions and achieve enrolment targets for the assigned school/branch through effective lead generation and conversion.
Channel Partnerships: Identify and build relationships with preschools, daycare centres, tuition centres, activity centres, educational consultants and other relevant partners to generate admission leads.
Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with channel partners, prospective parents and local stakeholders to support admission growth.

BTL Marketing: Execute local BTL marketing activities, campaigns and community outreach initiatives to increase school visibility and generate leads.

Events & Lead Generation: Coordinate and participate in school events, open houses and promotional activities to generate quality leads and drive conversions.

Performance Tracking: Track leads, conversions and partner performance and prepare regular reports to support achievement of admission targets.

Preferred Candidate Profile 1-2 years of experience in the education sector is mandatory, preferably in school admissions, education sales, EdTech, preschool, K-12 or related sectors. Prior experience in sales, business development, admissions, marketing or channel partnerships is preferred. Strong relationship-building, communication and convincing skills. Energetic, extroverted and target-driven personality. Ability to build relationships with parents, partners and external stakeholders. Willingness to work in the field and achieve business targets.
Details
Work Mode: Onsite / Field-based (School Branch) Working Days: 6 days per week (with 1 rotational day off) Compensation: Competitive salary + Performance-based incentives

Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
Role & responsibilities


Job Title: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager Mid-Market (B2B Sales)

Company: G4S Secure Solutions India
Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 – 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.
Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.
3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time)
Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM).
Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing.

Who We Are Looking For
Experience & Education:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus).
Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales.
Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience.

Skills & Competencies:
Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers.
Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures.
Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel.
(Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Vadodara
Experience: 3 to 6 Years


About Livspace

Livspace is a leading technology-driven home interiors and renovation platform, providing end-to-end interior solutions for homeowners. We combine design, technology, project execution, and customer experience to deliver beautiful and functional homes.
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced and creative Senior Interior Designer who can independently manage residential interior design projects from concept to final design closure.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in space planning, modular interiors, design concepts, client management, and design software, along with the ability to deliver high-quality designs within defined timelines.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of residential interior design and space planning.
Excellent understanding of modular kitchens, wardrobes, living rooms, bedrooms, and complete home interiors.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max/3D visualization tools, and MS Office.
Strong knowledge of materials, finishes, hardware, lighting, and furniture.
Excellent presentation and client-handling skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand client needs and convert them into practical design solutions.
Strong attention to detail and design aesthetics.
Ability to manage multiple projects and work within deadlines.
Good understanding of design feasibility, execution requirements, and site constraints.
Experience & Qualification

3 to 6 years of relevant experience in residential interior design.
Bachelor's/Diploma degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
Candidates with experience in home interiors, modular interiors, design studios, or interior design companies will be preferred.
Strong portfolio demonstrating residential interior design projects is preferred.

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Kindly Note : We are considering candidates who can relocate to the below mentioned locations

Job Location: Bangalore, Vadodara, Chennai

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale 
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Regional oversight and stewardship of integrity work product metrics for quality, effectiveness, and efficiency in achieving business unit/ manufacturing site objectives.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 3 to 8 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas) 
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas 
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies 
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development 
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards 
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams 
- Excellent communication 
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Project Role: Assoc Lab Project Svcs Mgr

Work Experience: xp- 5+ yrs , Clinical project management+ client/sponsor direct handling exp, life science background.

Work location: Bangalore, Thane, Hyderabad, Kochi, Ahmedabad.

Work Mode: Hybrid

Shift Timings: 5:00 pm -2:00 am(Night Shifts)

Preferred candidate profile
Under general direction, manage all laboratory aspects of assigned clinical trial projects for a Customer or a specific program for a Customer. May have responsibility for a specific Customer, drug program, indication or drug compound. Acts as the main point of contact for the Customer after study award and throughout the entire study lifecycle (startup, maintenance, closeout). Ensures work is conducted in line with standard operating procedures, policies and good practices.
Essential Functions
Study Setup and Planning:
Facilitate seamless study set-up including Protocol and Budget review, leading meetings, develop and implement project plans, milestone, risk, issue and action logs. Partner with Study Setup team to ensure quality database set-up, oversee preparation of protocol specific documentation. Will prepare and present protocol-specific materials at Kick Off and Investigator meetings
May participate in the proposal and business development process including bid defence meetings. Support development of Customer standards
Study Activity Monitoring and Closeout:
Will monitor the Project Management Plan, timelines and deliverables, manage study documentation throughout the Project lifecycle including filing into eTMF, oversee study monitoring and reporting, conduct meetings to meet needs of the Study and Customer requirements
Will manage study scope changes and budget monitor quality of the study and any service-related issues, implementing changes as required. Lessons learnt will be reviewed and shared
Proactive Lines of Communication:
Build and own the Customer relationship, facilitate communication, collaborate with all operational areas within the company
Will serve as an escalation point for study level issues and will coordinate and triage study-specific issues
Coordinates customer survey follow up and ongoing health checks to support Customer relationship building
Meetings, Initiatives and Training Activities:
Will represent the company at Investigator meetings and other internal / external face to face meetings. Will participate in audits and inspections as required
Will provide study training to sites, CRAs and customers
Will establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage on-going project expectations and issues. Will participate in improvement projects as needed
Will assist in training of less experienced staff.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree Life Sciences and/or related field preferred Req
2-3 years of experience in clinical trials/ hospital-funded research, project management or laboratory environment preferred. . Equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Strong interpersonal and customer management skills.
Working understanding of medical and clinical research terminology.
Working knowledge of Project Management processes, the company laboratory processes, and/or equivalent working knowledge of central laboratory operations (kits/supplies, logistics, laboratory operations, specimen storage, data reporting and transfers, site alerts, etc.) preferred.
Demonstrated computer proficiency with Microsoft Office and the company systems, or equivalent experience with similar Centralized Laboratory systems preferred.
Experience in successfully leading Phase I-IV clinical trials preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment while possessing strong organizational skills and a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. In certain geographies where communication in local language is desired (e.g. Japan, China), excellent command of local language with reasonable proficiency in English preferred.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and customers.
