Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Description:
CBRE is seeking a high-performing senior professional to join our Office Leasing practice as Landlord Representation.

In this role, you will lead business development, strategic landlord advisory, and deal execution for major institutional investors, developers, and asset owners. You will be responsible for securing multi-asset leasing mandates across key markets, formulating asset positioning strategies, driving revenue targets, and delivering end-to-end commercial real estate transactions.

Key Responsibilities

Mandate Origination & Business Development: Drive pipeline growth by identifying, pitching, and securing high-value Landlord Representation mandates; expand existing accounts through strategic relationship management.
Strategic Advisory & Commercial Structuring: Formulate asset-specific leasing strategies, pricing models, rent escalation structures, lock-in terms, tenant incentives, and positioning frameworks based on competitor benchmarking and occupier demand.
Portfolio & Governance Management: Oversee multi-asset, multi-city portfolios; establish structured client governance including weekly reporting, leasing dashboards, milestone tracking, and escalation frameworks.
Marketing & Positioning Execution: Conceptualize and drive go-to-market strategies, broker engagement protocols, collateral development, and targeted campaigns in collaboration with branding and design agencies.
Transaction Execution & Deal Closure: Lead high-value lease negotiations, prospect engagement, heads of terms drafting, and transaction closures while advising landlords on risk mitigation.
Stakeholder & Ecosystem Engagement: Build and maintain high-level relationships with institutional landlords, developers, corporate occupiers, investors, and third-party channel partners/agents.
Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate with CBRE Research, Capital Markets, Project Management, and Occupier Services to deliver integrated solutions and cross-sell business lines.
Team Leadership & Performance: Mentor junior and mid-level team members, manage channel partner ecosystems, and ensure alignment with regional revenue and occupancy targets.

Candidate Profile

Experience: 712+ years of relevant commercial real estate experience, with a proven track record in Landlord Representation, agency leasing, and developer account management.
Occupier Relationship: Experience in engaging with regional and international occupiers, institutional landlords, developers, and corporate real estate (CRE) heads.
Portfolio Capabilities: Proven capability to manage multi-asset, portfolio-wide leasing mandates across geographic markets.
Commercial & Financial Acumen: Deep knowledge of commercial office lease structures, financial modeling, market dynamics, and yield optimization strategies.
Leadership & Influence: Strong negotiation, pitch presentation, and client advisory skills with an ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively at senior executive levels.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.

Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Role & responsibilities
roduction Operations
Assist in operating BOPP film production lines, including extrusion, stretching, winding, and slitting processes.
Monitor machine parameters such as temperature, pressure, speed, and tension.
Support machine startup, shutdown, and grade change activities.
Ensure continuous and smooth production during shifts.
Process Monitoring
Record production data and process parameters.
Identify process abnormalities and report them to supervisors.
Assist in troubleshooting production and quality issues.
Quality Control
Conduct routine checks on film properties such as thickness, width, appearance, and winding quality.
Help identify defects including wrinkles, gels, thickness variation, and surface imperfections.
Follow quality standards and operating procedures.
Material Handling
Monitor consumption of polypropylene resin, additives, and masterbatches.
Assist in raw material feeding and inventory coordination.
Minimize material wastage and scrap generation.
Safety & Housekeeping
Follow plant safety rules, PPE requirements, and standard operating procedures.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the production area.
Participate in safety training and improvement initiatives.
Documentation
Maintain shift logs, production reports, and quality records.
Assist in preparing daily production summaries.
Ensure accurate documentation of process changes and observations.

Description:
Position : Associate Director / Director

Department: Tax Restructuring/Succession Planning Team
Designation: Associate Director / Director (10+ years)
Experience: 10+ years post-qualification
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)
Location: Vadodara (Preferred) | Ahmedabad | Mumbai
Role Overview
We are looking for experienced Chartered Accountants to join its Succession Planning Team. The role involves independently leading succession and estate planning assignments for business families and HNIs, covering the complete process from understanding family objectives to structuring, drafting and implementation.
The candidate should have the ability to understand business strategy, ownership structures and long-term family objectives and design appropriate succession structures beyond conventional tax and legal considerations.

Key Responsibilities
1. Succession & Estate Planning
Lead succession and estate planning assignments for operating businesses, promoter shareholdings, immovable properties, investments, artwork and other family wealth.
Analyse family ownership structures, family dynamics, commercial objectives and long-term goals.
Design succession structures involving private trusts, Wills, family arrangements, family charters, gifts, partition arrangements, holding structures and family governance mechanisms.
Advise on ownership succession, management succession, business continuity and next-generation involvement.
2. Transaction & Corporate Structuring
Consider M&A, business restructuring, business sales and other corporate events while designing succession structures.
Handle succession planning for pre-IPO and IPO-bound businesses, considering DRHP disclosures, promoter contributions, lock-in and holding-period requirements.
Advise on listed company succession matters involving SEBI regulations, promoter and promoter-group requirements, disclosures, transfer restrictions and regulatory approvals.
3. Tax, Legal & Regulatory Advisory
Analyse Indian tax, stamp duty, Companies Act, FEMA, SEBI and succession-law implications.
Handle assignments involving NRIs, non-resident trustees or beneficiaries, foreign trusts, overseas foundations and foreign assets.
Assess overseas taxation, succession laws and inheritance or estate-tax implications, coordinating with specialist teams wherever required.
4. Documentation & Implementation
Draft, review and finalise trust deeds, Wills, family arrangements, shareholder agreements, family charters, partition deeds and other legal documents.
Prepare structure notes, technical opinions and presentations explaining available alternatives, risks and recommended structures.
Lead client and family discussions and translate commercial and family objectives into practical legal and tax structures.
Coordinate with internal specialists and external legal, tax, regulatory and valuation advisers for implementation.
5. Team Management
Supervise junior team members.
Review research, documentation, drafting and technical work.
Ensure quality and timely execution of succession planning assignments.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sales & Business Growth
Achieve monthly and annual sales volume, revenue and product mix targets.
Develop the assigned territory through structured customer and market coverage.
Identify growth opportunities within existing and potential customer segments.
Drive sales of priority and premium products in line with business objectives.
2. New Customer Acquisition
Identify and generate new customer leads within the territory.
Prospect, qualify and develop potential industrial accounts.
Initiate product trials, demonstrations, and customer evaluations.
Convert successful trials and opportunities into sustainable business.
3. Existing Customer Development
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers.
Improve customer retention and reduce business churn.
Identify opportunities to increase Share of Wallet.
Develop relationships with key stakeholders across the customer organization, including users, maintenance, purchase, and management.
4. Solution & Value Selling
Understand customer equipment, applications, operating conditions, and business requirements.
Recommend appropriate products and solutions based on identified customer needs.
Communicate product features, customer benefits and value propositions effectively.
Coordinate with technical or service teams where specialized customer support is required.
5. Commercial & Receivables Management
Ensure business is conducted in accordance with agreed commercial and credit terms.
Support timely collection of outstanding payments.
Monitor customer receivables and proactively address potential payment issues.
Ensure quotations, orders, pricing and supplies follow approved company processes.
6. Channel / Distributor Coordination (Where Applicable)
Work closely with distributors, dealers, or channel partners to execute territory plans.
Support distributor sales development and customer coverage.
Provide market inputs to support appropriate inventory planning.
Coordinate product availability and timely supplies to customers.
7. Customer Service
Ensure timely response to customer queries and requirements.
Coordinate resolution of product, service and supply-related complaints.
Follow up on customer issues through satisfactory closure.
Support customers in improving inventory and product management practices.
8. Territory & Market Development
Develop and execute territory-level business development plans.
Maintain an updated customer and prospect pipeline.
Track competitor activities, pricing, products, and market developments.
Provide regular market intelligence and customer insights to the organization.
Identify emerging applications, industries, and opportunities within the territory.
9. Sales Planning & Reporting
Maintain accurate records of customer visits, opportunities, trials, and sales activities.
Prepare periodic sales forecasts and territory plans.
Monitor performance against agreed KPIs.
Maintain and update customer and opportunity information in the applicable CRM or sales management system.
10. Product Knowledge & Capability Development
Maintain sound knowledge of the company's products, applications, and value propositions.
Stay updated on relevant industry trends, equipment, and technologies.
Complete assigned product, technical, sales and compliance training.
Continuously improve consultative and solution-selling capability.
11. Safety, Ethics & Compliance
Conduct all business activities in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations.
Follow company standards relating to Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE).
Maintain high standards of ethical conduct and commercial integrity.
Comply with applicable competition and antitrust requirements and approved commercial processes.

Preferred candidate profile

Graduate, Diploma, or Engineering qualifications.
Technical qualifications are preferred for industrial or technical sales roles.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in industrial sales, B2B sales, industrial operations, technical services, or related fields.
Experience with industrial customers, equipment, lubricants, engineering products, consumables or industrial solutions is an advantage.

Description:
Dear Candidate,
Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Cluster Sales Manager Steel.

Role - Cluster Sales Manager Steel
Experience: 5+ years | Location: Ahmedabad and Bangalore

About the role:
Tata nexarc serves MSMEs with raw material procurement, credit and logistics solutions. We are looking for a self-driven Steel expert to generate demand and build our procurement business from the ground up in a defined cluster.
Key Responsibilities:
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets (number of clients and GMV) for your cluster.
Drive the sales funnel, acquire new SMB customers, and represent Tata nexarc at industry forums.
Work with cross-functional teams to keep operations smooth for acquired customers and to retain them.
Track steel pricing and market conditions, and share pricing and product availability with customers.
Handle lead pickup, negotiations and payment follow-ups.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or BE (Civil/Mechanical); MBA preferred.
5+ years in B2B business development, sales or account management, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
Experience selling steel (fabricated structures, TMT bars, coils or related products).
Experience with CRM, data analytics and BI tools; MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in the regional language.
An entrepreneurial mindset, ideally with startup experience.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.

Skills: Steel Sales, B2B Sales, Business Development, Account Management, TMT Bars, MSME, CRM, Negotiation

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an energetic Business Development Executive to grow AllHomes specifier network in Mumbai - across the AllHome Bharat Platform and its partner brands (ColourCoats, FIAMARC, The Window Factory, Metalia, Shapes, Ledlum, and The House of W). Reporting to the Regional Sales Head - West, you will open doors with architects, interior designers, contractors, and developers, get our brands specified at the design stage, and convert those relationships into project orders across categories. Candidates from any architectural or interior products background are welcome - what matters is that you know how to sell to the design fraternity.

Key Responsibilities
Market Mapping & Lead Generation
Map architects, interior designers, PMCs, contractors, and developers across Mumbai and MMR; build a live project database
Generate qualified leads through daily field visits, referrals, site scouting, and industry networks
Track upcoming residential, hospitality, retail, and office projects in the territory
Specification & Relationship Building
Make studio and site visits to introduce the AllHome portfolio and secure specification at the design stage
Arrange product demos, samples, mock-ups, and experience-centre walkthroughs for design teams
Cross-sell across brands - take more than one AllHome category into the same project, coordinating with the respective brand teams
Sales Support & Order Closure
Support the regional team on proposals, BOQs, and quotations, and follow up from enquiry through tendering to closure
Own conversion of small and mid-ticket opportunities end-to-end; support high-value mandates with the regional team
Coordinate with dealers, supply chain, and accounts on dispatches, deliveries, and post-order support
Process, CRM & Reporting
Maintain daily call reports, funnel stages, and quotation trackers on the CRM with clean data hygiene
Share weekly territory reports - pipeline value, win rates, and competitor activity across categories

Key Requirements
10+ years of B2B sales or business development experience in architectural or interior design products - lighting, hardware & fittings, tiles & surfaces, bathware, modular furniture, flooring, paints, windows, or faades
Demonstrated success in selling to or influencing architects, interior designers, and contractors; an existing Mumbai design and construction network is a strong plus
Working understanding of specification-led selling, BOQs, quotations, and tender basics
Confident communication and presentation skills - able to pitch to design principals and senior consultants
Self-driven, organized, and comfortable with CRM tools and daily field travel across MMR

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or an MBA in Marketing preferred
Exposure to building materials, home improvement, or premium interior product categories is an added advantage
AboutCompany:
About Us
AllHome is a house-of-brands platform for architectural and interior design products, founded by the founding team of PharmEasy and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. We design, manufacture, source, and supply across seven brands Ledlum (architectural lighting & fans), Shapes (hardware & furniture fittings, est. 1992), Colour Coats (wood coatings & paints), House of W (luxury bathware), The Window Factory (high-end windows), Metalia India (metal faades), and Fiamarc (interior & construction products).

AboutCompany:
EcomEx Smart Shipping & Logistics for eCommerce Businesses

EcomEx is a technology-driven logistics aggregation platform designed for eCommerce, D2C brands, marketplaces, and online sellers across India. Multi-Carrier Shipping Platform

Access multiple courier partners from a single dashboard. Compare shipping rates, delivery timelines, and serviceability to select the most efficient carrier for every order.

AI-Powered RTO Reduction

Reduce Return-to-Origin (RTO) losses with intelligent courier recommendations, automated Non-Delivery Report (NDR) management, and proactive shipment recovery tools that help improve successful delivery rates.

Unified Shipping Dashboard

Manage all shipping operations from one platform. Seamlessly integrate with popular eCommerce platforms and marketplaces to automatically sync orders, generate bulk shipping labels, track shipments in real time, and streamline fulfillment processes.

Real-Time Tracking & Visibility

Monitor shipments from pickup to delivery with live tracking updates and centralized order management.

Additional Logistics Solutions

International Shipping

Expand your business globally with reliable cross-border shipping solutions and end-to-end shipment management.

B2B Cargo Shipping

Move bulk consignments efficiently with B2B logistics services starting from 140 for 10kg.

Warehousing & Fulfillment

Optimize inventory storage, order processing, packing, and dispatch through EcomEx's fulfillment and warehousing network.

Pricing

- No registration fee
- No subscription charges
- No platform fees
- Suitable for startups, growing brands, and high-volume sellers

Competitive Shipping Rates

- Domestic shipping starts from 19 for 500g
- B2B cargo shipping starts from 140 for 10kg
- Pay only for the shipments you create

Description:
Position: Senior Engineer - Linux BSP (Solutions)
Key Responsibilities
- Responsible for design and development of real time embedded software/firmware and PC/mobile based software application.
- To Analyse domain specific technical or low level requirement and modification as per end customer or system requirement.
- Participate in High level and low level software design
- Perform software testing including unit, functional and system level requirement including manual and automated
- Performs software requirement to design to coding to testing traceability
- Performs code review following coding guidelines and static code analysis
- Troubleshoots software problems of limited difficulty.
- Documenting technical deliverable like software specifications, design document, code commenting, test cases and test report, Release note etc. throughout the project life cycle.
- Follow defined process for software Development life cycle
- Develops software solutions from established programming languages or by learning new language required for specific project.
Experience / Skills Required
- Strong knowledge for Linux device drivers, Linux Kernel Programming, Linux Kernel Internals, Yocto / Buildroot or any other build systems
- Experience working with development tools like oscilloscope, protocol analyser, emulator, signal generator, JTAG programmer, GIT, SVN, JIRA.
- Experience working with different embedded microprocessor based on Qualcomm, TI, NXP, NVIDIA, Intel or similar
- Experience of Board support package, Device driver and boot loader development/porting.
- Understanding of hardware schematic, datasheet of hardware component to derive firmware/software specific solution
- Strong sense of ownership, passionate, fast learner, analytical mind set, perfection seeker.
Location: IN-UP-Noida, India-World Trade Tower (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Description:
Roles and Responsibilities
Prepare timely and accurate Net Assets Values (NAV) for Mutual Fund and AIF client and other fund accounting output for subsequent review.
Record accurately, and in accordance with the client s policies and procedures, such as accounting records as securities positions, corporate actions related, and journal entries.
Reconcile various accounts, or reviewing reconciliations prepared by others, and promptly researching and correcting any variances.
Identify exceptions and problems affecting accounting records and prices.
Assist, as assigned, in preparing audit schedules, compliance reports, tax returns, financial statements, or other reports.
Research, as assigned, certain securities in Fund portfolios for the purpose of ensuring proper accounting treatment.
Participate in the regular rotation of trade processing and other accounting processes to prepare the fund accounting system for the next day.
Managing corporate actions for the portfolio of Mutual Fund and AIF clients.
Ensure the correct valuation of all asset classes in the portfolio.
Drive Automation in the Fund Accounting system and suggest ways to automate the current process.
Train and guide the team issues faced in the daily process of Fund Accounting
Manage client queries on TDS, NAV and other reporting requirements.
Ensure that all SLA and timelines are met for a client deliverable
Job Specification
Must hold a Bachelor s Degree
Good Business Acumen
Excellent written Oral Communication skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to prepare and analyze comprehensive reports as and when required.
Excellent organizational skills.
Eye for detail with excellent Analytical Skills
Passion to drive Change Management
Ability to work on tight timelines
AboutCompany:
KFin Technologies is a leading financial services provider specializing in investor and issuer solutions across asset management, mutual funds, and corporate registries. The company offers technology-driven platforms for transaction processing, compliance, and customer engagement. With a strong presence in India and global markets, KFin supports asset managers, corporates, and investors with scalable and efficient financial solutions. It is recognized for its innovation, reliability, and role in strengthening the financial ecosystem.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.
AboutCompany: Bajaj Broking is a 100% subsidiary of Bajaj Finance Limited offering wide spectrum of Capital Market Solutions covering Equities, Mutual funds, corporate deposits, Bonds, Insurance & Loans which are been offered to Corporates, High-net-worth individuals, and Families.

Description:
Role: AI Architect.
Location: Ahmedabad, Pune, Indore
Years of Experience: 10-15 years
Notice Period 0-45 Days (Preferred)

Job Description:
A highly skilled and motivated AI Architect for designing, developing, and implementing artificial intelligence (AI) solutions within an organization. The role focuses on leveraging AI & GenAI technologies, machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and predictive analytics to solve complex business problems and drive innovation. The AI Architect bridges the gap between business objectives and technology, ensuring that AI systems align with the organization's strategic goals.

What we're looking for:
Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in AI projects, data science, or a related field.

Skills:
Expertise in AI & GenAI technologies, frameworks, and methodologies (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision).
Proficiency in programming languages like Python or .Net
Strong understanding of cloud technologies (Azure & GCP), APIs, and microservices.
Knowledge of big data processing tools (e.g., Hadoop, Apache Spark).
Hands on experience with tools and platforms used in AI development (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Ollama, DataBricks etc.).
Proven experience in managing technical projects, preferably in AI, machine learning, or data-driven technologies.
Experience in architecting AI Solutions using on premise and Cloud technologies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
Experience with agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) for managing technical projects.
Knowledge of AI ethics and regulatory compliance frameworks.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Proficiency with data engineering and cloud architecture principles.

What you'll be doing:
Define and design AI architecture, frameworks, and strategies to meet organizational needs.
Evaluate and select AI tools, platforms, and frameworks to develop innovative solutions.
Supervise or contribute to the development, training, and optimization of Large as well as small language models.
Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing business processes while ensuring that the solution complies with customers internal policies and guidelines.
Design AI solutions that are scalable, secure, and maintainable over time.
Stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning to propose innovative solutions.
Strong understanding & knowledge about Microsoft Azure cloud and deploying PaaS & SaaS applications on Azure
Strong architecture background especially in AI Solutions and Cloud technologies.
Collaborate with external vendors and partners to leverage their expertise and solutions.
Project Planning and Execution
Define project scope, goals, and deliverables that align with business objectives.
Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and milestones for AI development and deployment initiatives for the inhouse GenAI platform.
Collaborate with business units for ROI determination and identify KPI’s for measuring ROI for each project.
Manage day-to-day project activities to ensure successful execution and timely delivery.
Anticipate potential risks and challenges in AI projects (e.g., data limitations, algorithm performance issues, regulatory concerns).
Proactively implement risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
Ensure that AI projects comply with data privacy regulations, industry standards, and ethical guidelines.
Promote responsible use of AI technologies across all projects.

Team Collaboration and Coordination
Act as the primary liaison between AI research teams, data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Facilitate regular meetings and communications between business units and IT to discuss AI project progress, challenges, and opportunities.
Plan and coordinate work between onsite and offshore AI teams.
Foster collaboration among team members and remove obstacles to productivity.

What We Offer:
Competitive Salary
Work Life Balance
Professional Development
Innovative Work Environment.
Recognition and Rewards

About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our
team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue

Designation - Business Development Manager/Area Sales Manager

Role summary
• Responsible for the strategic management and growth of sales operations within a designated geographic area, with a focus on serving the specific needs and challenges of small and medium-sized business clients

• Team Leadership: Lead, motivate, and manage a sales representatives or executives team to achieve sales targets and performance goals.

Build and maintain strong relationships with SME clients and serve as a point of contact for addressing their business challenges.

• Goal Setting and Reporting: 
Set achievable sales targets and quotas for the sales team and monitor progress. Regularly report on sales metrics and performance to higher management.
• Client Feedback:
Gather feedback from SME clients and relay this information to product or service development teams to improve offerings.
• Training and Development:
Provide training and professional development opportunities for the sales team to keep them updated with best practices and market changes.

(Minimum) Graduate preferably with a degree
Additional Qualification MBA Marketing

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
• Exceptional problem-solving and negotiation abilities.
• Exceptional customer service skills
• Excellent communication and team management skills.
Competencies Required
• Results-driven and adaptable to the unique needs of SME clients in the area.
• Knowledge of SME business environments and challenges.
• Proficiency in CRM and sales software tools.
Why us
• We are a values-driven organization with a perfect work-life balance and one of the industry's lowest attrition.
• We work in a dynamic business organisation where we adapt ourselves to the needs of the business.
• We promote and encourage accountability and entrepreneurial spirit.

Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

Good written and verbal communication skills
Good Analytical skills.
Self-driven and highly ambitious
Results-orientated & the ability to handle pressure
Relationship building & management skills
Understanding of competitor products
Comfortable with tight deadlines

Job Summary:

G4S Security Systems India Pvt. Ltd. (An Allied Universal Company) is looking for a technically qualified, self-driven, and result-oriented Manager Sales to drive business growth across Extra Low Voltage (ELV) systems and our state-of-the-art Security Risk Operation Center (SROC).

In this role, you will manage large and strategic accounts, leveraging strong local market insights and a deep understanding of client needs to deliver tailored enterprise security solutions.

Roles & Responsibilities
Business Development: Acquire new accounts for ELV and SROC solutions across target sectors including IT/ITeS, BFSI, NBFC, Healthcare, Warehousing, Logistics, Retail, Hospitality, Residential, and Critical Infrastructure within the assigned region.
Account Management: Retain and grow existing strategic accounts by addressing client pain points and delivering customized security solutions.
Sales Strategy & Revenue: Execute and contribute to regional sales plans to consistently achieve sales and revenue targets.
Technical & Pre-Sales Leadership: Apply strong technical knowledge of ELV systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion Detection, etc.) and SROC technologies to drive consultative sales and pre-sales efforts.
Local Market Presence: Leverage regional geographical insights to tailor sales strategies and build a strong on-ground presence for client trust and smooth project execution.
CRM & Forecasting (SFDC): Utilize Salesforce (SFDC) to manage sales pipelines, track opportunities, maintain sales hygiene, and provide accurate sales forecasts and metrics.
Market Intelligence: Monitor local market trends, emerging technologies, and competitor activities.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with technical, pre-sales, and project delivery teams to ensure successful project implementation.
Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements.

Desired Candidate Profile (Qualifications & Skills)
Experience: 7 to 12 years of proven B2B sales experience in ELV systems, SROC, and enterprise-class security solutions with a strong track record of managing large accounts.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Electronics. An MBA in Sales/Marketing is preferred.
Domain & Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of ELV systems and modern SROC technologies (AI-enabled surveillance, CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion Detection, etc.).
Tools & Software: Hands-on proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) for pipeline management, along with strong MS Office skills.
Core Competencies: Exceptional communication, negotiation, analytical, and presentation skills with a client-centric mindset.
Personal Attributes: Proactive, strategic thinker who thrives in fast-paced, high-pressure, target-driven environments.

Work Schedule & Travel Requirements
Work Schedule: Full-time role requiring flexibility. Working on the 1st and last Saturday of every month is mandatory.
Work Environment: Combination of office and client site visits.
Travel: Frequent local travel within the assigned city/region, with occasional national travel.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs

Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.

What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Description:
Job Summary
As an Associate in the Financial Institutions Group Client Support team, you will provide consultative support for business intelligence tools and financial data products. You will manage complex client queries, troubleshoot data-related issues, and help clients maximize the value of our platforms.
You will act as a client advocate, working closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Content, and Industry Research teams to improve the client experience, support data quality initiatives, and contribute to product adoption and revenue growth.


The Team
The Financial Institutions Group team provides specialized support to clients across financial institutions, government organizations, universities, and other market participants. With team members across multiple global locations, the team operates in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Associates develop strong subject matter expertise in financial institutions, banking regulations, mortgage data, demographic research, asset-level analytics, and market intelligence workflows.


The Impact
In this role, you will help strengthen client relationships by delivering timely, accurate, and consultative support. Your work will contribute to client retention, product usage, operational efficiency, and overall client satisfaction.
You will also help identify product enhancement opportunities, improve internal workflows, and support initiatives that enhance data quality and platform usability.


Responsibilities
Provide advanced client support via phone, email, and chat, resolving complex and data-intensive inquiries.
Conduct investigative client conversations to understand business needs, troubleshoot issues, and recommend effective solutions.
Act as a client advocate by identifying opportunities to improve product usability, data quality, and presentation.
Build customized Excel models, templates, and workflows using multiple datasets, including data not directly available on the platform.
Support clients in using mapping tools for mortgage, demographic, asset-level, and market analysis.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to test new features, enhancements, and platform updates with a focus on the end-user experience.
Lead proactive outreach campaigns related to product enhancements, new datasets, and workflow improvements.
Conduct client webcasts and product demonstrations, showcasing knowledge of FIG products, data, and industry trends.
Create Salesforce reports and analyze support trends to improve workflows, team procedures, and client outcomes.
Lead assigned projects from planning through execution and identify opportunities for process improvement.
Mentor new hires and junior team members through training, knowledge sharing, and best-practice development.
Collaborate with global teams across Sales, Product, Technology, Content, and Industry Research to resolve complex client issues.


What We're Looking For

Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
Strong understanding of finance, capital markets, banking, or the global economy.
Prior experience in client support, financial data, research, product support, or a related role preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and professionally.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
Strong working knowledge of MS Excel and common business tools.
Ability to learn and apply tools such as SQL, Salesforce, mapping platforms, and financial data products.
Flexibility to work rotational shifts and weekends based on business requirements.

AboutCompany:
EcomEx Smart Shipping & Logistics for eCommerce Businesses

EcomEx is a technology-driven logistics aggregation platform designed for eCommerce, D2C brands, marketplaces, and online sellers across India. By connecting businesses with 25+ leading courier partners, including major national carriers, EcomEx enables seamless shipping management through a single, easy-to-use dashboard.

With coverage across 29,000+ pin codes, EcomEx helps businesses automate their shipping operations, reduce logistics costs, and improve delivery performance. Domestic shipping rates start from just 19 for 500g, making it an affordable and scalable solution for businesses of all sizes.

Key Features

Multi-Carrier Shipping Platform

Access multiple courier partners from a single dashboard. Compare shipping rates, delivery timelines, and serviceability to select the most efficient carrier for every order.

AI-Powered RTO Reduction

Reduce Return-to-Origin (RTO) losses with intelligent courier recommendations, automated Non-Delivery Report (NDR) management, and proactive shipment recovery tools that help improve successful delivery rates.

Unified Shipping Dashboard

Manage all shipping operations from one platform. Seamlessly integrate with popular eCommerce platforms and marketplaces to automatically sync orders, generate bulk shipping labels, track shipments in real time, and streamline fulfillment processes.

Real-Time Tracking & Visibility

Monitor shipments from pickup to delivery with live tracking updates and centralized order management.

Additional Logistics Solutions

International Shipping

Expand your business globally with reliable cross-border shipping solutions and end-to-end shipment management.

B2B Cargo Shipping

Move bulk consignments efficiently with B2B logistics services starting from 140 for 10kg.

Warehousing & Fulfillment

Optimize inventory storage, order processing, packing, and dispatch through EcomEx's fulfillment and warehousing network.

Pricing

Free Platform Access

- No registration fee
- No subscription charges
- No platform fees
- Suitable for startups, growing brands, and high-volume sellers

Competitive Shipping Rates

- Domestic shipping starts from 19 for 500g
- B2B cargo shipping starts from 140 for 10kg
- Pay only for the shipments you create

Description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is currently looking for dynamic personnel in Quality Assurance Team at Insulation Kit Center for the Transformers Business to join their team in Halol, India, where we have two state of the art insulation kit centers. These kit centers are supplying insulation kits for all major large power transformer manufacturers in India as well as Hitachi Factories in HUB APMEA. This team seeks a skilled and motivated individual.
Transformers BU team leverages innovative and diverse technology to transform energy, delivering social, environmental, and economic value and enabling a sustainable energy future for current and future generations. The business's comprehensive portfolio includes power transformers, traction transformers, insulation and components, digital sensors, and transformer services.The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible in accommodating business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & deliver within timelines is essential. The candidate will have excellent communications skills. The job requires travelling to visit customers when needed.


How you'll make an impact
Develops and implements quality assurance strategies and plans to enhance production quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Lead QMS and ensure the system established is fulfilling the ISO requirements such as Functional requirements, Audit requirements, regular review of ISO processes and upgrade them for continuous improvement. Provides internal reporting on quality assurance activities, progress, and outcomes to relevant stakeholders.
Utilizes data-driven insights to drive/contribute decision-making and implement necessary process improvements.
Conducts training programs and workshops to promote quality awareness to develop the skills of manufacturing personnel.
Collaborates with manufacturing teams to address customer-specific quality requirements. Assist in analyzing customer feedback and identifying areas for improvement.
Participate in cross functional projects aimed at improving product quality through manufacturing/assembly process improvements.
Participates in development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions to mitigate process risks. Conducts process audits and inspections to verify compliance with process risk mitigation measures.
Conducts comprehensive risk assessments for manufacturing/assembly processes to identify potential risks by performing activities like failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA).
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Involves in PPAP and supplier development activities and lead with cross functional team till supplier onboarding in line with the global Hitachi guidelines.
Incoming quality inspections and maintaining relevant data and records, supporting suppliers for improving their QMS and rejection rates and processes.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background
Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Mechanical engineering
Relevant experience 6 to 8 years in quality assurance function at any large transformers manufacturing unit.
Experience in Transformer Insulation Kits manufacturing will be an added advantage
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certified

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Description:
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
The opportunity
Hitachi Energy is seeking a Design Engineer for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking Global Product Care team for Insulation and Components. You will play a crucial role in the development and design of innovative products and systems that meet our customer needs and industry standards. You will collaborate with cross functional teams and factories globally to ensure project specifications are met while adhering to industry standards and design best practices. Your expertise in engineering principles and practices will contribute to optimize designs for performance, functionality, and sustainability.
How you will make an impact
You will establish mechanical simulation models for transformer components such as bushings, tap-changers and measurement devices, conduct static/dynamic mechanics, model, seismic, short-circuit impact and thermal-structure coupling simulation analysis.
You will conduct mechanical performance verification in accordance with IEC, IEEE, GB and other international domestic standards, issue professional simulation reports, provide technical support for product RD, type test and mass production.
You will continue to develop internal tools for mechanical evaluations, participate in industrial technical exchanges. Support factories troubleshooting in your domain of expertise and collaborate with global team on evaluation of new RD solution.
You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components.
Evaluate and select appropriate materials and manufacturing processes.
Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality.
Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues
Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team
Your background
Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in RD or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components
Solid mechanical knowledge, ideally in the field of electrical insulators or high-voltage components
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
Should have good understanding of IEC /IEEE/ISO/ASTM Standards.
Experience in the finite element analysis and in the use of the ANSYS software
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world.
Proactive attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership.
Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement.
More about us
At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.
Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:
Private medical care and life insurance
Access to fitness and wellness programs
Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
Company events and teambuilding activities

Description:
Data Analyst - Power Transformer
The opportunity
As a Data AnalyticsEngineer at the Global Engineering Center in Vadodara, India, youll be part of a dynamic team that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration. The Transformers Business Unit is leading the way in energy transformation, delivering advanced solutions across a wide range of industries.
This role offers a unique opportunity to work alongside experts from diverse backgrounds, united by a shared commitment to building a sustainable future.
How youll make an impact
Create a Data Analysis system for various projects and utilize it for business case analysis as well as KPIs.
Automate the KPIs /metrics and analyse data to provide insights in improving the business.
Create reports to show standardization results in designs, and implementation results for various development projects.
Analyze test vs calculated performance data provided by existing data warehouse tools or create new tools/reports to provide insights and also help reduce test failures.
Automate the repeat data analysis often done in excel and local queries so we support the business long term and preserve knowledge.
Analyze Margin and Schedule Slippage and provide data regarding trends and projections
Identify cost saving ideas from data analysis.
Coordinate tasks/activities within a worldwide factories network.
Implementation of new softwares related to engineering
Supporting existing IT systems (e.g. cPLM, SAP) related to engineering
Demonstrated team building skills and networking skills, would be a preference.
Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world.
Living Hitachi Energys core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Your background
Graduate in Mechanical, Electrical or Data Science Engineering having 2-7 years of experience
Experience with Microsoft SQL Mandatory.
Experience with Power BI, Excel Power Automate Mandatory.
Experience with Power Apps SAP skill a plus
Experience performing Data analysis is mandatory.
Experience in cPLM/Windchill will have added advantages.
Knowledge of programming languages like Python, Excel-VBA will have added advantage
Transformer experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Good English written and spoken skills
Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world.
Demonstrated team building skills, would be a preference.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Field Service Project Manager:
Invoicing to customer POs, payment documents, payment follow up receipts etc. for ETC projects supervision invoices, time sheets, counting, clubbing, totaling etc.

.

ISO Audit documentation, timely keeping all the ISO records. Audit points compliance etc. GPG Audit requirements, updates and records maintaining, audit point compliance etc. HUB/Global safety audit points maintenance, audit compliance points circulation to all team follow up regularly within service engineersteam.
Vendors ARC renewal, adding new vendors, CCQQ, finalization with SCM etc.
SAP/Reiwa related works in after sales services. Site visit for safety contractor compliance point of view improvements ensure all safety compliance fully followed at sites.
Safety training details are maintained for all engineers like PICW, Confined space, First AID and keeping records, tracking, push if any to ensure all are timely trained/certified. Support service engineers for their requirements in PPE/stationary/ logos etc. ABRA, Night permission approvals etc.
Welfare programmes, events for service engineers like SERVICE MEETS, Awards, sending Hitachi welfare items to them etc. Hitachi T-shirts, safety shoes etc.

Build and maintain strong customer relationships by understanding customer requirements and providing specialized technical support and solutions.

Demonstrate leadership, collaboration, and a team-oriented approach while maintaining a high level of self-discipline, quality, and accuracy in all deliverables.
Update installed base records to reflect modifications and changes implemented at customer sites.
Develop long-term customer relationships by understanding customer requirements and applicable regulations, responding promptly to issues, and leveraging in-depth technical knowledge to promote product lifecycle management solutions.
Ensure compliance with quality assurance requirements at power plant and substation sites and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Living Hitachi Energys core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Manage the full lifecycle of transformer service projects from initiation through closure.
Develop project plans, including scope, timelines, resource allocation, and budgets.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and third-party contractors.
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, maintaining communication and managing expectations throughout project execution.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues while developing contingency plans.
Monitor project progress, track KPIs, and provide regular updates to management.
Manage project budgets, approve expenditures, and support cost-effective project delivery.
Support post-project reviews and continuous improvement of project management processes and tools within the Services Division.
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines
Your Background
Bachelor''s degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
Strong technical expertise in Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA) and transformer condition assessment, transformer testing, asset management, monitoring, or diagnostics.
Independent use of digital and data insights to manage service performance, teams, customer outcomes, and improvement actions.
Knowledge of transformer failure modes, insulation systems, and condition-based maintenance practices.
Familiarity with industry standards such asIEEE,IEC, andCIGRErelated to transformer diagnostics and monitoring.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into meaningful recommendations.
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in a global, multidisciplinary environment.
Willingness to travel regularly to customer sites, factories, conferences, and technical meetings.
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines.
Experience managing transformer services or heavy industrial equipment projects.
Understanding of transformer technology, maintenance, and repair processes preferred.
Ability to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, sales teams, and cross-functional project participants.
PMP or equivalent project management certification is highly desirable.

Description:
Key missions of the position:
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Service Engineer to join our team, specializing in the Troubleshooting of field complaint and perform installation, commissioning and maintenance of Wabtec systems. The candidate will require to have a strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and Pneumatic circuit diagrams, electronic components, and their working principles. This role requires hands-on experience in trou
bleshooting, repairing of Electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems.
Roles and responsibility are as below:
Production Support: Assist in the Installation, commissioning, Testing of Wabtec system/Product in the rolling stock
Field Complaint Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve the field complaints related to Wabtec systems, providing timely resolution and closure of the complaints. Such requirement relates to troubleshooting the Mechanical, electrical, electronics, pneumatic or maintenance related issues and relacing the defective part to close the complaint within the contractual timelines.
Installation and Commissioning: Support the installation and commissioning of the Wabtec product and performing the required testing. Enabling customer to perform the task in a right manner if needed.
Retrofit, Maintenance and Repairs: Perform retrofit, regular maintenance and emergency repairs on Wabtec products inline with procedure and site requirement.
Reporting and Documentation: Report and record the field interventions performed by himself and associated team. The service engineer would require making a report of the issue and also get the Joint notes or associated document as needed by customer contract. Daily, weekly and Monthly reports to be submitted to manager.
NCR and Failed Part Management: Maintain accountability for Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), maintain consumed spares/Failed part and site spares data. Organizing the dispatch of the defective parts from site to plant in co-ordination with plant team.
Customer Interaction: Communicate effectively with clients to understand their issues and provide clear explanations of the work performed. Follow up the closure of Nonconformity reports and work orders issued.
Travel: Willingness to travel across India to various sites as needed for warranty, installation & Commissioning, retrofit and maintenance service for the customer order.
Safety, Quality, and Compliance: Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our organizations strict safety, quality, and compliance standards.
Education/Training
BE / B.Tech in Mechanical / Electrical & electronics.
Professional Experience:
How many years of professional experience in a specific professional area are required for the position?
Minimum of 6 years of experience in a similar role (Field service) preferably in the transportation railways or Lifts and escalator with good troubleshooting skills
Key Competences (Transversal/Professional)
Reading and interpreting circuit diagrams : Intermediate
Knowledge on software installation : Novice
Troubleshooting & repair:Advanced
problem-solving abilities: Advanced
Microsoft Office:Intermediate
Communication: English speaking and writing:Intermediate
Languages:
English and Hindi & Any other regional language (is an added advantage)
Other Specifications:
Position will be initially in Eastern region, subsequently transferrable anywhere in the country
Ability to learn quickly. Agility to adapt to new environment/ business strategies
Collaborate with multiple departments
Passionate to lead and take initiatives
Good attitude and interpersonal relationship
AboutCompany: Wabtec (Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies Corporation) is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and services for the freight rail, passenger transit, mining, industrial, and marine sectors. The company is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA
