3 to 6 years of video editing and shooting, with brand or business content
A portfolio with reels, shorts and talking-head work for real clients
Strong in Premiere Pro, Final Cut or DaVinci Resolve
Comfortable shooting with a DSLR or mirrorless camera, lights and mics
Fast, reliable turnaround
Takes feedback well
Nice To Have
Motion graphics (After Effects)
Podcast or multi-camera shoots
An eye for thumbnails and covers
Video ads experience
Has guided a junior editor
KPIs
Videos delivered on time
Few revisions needed
Consistent quality and style for each client
Video results like views and watch time improving
Perks
Shoot and edit for a wide range of B2B and B2C brands
Room to shape our in-house video style
Work alongside designers, social media and ads teams

Description:
Job Type
Full-time


Job Summary
You will lead SEO, content and outbound (cold email and LinkedIn) for our B2B and B2C clients in India, the UK, the UAE and the US. You plan the strategy, guide a small team to deliver it, and own the results: more traffic, more leads and more sales meetings for our clients.


What this role is
You have done hands-on SEO and outbound for clients, and you are ready to lead a team.


Responsibilities
Plan the strategy. Build SEO, content, LinkedIn and cold email plans for each client, with clear targets you can stand behind.
Lead the team. Decide who works on what, brief them clearly, review their work and help them improve.
Run SEO. Audits, technical fixes, content plans, link building, and getting clients found in AI search tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity.
Run outbound. Set up and manage cold email and LinkedIn campaigns, from domains and deliverability to lists, copy and replies. Make sure campaigns follow email laws in each country.
Own website projects. Plan pages and content, and see sites through to launch, working with our design and tech teams.
Check quality. Nothing goes to a client until it meets the standard: accurate, well written, every fact checked.
Work with clients. Join client calls, explain results honestly, and say no politely when a request is outside the agreed work.
Report results. Share weekly and monthly progress with our delivery team.


Requirements
4 to 7 years in B2B and B2C marketing, at an agency, a consultancy or an in-house team
Hands-on SEO and content experience
Hands-on cold email or LinkedIn outbound experience
Has managed or guided at least 1 or 2 people (team members or freelancers)
Comfortable talking to clients, including when the news is not good
Clear written English


Nice to Have
Experience with tools like Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead or Lemlist
Worked with international clients (UK, US, UAE)
Worked on website builds or redesigns
Uses AI tools well, and checks their output properly


KPIs
Client work delivered on time and to a high standard
More traffic, leads and meetings for clients, against the targets you set
Fast replies to every lead from outbound campaigns
A team that gets better under you
Clear, on-time progress reports


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, at our Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Procurement &Tendering) to support the implementation of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting procurement and tendering activities for utility projects, ensuring compliance with procurement procedures, facilitating bid management, vendor coordination, contract finalization, and monitoring procurement-related project deliverables.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on procurement and tendering functions. Key responsibilities include:

Procurement & Tendering Support
• Provide day-to-day support to MeECL and its subsidiaries on procurement and tendering activities.
• Review the existing Operating Procedure of MeECL for bidding of services and goods.
• Prepare Request for Proposals (RFPs) for procurement of materials and services as per client requirements and in line with the State and Central Procurement Guidelines.
• Coordinate with the State E Procurement management team.
• Advise the client from time to time on updation of the procurement process and digital intervention in the procurement.

Vendor Identification & Bid Management
• Identify and facilitate the selection of suitable vendors in line with MeECL procurement processes.
• Support release of RFPs and tender documents.
• Coordinate pre-bid meetings and manage clarifications with prospective bidders.
• Facilitate all procurement activities through to contract award.

Bid Evaluation
• Review all the technical and commercial bids.
• Find out the deviations in the submitted bids from the conditions in the RfP.
• Prepare comparative statements, bid evaluation reports, and recommendations for tender finalization.
• Support evaluation committees during the bid assessment process.

MIS & Reporting
• Prepare, review, and validate MIS reports, dashboards, progress reports, and periodic submissions.
• Prepare a database for the bids with details of technical requirement, deviations allowed, revisions in the tenders done if any etc.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure timely reporting to the Client.
• Ensure quality and accuracy of reports, presentations, and Minutes of Meetings (MoMs).

Stakeholder Coordination
• Coordinate with officials MeECL, contractors, vendors, and internal consulting teams.
• Monitor procurement milestones and facilitate timely resolution of issues.

Additional Responsibilities
• Prepare a Standard Operating Procedures with timelines for each type of procurement and ensure compliance of the approved procedure.
• Support any other procurement and tendering activities assigned by the Client.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and procurement best practices within the project.

C. Required skill set:
• Strong understanding of procurement and tendering processes in the Power Sector including, distribution, generation and transmission.
• Experience in preparation of RFPs, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract award processes.
• Knowledge of public procurement procedures and utility procurement practices.
• Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
• Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
• BE/ B. Tech or MBA (Candidates with B.Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
• Atleast 5 Years experience in Procurement, Tendering & Contracts Management in a Power Utility / Discom company or Power utility consultancy company.

E. Location:
• Shillong, Meghalaya.
• The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
• We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Job Summary

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Description:
Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion
Shillong, Meghalaya
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion to drive financial access, literacy, and empowerment initiatives for rural communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Key Responsibilities
Bank Linkage & Loan Facilitation: Facilitate SHG-bank linkages, streamline loan application processing, and monitor sanctioning, disbursement, and repayment.
Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise closely with local banks, Bank Sakhis, and Business Correspondents (BCs) to improve financial delivery networks.
Financial Literacy & Awareness: Conduct structured awareness programs on financial management and promote key government social security schemes (PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY).
Enterprise Support & Insurance: Assist SHG members in securing financial access for local enterprises, and support insurance enrollment and claim settlements.
Data & Community Management: Organize bank coordination meetings, foster community engagement, and maintain detailed data and reporting on financial inclusion metrics.
Key Qualifications & Eligibility
Education: Post-graduate degree or diploma in Science, Business Management (Finance), or Commerce from a recognized university or institution.
Age Limit: Below 30 years.
Experience: 1-2 years of experience in Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation programs.
1-2 years of experience working in Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), or Microfinance Institutions (MFIs).
Technical Skills: Proficient in computer applications, with strong knowledge of MS Office and Google Sheets.

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics

Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.

Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.

Graduate in any discipline.

Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.

Description:
Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Job Summary:
Pharmacist will be responsible for preparing and administering appropriate pharmaceuticals to patients. She/he achieves this by executing a physician s order. The job entails a high level of responsibility and knowledge. A pharmacist does not merely hand out prescribed medicine; he/she has the expertise and willingness to assist people and provide them with information and solutions.

1. Duties and Responsibilities:

The key responsibilities of this position are as given below:
Organize the pharmacy in an efficient manner to make the identification of products easier and faster;
Maintain full control over delivering, stocking and labeling medicine and other products and monitor their condition to prevent expiring or deterioration;
Review and execute physician s prescriptions checking their appropriateness and legality;
Listen carefully to customers to interpret their needs and issues and offer information and advice;
Provide assistance other medical services such as injections, blood pressure/ temperature measurements etc.;
Keep records of patient history and of all activities regarding heavy medication;
Comply with all applicable legal rules, regulations and procedures;
Liaoning with other healthcare personnel / medical officers to supply and receive relevant information about the background and progress of patients, as well as to refer order for progress to be made.
Assist the coordinator health/ medical officers during routine mobile OPD / health camps or in time of emergency.
Undertake any other duties assigned time to by Coordinating Office management

Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)

Community mobilization and communication skills

Job Summary
Recruitment Associate. Location: Meghalaya, India. Contract type: Fixed term consulting contract up to . Negotiable as per experience.


Role Overview
The Recruitment Associate will assist the Recruitment Manager in managing recruitment processes. This role involves coordinating candidate interviews, assisting with onboarding processes, maintaining recruitment databases and ensuring smooth recruitment operations. The Associate will also provide administrative support to the HR team as needed.


What will you do as the Recruitment Associate

Supporting a Positive Work Environment
Assist in implementing practices that support a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace.
Help coordinate staff recognition efforts and team engagement activities.
Support efforts to gather employee feedback and share insights with the HR team for cultural improvements.


Recruitment & Onboarding Support
Assist with posting job openings, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and preparing interview documentation.
Coordinate reference checks and support onboarding logistics for new hires.
Maintain accurate records of recruitment and onboarding processes.


Employee Relations Assistance
Support the HR Team in handling employee concerns and maintaining clear documentation.
Help coordinate and document discussions related to workplace issues or grievances.
Promote open communication by helping to manage feedback tools and suggestion channels.


Performance Management Support
Assist in coordinating the performance appraisal cycle, including scheduling and document preparation.
Help track the completion of employee KRAs and appraisals.
Provide administrative support for performance discussions and performance improvement processes.


Training & Development Coordination
Support the planning and logistics of training sessions (e.g., booking venues, managing attendance, sharing materials).
Collect participant feedback and compile summaries for review.
Assist in the development of basic training content related to values, inclusion, and workplace conduct.


HR Administration
Prepare and maintain HR documents such as offer letters, contracts, and confirmation letters.
Keep employee records up to date, including attendance, leave, and personnel files.
Assist in the administration of employee benefits, leave tracking, and policy communication.


Who are we looking for
Experience: 2-3 years of experience in recruitment or HR support roles.
Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related fields.
Strong organizational, communication and administrative skills.
Experience in recruitment processes, interview scheduling and candidate coordination.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Project Identification and Scope
Build and maintain a pipeline of stores, markets or business areas that may require focused project intervention.

2. Business Diagnosis and Opportunity Assessment
Analyse sales, target achievement, market potential, competitor performance, product mix, stock availability, promoter productivity, display, finance penetration and retailer engagement when relevant to the project.
Conduct field visits and structured discussions with store owners, promoters, TLs, Sales, Retail and other teams to identify the actual causes of weak performance.

3. Project Planning
Prepare practical 30-day, 60-day or 90-day project plans with targets, activities, owners, deadlines, resources and expected results.
Recommend project-specific interventions involving manpower, stock, product mix, display, training, finance, retailer schemes, local activation, relationship improvement or process correction.

4. Retailer Negotiation and Stakeholder Alignment
Present the business opportunity and proposed solution to store owners, distributors and other external partners.
Negotiate measurable commitments related to sales, stock investment, display space, promoter placement, branding, finance, local activity or other project requirements.

5. Cross Functional Execution
Coordinate with Sales, Retail, GTM, Marketing, Branding, Training, Affordability, Supply Chain and branch teams according to the needs of each project.

6. Fortress Store and Core Store Projects
Support the opening, ramp-up, performance improvement and turnaround of Fortress Stores.
Lead structured breakthrough projects for high-potential core outlets where vivo has a meaningful opportunity to improve sales or share.

7. Monitoring and Project Closure
Maintain a project tracker covering the baseline, target, actions, owners, deadlines, risks, support required and current status.
Review performance weekly and distinguish completed activity from actual business impact.
Provide concise management updates focused on results, major risks, unresolved dependencies and decisions required.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate degree in Business, Marketing, Retail Management or a related discipline. An MBA is preferred but not essential.
Four to seven years of relevant experience in smartphones, consumer electronics, telecom, FMCG, retail operations, channel development or field-project execution.
At least two years of experience independently managing store improvement, channel development, territory improvement or another measurable business project.
Evidence of completing projects with a clear baseline, personal actions and measurable before-and-after results.
Experience working with retailers, distributors, promoters or field-sales teams.
Ability to analyse store-level or territory-level data and convert findings into practical actions.
Strong communication, retailer negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple departments even when the project owners do not report directly to the role holder.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including project trackers and business-review presentations.
Willingness to travel frequently and spend significant time in the market.
Good English and Hindi communication. Knowledge of Assamese or other Northeast Indian languages will be an advantage.

Description:
Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

.

Required Skills
government liaison Decision-Making Field Readiness field operations Teamwork Problem-Solving Communication Skills

Description:
Role & responsibilities :-
Hospital Revenue Cycle Management (RCM): Practical exposure to IPD and OPD billing cycles, multi-tier tariff plans, cash/credit billing audits, and plug of revenue leakages.
TPA & Corporate Insurance Claims: Experience with pre-authorizations, query resolution, handling rejection/deduction patterns, and liaison with insurers/TPAs for outstanding claim realization.
Doctor Payouts & Departmental Accounting: Proficiency in calculating consultant honorariums, fee shares, OPD/IPD procedure split models, and tracking physician revenue contributions.
Cash Flow & Counter Oversight: Supervision of daily collection summaries across billing counters, POS settlements, daily bank reconciliations, and cash limit audits.
Accounts Payable (AP) & Vendor Ledgers: Verification and clearance of pharmacy, surgical consumables, biomedical equipment vendors, and medical supply invoices with ledger scrutiny.
Budgeting & MIS Assistance: Assisting senior management with OPEX/CAPEX variance tracking, EBITDA drivers, ARPOB metrics, bed turnover data, and monthly departmental packs.


Preferred candidate profile Must have the below Knowledge:-
Hospital Information System (HIS): Working knowledge of specialized hospital ERP modules (e.g., SAP, TallyPrime, Oracle, Meditech, or custom HIS).
Advanced Microsoft Excel: Strong skills in VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, handling large hospital billing data dumps.
Statutory Compliance: Thorough understanding of TDS deductions (specifically 194J on doctor fees, 194C on contractor invoices) and GST applicability in healthcare.
Audit Support: Prior experience in assisting internal audits, statutory financial audits, and insurance regulatory reconciliations

Job Title: Apprentice Hiring for 2026- 2027
Location: Bangalore
About the programme:
This 12-month apprenticeship, under India's National Apprenticeship Training Scheme, provides valuable on-the-job training; Please note, there is no obligation for permanent employment with Deutsche Bank Group upon completion of the Apprenticeship Training tenure.
Role Description
About DWS
DWS, publicly listed asset management division of Deutsche Bank, is one of the world's leading investment management organizations with assets under management. DWS provides flexible products and solutions to a wide range of investment opportunities across all asset classes from pooled funds to highly customized portfolios for a wide range of investors and offers individuals and institutions traditional and alternative investments across all major asset classes.
About the team
The Platform Sustainability function is a cross-divisional function, linked to both the investment and product divisions of DWS Group. It coordinates and steers the business implementation of DWSs Sustainability Strategy as well as the sustainability related regulatory requirements in the product and investment areas. Its focus is on the liquid product range of DWS Group and the product-related sustainability activities for alternative investments. Its activities comprise the development of sustainability-related frameworks as well as their integration into engagement processes, ESG integration processes and product-specific investment policies.
The Product Infrastructure & Standards team is part of Platform Sustainability within the Product Division.
The team is responsible for developing the sustainability-related product infrastructure including data management and contributing to product disclosure processes.
In this responsibility, the team plays a key role in designing efficient processes for a technology-driven future. In addition, the team actively contributes to navigating regulatory developments that are shaping the industry. To achieve this, it works closely together with colleagues across the Product Division and other relevant sustainability experts at DWS globally.
Your key responsibilities
As a Product Sustainability Analyst of the Product Sustainabilitys Infrastructure & Standards Team, you will be jointly responsible for
Analysing and conceptualizing the sustainability-related data and process flow from product development to the monitoring of investment guidelines compliance
Coordinating and overseeing the implementation of systematic changes in close collaboration with business and infrastructure teams
Developing a workflow tool for product launches
Automating existing processes related to fund disclosures
Supporting development of sustainability-related product infrastructure with exposure to sustainability specialists and close
collaboration with sustainability investment experts
Your skills and experience
Essential skills:
University degree in Commerce/Science or similar
Candidates with full time exp refrain from applying
Candidates with Master degree refrain from applying
Candidates holding PF/UAN no. not eligible to apply
Fresh graduates only can apply
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) for documentation purposes

Job Title: Relationship Manager Location: Pune
Position Type : Fulltime
Work Mode : Work from Office

Employee Value Proposition:
Employee health insurance of Rs 1 lakh per year. Premium is paid by the company.
Employees get free lunch and snacks.
Monthly reward and recognition to outstanding performers.
Employees get promotions every 6 months based on performance.
Outstanding performers can qualify for promotion every quarter. So an employee can get promoted up to 4 times in a year. Every promotion results in a change of designation and increase of salary .
Accelerated career growth of employees and one can become UH in another 3 months time)
Regular team parties and Annual Day outing for all employees.

Qualication / Education and other Requirements:
Education- Any Undergraduate (BBA,B.Tech, B,A) etc.
Excellent verbal and written communication.
Good Interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability.
Decision making skills.
Language required: English & Hindi or English, Hindi & 1 South Regional Language (Kan, Tel, Tam)
Procient in MS-Office (Excel, Word).
Should be exible for day shift- (9-hour of login between 8 AM - 10 PM).

About the company
NoBroker.com is the world's largest C2C marketplace in online real estate. With a cumulative 85 lakh customers, it has grown 10X in the last one year. With three rounds of funding of $151 mn, it is well funded by key US, Indian, Japanese & Korean investors like General Atlantic,Tiger Global SAIF Partners, KTB ventures and BeeNext. It is headquartered in Bangalore with a team of 4000+ employees.
Role and Responsibility Relationship Manager
Act as relationship manager for the Paid customers of NoBroker.
Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication.
Identify and assess customers' needs to effectively upsell or cross-sell relevant products or services.
Service customer in nding the right tenant / house as per the requirement of the customer.
Dial outbound and attend inbound calls of customers and leads.
Use internal tools and methods to provide the best possible service to the customer.
Negotiate with leads on behalf of customers.
Keep customers up-to-date on the progress of his account.
Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
Go extra mile to provide excellent customer service

About Training- Training will be provided for initial few days for an employee to understand the end to end process.

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated individual to join our team as a Premium Retail Sales Executive in Bangalore. Your Role

As a Data Analytics Architect, you will be responsible for designing end-to-end data architectures, establishing data standards and frameworks, and enabling business-driven analytics solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and governance functions to deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality data ecosystems.



In this role, you will:

Define, design, and lead the implementation of end-to-end scalable data architectures from concept through production deployment.

Collaborate with compliance, privacy, risk, security, platform, and operations teams to incorporate all business and regulatory requirements into data solutions.
Develop data strategies, architectures, and policies covering:
Data Governance
Master Data Management (MDM)
Metadata Management
Data Quality
Data Security and Privacy
Provide technical leadership and act as a trusted advisor for data-related initiatives across programs.
Define and establish scalable, reusable standards, frameworks, and best practices for data architecture and analytics.
Lead data analysis activities including data profiling, transformation design, integration requirements, and quality assessments.

Design visual analytics and dashboards that enable effective decision-making across stakeholders.
Apply statistical and analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and uncover business value.
Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, scientists, and platform teams to implement scalable analytics solutions.
Drive quality, governance, and delivery excellence across data and analytics initiatives.
Manage and optimize large-scale structured and unstructured datasets for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.

Mandatory Skills
12+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Analytics, and Enterprise Data Management.
Strong expertise in Data Architecture and Data Modeling techniques.
Hands-on experience in Data Engineering and Data Integration (ETL/ELT).
Deep understanding of Data Warehousing and Lakehouse Architecture.
Experience implementing Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management frameworks.
Strong capabilities in Data Analysis, Data Profiling, and Data Transformation.
Experience designing Business Intelligence and Data Visualization solutions.
Expertise in Statistical Analysis, Predictive Analytics, and Data Mining methodologies.
Experience working with Big Data platforms and distributed data processing frameworks.
Proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python and PySpark.
Strong understanding of Cloud Data Platforms and modern analytics architectures.
Experience in Data Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Regulatory requirements.
Knowledge of DataOps, CI/CD practices, and automation frameworks.
Strong stakeholder management, consulting, and technical leadership skills

Description:
Job Summary
Cisco's Global Lab Solutions (GLS) team is seeking a highly motivated and skilled Lab Systems Operations Engineer to manage cutting-edge liquid cooling rack infrastructure, operate precision thermal/environmental chambers, and maintain network lab sustainability metrics across our Bangalore engineering facilities. As Cisco accelerates its next-generation Silicon One ASICs, AI/ML compute clusters, and high-density routing platforms, you will work at the forefront of hardware lab innovation - ensuring high-density equipment reliability, optimizing lab Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), reclaiming stranded power capacity, and driving sustainable operations.


Key Responsibilities
Liquid Cooling Infrastructure: Manage, monitor, and maintain in-rack and row-based Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), secondary fluid loops, manifold distribution systems, and quick-disconnect (QDC) couplings powering high-density AI/ML compute racks.
Fluid Chemistry Maintenance: Perform routine fluid sampling, pH testing, glycol concentration analysis, biocide/corrosion inhibitor monitoring, and particulate filtration servicing.
Thermal Chamber Operations: Oversee the day-to-day operation, test scheduling, and preventative maintenance of environmental test chambers, executing precision thermal stress profiles (-40 C to +85 C).
Instrumentation Calibration: Deploy and calibrate sensors, thermocouples (T/K-type), RTDs, pressure transducers, and thermal imaging cameras to capture component-level thermal gradients.
Sustainability Telemetry Monitoring: Leverage Smart PDUs, LIMIT portal, and Command Center telemetry to monitor real-time rack power draw (kW), optimize lab PUE, and proactively reclaim stranded electrical and cooling capacity.
Leak Detection Safety Systems: Maintain continuous surveillance over liquid leak detection sensor ropes, optical sensors, automated shut-off solenoid valves, and emergency containment protocols.
Collaborative Engagement: Collaborate with BU Engineering Tech Leads, thermal OEMs (nVent, Motivair, CoolIT), and Workplace Resources (WPR Facilities) on facility integration, chilled water feeds, and lab placement.
Documentation Best Practices: Develop and maintain comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), chemical Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 environmental standards.


Who You Are
Academic education in Mechanical Engineering, Biotechnology / Chemical Engineering, Electrical Electronics, Thermal Engineering, Instrumentation, or related disciplines (B.S./B.E./B.Tech or M.S./M.Tech with a minimum average GPA of 3.5 out of 4 or 8.5 out of 10)
Experience up to 3 years in laboratory operations, thermal/environmental testing, fluid dynamics/cooling systems, data center facilities, or precision analytical operations is desired but not essential
Academic knowledge of Thermodynamics, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics, Closed-Loop Hydraulics, and Thermal Resistance
Working knowledge or familiarity with liquid cooling systems (Direct-to-Chip cold plates, CDUs, manifolds, dielectric/water-glycol fluids)
Familiarity with environmental test chambers, temperature profiling, thermocouple instrumentation, and data logging
Exposure to lab telemetry platforms (Smart PDUs, DCIM, LIMIT portal) or basic scripting (Python, Shell, MATLAB) is a plus.
Good debugging skills, good problem-solving, and analytical skills
Basic understanding of how laboratory equipment and electro-mechanical hardware operate
Positive energy, motivation to learn, and ability to work as part of a team
High level of work autonomy, disciplined safety adherence, and sense of responsibility
Desire for improvement of current skillset in a fast-paced working environment
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Education: B.C.A. in Any Specialization, B.Tech / B.E. in Any Specialization, B.Sc in Any Specialization
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, BlogsVideo EditingGraphic DesigningWordpressContent Creation, Social Media MarketingGoogle AdWordsSEOGoogle AnalyticsGoogle AdsWebsite ManagementWebsite OptimizationWeb DevelopmentWordpress DevelopmentCanvaPoster Design, About company, About Nexus Infosys
Description:
Role & responsibilities
We are looking for enthusiastic and creative Digital Marketing Executives to join Nexus Infosys. The role involves managing digital content, video editing, graphic designing, website management, SEO and online advertising.

1. Video Editing, Graphic Designing & Content Creation
Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and promotional videos.
Create attractive social media posts, banners, posters and marketing creatives.
Develop engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
Create product videos, product demonstrations and promotional content.
Assist with product photography and video shoots.
Create marketing content for leading IT brands and our BenQ Experience Centre.
2. Website Management & E-commerce
Manage and maintain the company's WordPress and WooCommerce website.
Upload new products and update product descriptions, images and pricing.
Manage website pages, banners, categories and product listings.
Assist with website updates, improvements and user experience optimisation.
Ensure product information and website content are regularly updated.
3. SEO & Google Ads
Assist in managing Google Ads campaigns, including Search and Performance Max.
Perform keyword research and competitor analysis.
Work on on-page SEO, meta titles, meta descriptions and blog publishing.
Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
Assist with Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
Analyse digital marketing performance and prepare reports.


Preferred candidate profile
Freshers and candidates with 01 year of experience are welcome.
Basic knowledge of Canva, Photoshop or other graphic designing tools.
Knowledge of video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Filmora or CapCut.
Basic understanding of WordPress and WooCommerce.
Interest in SEO, Google Ads and digital marketing.
Good communication, writing and creative skills.
Knowledge of social media platforms and current digital trends.
Willingness to learn, take initiative and handle multiple responsibilities.


Perks and benefits
Opportunity to work with leading technology brands.
Hands-on experience in e-commerce and digital marketing.
Practical exposure to Google Ads, SEO and website management.
Creative freedom and opportunities to develop new ideas.
Learning, skill development and career growth opportunities.
Friendly and collaborative working environment.
AboutCompany:
About Nexus Infosys

Nexus Infosys is an established LED Monitor Distributor and IT Hardware Solutions company with over 15 years of industry experience. We specialise in the distribution and marketing of LED monitors, display solutions, computer peripherals and IT hardware from leading global brands including BenQ, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Acer, ASUS, MSI, LG, Samsung and ViewSonic.

We are an authorised regional distribution partner for multiple leading monitor brands and also operate the BenQ Experience Centre in Mumbai, showcasing the latest monitor and display technologies.

We are focused on expanding our e-commerce business through our website, www.mynexusinfosys.com, and strengthening our digital presence across social media platforms.

Our objective is to increase online sales, drive website traffic, improve search engine visibility, build brand awareness and generate quality customer enquiries through effective digital marketing and content creation.

At Nexus Infosys, we encourage creativity, innovation and continuous learning. Team members get the opportunity to work on real-world e-commerce projects, digital marketing campaigns, website management and creative content for leading technology brands.

Join Nexus Infosys and be part of our digital growth journey!
CompanyAddress: Ground Floor, Shop No.2, Ganesh Niwas, Tara Temple Lane, Lamington, Road, Grant Road East, Mumbai City, Maharashtra, 400007, MUMBAI, Maharashtra, India

Description:
First impressions are everything.
When guests arrive at our hotels, we want that impression to be memorable.
The same goes for departures.
When guests leave, we want them to go with a smile and a feeling that we were there for them throughout their stay.
We want to build an experience that is memorable and unique from start to finish.
Our Guest Arrival Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their arrival and departure experiences.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Arrival Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Arrival Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing more than 75 pounds with assistance.
.
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Arrival Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Position: CMA Intern - AI & Automation
Qualification: CMA Intermediate Both Groups Cleared

Role Overview
We are looking for a tech-savvy CMA Intern with a strong understanding of finance and accounting, along with an interest in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation. The candidate will work on leveraging AI tools and automation technologies to streamline finance processes and improve efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
Identify and automate repetitive finance and accounting activities.
Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot for finance-related tasks.
Automate MIS reporting, reconciliations, and financial data analysis.
Develop dashboards and reports using Excel and Power BI.
Explore AI applications in budgeting, costing, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
Identify opportunities for process improvement through automation.

Eligibility & Skills
Must have cleared both groups of CMA Intermediate.
Strong understanding of accounting, costing, and financial management.
Good knowledge of MS Excel.
Familiarity with AI tools and Power BI is preferred.
Knowledge of Python, VBA, SQL, or Power Automate will be an added advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and learning abilities.

What We Offer
Hands-on exposure to AI and automation in finance.
Opportunity to work on real-world finance transformation projects.
Practical experience with emerging AI and automation technologies.

Interested candidates are invited to attend the walk-in interview with their updated resumes.We look forward to meeting you!

Be a part of the future of finance Combining CMA with AI & Automation!

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Encourage, recruit, register, and schedule guests to participate in recreation activities. Promote a fun and relaxing atmosphere for guests. Provide information to guests about available recreation facilities and activities. Promote the rules and regulations of the recreation facility intended for the safety and welfare of guests and members. Observe activity in the recreational facility and respond appropriately in accordance with local operating procedure in the event of an emergency. Be aware of possible situations where guests are not able to safely participate in an activity and inform supervisor/manager. Clean and maintain recreational equipment and supplies.

Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation.

Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Process payments for rental equipment, recreation activities, facility rentals, or retail sales. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.

Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 50 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: CPR Certification
First Aid Certification
Recreation Equipment
Any certification or training required by local and state agencies.
