Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
jaro education
Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.
Page 1 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!
Page 5 of 5

Job Summary
Associate Consultant - Risk - Internal Audit


The Opportunity
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract.
You will be responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of governance, risk compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance.


Key Responsibilities
Execution on client engagement - Ensure quality delivery as per client requirements.
Review of working papers and client folders. Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Understand business industry issues / trends. Identify areas requiring improvement in the clients business processes to enable preparation of recommendations.
Handling data analytics - Access, ACL etc.
Ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality risk management procedures.
Awareness of internal auditing standards issued by IIA and ICAI.
Demonstrate an application solution-based approach to problem solving technique.
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development.
Develop strong working relationships with client (process owner/functional heads).
Attention to detail and mentor young interns and analysts within the practice.
Contribute to knowledge management sessions within the practice.
Bring and utilize extensive knowledge of the client's business/industry to identify technological developments and evaluate impacts on the client's business.
Demonstrate excellent project management.
Acon - Internal Audit 2


Skills and Attributes for Success
Data analytics
Internal auditing
Project management
Problem solving
Client relationship management
Knowledge management
Risk management
SOX compliance

Description:
Job Title: Apprentice Hiring for 2026- 2027
Location: Mumbai, India
About the programme:
This 12-month apprenticeship, under India's National Apprenticeship Training Scheme, provides valuable on-the-job training; Please note, there is no obligation for permanent employment with Deutsche Bank Group upon completion of the Apprenticeship Training tenure.
Role Description
About DWS
DWS, publicly listed asset management division of Deutsche Bank, is one of the world's leading investment management organizations with assets under management. DWS provides flexible products and solutions to a wide range of investment opportunities across all asset classes from pooled funds to highly customized portfolios for a wide range of investors and offers individuals and institutions traditional and alternative investments across all major asset classes.
About the team
The Platform Sustainability function is a cross-divisional function, linked to both the investment and product divisions of DWS Group. It coordinates and steers the business implementation of DWSs Sustainability Strategy as well as the sustainability related regulatory requirements in the product and investment areas. Its focus is on the liquid product range of DWS Group and the product-related sustainability activities for alternative investments. Its activities comprise the development of sustainability-related frameworks as well as their integration into engagement processes, ESG integration processes and product-specific investment policies.
The Product Infrastructure & Standards team is part of Platform Sustainability within the Product Division.
The team is responsible for developing the sustainability-related product infrastructure including data management and contributing to product disclosure processes.
In this responsibility, the team plays a key role in designing efficient processes for a technology-driven future. In addition, the team actively contributes to navigating regulatory developments that are shaping the industry. To achieve this, it works closely together with colleagues across the Product Division and other relevant sustainability experts at DWS globally.
Your key responsibilities
As a Product Sustainability Analyst of the Product Sustainabilitys Infrastructure & Standards Team, you will be jointly responsible for
Analysing and conceptualizing the sustainability-related data and process flow from product development to the monitoring of investment guidelines compliance
Coordinating and overseeing the implementation of systematic changes in close collaboration with business and infrastructure teams
Developing a workflow tool for product launches
Automating existing processes related to fund disclosures
Supporting development of sustainability-related product infrastructure with exposure to sustainability specialists and close
collaboration with sustainability investment experts
Your skills and experience
Essential skills:
University degree in Commerce/Science or similar
Working knowledge of any coding language
Experience in working on ESG related topics
Good knowledge of project management
Experience on Automation projects (preferred)
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) for documentation purposes
Strong analytical and methodological thinking to understand (regulatory) sustainability-related requirements and the associated implications and risks
Proactive solution-oriented mindset to effectively work hand in hand with different teams
Competencies:
Highly motivated, self-sufficient and ability to learn quickly
Intercultural competence, superior communication skills and strict attention to detail
Highly structured and dedicated approach to work
High interest in taking on new challenges

Monthly reward and recognition to outstanding performers.

Accelerated career growth of employees and one can become UH in another 3 months time)

It is headquartered in Bangalore with a team of 4000+ employees.

Role and Responsibility Relationship Manager
Act as relationship manager for the Paid customers of NoBroker.
Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication.
Identify and assess customers' needs to effectively upsell or cross-sell relevant products or services.
Service customer in nding the right tenant / house as per the requirement of the customer.
Dial outbound and attend inbound calls of customers and leads.
Use internal tools and methods to provide the best possible service to the customer.
Negotiate with leads on behalf of customers.

Description:
Hiring: TSS Real Estate

Location: BANGALORE
Work Mode: Work from Office + Field Visits
Experience: Property Sales preferred

Salary -17000 per month fixed

About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Associate (BDA) who will work closely with property owners and prospective tenants to facilitate property transactions and close deals.

The candidate will receive leads from the company, visit properties with clients, understand owner requirements, identify potential tenants, and drive the deal to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Handle company-generated leads and connect with potential clients/tenants.
Visit properties and show them to prospective tenants/clients.
Travel approximately 3040 km daily for property visits and client meetings.
Understand and manage property owner requirements.
Identify suitable and potential tenants based on property requirements.
Coordinate between property owners and tenants throughout the transaction.
Conduct property visits, explain property details, and address client queries.
Negotiate and follow up with both parties to close the deal.
Maintain regular follow-ups with leads until closure.
Build strong relationships with property owners and clients.
Maintain updated records of leads, property visits, follow-ups, and closures.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Real estate knowledge is preferred.
Good understanding of property types, location, configuration, and surface/built-up/carpet area.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and sales skills.
Comfortable with daily field travel of 3040 km.
Ability to understand client and owner requirements and match them effectively.
Target-oriented and strong in follow-ups.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple property/client requirements.
Ideal Candidate

Someone who is sales-driven, confident in client interactions, comfortable with field work, and has a good understanding of the real estate market.

If you enjoy meeting clients, exploring properties, and closing real estate deals, this role is for you!e & responsibilities

Description:
Client Advisor Sales | NoBroker
Company: NoBroker
Job Location: Bangalore | Hyderabad | Delhi
Designation: Client Advisor
Actual Role: Area Sales Manager (ASM)
Experience: 0–5 Years (Freshers Can Apply)
Education: Any Graduate
Age Limit: Up to 30 Years
Industry: Real Estate / PropTech
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full Time
Job Description
NoBroker is looking for enthusiastic and result-oriented Client Advisors to join its growing sales team. The candidate will be responsible for driving sales, engaging with potential customers, understanding their property requirements, and converting leads into successful business opportunities.
Candidates with strong communication, negotiation, customer-handling, and sales skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and achieve assigned monthly and individual targets.
Connect with potential customers and understand their property requirements.
Explain NoBroker's products, subscription plans, and value-added services.
Convert prospective leads into paying customers.
Handle customer queries, objections, and negotiations effectively.
Generate business through calls, referrals, and follow-ups.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
Maintain customer details, follow-ups, and sales updates in CRM.
Track daily sales performance and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding.
Candidate Requirements
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Graduation in any stream is mandatory.
Maximum age limit: 30 years.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and closing abilities.
Customer-centric approach with a sales-oriented mindset.
Ability to work in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, energetic, and result-oriented.
Why Join NoBroker?
Opportunity to work with India's leading PropTech platform.
Excellent learning and career growth opportunities.
Exposure to sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Performance-driven work environment.

Description:
Title- Finance Analyst (CA)
Experience- 0-1 Year
Location-Pune
We are looking for Financial Analyst to manage financial planning, accounting, invoicing, revenue recognition, budgeting, MIS reporting, and financial compliance activities for engineering services projects.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Accounting & Reporting
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
Ensure accurate booking of revenues, expenses, accruals, and provisions.
Perform month-end and year-end closing activities.
Support statutory audit, internal audit, and tax audit requirements.
Maintain General Ledger and ensure reconciliation of balance sheet accounts.
Project Finance & Revenue Management
Monitor project-wise profitability and margins.
Review project budgets versus actual costs.
Ensure accurate revenue recognition as per contractual milestones and accounting standards.
Track unbilled revenue, deferred revenue, and WIP balances.
Coordinate with project managers and delivery teams for financial reviews.
Budgeting & MIS Reporting
Assist in annual budgeting and periodic forecasting.
Prepare business unit-wise MIS reports.
Analyze revenue, gross margin, utilization, and cost variances.
Present financial insights and recommendations to management.
Business Partnering
Evaluate commercial proposals and customer contracts.
Support pricing, profitability analysis, and business case preparation.
Provide financial guidance to stakeholders for decision-making.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Accounting Standards and Financial Reporting.
Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and MIS reporting.
Knowledge of revenue recognition and project accounting.
Understanding of GST, TDS, and corporate taxation.
Proficiency in SAP (FI/CO), Oracle, or similar ERP systems.
Advanced MS Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Financial Modeling).
Strong analytical and communication skills.

Description:
Job Summary:
Ensures products received or produced meet technical specifications and trains others. Works under minimal supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Verifies the final quality of products on the production line. Compares the physical characteristics of components, materials, equipment and products to technical specifications to identify defects. Separates products that do not meet the desired technical specification, using basic and/or complex measurement techniques and equipment. Documents products that do not meet technical specifications using specified systems. Trains others in the use of measurement equipment, segregation of non-conforming product and documentation. Follows the norms and standards of quality defined by the Company.
Key Responsibilities Skills
Hands-on experience in operating and maintaining metrology laboratory equipment, including CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine), Roundness Tester, and Surface Finish Tester .
Expertise in programming and measurement execution on metrology equipment.
Strong knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning Tolerancing (GDT) and interpretation of engineering drawings.
Experience in Measurement System Analysis (MSA) , calibration management, and layout inspection activities.
Conducting and managing incoming/receiving inspection of components and materials.
Handling supplier quality issues , including investigation, containment, corrective actions, and follow-up.
Knowledge of Corrective Action Requests (CAR) and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCAR) , including root cause analysis and effectiveness verification.
Ensuring compliance with quality standards, inspection plans, and customer requirements.
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives for metrology and supplier quality processes
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Measurement Science - Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, Metrology e. g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.

Quality Process Management - Proficient application of quality tools and methods (e. g. APQP, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, Capability studies, Process Audit, inspection, test, etc. ) to ensure quality of products, processes and services.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Laboratory Management - Leads technical resources while managing the business aspects of a laboratory using measure to control both the technical and business aspects of the organization and assuring the requirements of the appropriate certifications and/or accreditations are met.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Description:
Position: Deputy Manager / Assistant Manager Project Sales, Trade Sales & OEM Sales
Location: Mumbai/ Navi Mumbai
Company: Greenlam Industries Ltd.

Key Responsibilities

Project Sales
Develop and maintain relationships with Architects, Interior Designers, PMCs, Contractors, Builders, and Developers.
Generate specifications and business from residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, retail, and institutional projects.
Conduct product presentations and technical discussions with influencers and consultants.
Track upcoming projects and convert opportunities into sales.

Trade Sales
Drive primary and secondary sales through distributor, dealer, and retailer networks.
Appoint and develop channel partners for market expansion.
Ensure implementation of promotional activities and visibility initiatives.
Monitor market trends, competition, and customer requirements.
Achieve territory-wise sales and collection targets.

Expand market share and strengthen brand presence.

Coordinate with internal teams for timely execution and customer satisfaction.
Ensure timely collections and account management.
Prepare sales forecasts, MIS reports, and market intelligence updates.

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.
3 to 10 years of experience in Project Sales, Trade Sales, OEM Sales, Specification Sales, Institutional Sales, or Channel Sales.
Preferred industry exposure: Laminates, Plywood, Veneers, Flooring, Building Materials, Decorative Surfaces, Furniture, Interior Products, Paints, Tiles, Sanitaryware, or related sectors.
Strong network with Architects, Interior Designers, Contractors, Dealers, Distributors, Builders, and OEM customers.

Description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Telesales Representative to join our sales team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for reaching out to potential customers, presenting our products or services, and closing sales over the phone. This position requires excellent communication skills, a persuasive demeanour, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. If you are passionate about sales and enjoy building relationships with customers, we invite you to apply.
Responsibilities:
Outbound Calling: Initiate outbound calls to potential customers with the aim of introducing our products or services.
Lead Generation: Identify and qualify leads through effective questioning and active listening.
Product Knowledge: Develop a deep understanding of our products or services to effectively communicate their features and benefits to potential customers.
Pitching and Closing: Present our products or services persuasively and close sales over the phone. Address any concerns or objections raised by potential customers.
Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and quotas.
Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the sales team to share insights, strategies, and best practices.
Qualifications:
Experience: 0-3 years of experience in telesales or a similar role.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal communication skills with a clear and confident speaking voice.
Goal-Oriented: Results-driven with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Team Player: Capable of working collaboratively within a team-oriented environment.
Working Conditions:
This role is primarily office-based, involving extensive telephone communication.
If you are a motivated and energetic individual with a passion for sales, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience.
AboutCompany:
Own and Drive End-to-end Area Operations for the commission based truck placement business (BlackBuck Superloads) BlackBuck platform for the assigned territory. Own the business growth, scalability
Manage and troubleshoot day to day key fulfilment metrics in each branch - Vehicle placement for various booking offices orders, process adherence and driving the quality metrics on various operational workflows
Resolve escalations on both the sides of the market place [for booking offices and truckers] and ensuring smooth operations
Execute centrally defined collections framework and processes at the city/state/Zone level to drive collections
Hiring, mentoring and managing a team of high performing branch operations teams

Description:
Company: Mind Studio
Location: Pune | Employment Type: Internship | Counsultant Duration: 6 -12 months | Experience: Fresher

About the Role
Were looking for a design intern to support our team on furniture and interior projects. You’ll get hands-on experience in furniture curation, material selection and client presentations on residential, hospitality and commercial projects.

Key Responsibilities
Furniture Selection: Research and shortlist furniture, lighting and decor that suit each project’s design brief and budget.
Material Selection: Help choose fabrics, finishes, laminates, veneers and hardware, and keep the material library up to date.
Presentations: Prepare mood boards, furniture schedules and client presentations.
AutoCAD Drawings: Draft furniture layouts, floor plans and basic working drawings.
Vendor Coordination: Follow up with vendors for catalogues, samples, quotes and product details.
Documentation: Keep project files, furniture specifications and selection sheets organised.
Site Visits: Go on site visits for measurements and installation reviews when needed.

Requirements
Pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in Interior Design, Furniture Design or Architecture.
Working knowledge of AutoCAD.
Comfortable making presentations in PowerPoint, Canva or InDesign.
Good eye for aesthetics, materials, colour and finishes.
Organised, eager to learn and a good communicator.
Portfolio of academic or personal work (mandatory).

Good to Have
Basic knowledge of SketchUp or Photoshop.

What We Offer
Hands-on exposure to premium furniture and interior projects.
Direct mentoring from the design team.
Internship certificate, with a possible full-time role based on performance.

Description:
What you will do
The Purchasing Strategy & Digitalization (PS&D) function within Trucks, Technology & Industrial Division is aCenter of Excellence. We are responsible for guiding and facilitating the strategic direction of purchasing onbehalf of the Executive Management Team. PS&D, together with relevant line functions, drives efficiency indigitalization, governance, harmonization, group synergies, continuous improvements, and digital & IT projectsto create business value. We work proactively with change management and transformation in collaborationwith TTI line functions.
Your future team
Purchasing Support Center (PSC) is a young, energetic team of talented and skilled professionals deliveringthe purchasing-related tactical scope of activities to global purchasing communities. Here we work with globalstakeholders and suppliers cross-functionally performing various purchasing tasks and being problem solvers.
Who are you?
As a Graduate Apprentice Trainee (GAT), you will get to learn and perform at the same time with highlyexperienced global end users and supply chain experts, which will pave your path to becoming a successfulpurchasing and Supply Chain Management professional.
The GAT within the Purchasing Support Centre (PSC) will be responsible for supporting the team on internalactivities, handling standard scope activities delegated by buyers from all Group trucks, buses, and Penta sitesglobally.

Main Activities & Responsibilities:
Autonomous maintenance of Handler Logs and other Portfolio Activities/Order Management/PriorityAftermarket Requisitions handling
RFQ Management, including launching, follow-ups for quotes, and answering supplier queries incollaboration with buyers and PD and XF teams
Supplier Price Discrepancy Management / Issues Handling/ Clearing invoice & payments related queries
Compiling & analyzing quotes from suppliers, preparing preliminary quotes summary/analysis as well as acost breakdown for various suppliers and parts
Solving portfolio-related issues with suppliers/cross-functional teams and Supplier Price DiscrepancyManagement/Issues Handling
Performing various analyses for buyers and managers, like Price Inconsistency Analysis, 80/20 Analysis,ABC Analysis, Volume trend Analysis, Supplier Dashboard Creation, Material Cost Levels Report, SupplierSpend Analysis, Part Price Evolution, Cost Per KG Analysis, Supplier Deep Dive Analysis
Supplier Integration Support on buyer request - Support in establishing EDI Connections, Supplier PortalAccess, Creation/Addition/Deletion of Parma Code/Supplier base administration, Supplier Base Follow-ups
Taxonomy and Segmentation Support to buyers and management, segment owners, and maintenance ofVarious Department Dashboards and Reports
Portfolio Analysis and Cleaning
Coordinating on the Agreements approval flow

Qualifications:
University degree in BE/B.Tech in Mechanical/Automobile/E&E/ Industrial Engg & Mgmt
Quick Learner who drives Competence Building
Teamwork and collaboration
Multi-cultural openness and customer focus
Continuous Improvement and Excellence mindset with good communication skills
Good understanding of different manufacturing processes and best practice costing.

Description:
Asset Management
Bringing together traditional and alternative investments, we provide clients around the world with a dedicated partnership and focus on long-term performance. As the firm s primary investment area, we provide investment and advisory services for some of the world s leading pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors and individuals, for which we oversee more than trillion in assets under supervision. Working in a culture that values integrity and transparency, you will be part of a diverse team that is passionate about our craft, our clients, and building sustainable success. We are:
Investors , spanning traditional and alternative markets offering products and services
Advisors , understanding our clients priorities and poised to help provide investment advice and strategies that make sense for their portfolios
Thought Leaders , providing timely insights across macro and secular themes to help inform our clients investment decisions
Innovators , using our suite of digital solutions to help our clients address complex challenges and meet their financial goals


Operations
Operations is a dynamic, multi-faceted division that partners with all parts of the firm to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients around the world. In addition, Operations provides essential risk management and controls to preserve and enhance the firms assets and its reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develops and manages the processes and controls that enable business flow.


Your Impact
Are you looking to expand your understanding of financial products and be well versed on the life cycle of a trade Our Trade Management team is seeking a professional who is looking to collaborate with traders, portfolio managers and external counterparties to ensure all trades are communicated, confirmed, and settled to safeguard our clients and funds.


Our Impact
Goldman Sachs Asset Management (GSAM) is the investment management arm of the firm. As a leading player in the asset management world, GSAM makes pioneering industry improvements a priority across all of its sectors. The Trade Management team has primary responsibility of mitigating risk throughout all aspects of trade flow, settlement, and collateral management.


Job Summary
Prepare to gain a comprehensive understanding of the trade lifecycle by interacting with traders, strategists, clients, and technologists to work toward the shared goal of risk mitigation.
Connect daily with traders and brokers to resolve issues and ensure timely settlement of trades.
Understand and improve problem solving capability for complex trade flow, accounting issues, and transactional discrepancies.
Showcase leadership in project management skills toward aims of improved cross-product support and relationship management.
Leverage your quantitative skills to decompose processes to improve control and scale of the business.
Provide reporting to senior leadership and produce insightful analyses of the business upon request for management.
Grow with the team; develop a deeper understanding of complex transactions and work with our business partners to progress our trade capture capabilities.


Basic Qualifications
Bachelor s degree or above
Knowledge of financial products, whether academically or professionally acquired.
Proven ability to effectively manage competing priorities and to work well under pressure in a team environment.
High level of discretion and awareness of accountability.
Analytical skills and interest in developing problem-solving capabilities.


Preferred Qualifications
Basic understanding of Fixed income, Equity, Money Market and Derivatives products.
Understanding of trade life cycle of these products and experience in trade confirmation and settlement process.
Work experience in financial services.
Comprehension of industry agenda and platforms.
Positive attitude and eagerness to learn.

Description:
Sales Processing Analyst 1
This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
Job Family Definition:
Executes operational activities related to quote, price, configuration, deal registration, order management process, invoicing, and contract life-cycle management to ensure that sales orders are successfully completed from quote to delivery and credited appropriately assigned for sales compensation. Produces deal documentation and configures systems to reflect ordering processes. Generates invoices and client billing in accordance with service and product agreements. Records, updates and validates customer and deal information in systems produces reports and analyses of sales processing activities.
Management Level Definition:
Applies basic foundation of a functions principles, theories and concepts to assignments of limited scope. Uses professional concepts and theoretical knowledge acquired through specialized training, education or previous experience. Develops expertise and practical knowledge of applications within business environment. Acts as team member by providing information, analysis and recommendations in support of team efforts. Exercises independent judgment within defined parameters.

What you ll do:
Responsibilities:
Supports sales processing activities for assigned areas and processes
Learns requirements and develops capability in all areas of sales processing
Collects, consolidates, and charts data from sales and process results for assigned portions of operations areas to identify trends and issues
learns and practices basic analysis
Implements specified changes to processes and tools to improve performance, efficiency and customer satisfaction
Develops understanding of internal and external relationships with stakeholders for performance expectations and needs

What you need to bring:
Education and Experience Required:
Bachelors degree in Business Management or equivalent
Typically 0-2 years experience
Knowledge and Skills:
Basic understanding of business and sales processing tools, systems and practices
Good analytical, statistics and problem solving skills.
Good written and verbal communication skills
mastery in English and local language.

Description:
Sales Processing Analyst 1
This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
Job Family Definition:
Executes operational activities related to quote, price, configuration, deal registration, order management process, invoicing, and contract life-cycle management to ensure that sales orders are successfully completed from quote to delivery and credited appropriately assigned for sales compensation. Produces deal documentation and configures systems to reflect ordering processes. Generates invoices and client billing in accordance with service and product agreements. Records, updates and validates customer and deal information in systems produces reports and analyses of sales processing activities.
Management Level Definition:
Applies basic foundation of a functions principles, theories and concepts to assignments of limited scope. Uses professional concepts and theoretical knowledge acquired through specialized training, education or previous experience. Develops expertise and practical knowledge of applications within business environment. Acts as team member by providing information, analysis and recommendations in support of team efforts. Exercises independent judgment within defined parameters.

What you ll do:
Responsibilities:
Supports sales processing activities for assigned areas and processes
Learns requirements and develops capability in all areas of sales processing
Collects, consolidates, and charts data from sales and process results for assigned portions of operations areas to identify trends and issues
learns and practices basic analysis
Implements specified changes to processes and tools to improve performance, efficiency and customer satisfaction
Develops understanding of internal and external relationships with stakeholders for performance expectations and needs

What you need to bring:
Education and Experience Required:
Bachelors degree in Business Management or equivalent
Typically 0-2 years experience
Knowledge and Skills:
Basic understanding of business and sales processing tools, systems and practices
Good analytical, statistics and problem solving skills.
Good written and verbal communication skills
mastery in English and local language.

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here .

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
What We Can Offer You:
Health Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
Personal Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for assisting with the administrative and clerical duties of the Human Resources department, management of team member files, support of the hiring process, onboarding of new hires, coordination of training activities, and so on. As a HR Coordinator, you re not just providing support to HR department managers - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Relevant work experience in human resources and administrative.
Proficient in the use of the Microsoft Office suite.
Demonstrates knowledge of fundamental labor laws and employment regulations, or exhibits a willingness to learn about them
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Provide exceptional front office support: Welcome and assist guests, applicants, and team members with prompt, professional, and courteous service
Support daily office operations: Provide administrative support such as word processing, data entry, filing, and copying to support HR department operations
Manage communication: Handle phone calls, emails, mail processing, and meeting coordination
Coordinate travel arrangements: Organize and manage bookings for HR department managers
Support special projects: Assist with departmental initiatives or ad-hoc assignments

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.

Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.

Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.

We are seeking an experienced Amazon Connect Professional with 8-15 years of overall IT experience and strong expertise in cloud-based contact center solutions. Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, SNS, and Kinesis.
Knowledge of contact center technologies including ACD, CTI, IVR, Routing Strategies, Workforce Optimization, and Omnichannel Support.
Experience integrating Amazon Connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Proficiency in REST APIs, web services, and cloud integrations.
Understanding of contact center reporting, analytics, and monitoring solutions.
AWS certifications are desirable.

Role & responsibilities:
Lead SAP Security & GRC managed services engagements, including solution design, configuration, implementation, enhancements, and ongoing support.
Manage SAP Security operations across S/4HANA On-Premise, Private Cloud, Public Cloud, Fiori, GRC, BTP, and hybrid SAP landscapes.
Ensure adherence to SLAs, KPIs, and service delivery commitments, including incident, change, and problem management.
Drive security architecture improvements, role redesign, access governance, SoD remediation, and compliance initiatives.
Lead SAP Security audit activities, including SOX compliance, ITGC assessments, access reviews, audit evidence preparation, and remediation of audit findings.

Lead security configuration, implementation, and troubleshooting for SAP BTP, Cloud Identity Services, IAS/IPS, and identity integrations.

Manage client relationships, service reviews, escalations, resource planning, and delivery risks.

Support solutioning, service transitions, transformation, and implementation activities for managed services engagements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to SAP Security CoE and capability development.
Strong practical experience in SAP Security role design, authorization configuration, implementation, and troubleshooting.
Proven experience with SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM), MSMP workflows, BRF+, connectors, synchronization jobs, and ruleset configuration.
Experience performing SoD analysis, configuring mitigation controls, risk remediation, and supporting SOX compliance.
Demonstrated experience in SAP S/4HANA Security across On-Premise, Private Cloud, and Public Cloud environments.

Perks and benefits:
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG), advanced GRC, and security automation.
Experience in SAP Security transformation, S/4HANA migrations, and cloud security implementations.

brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation

Basic understanding of networking and ports

Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks

Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines

Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field

Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Description:
Network Engineer

Experience : 5 to 10 years
Location : Bangalore

We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Routers, Switches, Wireless Access Points, Wireless Controllers, and Firewalls to design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and security of the organizations network fabric across LAN, WAN, wireless, and perimeter security domains, supporting business continuity and enabling seamless connectivity.
Responsibilities

Router Administration & WAN Management
Design, deploy, and manage enterprise routers (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent) across LAN, WAN, and SD-WAN environments
Configure and maintain dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP for optimal path selection and redundancy
Manage WAN connectivity including MPLS, leased lines, broadband, and SD-WAN overlays
Implement and maintain QoS policies to prioritize business-critical traffic across WAN links
Perform router hardening, IOS/firmware upgrades, and lifecycle management
Troubleshoot routing issues, packet loss, and latency affecting network performance and application availability
Switch Administration & LAN Management
Deploy, configure, and administer enterprise-grade switches (Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, or equivalent) in access, distribution, and core layers
Design and manage VLAN architecture, trunking (802.1Q), and inter-VLAN routing to support network segmentation
Configure and maintain spanning tree protocols (STP, RSTP, MSTP) to prevent loops and ensure redundancy
Implement link aggregation (LACP/PAGP), port security, and storm control across the switching infrastructure
Perform switch stack management, firmware upgrades, and hardware lifecycle activities
Monitor switch performance, port utilization, and MAC address tables to proactively identify and resolve issues
Wireless Access Point Deployment & Management
Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise Wireless Access Points (Cisco, Aruba, Meraki, or equivalent) across campus, branch, and remote sites
Perform RF site surveys, channel planning, and transmit power optimization to ensure seamless wireless coverage
Configure SSIDs, band steering, roaming policies (802.11r/k/v), and QoS for wireless clients
Monitor AP health, client association metrics, and interference sources to maintain optimal wireless performance
Perform firmware upgrades, configuration audits, and hardware replacement for access point lifecycle management
Support high-density wireless deployments for conference rooms, auditoriums, and open-plan office environments
Wireless Controller Administration
Administer and manage centralized Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC) and cloud-managed wireless platforms (Cisco WLC, Aruba Mobility Controller, or equivalent)
Configure and maintain controller-based policies for mobility, roaming, load balancing, and client exclusion
Manage WLAN profiles, RF groups, mobility groups, and guest access portals across controller clusters
Implement and maintain wireless security policies including WPA3, 802.1X/EAP, certificate-based authentication, and NAC integration
Perform controller software upgrades, redundancy failover testing, and disaster recovery validation
Integrate wireless controllers with AAA platforms (RADIUS/TACACS+) and network management systems for centralized visibility
Firewall & Perimeter Security Administration
Design, implement, and manage enterprise firewalls (Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or equivalent) for perimeter and internal segmentation
Create and maintain firewall rule sets, security zones, NAT policies, and application-layer inspection policies
Manage VPN configurations including site-to-site IPSec VPN and remote access VPN (SSL/TLS) for secure connectivity
Implement and maintain Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) policies, URL filtering, and threat intelligence feeds
Conduct periodic firewall rule base reviews, policy optimization, and compliance audits
Respond to security events flagged by firewall logs, and coordinate with the SOC team for threat investigation and remediation

Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field preferred
Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network administration and engineering
Strong proficiency in routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) and switching technologies (VLANs, STP, LACP)
Proven experience with enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco, Aruba, or Meraki) including controller and AP management
Hands-on expertise with enterprise firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco FTD, or Check Point)
Experience with network security standards including 802.1X, WPA3, IPSec VPN, and SSL/TLS VPN
Familiarity with network automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, Netmiko, or NAPALM)
Strong working knowledge of ITIL principles and ITSM practices
Industry certifications preferred: CCNA / CCNP, PCNSE, NSE 4+, Aruba ACMP, or equivalent
Current understanding of industry trends including SD-WAN, SASE, Zero Trust Networking, and cloud networking
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with ability to work under pressure during critical incidents
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams

Description:
GenAI Full Stack- Senior Associate

Responsibilities
- Design and develop responsive, performant user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js), implementing reusable component libraries and ensuring design consistency.
- Optimize frontend performance through techniques like lazy loading, code splitting, caching, and efficient rendering strategies for scalable web applications.
- Build, secure, and maintain scalable REST and GraphQL APIs and backend services using Node.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python, handling business logic, data validation, and error handling.
- Develop and manage microservices architectures and design relational and NoSQL database schemas with optimized queries and migrations for production environments.
- Deploy applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for continuous integration and delivery.
- Collaborate closely with product managers to translate UX designs and user stories into pixel-perfect, accessible, and consistent user interfaces across devices and browsers.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Experience working with AI or Generative AI tools-based applications.
- Strong backend development skills using Node.js, Nest.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python frameworks, with solid understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL.
- Proficient in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, or Next.js.
- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB, along with authentication and authorization mechanisms.
- Knowledgeable in version control systems, preferably Git, to manage code and collaborate effectively.

Description:
AI Agent Developer- Senior Associate

As an AI Agent Developer you will design and develop AI-enabled solutions within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, turning raw data into insights that support client decision-making and business growth. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client connections, and guide junior team members while navigating ambiguity and maintaining professional and technical standards. In this role at PwC, you will use advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and data visualization methods to support AI-driven automation, explore new ideas, and deliver work that aligns with broader project objectives.
Responsibilities
- Develop and optimize AI agents using Python, integrating with OpenAI API, Claude, and Azure AI Foundry for advanced natural language processing capabilities.
- Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and Prompt Engineering techniques to improve agent accuracy and contextual understanding.
- Build scalable multi-agent systems using Multi-Agent Frameworks, LangGraph, LangChain, and AutoGen for orchestrating complex AI workflows and interactions.
- Develop and maintain REST APIs to expose agent functionalities, ensuring seamless integration with cloud platforms and external systems.
- Implement observability and monitoring solutions to track agent performance, system health, and facilitate debugging across cloud environments.
-Manage data storage and querying with SQL databases, harnessing Agent Core and Github for version control and collaboration in building AI Code Assistants.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
Expert in developing and optimizing AI agents using Python, seamlessly integrating with cutting-edge APIs like OpenAI, Claude, and Azure AI Foundry to deliver advanced NLP solutions.
- Proven ability to design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and apply sophisticated Prompt Engineering techniques that significantly enhance agent accuracy and contextual relevance.
- Skilled in building scalable, collaborative AI ecosystems using Multi-Agent Frameworks, LangGraph, LangChain, and AutoGen to orchestrate complex, multi-agent workflows efficiently.
- Experienced in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs that enable smooth integration of AI agents with diverse cloud platforms and third-party systems.
- Strong background in implementing comprehensive observability and monitoring frameworks to ensure high performance, reliability, and maintainability of AI systems in cloud environments.
- Proficient in managing data with SQL databases and leveraging tools like Agent Core and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and accelerating the development of AI Code Assistants.
Travel Requirements
Not Specified

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Maximo Developer - Senior Associate, you will engage in business application consulting within our Technology Consulting network, focusing on Maximo Consulting. You will work directly with clients to modernize field service and operations, leveraging your skills to deliver impactful solutions. As a Senior Associate, you will navigate complex situations, build meaningful client relationships, and mentor junior team members. You will utilize your problem-solving skills and critical thinking to analyze complex concepts and anticipate client needs, contributing to the delivery of quality work.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a dynamic team within our Technology Consulting practice. You will have the opportunity to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills while managing and inspiring others. Embracing ambiguity, you will use these moments as opportunities to develop self-awareness and enhance your strengths. Your work will fit into the broader objectives of the firm, and you will uphold professional standards, guiding and mentoring others to deliver value to our clients.
Responsibilities
- Developing and implementing Maximo solutions to enhance asset management capabilities
- Integrating Maximo with other enterprise systems to streamline operations and data flow
- Collaborating with clients to understand their business needs and tailor Maximo functionalities accordingly
- Utilizing analytical thinking to troubleshoot and resolve Maximo-related issues efficiently
- Leading the design and architecture of Maximo applications to support field service and operations modernization
- Applying knowledge of middleware architecture to facilitate seamless application integrations
- Supporting the deployment of emerging technologies within Maximo environments to drive innovation
- Managing project timelines and deliverables to align with client expectations and industry standards
- Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members in Maximo development and integration
- Engaging with stakeholders to gather feedback and continuously improve Maximo solutions
What You Must Have
- App Designer and DB Config: design and implement UI changes, custom Maximo applications, and schema extensions including custom objects and relationships
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
Strong hands-on expertise in IBM Maximo 7.6.x and IBM MAS Manage (8.x / 9.x) across multiple functional modules
– Advanced Automation Script development: complex multi-object scripts, launch-in-context extensions, custom MBO validation, integration event framework, and field-level scripting in JavaScript (Rhino) and Jython
– Deep Integration Framework expertise: design of object structures, bidirectional ERP/GIS/SCADA integration, error handling, JMS queue management, and enterprise messaging patterns
What Sets You Apart
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's degree preferred)
- Developing solutions using IBM Maximo Asset Management
- Integrating Maximo with enterprise systems for seamless operations
- Navigating complex middleware architecture for application integrations
- Embracing emerging technologies in energy and utilities sectors
- Managing field service mobility projects with FSM expertise
- Excelling in analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

Job SummaryA senior, customer-facing SRE who owns the reliability of a client's production systems end to end. Embedded as the main technical point of contact, you will design reliable infrastructure, lead incidents, apply AI-assisted operations, and mentor the team.Key Responsibilities
Own the reliability of production systems for one or more enterprise customers on AWS.
Define and manage SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and ensure monitoring provides meaningful insight.
Lead the response to serious (P0/P1) incidents and run blameless post-mortems that lead to fixes.
Lead within the on-call rotation.
Operate and optimise Kubernetes clusters and AWS services as workloads grow.
Introduce AI SRE tooling and AIOps where it speeds up triage and resolution, with appropriate guardrails.
Advise customers on improving their reliability practices, and mentor associate engineers.
Share field learnings with product and engineering teams.
Required Qualifications
Substantial SRE experience with real ownership of production reliability on AWS.
Experience running Kubernetes and AWS services at scale.
A track record of defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.
Strong observability practice.
Proven incident leadership and post-mortem facilitation.
Strong automation skills (Python, Go, or Bash).
Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted operations, including introducing AI SRE tooling with sensible guardrails.
AWS certification at Associate level as a minimum.
Preferred Qualifications
Owning CI/CD pipelines and release automation.
Writing and maintaining Terraform modules.
GitOps workflows and Helm.
Designing telemetry collection across services.
Incident-management tooling such as PagerDuty.
Hands-on experience integrating AIOps or AI SRE tooling into production operations.
Familiarity with observability or evaluation of AI systems (e.g., Langfuse).
Experience delivering AI-based work or AI/ML-driven initiatives in production.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional.
Technical Skills & Tools
Cloud (AWS): EC2, EKS, ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, ELB/ALB, Route 53
Containers & orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm
Observability & monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Tempo/Jaeger (tracing), ELK/Elastic
Reliability practices: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident command, capacity planning, failure-mode analysis
Incident & on-call: PagerDuty, Opsgenie, blameless post-mortems
Automation & scripting: Python, Go, Bash, Git
AI-assisted operations: AI SRE tooling, AIOps, anomaly detection, automated RCA
DevOps (good to have): CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Terraform modules, GitOps (ArgoCD), Helm

Description:
Regulatory, Risk & Forensic
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
Position Summary
Level: Consultant or equivalent
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
Work youll do:
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value - added outcomes.
The Consultant will be responsible for completing timely and high-quality validation activities, as well as, for identifying issues, validation concerns, and observations, recommending corrective actions, presenting results of validation reviews, interfacing with business partners, and writing reports. Additionally, in this role, you will:
Plan and complete testing within required timeframes and in accordance with established processes and procedures
Applying risk analysis principles, determine the scope, including focus, objectives, and rationale
Develop testing strategies, including procedures and selection of samples, sample size, and rationale 
Prepare working papers, ensure that documentation appropriately supports the testing conclusions, and document process flows and describe major processes within the area being reviewed
Analyze the results of testing and review activities. Analyze exceptions and make recommendations to enhance internal controls
Ensure that testing is accurate, complete, and in accordance with standards and protocols. Communicate test/review results and issues/concerns to leadership, validating and recommending resolutions to issues
Effectively communicate the testing or validation process, status, and results to business and risk partners
Write and/or review reports or presentations that clearly articulate the results/conclusions of testing or validation activities
Effectively communicate with leadership and escalate validation concerns or issues as appropriate
Identifying and implementing efficiencies and process improvements
Complete assigned activities in accordance with established processes and procedures under limited supervision
Actively participate in learning & development opportunities to ensure the use of best-in-class processes and procedures
Proven client-facing experience with strong relationship-building skills
Experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members
Developing clear and concise reporting to be shared with leadership
Assist in managing change to ensure an effective risk management program
The team: 
We are experts in :
Providing FinCrime Operate solutions to optimize cost, quality, and effectiveness of FinCrime operations, including transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, Know Your Customer, screening, and controls testing, leveraging GenAI, technology platforms, and data analytics.
Comprehensive Discovery and data analysis support, preservation, collection, processing, hosting, and production using advanced technologies and GenAI.
Industrialized testing and transformation of regulatory, risk, and compliance processes, driving efficiency with automation, GenAI, and technology.
Dynamic, cost-effective risk monitoring using expert resources and technology to quickly identify elevated risks and potential noncompliance.
Qualifications
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in in risk management (includes control testing, issue identification and validation, compliance, financial crimes, operational risk, internal audit, business process management)
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
Financial services knowledge: compliance, risk management, audit operations
Experience in testing procedures; evaluating policies, processes, controls; identifying compliance issues
Public accounting experience in audit or SOX advisory/consulting
Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
High responsibility, initiative, accountability
Excellent communication skills
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail
Ability to interact across organizational levels
Education: 
B. Com / BBA or similar 3 year graduate course
M.Com / MBA or similar post grad course (Tier 2/3 colleges)
Location:
Hyderabad , Bangalore, Chennai
The professionals are expected to work from Office all 5 days in a week.
Shift Timings: 
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements. Role & responsibilities

Description:
Meet the Team
The Silicon One ASIC delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. With ~2,100 employees across 16 countries, we design the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers of various sizes, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Come join us and take part in shaping Cisco's ground-breaking solutions by designing, developing and testing some of the most complex ASICs being developed in the industry.
You will be in the Silicon One development organization as an ASIC Implementation Technical Lead in Bangalore India with a primary focus on Design-for-Test. You will work with Front-end RTL teams, backend physical design teams to understand chip architecture and drive DFT requirements early in the design cycle. As a member of this team you will also be involved in crafting groundbreaking next generation networking chips. You will help lead to drive the DFT and quality process through the entire Implementation flow and post silicon validation phases with additional exposure to physical design signoff activities.


Your Impact
Responsible for implementing the Hardware Design-for-Test (DFT) features that support ATE, in-system test, debug and diagnostics needs of the designs.
Responsible for development of innovative DFT IP in collaboration with the multi-functional teams, and play a key role in full chip design integration with the testability features coordinated in the RTL.
Work closely with the design/design-verification and PD teams to enable the integration and validation of the Test logic in all phases of the implementation and post silicon validation flows.
Your team will participate in the creation of Innovative Hardware DFT physical design aspects for new silicon device models, bare die stacked die, driving re-usable test and debug strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

Verification skills include, System Verilog Logic Equivalency checking and validating the Test-timing of the design

Strong verbal skills and ability to thrive in a multifaceted environment

Preferred Qualifications

DFT CAD development - Test Architecture, Methodology and Infrastructure

Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Description:
Position: Senior Engineer Advanced Flight Management System (FMS) Aerospace
Role Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Advanced Flight Management System (FMS) team. The ideal candidate will have strong avionics software development experience, mandatory hands-on experience in Flight Management Systems, and expertise in developing safety-critical software in a DevOps environment. The role requires ownership of product quality, collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, and a mindset focused on delivering optimized and efficient solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
- DO178 Level A verification experience
- Very good knowledge on C++.
- Display products experience will be plus
- Design, develop, integrate, and verify safety-critical FMS software.
- Work in a DevOps environment, contributing to CI/CD and continuous improvement.
- Own product quality and ensure compliance with DO-178B/C standards.
- Collaborate with Systems, Certification, and other cross-functional teams.
- Works on software design, coding, integration, and verification
- Drive software optimization, automation, and engineering best practices.
- Mentor team members and contribute to technical excellence.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor s or master s degree in aerospace, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline.
- 3 to 10 years of experience in avionics software development.
- Mandatory experience in Flight Management System (FMS) software development. User Interface skills are recommended
- Strong knowledge of DO-178B/C and software design, development, integration, and verification.
- Experience working in a DevOps environment with CI/CD practices.
- Strong programming skills in C/C++, scripting languages, and embedded real-time software development.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Desired Competencies:
- Strong ownership and accountability for product quality.
- Ability to identify and implement optimized, scalable, and efficient solutions.
- Self-driven team player with a passion for developing high-quality, safety-critical avionics software.
Location: IN-KA-Bangalore, India (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
