We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.

Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.

Role / Job Title- Manager - Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant
Experience - 8 - 14 years

Key Skills -Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, US Payroll, Payroll Configuration, Elements, Calculation Cards, Balances, Fast Formulas, Payroll Flows, Retro Processing and Costing
Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/ Pune /Gurugram

Role & responsibilities

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.
Must have worked on at least two end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, with strong Oracle US Payroll experience; Canada Payroll experience is a plus.
In-depth hands-on configuration across Legislative Data Groups, payroll definitions and calendars, Payroll Statutory Units / Tax Reporting Units, elements, input values, element eligibility, calculation cards, balances, payment methods and payroll costing.
Strong knowledge of QuickPay, payroll flows, retroactive processing, proration, balance adjustments, costing and payment processing.
Hands-on expertise in Payroll Fast Formulas and troubleshooting complex payroll calculation and configuration issues.
Strong understanding of US payroll processing, including federal, state and local taxation, quarter-end / year-end activities and legislative updates.
Experience with HDL / payroll data conversion, payroll extracts and reporting, with the ability to collaborate with technical teams on integrations and extensions.
Ability to perform fit-gap analysis, translate business requirements into scalable configuration, and lead unit testing, UAT / regression testing, quarterly release readiness and production issue resolution.
Strong client-facing communication and delivery leadership, including risk / escalation management, team guidance and working knowledge of Core HR and related HCM touchpoints.
As a Manager, you will serve as the functional lead and client-facing subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, combining deep payroll configuration expertise with delivery leadership across implementation, enhancement and production support engagements.
Lead the Oracle HCM Payroll functional workstream across solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, hypercare and ongoing support.
Lead client requirement and design discussions, translate payroll policies into Oracle configuration, and provide clear recommendations on solution options and impacts.
Own complex payroll functional issues from analysis through resolution, driving root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
Review payroll configurations, functional designs and deliverables for quality, accuracy, controls and adherence to agreed standards.
Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate with Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Time and Labor, Integrations, Reporting and Finance teams, and lead quarterly release impact assessment and regression testing.
Mentor functional consultants, provide configuration oversight, build team capability and drive continuous improvement while maintaining strong client relationships.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Job Locations: Mumbai | Bangalore | Noida | Pune

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced SAP BRIM SOM (Subscription Order Management) Consultant with 6–12 years of SAP experience and hands-on expertise in SAP BRIM solutions. Order Distribution & Fulfillment

Job Title: SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams to deliver innovative workflow-based solutions across SAP landscapes.
As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant, you will:
Design, develop, and implement SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate end-to-end business processes.
Configure and develop workflow components including Tasks, Standard Tasks, Workflows, Events, Methods, Rule Resolution, and Agents.
Create and enhance Business Objects (BOR) and ABAP OO-based workflow objects.
Develop custom workflow functionalities using ABAP programming techniques, User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancements, and Function Modules.
Configure event management and workflow triggering mechanisms using change documents, business transactions, and custom events.
Develop and troubleshoot workflow notifications, work items, inbox configurations, and approval processes.
Integrate workflows with SAP modules such as MM, SD, FI, CO, HCM, and SRM based on business requirements.
Perform workflow administration activities including monitoring, debugging, error handling, and performance optimization.
Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA workflow framework will be an added advantage.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.Role & responsibilities

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Lead SAP PM functional consulting activities across requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to understand maintenance processes, asset management requirements, and operational challenges.
Configure and implement SAP Plant Maintenance functionalities including Technical Objects, Functional Locations, Equipment Masters, Work Centers, Maintenance Notifications, Maintenance Orders, Task Lists, Maintenance Plans, and Measuring Points/Counters.
Design and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance processes aligned with business objectives.
Analyze business requirements and prepare functional specifications for custom developments, reports, forms, enhancements, interfaces, and workflows.
Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend SAP best practices to improve maintenance efficiency and asset reliability.
Work closely with ABAP, Basis, Data Migration, and Integration teams to implement business requirements.
Configure and support calibration management, refurbishment processes, warranty tracking, and maintenance costing processes.
Manage SAP PM integration with MM, QM, PP, SD, PS, and FICO modules to support end-to-end business processes.
Support inventory and spare parts management through PM-MM integration.
Define authorization requirements and assist in security role testing related to maintenance functions.
Participate in data migration activities involving equipment masters, functional locations, maintenance plans, task lists, and historical maintenance data.
Develop and execute unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing scenarios.
Prepare configuration documents, functional design documents (FDD), business process documents (BPD), test scripts, and end-user training materials.
Support cutover planning, go-live activities, hypercare support, and production stabilization.
Analyze and resolve production issues, ensuring adherence to SLAs and business continuity requirements.
Collaborate with business users to drive continuous process improvements and system optimization initiatives.
Provide guidance on SAP S/4HANA PM functionalities and Fiori applications related to maintenance operations.
Support implementation of asset management strategies focused on equipment reliability, maintenance compliance, and cost optimization.
Participate in project estimation, effort planning, risk assessment, and change request management.
Mentor junior consultants and provide functional expertise during project execution.
Work directly with client leadership, plant maintenance teams, operations teams, and external stakeholders in a customer-facing consulting role.
Ensure solutions comply with industry standards and maintenance best practices across Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharma, Chemicals, Utilities, Oil & Gas, and Engineering sectors.
Must have hands-on experience in at least one complete end-to-end SAP PM implementation lifecycle covering Blueprint, Realization, Testing, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.

Preferred candidate profile

Minimum 6+ years of strong SAP PM functional consulting experience.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Completed at least one full-cycle end-to-end SAP PM implementation project with active involvement across all project phases.
Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PM configuration and business process design.
Experience working on SAP S/4HANA PM implementations, migrations, or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and maintenance management best practices.
Proven experience in maintenance planning, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, shutdown management, and asset lifecycle management.
Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, QM, PP, PS, and FICO modules.
Experience in preparing functional specifications and coordinating with technical teams for developments and enhancements.
Exposure to Fiori applications and SAP S/4HANA innovations in Plant Maintenance.
Ability to independently interact with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into SAP solutions.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in client-facing consulting environments and global delivery models.
SAP PM or SAP S/4HANA Asset Management certification will be an added advantage.
Prior experience in Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Utilities, Chemicals, EPC, or Oil & Gas industries preferred.
Ability to work from Mumbai, Pune, or Bangalore and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Candidates with implementation plus support/rollout experience will be highly preferred.
Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods are preferred.

Description:
Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.
Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Role
National Strategic Accounts Manager
Job Level/ Designation
M2/AGM
Function / Department
Enterprise/Strategic Accounts
Location
Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore
Job Purpose

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. End to end operational excellence for the entire customer life cycle journey from opportunity to closure. The role of Client Manager is to focus on incremental product wise Revenue Market Share from those assigned accounts.
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
Single & Most important bearer of Relationship with Enterprise Customer with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for all assigned Enterprise Customers.
Responsible for the incremental revenue growth on all product lines.
Farming - Protecting the Existing Revenue Stream from Competition & Downward Tariff Revision
Seeding New Products & Services - Cross Selling & Up selling - to enhance overall revenue
Business planning & Accurate Forecasting on Revenue, Order booking, Gross Addition, Gross Net, Net Addition, Churn, Billing, Collection & Bad debts.
Coordination with Cross Functional team to ensure sync in terms of tariff offering, other circle acquisitions, Order fulfilment, Issues Resolution & various other day to day activities
Monitor the service delivery and service assurance aspects are in line with agreed SLA / MSA
Facilitating Collections Team to ensure timely payments and reduction in bad debts
Manages detailed Account Dossier, Accont plans , Heat Map and update periodically.
Adhere and comply to all processes and systems of VIL & VIBS
Collaborative aproach within the team and organisation
Account Engagement and Account Mapping across multi levels /verticals
End to end operational responsibility leading to CXX
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience
Competencies
Experience in managing global and a track record of global accounts/ enterprise solution selling
Experience in complex change management and operating in a matrix, fast moving and technical environment.
Experience in working in multi-cultural environment ability to manage an international and distributed team.
Team player, strong influence and relationship management skills, customer centric.
Strong communication and decision making skills– ability to balance conflicting interests and ability to lead in a high-growth, high-uncertainty environments
Learning
To learn new products and services so as to be updated with the Customer needs and market trends
Apply the learning in own Customer scenario
Must have technical/ professional qualifications
Experience handling Strategic Accounts and C-level engagement
Education: MBA and Engineering background preferred
5+ years of experience
Should have preferably worked with Telecom, Technology Companies

Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gandhinagar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Role: EY- Assurance Manager ( Audit )
Experience: 5 to 9 years
Notice Period - Immediate to 30 Days
Location: Pune and Bangalore
Mode of work - Hybrid

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity:

Were looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles

Your key responsibilities:

Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement teams expectations
Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

Skills and attributes for success:

Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
Experience in either:

a) Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters.

Location: Bangalore / Pune
Experience: 7-15 Years
Role Purpose
Design and maintain high-quality enterprise data models for Private Banking and Wealth platforms, ensuring consistent, governed, and scalable data structures across client, portfolio, and transaction domains. • Participate in design reviews and architecture governance forums
• 5-8 years of experience in data modelling
• Strong experience in Private Banking / Wealth Management domain
• Understanding of wealth data structures (client lifecycle, portfolio, transactions, products)
• Experience working with multi-system banking environments

Company Description
We are a technology-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent thats bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com Looking to jump-start your career? We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast-track career where you can grow along with Indegenes high-speed growth. We are purpose-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.
We are a rapidly growing global organization and are scouting for the best talent for this phase of growth. With us, you are at the intersection of two of the most exciting industries of healthcare and technology. We offer global opportunities with fast-track careers while you work with a team that is fueled by purpose. The combination of this will lead to a truly differentiated experience for you.
If this excites you, then apply below.
Who are you?
We are looking for a talented professional with Dutch and English copywriting skills focused on the Medical Industry, who can work on developing copy content for brand deliverables. This role would complement the design team, while working for our client in the pharmaceutical industry.
The focus of the role will be to create promotional communication content. You should be recognized as a brand expert with an ability to translate the science and data into compelling promotional copy complying with medical, regulatory, legal and compliance guidelines. The aim is to make the complex simple’ adapting larger pieces of content to create smaller, easy-to-read materials for digital and non-digital channels, maintaining key medical messaging and being able to anchor medical literature references.
Creativity, innovative thinking, and problem-solving should be at the heart of all you do.
Job Description:
The role and responsibilities of the Medical Copywriter includes the following:
The main focus is to develop and update content for various commercial assets, with an additional focus upon omnichannel implementation on digital channels (including but not limited to banner ads, emails, sales rep materials such as i-detail, social media posts/content and websites) – as well as printed material (including but not limited to posters, slide kits, patient guidelines, sales content, leaflets and conference materials).
The role works within medical, regulatory, and legal guidelines to ensure compliance with legislation and regulations in the Netherlands, including the client's internal policies. It also ensures that all content is supported by authentic, current, and up-to-date references. A working understanding of the CGR Code (Code Geneesmiddelenreclame) and the Dutch Medicines Act is required.
There may be occasional opportunities to be involved in creative projects involving ideation and moving image for campaign level activity.
Working in partnership with a graphic design team (on the needs for copy and content), with the brand and production teams on briefs, workshops and project deliveries.
Ensuring compliance to local legislation and regulations including client internal policies, ensuring that content development & activities are supported by authentic and up-to-date references.
Follow best practices in the department regarding processes, communication (internal and external), project management, documentation and technical requirements such as language, grammar, stylization, content search, summarizing, data conflicts, and referencing
Adherence to the highest editorial standards is expected while creating copy drafts
Participating in assigned training programs and working on assignments as per requirement.
Participating in client calls as per project requirements
Use of, overseeing and harnessing the advantages of AI tools in providing accurate and relevant copy content.
Being compliant to quality, confidentiality, and security; adhering to and following quality systems, processes, and policies; and being compliant to training and specifications.
Ideal Profile:
Education— related healthcare Degree/Masters or equivalent qualification preferable
Minimum of 3+ years of experience, including an in-house creative or agency role working with Pharma sector clients
Awareness of local and country/region specific regulatory requirements
Familiarity with / intermediate understanding of, the fields of medicine and good to have respiratory & immunology, cardiovascular, renal & metabolic, oncology therapy areas
Be open to developing such knowledge, outlined immediately above, further working with relevant Medical teams
Strong flair, skills and passion for writing with conceptual ability and a solid knowledge of the digital landscape
Strong written and verbal communication/presentation skills
To have had relevant experience and being skilled in SEO copywriting, pairing best practices that drive traffic (keyword research), with compelling copy, encouraging a desired action, is a distinct advantage.
Passion for networking and stakeholder engagement.
Being up to date with the latest technical/scientific developments and relating them to various projects
Client-oriented attitude with focus on creating strong long-term relationships with clients and encouraging others to work toward this goal
Ability to assure timely completion of assignments
Skilled in problem identification and problem solving
Detail oriented, well organized and timeline driven with the ability to multitask.
Experience working within a large multi-national company in a matrix corporate environment preferable.
Should have both strong written and verbal communication skills in native Dutch language and good business English language skills.
Qualifications
(Lifescience BSC/ MS/ MSC) + MBA

We leverage the depth of our scientific expertise, scale of our operations, our hybrid delivery model, global footprint and intellectual property to deliver value across multiple dimensions. We are 500 plus professionals spread across various locations.

Medical Affairs-Publication writing, Medical Information Management, Medical Communications

Description:
Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecyclefrom concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking

Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Navisworks
MicroStation, ORD (Preferred )
ProjectWise / Forma
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Required Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Proactive and customeroriented mindset.
Excellent communication skills.
High attention to detail.
Strong analytical and problemsolving abilities.
Ability to work under tight deadlines and stretch targets.
Positive, proactive (cando”) attitude with eagerness to learn.

Description:
Territory Sales Manager (TSM)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our

Delivery / Program Manager Telecom
Experience Level: Senior (15+ years)
Role Overview:
The Delivery/Program Manager will lead complex, multi-project programs in the telecom domain. This role combines strong technical expertise with program management skills to ensure successful delivery of large-scale IT transformation initiatives for global telecom clients.
Key Responsibilities:
Program Leadership & Delivery: 
Drive end-to-end delivery of strategic programs involving OSS/BSS systems and wholesale processes.
Define program scope, technical architecture alignment, timelines, and success metrics.
Technical Oversight: 
Collaborate with solution architects and engineering teams to ensure technical integrity of solutions.
Review designs, integration plans, and ensure compliance with industry standards.
Stakeholder Management: 
Act as the primary technical and delivery interface for client leadership.
Manage expectations and ensure alignment between business and technical objectives.
Governance & Reporting: 
Establish governance frameworks, track KPIs, and ensure adherence to SLAs.
Conduct regular program reviews and executive-level reporting.
Risk & Issue Management: 
Identify technical and delivery risks early; implement mitigation strategies.
Financial Management: 
Manage program budgets, forecasts, and profitability.
Team Leadership: 
Lead cross-functional teams (architects, developers, testers, PMs) across geographies.
Mentor technical leads and delivery managers for performance excellence.
Continuous Improvement: 
Drive adoption of Agile/DevOps practices and automation initiatives.
Implement best practices for technical delivery efficiency and quality improvement.
Required Skills & Experience:
Domain Expertise: 
Strong understanding of telecom wholesale processes: interconnect, roaming, carrier billing, settlements, and partner management.
Technical Knowledge: 
Deep knowledge of OSS/BSS systems, mediation, rating, billing platforms, APIs, and integration frameworks.
Exposure to cloud-native architectures, microservices, and containerization.
Program Management: 
15+ years of IT delivery experience, with at least 5 years in technical program management.
Proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar programs.
Certifications: 
PMP, SAFe, or equivalent certifications preferred.
Leadership & Communication: 
Excellent stakeholder management and executive-level communication skills.
Ability to manage global delivery teams and vendors.
Tools & Methodologies: 
Proficiency in Agile, DevOps, and ITIL practices.
Experience with Jira, MS Project, and other program management tools.
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
MBA or equivalent business qualification is a plus.

Position: MLOps
Experience: 5-9 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for talented MLOps with 5-9 years of experience to design, automate, deploy, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications and machine learning platforms. The ideal candidate should have expertise in cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, containerization, monitoring, and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments.

MLOps
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for model development, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
Automate machine learning workflows using MLOps best practices.
Deploy and manage ML models in production environments.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Platform teams.
Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, and drift detection mechanisms.
DevOps

Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
Manage code repositories, branching strategies, and release processes.
Implement DevSecOps practices and security controls.
Improve deployment efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
CloudOps
Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Monitor cloud resources, performance, cost, and availability.
Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues.
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Implement infrastructure-as-code and cloud governance standards.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Solutions Architect / Solutions Manager
Role Overview
We are hiring a Solutions Architect / Solutions Manager to own technical pre-sales and deal pursuit in our Data Engineering, Data Analytics and AI practice. You will lead client conversations from first discovery call to signed proposal, design the target architecture, and shape the commercial response. This is a client-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable at a whiteboard and in a deal review.
Role
Solutions Architect / Solutions Manager
Experience
58 years
Location
Pune / Mumbai / Bangalore
Work setup
Hybrid
Domain
Data Engineering, Data Analytics and AI
Preferred background
IT Services
Key Responsibilities
Client engagement and discovery
Lead technical and business discovery conversations with CXOs, data leaders and architects to understand goals, constraints and the current data landscape.
Drive credible, consultative technical discussions on data platforms, analytics and AI use cases, and position our point of view against client priorities.
Solution architecture
Design end-to-end solutions and reusable frameworks across data ingestion, lakehouse, data modelling, governance, BI and AI/ML on Azure + Databricks or AWS + Databricks.
Define target-state architectures, migration and modernisation roadmaps, and effort and delivery approaches that delivery teams can execute.
Run solution reviews, proof-of-concepts and demos with technical and business stakeholders.
Deal ownership, discovery to closure
Own the pursuit end to end: discovery, solution design, estimation, proposal or RFP response, pricing inputs, negotiation support and closure.
Work with Sales, Delivery, Practice and Finance leaders to build winning, deliverable and profitable proposals.
Maintain pipeline hygiene, deal qualification and win/loss insights.
Practice and delivery enablement
Build solution accelerators, reference architectures, case studies and pitch material for the practice.
Hand over won deals smoothly to delivery, and stay engaged as a trusted advisor to protect scope, quality and client relationships.
Track hyperscaler and Databricks roadmap changes, and work with partner teams on joint pursuits.
Required Qualifications and Skills
5–8 years of experience, with a strong IT Services or consulting background preferred.
Proven experience in pre-sales, solutioning or solution management for Data Engineering, Data Analytics and AI engagements.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture: lakehouse, ELT/ETL, streaming, data modelling, data governance and BI.
Working experience with Azure + Databricks or AWS + Databricks (for example Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark, workflows and MLflow).
Demonstrated ability to architect solutions and frameworks, not just describe them.
Track record of owning deals end to end: discovery, solution, proposal, pricing and closure.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to lead technical conversations with client architects and senior business stakeholders.
Strong written skills for proposals, RFP responses and solution documents.
Ability to work across Sales, Delivery and Practice teams and manage multiple pursuits at once.
Good to Have
Hands-on technical experience: PySpark, SQL, Python, or building PoCs and demos on Databricks.
Exposure to Generative AI, ML and MLOps use cases on Databricks, Azure or AWS.
Databricks, Azure or AWS certifications (for example Databricks Data Engineer / Architect, Azure Data Engineer, AWS Data Analytics).
Experience with tools such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Fabric, AWS Glue or Redshift, dbt, Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with cloud migration and data modernisation programmes, such as moving from legacy warehouses to a lakehouse.
Exposure to Databricks or hyperscaler partner ecosystems and co-sell motions.
What Success Looks Like
Discovery conversations that lead to a clear, client-validated problem statement and solution direction.
Proposals that are technically sound, competitively priced and delivered on time.
A healthy pipeline and a strong win rate on qualified Data, Analytics and AI deals.
Reusable architectures and accelerators that shorten future pursuits.
Smooth handover to delivery and repeat business from the clients you won.

Description:
Job Summary
The Engagement Manager is accountable for Fractals analytics and AI delivery on a Healthcare account, and owns outcomes from the first problem statement to the eventual retirement of each solution. The role combines client leadership, delivery management and technical judgement: you will be the primary contact for offshore delivery teams across multiple locations, the partner to the onshore farming team, a trusted advisor to Senior Directors and VPs of Client, and the person who makes sure every solution is built to last, run and, when the time comes, be replaced. The role also carries an implied farming mandate: growing Fractals business within the managed portfolio, in conjunction with the onsite ideation team.
Success is measured by client NPS, the innovative solutions created, impact on the KPIs most critical to Client and revenue growth from the account, as well as by how well the value of each solution holds up after go-live. Expect also to be judged on measurable business outcomes such as forecast accuracy, service levels and cycle time, and on execution consistency, stakeholder confidence and year-on-year gains in delivery productivity.


Experience
10+ years.


Location
Bengaluru preferred; Chennai and Pune and Mumbai also considered, in that order.


Team
50+ professionals across multiple locations.


Reports to
Principal Consultant.


Roles and Responsibilities
Lead the Consulting delivery
Lead and manage high-impact consulting projects for Clients in the health systems space, from problem framing through to measurable business outcomes.
Lead delivery across a broad range of analytics and AI use cases that span the end-to-end enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement.
Act as the primary contact for the offshore delivery teams, distributed across multiple locations: align with the client on the delivery plan, give regular status updates and keep the client, the onshore ideation team and the offshore teams working as one. Run an operating model that works across locations and time zones.
Partner closely with the onshore farming on converting new pursuits and road mapping existing engagements.
Oversee project extensions, ensuring accurate and comprehensive estimates for the work outlined.
Own engagement PL, commercial performance and Statements of Work, keeping delivery financially sustainable. Contribute to account-level business planning (including client annual operating plans), forecasting, budgeting and measurement of results.
Assess delivery capabilities to anticipate and mitigate risks, and give the client and Fractal leadership clear insight for effective risk management.
Lead multidisciplinary teams of 50+ professionals, including analytics consultants, BI developers, data engineers, data scientists, full-stack developers and GenAI engineers across multiple work streams, standardizing delivery practices and execution quality.
Establish governance mechanisms, delivery standards and success metrics, and champion Agile and DevOps practices, to improve predictability and stakeholder confidence and to drive year-on-year productivity gains.
Work with capability teams to keep offshore staffing at the right level across locations and resolve staffing issues that affect client deliverables.
Provide thought leadership and mentorship to the team, promoting a culture of learning and innovation. Build reusable methods, solution templates and consultative storytelling skills across the team.
Build forward-looking plans for staffing and upskilling in line with market and client demand, and partner with internal stakeholders to put those plans into action.


Shape and deliver Data AI Solutions, across their full lifecycle
Ideate: Work with Client stakeholders within the managed portfolio to identify and prioritize the business problems most worth solving with analytics and AI. Develop strategic frameworks that tie each one to business growth or operational efficiency. Take part in the sales process to scope client needs and frame the solution and delivery approach. Run proofs of concept and proofs of value to establish worth before scaling.
Design: Work with cross-functional teams to design end-to-end solutions that anticipate future needs, scale, and meet health-data privacy, security and regulatory requirements. Translate business requirements into technical designs that engineering, data science, BI, full-stack and GenAI teams can build from. Settle KPIs and success measures, ownership, adoption, data and model lifecycle, and run cost before build starts.
Build: Create and execute analytics-driven solutions. Apply technical fluency across BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI to manage execution and keep technical decisions aligned with the design. Lead by example in analytics delivery, guiding the team from data synthesis and modeling to actionable insights, implications and recommendations.
Operate: Own the handover into operations: monitoring, model and data refresh, support model, and tracking of the value delivered, so solutions keep performing after launch. Validate impact through test-and-control or incrementality measurement, and transition solutions to client teams for sustained use.
Sunset: Define up front when and how a solution will be retired or replaced, and manage the transition, including decommissioning, data retention and handover to successor solutions.


Client relationships establishment, sustenance and strengthening
Manage client relationships to ensure satisfaction and build long-term partnerships.
Advise Senior Directors and VPs across business and technology functions, and occasionally C-suite leaders, with data-driven business relevant insights.
Act as a trusted advisor inside the client organization and grow Fractals footprint within the managed portfolio by engaging stakeholders, identifying likely business problems, building points of view (POVs) and converting them into actionable roadmaps for execution. Shape each proposition end to end, from solution architecture and commercial development to delivery roadmap and go to-market.
Engage with client to institutionalize analytics across the organization, so that solutions are adopted and reused beyond their first use case. Convert proven value into broader, multi-year mandates within the managed portfolio.


Technical Skills
Expertise in building, delivering and operationalizing analytics solutions end to end, from problem definition to production.
Working knowledge of the full scope of work (BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack development and GenAI applications), including cloud data platforms and pipelines, modeling and machine learning, DataOps and MLOps, enough to challenge estimates, spot technical risk and keep delivery aligned with the design.
Familiarity with the client\'s native Microsoft technology stack, including Power BI.

Lead the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Production Engineering and Operations (PEO) module.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design solutions.
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and resources to ensure successful project completion.
Provide expertise in SAP S/4HANA PEO functionalities and integration with other SAP modules.
Conduct workshops, blueprint sessions, and training for business users.
Oversee the development, testing, and deployment phases of the project.
Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices.

Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.

Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams
Please visit our company website for further information:
https://www.db.com/company/company.html

Experience: 6+ Years
Job Locations: Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad

Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.

Knowledge of CI/CD tools and automated testing frameworks.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Description:
Academic Counsellor
Locations - Indore / Bangalore / Pune - Wakad / Pune - Kothrud)

About the Role
As an Academic Counsellor, you will play a key role in guiding potential learners, helping them identify the right career path, and showcasing how upGrads programs can accelerate their journey. You will be responsible for driving enrollments and revenue by nurturing leads, providing consultative counselling, and closing sales in a highly competitive environment.

5 Reasons to Join upGrad Offline Learning Centres
1.Performance Incentives: Target monthly incentive of INR 30,000, with potential to earn 1.5X/2X of that based on performance.
2.Career Growth: Promotion opportunities in 1 year or lateral movement across other Business Units at upGrad.
3.Continuous Upskilling: Access 100% free upGrad programs for yourself and a 50% discount for your family.
4.Comprehensive Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from INR 5L medical insurance for yourself and your family, plus a 24x7 mental health helpline for all-round support.
5.Employee Referral Bonus: Receive INR 15,000 for every successful employee referral bring great talent to upGrad and get rewarded.

Key Responsibilities
Engage with potential learners through calls, video sessions, and in-centre meetings to understand their career goals and recommend suitable programs.
Drive weekly & monthly enrollment and revenue targets by effectively converting leads into admissions.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle from first interaction to enrollment and post-sales support.
Track and improve key performance metrics such as counselling sessions, conversion rates, and revenue.
Maintain accurate learner records on CRM and share feedback with the Marketing team to improve lead quality.
Work closely with centre teams to ensure a smooth learner journey and high satisfaction levels.

Skills & Experience
Graduate with 25 years of experience in consultative or B2C sales (education industry exposure preferred).
Strong communication, persuasion and relationship-building skills.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
Empathetic listener with ability to build trust and focus on learner success.
Comfortable with CRM tools and basic MS Office proficiency.
AboutCompany:
About upGrad:
upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Our mission is to create a new digital-first learning experience to deliver tangible career impact to individuals at scale. upGrad currently offers programs in Data Science, Machine Learning, Product Management, Digital Marketing, and Entrepreneurship, etc. upGrad is looking for people passionate about management and education to help design learning programs for working professionals to stay sharp and stay relevant and help build the careers of tomorrow.

Description:
Requisition Id: 1747346 React Developer ( Remote )
Job Title: Senior React.js Front-End Developer
Location: Remote
Experience: 4 - 8 Years
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners
About the Role:
We are looking for a talented and experienced React.js Front-End Developer to join our dynamic web development team. You will be responsible for building high-quality, scalable, and performant web applications using React.js, working closely with cross-functional teams including UX/UI designers, backend developers, and product managers.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive web applications using React.js and related front-end technologies.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement pixel-perfect, user-friendly interfaces.
Optimize components for maximum performance across a wide range of devices and browsers.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.
Integrate RESTful APIs and manage state using Redux or Context API.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and continuous integration.
Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing applications as needed.
Mentor junior developers and help improve front-end development processes.
Required Skills Qualifications:
4 - 8 years of professional experience in front-end development using React.js .
Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 , and modern front-end build tools (Webpack, Babel, etc.).
Experience with state management libraries like Redux , Context API , or similar.
Familiarity with RESTful APIs, asynchronous programming, and handling API integrations.
Knowledge of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards.
Experience with version control tools such as Git .
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team.
Good communication skills to coordinate with remote and on-site teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with TypeScript is a plus.
Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or server-side rendering frameworks like Next.js.
Work Environment:
Hybrid working model with a combination of in-office (Mumbai/Bangalore) and remote work.
Collaborative and fast-paced environment focused on innovation and continuous learning.

Description:
Role & responsibilities :
Change Communications Consultant
Job Description
A Change Communications Consultant is responsible for developing and implementing communication strategies that support organizational change initiatives. During periods of change, this role helps keep stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned with organizational goals, ensuring a smooth and successful transition.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with change management teams to understand the impact of change initiatives and develop communication strategies that reduce resistance and drive adoption.
Design and tailor communication approaches for different audiences, translating complex concepts into clear, engaging, and impactful messages.
Create and deliver communication materials to support change programs, including presentations, newsletters, email campaigns, and leadership communications.
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of communication efforts, gathering stakeholder feedback and refining strategies as needed.
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure communication activities are aligned across the organization.
Facilitate communication between leadership, project teams, and employees to maintain transparency and engagement.
Required Skills & Experience
Proven experience in developing and executing communication strategies for organizational change initiatives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong project management and organizational capabilities.
Experience using communication and collaboration tools/platforms.
Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Ability to adapt and thrive in dynamic and evolving environments.
Strategic mindset combined with creative problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience with PTC Windchill and/or PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems.
Automotive industry experience or strong domain knowledge in the automotive sector.
Background in change management or organizational development initiatives.
Change Management certification such as Prosci or ACMP.
Familiarity with digital communication tools and employee engagement platforms.
Experience working in large, complex, and matrixed organizations.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Description:
CCNA CISCO Certification is mandatory. (Candidate must have claer the exam , training certified will not help.)

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners
