Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

ROLE SUMMARY
The Seller Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for acquiring and engaging property owners, conducting field visits, showcasing properties, assisting buyers, and driving successful property transactions. The company provides qualified leads.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property features, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate pricing between buyers and sellers to close deals.
Onboard property owners and encourage premium service subscriptions where applicable.
Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.
Upload property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring excellent customer experience.
ELIGIBILITY
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory
Smart freshers / Experience up to 2 years in field sales.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Bike and valid Driving License.
Smartphone.
Candidates should be comfortable communicating in at least one of the required language combinations: English/Kannada, English/Telugu, English/Tamil, or English/Hindi.

Field Sales ¢ Business Development ¢ Lead Generation ¢ Customer Relationship Management (CRM) ¢ Negotiation ¢ Client Acquisition ¢ Relationship Building ¢ Sales Closing ¢ Site Visits ¢ Communication Skills ¢ Target Achievement ¢ Time Management

Overview
We are seeking experienced individuals with previous exposure on Aviation schemes to join our land development team to work on diverse projects that deliver coordinated designs for landside and airside schemes. Your role

Leading projects from concept design stage through the life cycle of project.

Should be proactive to implement digital tools/systems in projects for a more effective way to deliver projects.
Strong understanding of management processes related to technical integration and associated analytical / investigative approaches.
Strong knowledge and understanding of supporting pan design disciplines such as Engineering Safety Management, Human Factors and Sustainability.
High level of accountability for Technical Delivery
Takes a leadership role and trusted to make decisions, typically at group / team level or within a specific area of the business.
Works autonomously within established procedures and practices.
Welcomes those with different or distinct perspectives, seeking to engage and harness disparate views at all levels of the organization.
About you
Detailed knowledge of the fundamental concepts, principles, and theories of system integration as applied to multi-disciplinary designs.
Project Technical Leader on large or complex multi-disciplinary projects.
Consistently produces concept and feasibility solutions.
Works as a Project Technical Leader on large complex projects / Project Technical Reviewer on large complex projects Driving the right behaviours within organization for digital initiatives to improve business performance productivity.
Professional Head of Discipline or possibly leading a subset technology as Technical Authority.

Description:
SQL DBA Azure
Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Job Summary

Implement data validation, reconciliation, and error-handling mechanisms.

Follow data governance, security, and best development practices.

Description:
Senior Network Test Engineer
Experience: 5 to 10 Years
Work location: Bangalore/ Pune/ Noida

Feature & Protocol Testing: Test network routing features to ensure they work exactly as designed.
Regression Testing: Re test existing features across different software versions to find new bugs or performance drops.
L2 & L3 VPN Testing: Set up and test virtual private networks, ensuring traffic flows correctly and safely between virtual routers.
Lab Setup: Recreate real world customer networks in a lab environment using traffic generators.
Troubleshooting: Find network bugs, analyze packet captures (Wireshark), and work with developers to fix them.
Network automation: Python, Ansible, REST APIs
Technologies:
MPLS Basics: Good understanding of how MPLS works, including LDP and RSVP TE.
VPN Services: Hands on experience testing L3VPNs and L2VPNs (VPLS, VPWS, EVPN).
Routing Protocols: Strong knowledge of how BGP / MP BGP, OSPF, and IS IS build paths and neighbors.
Network Convergence: Experience testing fast failover mechanisms like BFD and FRR (Fast Reroute).
Testing Tools: Experience using hardware traffic tools like Ixia (IxNetwork) or Spirent, along with Wireshark.

Description:
MS Dynamics Developer/Consultant
Location: Pune, India
Experience: 4 to 10 years

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?

In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, configure and customize solutions, and deliver scalable, high-quality applications that align with enterprise standards.
What you will do:
Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing
Create and maintain technical documentation, process documents and support materials
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver reliable solutions
Ensure solutions follow security, compliance and coding best practices
Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations

What you will need to have:

4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field

What would be great to have:
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management
Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards
Microsoft Dynamics certifications
Experience working in an enterprise environment with global teams
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.
Hiring Details
ParameterDetailsActual RoleASM – Area Sales ManagerDesignation for HiringClient AdvisorLocationsBangalore, Hyderabad & DelhiCandidate ProfileFreshersEducationAny GraduationAge LimitUp to 30 years
Why Join NoBroker?
Opportunity to build a career in a fast-paced PropTech environment.
Performance-driven growth opportunities.
Exposure to sales, customer management, negotiation, and business development.

Job Summary
Function SummarySales Manager - Tele Sales role at Axis Max Life Insurance focuses on driving virtual insurance sales through digital platforms. Key responsibilities include conducting virtual meetings, generating leads, and achieving sales targets. The role requires strong communication, relationship management, and customer service skills. Candidates with sales experience in insurance or financial services are preferred. We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Virtual Field Sales Representative to join our insurance sales team. The ideal candidate will leverage technology to conduct virtual meetings and webinars, build relationships, and sell insurance products to potential clients. The role requires excellent communication skills, a self-driven attitude, and a passion for sales in the insurance industry.


Key Responsibilities
Conduct virtual meetings and product presentations to prospective clients via video calls, webinars, or online platforms.
Prospect and generate new leads through digital channels such as social media, emails, and online marketing campaigns.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospects through regular follow-ups and nurturing of relationships.
Provide personalized insurance advice and product recommendations based on customer needs. Achieve sales targets and KPIs by converting leads into policies.
Collaborate with team members and use CRM software to track and report sales activities and progress.
Stay updated on the latest insurance products, industry trends, and regulations to offer the best advice to clients.
Manage customer inquiries and concerns, providing excellent customer service throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to encourage repeat business and referrals.


Key Competencies / Skills
Handling Customer Complaints
Relationship
Leading people
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build rapport via virtual channels
Lead generation
Self-motivated
Organization
Ability to work independently and manage multiple virtual sales processes simultaneously
Knowledge of CRM systems and online sales tools


Qualifications Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred).
Proven experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.

Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P4-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Lead will provide day-to-day operational leadership for telecom provisioning activities covering Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR, and circuit implementation. The role will ensure workload is effectively managed, provisioning milestones are achieved, quality standards are maintained, and operational issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the assigned provisioning workstream.
Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders and critical due dates.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT and delivery performance.
Support team members with telecom, provisioning, process and tool-related questions.
Review complex provisioning issues and guide the team toward resolution.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, ASR, Design, Operations and other internal teams.
Work with carriers/vendors where support or follow-up is required.
Identify delivery risks and take appropriate action before committed dates are impacted.
Ensure process adherence, documentation and inventory updates are completed correctly.
Support knowledge transfer and readiness as activities transition to the India team.
Coach team members and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Drive process improvement and automation opportunities across the workstream.
Provide regular operational updates to management and stakeholders.
Required Skills
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design and/or network implementation.
Good understanding of telecom circuits, carrier provisioning and network operations.
Experience leading or coordinating an operational team.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deliverables.
Strong stakeholder/vendor coordination.
Good communication and confidence in leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership and adaptability.
Good to Have
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals or telecom OSS/BSS systems.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging and operational KPI management.
Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.

Job Title: Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Description:
Skill required: Order to Cash - Order to Cash (OTC)

Designation: Order to Cash Operations New Associate

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:0 to 1 years

About Accenture

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?

You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions.
Optimizing working capital providing real time visibility and end to end management of revenue and cash flow and streamlining billing processes This team over looks the entire processes that starts from customers inquiry sales order to delivery and invoicing The Cash Application Processing team focuses on solving queries related to cash applications and coordination with the customers The role requires a good understanding of cash applications the process of applying unapplied cash reconciliation of suspense account in cash application and process them from payment receipt to finalization
Manage the end-to-end process from order receipt and credit authorization through collections and revenue assurance.

What are we looking for?
Primary skill - Order to Cash (OTC) - P1

Roles and Responsibilities:
In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines.
Your primary interaction is within your own team and your direct supervisor.
In this role you will be given detailed instructions on all tasks.
The decisions that you make impact your own work and are closely supervised.
You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team with a predetermined, narrow scope of work.
Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

Qualification
Any Graduation

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship Job description About the role: We are seeking a highly motivated Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship to join our team, contributing to our efforts in transforming healthcare delivery through Value-Based Care (VBC) initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a strong clinical background, basic understanding of the U.S. healthcare system, and a passion for leveraging data to drive better health outcomes and cost efficiencies. We are looking for individuals who will thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and are keen to significantly grow their skills and knowledge in clinical data analysis, clinical coding, and risk analysis. Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship will work directly with our clinical data analysts, prior authorization and utilization management reviewers, qualified clinical informaticists, and data scientists. This role bridges clinical knowledge with analytics, clinical information exchange, supporting strategic decision-making and operational efficiency across our value-based care programs.
What We Offer:
A challenging and rewarding experience at the intersection of healthcare and technology.
Direct mentorship from experienced clinical informaticists, data scientists, and analysts.
Opportunity to make a tangible impact on Value-Based Care initiatives.
Exposure to cutting-edge tools and methodologies in clinical data analysis.
A collaborative and supportive team environment dedicated to professional growth.
A Day in the Life
Collaborate and Learn: Work alongside clinical data analysts to evaluate and assist in extracting meaningful insights from electronic clinical data.
Data Translation: Assist in the translation of non-standard electronic clinical data into standard clinical codes (e.g., ICD, CPT, SNOMED).
Clinical Review Support: Support reviews of prior authorizations and utilization management guidelines, offering insights from both provider and payer perspectives.
Communication Presentation: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to both clinical and non-clinical stakeholders, effectively translating complex data into actionable strategies.
Process Improvement: Identify and recommend innovative ideas, processes, and/or procedures for enhancements, additions, and modifications to improve existing workflows and processes.
Regulatory Awareness: Research and stay informed on key updates related to CMS, HCC, NCQA, HEDIS, and other regulatory frameworks relevant to VBC and CMMI programs.

What you Need:

Clinical Background: Clinician experienced in direct patient care or clinical experience in a U.S. healthcare setting.
Data Familiarity: Familiarity with data concepts; exposure to SQL, FHIR, or experience working with clinical or claims datasets.
Analytical Aptitude: Demonstrated ability to approach clinical and operational challenges with a data-driven mindset, translating them into data requirements and potential insights.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and clinical problem-solving skills.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex information clearly.
Time Zone Alignment: Ability to work hours aligned with the U.S. Central Time Zone (typically 12:00 PM - 8:30 PM IST / 12:30 PM - 9:00 PM IST). This alignment is critical for real-time collaboration with U.S.-based teams.
Preferred:
Informatics Exposure: Prior exposure to clinical informatics, healthcare IT systems, or population health initiatives.
Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with concepts like HCC coding, risk adjustment, and quality metrics (e.g., HEDIS, STAR ratings).
Advanced Data Skills: More advanced experience with SQL, Python, R, or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Core Competencies
Analytical thinking and clinical problem-solving
Strong communication and presentation skills
Cross-functional collaboration and team orientation
Attention to detail with a systems-thinking mindset
Passion for improving healthcare delivery and outcomes

Benefits

Here s What We Offer
Generous Leaves: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
Parental Leave: Leverage one of industrys best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break Weve got you covered. Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
Care Program: Whether it s a celebration or a time of need, we ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

Job Summary
Function SummarySales Manager - Tele Sales role at Axis Max Life Insurance focuses on driving virtual insurance sales through digital platforms. Key responsibilities include conducting virtual meetings, generating leads, and achieving sales targets. The role requires strong communication, relationship management, and customer service skills. Candidates with sales experience in insurance or financial services are preferred.
Job SummaryWe are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Virtual Field Sales Representative to join our insurance sales team. The ideal candidate will leverage technology to conduct virtual meetings and webinars, build relationships, and sell insurance products to potential clients. The role requires excellent communication skills, a self-driven attitude, and a passion for sales in the insurance industry.


Key Responsibilities
Conduct virtual meetings and product presentations to prospective clients via video calls, webinars, or online platforms.
Prospect and generate new leads through digital channels such as social media, emails, and online marketing campaigns.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospects through regular follow-ups and nurturing of relationships.
Provide personalized insurance advice and product recommendations based on customer needs.
Achieve sales targets and KPIs by converting leads into policies.
Collaborate with team members and use CRM software to track and report sales activities and progress.
Stay updated on the latest insurance products, industry trends, and regulations to offer the best advice to clients.
Manage customer inquiries and concerns, providing excellent customer service throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to encourage repeat business and referrals.


Key Competencies/ skill required
Handling Customer Complaints
Relationship, Leading people, Effective


Desired qualification and experience
Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred).
Proven experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build rapport via virtual channels.
Self-motivated with a high level of professionalism and organization.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple virtual sales processes simultaneously.
Knowledge of CRM systems and online sales tools.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Direct customer service and sales to existing MLI customers through relationship building. Existing Customer database will be provided by company (called the Book of Relations- BoR).
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Service through relationship management
• Establishing and strengthening relationship with the allocated customer base.
• Ensure retention of customers in his/her allocated Book of Relations (existing customer database).
• Act as single point of contact for customers for any customer query/complaint.
• Identify financial goals of customers and providing financial planning assistance.
• Competition Analysis for giving professional advice to customer
• Fix self appointments everyday from the given customer database as per the campaign
Sales
• Focus on cross-sell & up-sell opportunity in allocated customers.
Ensure successful completion of licensing as per MLI standards
Measures of Success
• TAT adherence for updating System - CRM Next
• Successful completion of cross-sell/ up-sell Business Goals month on month
• Collection of payment/premium from 91-180 days due policies
• Complaint Resolution /Customer satisfaction
• Achievement of Retention Targets.
• > 45 unique customer meetings in a month
• More than 90% attendance (of total working days)
• Successfully score >=80% in the Functional Trainings imparted
Key Relationships (Internal /External)
• Internal – HR/Trainers/Supervisors/Peers
• External- Customers
Key competencies/skills required
• Process & Result orientation
• Customer centricity & relationship building
• Basic Computer Knowledge.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center in Bangalore is seeking a HW Test bench Lead- maintenance role.
In this role, you will manage Test Bench/ Automated Test Equipments maintenance and sustenance activities, which includes conducting scheduled maintenance procedure, inspecting, and troubleshooting test bench equipment.
These test benches primarily support various Thales defense applications and its products.

Essential skills:
Test Bench Hardware systems knowledge such as COTS Test and measurement instruments from different OEMs including NI Hardware including PXI systems, Industrial PC (PICMG SBC ) and VME systems.
5 +yrs Experience in handling various interface form factors such as PCI, PCIE, PCIe, CPCI, PXI, PXIe, VME etc.
Experience in Test Bench development or maintenance using COTS test measurement equipment, custom designed interface test adapters, PCBAs
Experience of testing avionics communication interfaces/buses such as MIL-STD-1553B, ARINC 429 , Serial RS 485 / 422, CAN etc is desirable.
Experience on interface cards such as Discrete IO, Analog, serial (RS232/422/482), synchro etc on various form factors listed above.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Experience in testing and knowledge of test equipment for measurement and control.
Hands on experience in handing various measuring tools such as Digital Oscilloscope, Function / wave generators up to 18GHz, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters etc.
Experience in analyzing / understanding electrical schematics, Cable Harness drawings and block diagrams.

Responsibilities:
As a maintenance engineer you will be responsible for undertaking periodic maintenance procedure and ensure the test system / bench are reliable.
Identify faults, efficiency and safety issues.
Respond to equipment breakdowns, provide first line diagnostic and arrange repairs or replacements.
Execute functional tests and validate the results against established standards
Perform quality inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
Should work closely with multi discipline teams and organize to fix the issues.
Preparation of the associated report and log maintenance to keep track of tasks
Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
Should be able to estimate and monitor costs of maintenance.

Role MDM Architect
Locations – Pune | Bangalore | NCR | Hyderabad
Your Responsibilities includes, but not limited to:
Understand the technical landscape current as well as desired future state Assess the current state architecture & understand current business processes for managing Master Data Management solutions.
Assess the functional and non-functional requirements of desired future state MDM solution Prepare the to-be architecture including data ingestion, data quality rules, data model, match/merge, workflows, UI, batch integration and real-time services.
Extensive hands-on experience in installation and configuration of core Informatica MDM Hub components such as Hub console, Hub Store, Hub Server, Cleanse/Match Server and Cleanse Adaptor.
Ability to deliver full lifecycle MDM projects for clients including Data modeling, Metadata management, design and configuration of matching and merging rules, design and configuration of standardizing, cleansing and deduplication rules.
Create Design Document and data models addressing business needs for the client MDM environment - Contribute to creating reusable assets and accelerators for MDM platforms.
Will also be involved in integration/transfer of data across multiple systems, streamlining data processes and providing access to MDM data across the enterprise.
Make technology decisions related to the Client MDM environment & Interpret requirements and architect MDM solutions.
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream system.
Coordinate with Project Managers and participate in project planning and recurring meetings.
Collaborate with other team members to review prototypes and develop iterative revisions.
Must have Skills:
12+ years of experience & should have hands on experience of working in MDM Projects and hands on experience in one or more MDM tools like Informatica or Reltio and has expertise in defining matching/ merging & survivor-ship rules.
Should have strong commercial knowledge of key business processes & compliance requirements within Pharma Industry across multiple master data domains like Physician & Product
Hands on experience in industry data quality tools like Informatica IDQ, IBM Data Quality.
Must be proficient reading and understanding data models and experience working with data and databases.
Strong technical experience in the areas of Master Data Management, Meta data management, Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Integration (ETL) and Data Security
Experience with (all stages of MDM SDLC) planning, designing, building, deploying and maintaining scalable, highly available, mission critical enterprise-wide applications for large enterprises
Should have experience in integrating MDM with Data Warehouses and Data Lakes
Excellent query writing skills with Working knowledge of Oracle, SQL server, and other major databases
Good knowledge of SOA/Real-time integration, Pub-Sub Model and Data Integration with Various CRM systems like Veeva, Siebel.
Expertise in engaging with business users to understand the business requirements and articulate the value proposition.
Should have experience working with 3rd Party Data Providers like IQVIA, SHS, Veeva etc
Solid experience in configuring 3rd Party Address standardization tools Like or Tools Similar to Address Doctor, Loqate
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream systems
Possesses excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, innovative presentation skills
Experience with RFP/RFI and pre-sales
Education:
BE/B.Tech/MCA/BCA/BSC CS with 60%+
Why Axtria: -
Axtria (www.Axtria.com) is truly a New-Age Software Product Unicorn, a first of its kind in providing the cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences industry globally. We help Life Sciences companies transform the product commercialization journey to drive sales growth and improve healthcare outcomes for patients. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of patients and lead passionately to improve their lives.
Since our founding in 2010, technology innovation has been our winning differentiation, and we continue to leapfrog competition with platforms that deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Our cloud-based platforms - Axtria DataMAX™, Axtria InsightsMAX™, Axtria SALESIQ™, Axtria CUSTOMERIQ™ and Axtria MarketingIQ- enable customers to efficiently manage data, leverage data science to deliver insights for sales and marketing planning and manage end-to-end commercial operations. With customers in over 20 countries, Axtria is one of the biggest global commercial solutions providers in the Life Sciences industry. We continue to win industry recognition for growth and are featured in some of the most aspirational lists - INC 5000,

Description:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
5-10 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions

Description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Cadence Design Systems is seeking Analog CAD engineers to support the growing analog design and custom layout team building IP using the Cadence design tools (Virtuoso, Pegasus, Quantus, etc. ) to build high speed interfaces used in chips found in cars, cell phones, data centers, etc.
You will get the opportunity to collaborate with circuit implementation experts to contribute to the development of exciting chips, work with the best-in-class EDA tools and interact with the Cadence engineers using developing those tools to improve those tools.
Analog CAD tasks
The Analog CAD team is a part of the Cadence Design IP development group responsible for supporting the design and layout teams as they design analog IP circuits. They support the design teams in the different steps of the design and layout flow: design capture, pre and post-layout simulation, optimization, layout, EM/IR analysis, thermal analysis, reliability, 2. 5D and 3D IC, etc.
We also collaborate with the best in class tools developed by Cadence to improve them and tailor them to our needs.
We also build tools to help increase the efficiency of the teams and the quality of the circuits. We collaborate with the teams to improve their flows and design methodologies.

Additional
BSEE, MSEE
Previous experience in Analog CAD support
Very good understanding of circuit design and layout design
Exposure to Cadence Virtuoso Layout and physical verification tools is a plus
Team player, driven, self-motivated, innovative and autonomous
Excellent communication, presentation and customer service skills
We re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can t.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
As Wastewater Modeller, you will be working on diverse range of sewerage related projects that deliver sustainable benefits to communities and the environment through a range of public and private sector clients.
Your role
Perform a role bringing together hydraulic modelling (1D-2D) and engineering aspects of the project. You will have to understand the engineering constraints and opportunities associated with modelling solutions to drainage problems to ensure model outputs are realistic.
Undertake technical work including hydraulic modelling like model build (1D - 2D), model verification, evaluation, feasibility, optioneering and outline design of solutions.
Understand the client requirements and deliver the work in smarter way by developing some automation tools along with high quality.
Demonstrate high standards deliverables by adopting various self-check methods and documentations.
Assist with project management and take a proactive approach to managing client relationships, clarifying expectations and outcome measures in order to meet their requirements and deliver successful projects.
Support wider business lines and develop and strengthen internal team.
About you
Has a Bachelor or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or Water Resources or Environmental engineering or Geology or Geography.
10+ years of experience in hydraulic design or modelling.
Working towards achieving chartership with appropriate institution (i.e. ICE, CIWEM).
Good working knowledge or experience of Infowork ICM, Mapinfo, QGIS, Sewer Gems, HEC-RAS, MicroDrainage or similar.
A strong, self-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
Good communication writing skills.
Flexible to adopt new work /challenge work as per business requirement.
Reward benefits
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis

Your role

Description:
Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.


Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

An Executive - Operations is responsible for overseeing the day - to - day operations of a company to ensure efficiency, profitability, and growth. Some of the key responsibilities for this role include : 1. Developing and implementing operational strategies. 2. Monitoring and analyzing operational metrics to identify areas for improvement and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 3. Express their operations strategies & objectives to make sure that the company which they are working for reaches its target and operates effectively. 4. Strong leadership and problem - solving skills, as well as the ability to analyze data and make informed decisions, are essential for success in this role.

Disclaimer : This job description has been sourced from a public domain and may have been modified by Naukri. com to improve clarity for our users. We encourage job seekers to verify all details directly with the employer via their official channels before applying.
AboutCompany:
Startek is a global provider of customer experience management and business process outsourcing solutions, serving industries such as telecom, healthcare, banking, and retail. The company offers services including customer care, technical support, collections, and back-office operations, leveraging digital technologies and analytics to enhance client engagement. With a strong presence in India and worldwide, Startek focuses on delivering scalable, cost-effective, and high-quality outsourcing solutions. Its operations firmly position it within the BPO & customer experience management industry.

Description:
Position: SALES MANAGER
Department: BROADCAST & AV
Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Noida, Mumbai, Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: HOD Sales
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Manager with a strong background in the Audio Visual (AV) and Broadcast Industry.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities, managing key customer accounts, and achieving revenue targets.
The candidate should have a proven track record in B2B sales and an established network within the AV and Broadcast ecosystem
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales of the company's AV and Broadcast products, solutions, and services across the assigned territory.
Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities while expanding the company's customer base.
Manage and grow relationships with key accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction and long-term business partnerships.
Prepare and execute strategic sales plans to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.
Collaborate with the technical and pre-sales teams to develop customized AV and Broadcast solutions for customers.
Maintain accurate customer records, sales pipelines, forecasts, and activity reports in the ERP/CRM system.
Required Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
5-10 years of sales experience, with a minimum of 35 years in the AV and Broadcast Industry (mandatory).
Proven experience in selling AV, Broadcast, Pro AV, Media Technology, or related solutions.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience working with leading AV or Broadcast equipment manufacturers, distributors, or system integrators.
Strong understanding of AV technologies, broadcast workflows, IP-based solutions, digital signage, video conferencing, streaming, and media infrastructure.
Highly motivated, customer-focused, and capable of managing complex sales cycles and key accounts independently.

Company: Mastek Limited

About Us:
Mastek Limited is a trusted digital engineering and cloud transformation partner for enterprises across the globe. The company focuses on delivering business value through technology, combining deep domain expertise with modern engineering practices. Teams at Mastek collaborate in an inclusive environment that values integrity, learning, and innovation. Mastek is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where every individual is respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. We are looking for a Workday HCM Functional Consultant with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in the Workday Payroll module

Key Responsibilities
Configure and support Workday HCM and Payroll modules.
Gather requirements and translate business needs into Workday solutions.
Configure Business Processes, Security, Compensation, Absence, and Time Tracking.
Handle Payroll configuration, processing, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
Support Workday implementations, enhancements, testing, and production support.
Collaborate with HR, Payroll, IT, and technical teams on integrations and EIBs.
Support UAT, regression testing, Workday releases, and issue resolution.

Required Skills
3+ years of hands-on Workday HCM experience.
Strong Workday Payroll experience is mandatory.
Knowledge of Core HCM, Business Processes, Security, Compensation, and Absence.
Experience with Workday Reports, EIBs, and Integrations.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Workday HCM/Payroll certification preferred.

Description:
Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled Spark Scala Engineer with 5-7 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining large-scale data processing applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Apache Spark, Scala, AWS services, and hands-on experience working on data migration projects. Experience with MongoDB schema validation, cloud-native architectures, and data pipeline optimization is highly desirable.
Roles & Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize scalable batch and real-time data processing solutions using Apache Spark and Scala.
Build and maintain robust data ingestion frameworks for processing high-volume data from multiple source systems.
Participate in large-scale data migration projects, including data analysis, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
Develop and manage ETL/ELT pipelines using AWS services such as EMR, S3, and Step Functions.
Analyze and resolve data quality issues, ensure data consistency, and support production troubleshooting.
Work closely with business stakeholders, data architects, and cross-functional teams to gather and translate requirements into technical solutions.
Implement monitoring, logging, and performance tuning of Spark applications.
Perform schema design, validation, and data modeling activities in MongoDB.
Conduct root cause analysis for data ingestion and processing issues and implement preventive measures.
Ensure adherence to coding standards, security guidelines, and best practices.
Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Skills
3-6 years of hands-on experience in Scala and Apache Spark development.
Strong experience in building ETL/Data Ingestion pipelines.
Extensive knowledge of AWS Cloud Services, including:
Amazon EMR
Amazon S3
AWS Step Functions
IAM and CloudWatch (preferred)
Experience working on data migration projects involving legacy-to-cloud or platform modernization initiatives.
Strong SQL skills and experience with large-scale data processing.
Hands-on experience with MongoDB, including:
Schema design
Schema validation
Data modeling
Query optimization
Experience in handling structured and semi-structured datasets (JSON, CSV, Avro, Parquet, etc.).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Agile development methodologies.
l scripting for automating tasks.

Drive acquisition of new unsecured loan customers from open market
Identify quality leads from unsecured loans liabilities customers through assessments by analyzing credit histories and performing financial analysis, ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations

Customer

Skills: elevator systems, troubleshooting, testing and commissioning, AES and Safety Tests, PM Audits, customer relationship management, spare parts inventory control, MIS reports, Service Operations Technical Leadership
Description:
Job Details
Company: Birla Elevators Limited - Birla Group
Location: Guwahati, Assam
Job Type: Full time
Language: English, Hindi


Responsibilities
Service Operations Technical Leadership: Plan, allocate and supervise daily PM schedules, breakdown call, route rationalization/route loading to ensure timely and high-quality service delivery.
Monitor response time, shutdown duration, call-back trends and implement corrective actions to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
Guide technicians in troubleshooting and repair activities, providing on-site technical support for complex faults.
Conduct AES and Safety Tests, PM Audits, ensure proper documentation of all the audits and safety tests, equipment inspections and other statutory requirements.
Reporting of Incidents and Near Missed in line with the company s process.
Organize service inspections of new installation units prior to handover to customers and ensure that incomplete jobs are not handed over.
Business Development - AMC, Repair Modernization Support Service Sales Team to drive revenue growth through proactive selling of AMCs, Spares, Repair and Modernization packages to new and existing customers.
Identify upgrade and modernization opportunities during AES and service visits, prepare inputs for proposals, book the SRM orders and ensure timely closure.
Improve service quality to ensure timely AMC renewal follow-up, collection of pending dues and promotion of OEM spares and value-added services to enhance customer loyalty.
Customer Relationship Management: Act as the single point of contact for key customers in the territory, handling escalations, service reviews and communication on equipment performance.
Conduct regular review meetings, non-price visits and performance presentations to strengthen long-term partnerships and understand future customer needs.
Coordinate internally to ensure commitments on response time, uptime and quality are met, and that customer complaints are resolved promptly and effectively.
People Management, Training and Vendor Development: Organize, mentor and develop the service team, including technicians, through regular coaching, performance reviews and skill-gap analysis.
Plan and conduct technical, safety and behavioural training for field staff, ensuring adherence to safe work practices and service standards.
Process, Inventory Compliance: Implement and sustain company service processes, documentation standards and digital tools for call logging, work order closure, billing and collection.
Oversee spare parts planning, ordering, inventory control and consumption analysis to support uptime targets and cost optimization.
Prepare and present MIS reports and periodic reviews to the Head Office team covering service KPIs, revenue performance, safety, quality and improvement plans.


Qualifications
Diploma in Electrical Engineering is mandatory.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering preferred.


Experience
Minimum 15 years of experience in the elevator industry for Diploma Engineers or 10 Years for Graduate Engineers with strong exposure to service, repairs and modernization.
Thorough knowledge of elevator systems, troubleshooting, testing and commissioning across multiple control and drive technologies.
Proven track record of leading service teams and delivering results in a demanding field environment.


Predicted Key Skills
elevator systems
troubleshooting
testing and commissioning
AES and Safety Tests
PM Audits
customer relationship management
spare parts inventory control
MIS reports
Service Operations Technical Leadership

Description:
Ambulance Operations Management
Monitor daily ambulance operations and ensure uninterrupted service delivery.
Ensure proper deployment and availability of ambulances at designated locations.
Monitor ambulance movement, response time and operational performance.
Coordinate with the control room for efficient ambulance allocation and dispatch.
Manpower Supervision
Supervise EMTs, drivers and other ambulance personnel at assigned locations.
Monitor staff attendance, duty rosters, punctuality and shift management.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and arrange replacements in case of absenteeism.
Conduct regular briefings and guide field staff on operational requirements.

Identify operational gaps and take corrective action.
Ensure proper maintenance of operational records and documentation.

Prepare and submit daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including ambulance availability, response time and manpower deployment.
Coordinate with Project Managers, Regional Teams and Control Room personnel.
Escalate operational challenges and critical incidents to the reporting authority.

Managing relationship with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting target through Bank s FOS

Excellent Relationship Skill
Managing Various level of Bank Management
Adherence to Process

Graduate in Any Discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved College and University.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales, experience in Insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Description:
Job Summary
Function SummaryThe agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Key Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects
Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s)
Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience , At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year
