Description:
Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.

Description:
Job Summary
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service need b)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects
Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s)
Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.


Measures of Success
Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience , At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
Job Summary
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the Assistant Manager drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities
Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.
Support supplier onboarding, vendor enablement, and supplier due diligence activities.
Manage supplier governance programs, MSA renewals, performance reviews, and compliance obligations.
Ensure adherence to risk, compliance, and third-party governance frameworks, escalating issues where required.
Support procurement and sourcing activities, including supplier evaluations and governance approvals.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and analytics on contracts, suppliers, compliance, and performance metrics.
Coordinate audit reviews, remediation activities, invoice governance, and payment-related issue resolution.
Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder training, and continuous enhancement of contract management practices.
Ariba supply chain management life cycle
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrates expertise in leveraging advanced analytics platforms and visualization tools (such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar) to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
High degree of professionalism and integrity
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 6 - 8 years work experience in professional services industry.
Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
What we look for
Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, MS office (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a must)

Description:
Job Summary
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation
Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts
Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash
Strong written and verbal communication skills able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Power BI report and dashboard development 57 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations 57 years.
ELK stack data analysis Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development 35 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores 57 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
STS Cross-Function Reporting Analyst
EY Technology:
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 450,000 people in more than 160 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connect to our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated into the client services we deliver and are key to us being more innovative as an organization.
EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
Client Technology (CT) focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
Enterprise Technology (ET) - ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on better user experience.
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protects EY and client data, and our information management systems.
The opportunity
The Cross-Function Support Reporting Analyst partners closely across the Security Technology Services (STS) organization and Information Security to support and management of Security products and services. This includes analytics and reporting, service reviews, service improvements, service transition, introduction and readiness, and other activities as identified pertaining to end-to-end service management of internal security technology offerings.
Your key responsibilities
Analyse and interpret security tools data to generate various reports.
Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations to present security metrics to stakeholders.
Collaborate with various security support teams to gather data and insights for reporting purposes.
Monitor reports and dashboard to ensure data accuracy and relevance.
Prepare regular and ad-hoc reports for management.
Identify trends and patterns in security data to inform decision-making.
Skills and attributes for success
Conceptual knowledge of security applications and technologies, as well as operating system platforms including Cloud technologies
Proficiency in Azure Cloud services, with a strong understanding of Azure security tools such as Azure Security Center, Azure Monitor, and Azure Sentinel
Advanced knowledge in Power BI and connecting it with various data sources, including Azure platform, SQL databases and other models.
Knowledge in scripting (Python) and API would be an added benefit
Analytical acumen and solution orientation to provide recommendations to teams and leaders in support of avoiding financial, operational, and security risks to EY and our customers
Build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically and culturally dispersed organization
Possess knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) to drive compliance in Incident, Problem, and Change processes and drive as necessary
To qualify for the role, you must have
Degree in Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent work experience
5 - 7 years working within Information Technology in a global firm
Advance knowledge in Power BI and DAX
Knowledge of Azure Data Explorer, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Log Analytics
Working knowledge of data analysis programming or scripting languages, such as Python (with libraries like pandas, NumPy) or PowerShell
Experience with Azure SQL and database management systems for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Certifications in data visualization or analytics platforms.
What we look for
Critical thinking skills demonstrating analytical and systematic approach to problem solving, data quality validation, business insights generation
Experience working in a global virtual environment
Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
Experience in Stakeholder Management Data Storytelling
Good judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
Ability to understand and integrate cultural differences and motives and to work with cross cultural teams.
Ability to deal with ambiguity and change, and exercise appropriate time management to meet deadlines
Ability to work autonomously but also within a team environment where necessary
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world

Supervising Associate - Strategy Execution Operations
Role brief
Provide end-to-end operational, reporting and data insights, CRM, integrated planning and enablement support to Europe Central MFA and Clients Industries Enablement Leader. The role coordinates business processes, end to end planning support, strengthens CRM adoption and pipeline governance, translates revenue, sales and pipeline data into actionable management insights, supports regional and Business Unit priorities, and drives consistent knowledge-sharing and process documentation across geographically dispersed teams.
Business requirements / key responsibilities
Integrated planning support
Coordinate and support integrated planning cycles, including planning calendars, stakeholder communications, query resolution and consolidation of planning inputs across relevant countries and Business Units.
Contribute to planning discussions by connecting account information and business priorities to support informed target setting and execution follow-through.
Track planning milestones, dependencies, submissions and follow-ups; escalate data gaps or timeline risks and provide clear status updates to stakeholders
Support preparation, validation and maintenance of planning reports and related files, ensuring alignment between agreed planning goals, account priorities and regional reporting requirements.
Take the lead role in Account refresh by communicating and coordinating across various Business Units.
Reporting, analytics business insights
Prepare, review and maintain recurring revenue, sales and pipeline reporting, dashboards and analytical outputs for stakeholders and leadership discussions.
Analyze CRM and Markets data to identify trends, wins, pipeline movements, data-quality issues and business insights; translate findings into clear management-ready updates.
Support KPI management and customized reporting requirements using data extracts and other reporting platforms like essentials and ThoughtSpot, Excel-based analysis and dashboards, while maintaining accuracy and consistency of source data.
Accounts, Markets Operations regional support
Support Markets Operations activities spanning account records, ARD/MDM-related administration, unassigned mapping, account and market-segment updates, and other region-specific operational requirements.
Provide operational and analytical support to Europe Central leadership and Business Units, adapting established practices across BUs and supporting regional priorities as operating models evolve.
Support account-centric and Markets reporting requirements by applying knowledge of GTER, margin, sales, pipeline and related market-performance concepts.
CRM governance, adoption user support
Support CRM adoption, governance, reporting and user enablement across business stakeholders, including functional guidance, access-related support, usage protocols and release awareness.
Maintain and strengthen CRM operating practices by documenting processes, sharing guidance and ensuring users understand relevant tools and protocols.
Sales, pipeline governance data quality
Drive pipeline hygiene and governance activities, including review and follow-up of lapsed, and lapsing opportunities, opportunity qualification, stage/status accuracy and other data-quality exceptions.
Coordinate stakeholder follow-ups and updates to improve pipeline reliability and support timely opportunity maintenance across relevant Business Units and market segments.
Stakeholder workstream management
Act as a key coordination point across business stakeholders, CRM users, regional teams and internal support groups; manage communications, follow-ups, dependencies and issue resolution across workstreams.
Plan and coordinate recurring activities, meetings, documentation and status updates; proactively identify risks, data gaps and process-improvement opportunities and drive actions to closure.
Build strong working relationships with geographically dispersed stakeholders and translate business requirements into practical operational, reporting and enablement deliverables.
Process improvement technology enablement
Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize recurring work through improved templates, structured governance, Power Query/macros, dashboards and other suitable automation or digital approaches.
Support testing, adoption and business-impact assessment of relevant CRM/reporting changes and evolving tools; capture feedback and convert it into process or enablement improvements.
Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)
Experience and qualifications
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration and Management) with 8 to 12 years of work experience
Experience working with senior stakeholders and geographically dispersed teams, with the ability to manage multiple recurring and ad-hoc priorities.
Mandatory skills attributes
Strong CRM and sales/pipeline management understanding, including opportunity lifecycle, pipeline hygiene, data governance and user support.
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify anomalies and trends, and convert findings into business insights.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Mercury-related opportunity processes, Excel and reporting/dashboard environments; strong capability with PowerPoint and business presentations.
Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and written/verbal communication skills; comfortable coordinating across regions, Business Units and senior stakeholder groups.
High ownership and attention to detail, with the ability to operate with minimal supervision, prioritize competing demands and drive workstreams end to end.
Ability to participate in and facilitate meetings, develop presentations, interpret data, generate meaningful business insights, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.
Process orientation with a continuous-improvement mindset
Business acumen and adaptability, with the ability to quickly understand evolving operating models, regional priorities and changing customer expectations.
Desired skills
Experience with Power Query, MS office (Power BI, MS Excel, MS PPT and MS Word) or similar analytics and productivity tools.
Change-management and release-adoption experience for CRM, reporting or other enterprise platforms.
Experience developing training materials and facilitating user orientation, refresher or knowledge-transfer sessions.
Exposure to account management, end to end planning, market-performance metrics, market-share analysis or business-development operations.
Role outcomes
Well-coordinated integrated planning cycles supported by complete inputs, validated data, visible milestones and timely follow-up.
Effective coordination across regional and Business Unit stakeholders, with risks, dependencies and follow-ups actively managed.
Reliable Accounts, CRM, revenue, sales and pipeline information for stakeholders and leadership.
Improved consistency of CRM adoption, pipeline governance and data-quality practices.

Supervising Associate
Private Equity Compliance Regulatory Management Support
Discipline
Clients Industries
Role Type
PE CoE - Private Equity Compliance Regulatory Management Support
Business unit specific description - PE CoE (UKI)
The Private Equity Center of Excellence supports the firm in managing independence, compliance and regulatory requirements associated with major UK-headquartered private equity groups and their portfolio entities. The team helps protect the firm by proactively monitoring proposed engagements and business relationships across service lines and supporting compliance with applicable SEC, EU, UK and EY independence requirements.
The Supervising Associate combines hands-on delivery with day-to-day team oversight across assigned PE accounts. The role coordinates regulatory procedures, account structures, research, reporting and stakeholder actions while maintaining high standards of accuracy, timeliness, documentation and professional judgement. The individual works closely with Market Segment Managers, account teams, Partners, senior management and internal risk stakeholders, and provides clear updates, practical guidance and timely escalation of issues.
Your key responsibilities
Lead day-to-day delivery across assigned PE accounts and related workstreams, taking ownership of priorities, timelines, dependencies and outcomes.
Support quarterly Independence Summary Memo procedures, including the initial review of submissions and supporting documentation to confirm required procedures are completed.
Establish and maintain account-level structures, trackers and documentation that enable account teams to meet regulatory and independence requirements.
Reconcile relevant systems and account information to confirm PE group and portfolio structures are accurately reflected.
Monitor press releases, industry announcements and research sources for acquisitions, disposals and other changes affecting focus accounts.
Support public and private company independence procedures for acquisitions and respond to general independence queries relating to PE accounts.
Plan and allocate work across team members, monitor progress and capacity, and ensure agreed deliverables are completed on time.
Perform detailed quality reviews, challenge incomplete or inconsistent outputs and ensure review points are resolved before submission.
Act as a key contact for routine stakeholder matters, communicate status clearly, manage expectations and escalate complex issues or risks promptly.
Facilitate team and stakeholder discussions, convert decisions into clear actions, assign ownership and drive follow-through to closure.
Collate leadership action points and support program and project coordination, management information and workload visibility.
Identify recurring issues, control gaps and improvement opportunities, and lead practical enhancements to processes, trackers, reporting, automation and knowledge materials.
Provide first-level guidance, coaching and constructive feedback to team members, promoting consistent ways of working, knowledge sharing and professional standards.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience with business, company, and market research platforms such as Bloomberg, LexisNexis, Factiva, Merger Market, Dun Bradstreet (DB), or similar tools.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to analyse synthesize, and clearly present research findings and insights to stakeholders.
Prior exposure to account, client, or master data management systems, along with experience using account or relationship management platforms.
Experience supporting compliance processes, including compliance work papers, due diligence activities, checklists, governance reviews, and policy adherence.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, SEC guidelines, compliance policies, risk management, or governance-related activities.
Exposure to AML, financial crime or stock market-related domains would be considered as an added advantage.
Experience with SharePoint content management, newsletters, surveys or knowledge repositories.
Experience using automation, artificial intelligence or emerging technologies to improve process efficiency, data quality and business insight.
Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and understand the objectives of different programs and initiatives.
Excellent analytical and reporting skills, including the ability to review, validate and interpret data; develop reports or dashboards; identify trends; and provide practical insights.
Strong presentation and facilitation capability, including leading discussions, preparing clear presentations and communicating insights to business stakeholders.
Ability to work with minimal supervision, prioritize effectively, manage competing demands and adapt to changing business expectations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working with business leaders and senior stakeholders.
Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerBI and PowerPoint skills, including pivot tables, lookups, filtering, conditional formatting, validation, charts, and professional slide formatting.
High degree of professionalism, integrity and sound judgement.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A graduate or postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Finance, Information and Data Science, or a related discipline.
Approximately 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in financial services, professional services, business process management, consulting, research and/or corporate strategy.
Demonstrated experience coordinating projects, reviewing deliverables and working effectively with multiple stakeholders.
Proven ability to analyse information, produce high-quality reports or presentations and communicate clear business insights.
Experience supporting business leaders or leadership groups in a deadline-driven environment.
What we look for
A delivery-focused professional who can balance hands-on execution with team oversight, prioritization, review and stakeholder communication.
A solution-oriented and adaptable thinker who can navigate ambiguity, identify risks or opportunities and make well-reasoned day-to-day decisions.
A collaborative team contributor who builds capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, constructive feedback and consistent quality expectations.
A self-motivated learner with strong interpersonal and cultural awareness, able to build trusted relationships across diverse teams.
Someone who maintains a broad view of account priorities, operational risks and dependencies while ensuring detailed execution remains accurate and timely.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Oracle Fusion Program / Project Manager - Manager
(Oracle Fusion Implementation, OUM, Agile Program Governance)
Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Program / Project Manager at Manager level with proven, hands-on experience leading end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation projects across ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, or related workstreams. The ideal candidate will be well versed in Oracle Unified Method (OUM), Application Implementation Methodology (AIM), Testing and Change Management (TCM), Agile and hybrid delivery models, and the complete project lifecycle. The role requires strong ownership of program governance, integrated planning, financial and resource management, RAID and dependency management, executive status reporting, and client discussions from mobilization through go-live and Hypercare.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation programs from mobilisation, discovery, design, configuration, build, testing, deployment, go-live, Hypercare, and transition to support.
Create and manage integrated program plans covering scope, milestones, workstreams, critical paths, dependencies, resources, budgets, environments, deliverables, and release schedules.
Apply and tailor OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches based on project complexity, contractual commitments, and client governance requirements.
Establish program governance, decision rights, escalation paths, stage gates, quality controls, meeting cadence, and reporting standards across functional and technical workstreams.
Own RAID management by identifying, assessing, assigning, tracking, mitigating, escalating, and closing risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies with clear owners and due dates.
Prepare and present weekly and monthly status reports, executive dashboards, steering committee packs, milestone health, effort and budget variance, resource outlook, decision logs, and recovery plans.
Lead client workshops, governance meetings, scope and design discussions, status reviews, risk escalations, steering committees, and executive communications, driving timely decisions and stakeholder alignment.
Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, change requests, contracts, and deliverable acceptance while protecting project outcomes and commercial commitments.
Coordinate solution design, configuration, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, testing, change management, training, cutover, and business readiness across all workstreams.
Drive fit-to-standard adoption, design governance, traceability, deliverable quality, defect closure, cutover rehearsals, go-live criteria, and production stabilisation.
Prepare, baseline, maintain, and control Microsoft Project Plan (MPP) schedules, including work breakdown structures, task dependencies, milestones, critical paths, resource assignments, progress updates, schedule variance, forecasting, and management reporting.
Manage system integrators, Oracle, third-party vendors, internal teams, and client stakeholders, ensuring accountability for scope, timelines, service levels, and quality.
Job Requirements:
Minimum 10 years of overall experience, including at least 5 years in project or program management and proven hands-on leadership of multiple end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations.
Strong delivery experience across one or more Oracle Fusion domains such as ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, Procurement, Projects, or cross-pillar transformation programs.
Thorough knowledge of OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid project lifecycles.
Demonstrated experience establishing governance, PMO controls, steering committees, stage gates, design authority, change control, delivery cadence, and quality assurance.
Strong command of scope, schedule, budget, effort, forecasting, resource capacity, dependency, critical-path, milestone, and benefits tracking.
Hands-on expertise in RAID logs, issue resolution, risk mitigation, decision logs, assumptions, actions, change requests, recovery plans, and executive escalation management.
Experience managing requirements, design, Conference Room Pilots, configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, defect management, security, training, cutover, go-live, Hypercare, and support transition.
Mandatory real hands-on expertise in Microsoft Project and MPP files, including creating and managing detailed schedules, baselines, dependencies, critical paths, milestones, resources, actuals, remaining work, slippage, variance, and forecasts.
Ability to generate schedule, milestone, resource, cost, and executive status reports directly from MPP and explain schedule health, delays, impacts, and recovery actions to senior stakeholders.
Strong client-facing experience, including leading difficult discussions, negotiating priorities, managing expectations, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving decisions and closure.
Experience managing distributed teams, system integrators, vendors, subcontractors, and business stakeholders across locations and time zones.
PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project/program management certification is preferred.
Competencies / Skills:
Strong leadership, ownership, commercial awareness, and delivery discipline, with the ability to maintain control in complex and high-pressure programs.
Excellent client communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict resolution, presentation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to translate strategic objectives into executable plans, measurable milestones, clear accountability, and outcome-focused governance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with sound judgement in prioritisation, decisions, risk response, and program recovery.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, schedule, budget, compliance, and stakeholder confidence.
Must have a valid passport.
Willing to work in MENA shift timings, Sunday to Thursday.
Willing to work at client sites and undertake business travel as required.
Education:
B.Tech, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. An MBA is preferred. Relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud and project/program management certifications are advantageous.

EY- Assurance - Manager
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
Your key responsibilities
Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team s expectations
Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team s skills.
Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.
Skills and attributes for success
Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
Experience in either
Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
Big 4 Firms - Indian Global practice
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.

A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

Description:
TechOps - CloudOps - AI/ML Platform Operations Engineer: Senior

The opportunity
We are looking for a seasoned and proactive Senior AI/ML Platform Operations Engineer to operate, support, and continuously improve enterprise machine learning and generative AI platforms. The role will focus on MLOps and LLMOps across model deployment, monitoring, API and endpoint operations, model pipelines, prompt and model configuration, observability, and incident resolution. The engineer will act as a technical escalation point for production AI services and work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, application teams, cloud platform teams, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective AI capabilities.


Your key responsibilities
Provide day-to-day production and operational support for machine learning, generative AI, and large language model platforms across development, test, staging, and production environments.
Deploy, configure, validate, and support machine learning models, foundation models, embedding models, rerankers, and associated inference services using controlled MLOps and LLMOps practices.
Monitor real-time and batch inference workloads, APIs, endpoints, model pipelines, queues, scheduled jobs, and dependent services, and restore failed or degraded services within agreed SLAs.
Troubleshoot endpoint errors, latency, throttling, token limits, authentication failures, networking issues, dependency conflicts, model-loading errors, memory constraints, and scaling problems.
Operate model training, evaluation, registration, approval, deployment, rollback, and retirement pipelines with traceability across model and environment versions.
Support prompt templates, system instructions, model parameters, routing rules, guardrails, content filters, retrieval configuration, tool connections, and environment-specific configuration.
Implement and maintain observability for model quality, response latency, throughput, error rate, availability, token consumption, cost, drift, data quality, hallucination risk, safety events, and user feedback.
Investigate production incidents using application, model, prompt, API gateway, orchestration, cloud service, infrastructure, and security logs, and coordinate service recovery.
Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement corrective actions, preventive alerts, automated recovery, runbook improvements, and platform engineering enhancements.
Develop and maintain Python utilities, automation scripts, health checks, deployment tooling, test harnesses, evaluation workflows, and operational dashboards.
Support enterprise integrations with OpenAI services, Azure OpenAI where applicable, AWS Bedrock, model gateways, vector stores, API gateways, identity providers, secrets management, and monitoring platforms.
Ensure secure handling of model endpoints, API keys, service identities, secrets, private networking, customer data, prompts, responses, and model artifacts.
Support capacity planning, autoscaling, quota management, rate-limit management, GPU or accelerator utilization, token forecasting, and cost optimization for AI workloads.
Coordinate controlled releases using Git and CI/CD, including testing evidence, model and prompt versioning, approvals, deployment validation, rollback planning, and post-release monitoring.
Manage complex incidents, service requests, problems, and changes, and mentor junior engineers in troubleshooting, platform operations, and operational best practices.
Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, architecture and dependency records, known-error articles, monitoring standards, escalation paths, and support knowledge bases.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong hands-on knowledge of MLOps practices covering experiment tracking, model packaging, model registry, validation, promotion, deployment, monitoring, rollback, and lifecycle governance.
Strong understanding of LLMOps, including foundation model access, prompt and configuration management, evaluation, observability, retrieval-augmented generation, guardrails, endpoint operations, and cost controls.
Experience operating model APIs and endpoints, including authentication, authorization, throttling, load management, autoscaling, latency troubleshooting, retries, timeouts, and high availability.
Strong Python skills for platform automation, API integration, log analysis, operational tooling, testing, and incident diagnosis.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY_ Consulting _ Risk Consulting _ Enterprise Risk - Senior 1/2
As part of our Consulting Enterprise Risk team, our clients look for EY s expertise across the consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404, Third Party Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management.
There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you re working with, you ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.
The opportunity
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies, by improving their processes and leveraging technologies. By plugging into our market-leading global network, youll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional Risk Advisor
Your key responsibilities
Delivery
Manage a team of Staffs (if needed) or independently deliver SOX engagements for multiple processes across client(s)
Participate in process discussions and walkthrough meetings with clients, prepare / review process flows/ narratives and risk control matrices, and identify process gaps and provide recommendations
Conduct, documents and review (if needed) test of design and operating effectiveness, and suggest controls to improve the client s control framework, as per the defined standards and quality benchmark
Drive / Support the Manager in scoping, rationalization, standardization, status update, deficiency and project management
Monitor project progress, manage multiple assignments and related project teams, if needed
Meet quality guidelines within the established turnaround time (or allotted budget) for assigned requests
Client Management
Develop strong working relationships with the client and onshore client teams
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Demonstrate application and solution-based approach to problem solving
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.
Operational excellence
Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
People related
Display teamwork, integrity and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation.
Utilize technology tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery.
Conduct workshops and technical training sessions for team members. Contribute to the learning development agenda and knowledge harnessing initiatives.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong command on spoken and written English
Analytical, organized and meticulous consulting skills
Strong academic history and professional experience (degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or similar work experience)
Proficient in MS-Office Suite
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
Ability to prioritize deliverables effectively in order to achieve optimum results.
To qualify for the role, you must have
More than 1 year of experience after completion of CA or 3+ years of experience (as B.Com/M.Com, BBA / MBA) in risks controls, with experience mainly in Internal Audit / SOX / internal controls
Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or similar)
Strong command on spoken and written English
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
CIA certification is preferred
Ideally, you ll also have
Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
Opportunities to work with EY Risk -Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world

Description:
TechOps - CloudOps - Data Governance Data Modelling Support Engineer - Senior

Job Summary
We are looking for a proactive Data Governance Data Modelling Support Engineer to provide production and operational support for enterprise data governance and data modelling platforms. The role will focus on the reliable operation of Collibra and Erwin environments, including workflows, catalog and metadata services, data lineage, access and role issues, model lifecycle support, and controlled model deployments. The engineer will work closely with data governance, architecture, data engineering, security, and business teams to resolve incidents, fulfil service requests, and continuously improve platform support.


Your key responsibilities
Provide day-to-day operational support for Collibra Data Intelligence Platform capabilities, including Data Catalog, metadata ingestion, workflows, lineage, communities, domains, assets, and operating model components.
Investigate and resolve Collibra access, permission, responsibility, role assignment, workflow, synchronization, and configuration issues in line with approved governance controls.
Monitor scheduled metadata ingestion and lineage jobs, troubleshoot failures, validate completeness, and coordinate remediation with source-system and platform teams.
Support onboarding and maintenance of business glossaries, data dictionaries, critical data elements, policies, standards, ownership, stewardship, and certification processes.
Provide operational support for Erwin Data Modeler and related model repositories, including logical and physical models, subject areas, naming standards, versioning, and model publication.
Coordinate model deployment and promotion across environments, perform release validation, maintain audit evidence, and support rollback or recovery when required.
Use SQL and Oracle to validate metadata, investigate data and connectivity issues, reconcile model definitions with database objects, and support root cause analysis.
Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and changes in accordance with ITIL-aligned support processes, service levels, security requirements, and change controls.
Create and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, known-error records, troubleshooting guides, support dashboards, and knowledge articles.
Collaborate with data owners, data stewards, architects, database administrators, security teams, and application teams to resolve issues and improve governance adoption.
Participate in release activities, periodic platform health checks, disaster recovery exercises, and rotational support coverage for business-critical services.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong hands-on knowledge of Collibra workflows, catalog, metadata management, lineage, operating model concepts, communities, domains, assets, responsibilities, and role-based access.
Hands-on experience with Erwin Data Modeler, enterprise model repositories, logical and physical data modelling, forward and reverse engineering, model comparison, version control, and deployment support.
Good SQL skills for querying, validation, issue diagnosis, reconciliation, and technical impact analysis.
Working knowledge of Oracle databases, schemas, database objects, connectivity, privileges, and common production-support scenarios.
Strong incident troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with a structured approach to problem management and preventive actions.
Understanding of data governance concepts such as ownership, stewardship, business glossary, critical data elements, metadata quality, lineage, access governance, privacy, and regulatory controls.
Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders across distributed teams.
Attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and commitment to service quality and controlled change.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree in computer science, information systems, data management, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
5-8 years of experience in data governance platforms, data modelling tools, database support, or enterprise application support, including production-support responsibilities.
Hands-on experience supporting Collibra, including workflows, catalog and metadata operations, lineage, user access, roles, and issue resolution.

Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

The Associate Agency Development Manager is responsible for driving business growth through the recruitment, development, and management of a team of insurance agents. This role involves identifying potential agents, conducting training sessions, and providing ongoing support to ensure agents meet their sales targets. The successful candidate will be focused on achieving branch sales goals, enhancing agent performance, and maintaining strong relationships with agents to foster a motivated sales environment. Key responsibilities include developing business plans, analyzing market trends, implementing sales strategies, and ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new agents to build a robust sales team.
- Design and implement training programs to enhance agents sales skills and product knowledge.
- Set performance targets for the team and monitor progress, providing feedback and support as needed.
- Foster growth and maintain motivation among agents through consistent communication and mentorship.
- Analyze sales data and market trends to develop effective sales strategies.
- Collaborate with management to align team goals with organizational objectives.
- Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements in the insurance sector.
- Organize performance assessments and identify areas for improvement for agents.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team-building skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze data and market trends effectively.
- Proficient in sales strategies and customer relationship management.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Proven track record in sales and business development in the insurance sector.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM).
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis tools for sales tracking and performance monitoring.
- Online training platforms for agent development.
- Communication tools (e.g., email, video conferencing software).

Description:
Job Description Branch Head (Sales )
Department: Sales & Marketing
Experience: 812 Years

1. Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Branch Head to lead the branch's sales, marketing, admissions, and operational activities. The incumbent will be responsible for achieving branch revenue targets, driving business growth, managing the sales team, developing institutional partnerships, and ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the student lifecycle.
The ideal candidate should have strong leadership capabilities, business acumen, consultative sales experience, and the ability to drive team performance and operational excellence.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
A. Sales & Business Development
Achieve branch revenue targets and Annual Business Plan (ABP).
Develop and execute regional sales and marketing strategies.
Identify new business opportunities across B2B and B2C segments.
Manage the sales pipeline, monitor conversions, and forecast monthly revenue.
Build strong relationships with schools, principals, coordinators, educational institutions, and corporate clients.
Explore new market segments and drive business growth.

B. Marketing & Lead Generation
Plan and execute marketing activities across the assigned region.
Organize seminars, school campaigns, open seminars, residential township activities, and corporate events.
Participate in relevant promotional activities to increase brand visibility and market share.
Ensure effective merchandising and product displays to drive customer engagement and sales.
Monitor competitor activities and identify market opportunities.

C. Student Lifecycle & Admissions Management
Drive the complete student lifecycle, including prospecting, counselling, admissions, orientation, and post-admission support.
Ensure effective lead management, follow-ups, and admission conversions.
Interact with parents and educational institutions to understand their requirements and provide need-based solutions.
Ensure timely resolution of customer queries and grievances to maximize customer satisfaction.

D. Team Leadership & Performance Management
Lead, motivate, and manage the branch sales and operations teams.
Conduct regular training on product knowledge, sales processes, and service offerings.
Monitor daily sales activities, team productivity, and admission performance.
Build strong collaboration between academic, sales, and operations teams.
Address employee concerns, sales-related conflicts, and pricing issues promptly.
Drive employee engagement and ensure a positive working environment.

E. Branch Operations & Business Governance
Manage end-to-end branch operations and ensure process compliance.
Prepare and review MIS reports, sales dashboards, and business performance reports.
Monitor daily sales activities and admission management processes.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Product, Marketing, Academic, and Operations teams.
Ensure effective execution of business strategies and operational standards.

3. Required Skills & Competencies
Strong experience in consultative sales and business development.
Excellent leadership, team management, and people management skills.
Strong business acumen and target-oriented approach.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.
Self-motivated, innovative, proactive, and result-oriented.
Strong interpersonal skills and stakeholder management capabilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of South Indian regional languages is mandatory.

4. Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA will be an added advantage.
8–12 years of relevant professional experience.
Candidates with experience in Education, Teaching, Training, Insurance, or Pharma industries are preferred.
Prior experience in branch management, sales leadership, business development, and team handling is desirable.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Achievement of monthly and annual revenue targets.
Lead generation and admission conversion ratios.
Branch profitability and business growth.
B2C business development.
Team productivity and individual target achievement.
Customer satisfaction and grievance resolution.
Operational efficiency and process compliance.
Market penetration and competitor tracking.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A strong business leader with proven sales performance, excellent team-handling capabilities, and the ability to independently manage branch-level business operations while driving sustainable revenue growth.

About Us
Aakash Educational Services Ltd. We specialize in coaching for major medical and engineering entrance exams such as NEET and JEE (Main & Advanced), as well as school/board examinations, scholarship tests, and Olympiads.
Our philosophy of “Student First” drives everything we do. With highly qualified and passionate faculty, we focus on understanding each student’s unique learning needs and guiding them to achieve their goals. Proven Impact: Aakash’s results speak for themselves, with 9 Lakh+ NEET and JEE qualifiers over the years, including All India Rank 1 in NEET and JEE (Advanced).

Job Title: Associate Sales Manager. Location: Branch Name (as per requirement). Department: Bancassurance. Function: Bancassurance YBL - Sales. Reporting to: Center Manager. Band: 5A.
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank's existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.

Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.


Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
2 to 4 years of experience in sales
Good communication skills - English regional language (preferred)
Age group: 22-28 years

Description:
Job Summary
Function SummaryRelationship Associate plays a pivotal role in driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers. The role involves lead conversion, ensuring process adherence, and supporting operational excellence. The incumbent will be responsible for meeting business targets and maintaining customer satisfaction. This position requires consistent coordination with stakeholders and adherence to company guidelines.
Job SummaryManages branches, collaborates with the objective to support and contribute to Axis bank strategy, achieve operations excellence, ensure systems are deployed and help build the channel WITHIN the company guidelines and the achieve business targets.


Responsibilities
Managing relationship with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting target through Bank s FOS.
Responsible for managing the leads generated from Branch and thereby convert into quality business.
Must adhere to the process set and timely coordinate with Cluster Manager and Operations HUB, ensuring minimal customer complaints.
Shall adhere to agreed TATs on first customer contact and follow-ups from the date of the lead being registered.
Ensuring 15-month persistency on track and thereby ensure a robust follow up mechanism with the customers.
Coordinating with Cluster Training Manager to ensure bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Shall be responsible for making active the branch banking sellers and thereby achieving the activation target.
Ensuring LMS usage as Tracking Mechanism online and follow up calls.


Key Competencies / Skills Required
Excellent relationship skills
Managing various levels of bank management
Adherence to process


Qualifications and Experience
Graduate in any discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved college and university.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales; experience in insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of life insurance sales management, retail bank distribution, and channel management and/or DSA relationship.

Job Summary: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Trainer/Quality Manager to oversee the learning and development of all Relationship Managers responsible for onboarding Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) customers after policy purchase until the underwriting decision is made. Job Title - Lead Business Analyst - Specialist - ACS Song
Management Level: 9 - Specialist
Location: Kochi
Must have skills: Requirement Analysis
Good to have skills: eCommerce techno-functional BA
Experience: 5-8 years of experience is required
Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
Job Summary
You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled commerce solutions. The role requires a consultative techno-functional Business Analyst who can work independently in client-facing engagements, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and enable delivery teams through clear requirements, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.
Roles and Responsibilities
Independently lead requirements elicitation for assigned eCommerce workstreams by facilitating client workshops, interviews and playback sessions.
Analyze as-is processes and design to-be business, solution and system requirements in partnership with client stakeholders and delivery teams.
Create and maintain epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, data needs and decision logs.
Own backlog readiness for upcoming sprints by planning refinement, identifying dependencies and clarifying functional and technical questions.
Act as a bridge between client Product Owner, business SMEs, UX/design, architects, developers, QA and project/program stakeholders.
Identify solution options and recommend fit-for-purpose approaches by balancing business value, user experience, feasibility and delivery complexity.
Ensure requirements and designs remain aligned throughout change, implementation, testing and release cycles.
Support UAT planning, test scenario review, defect triage and business readiness activities.
Contribute to product roadmap inputs, release scope definition and improvement ideas based on client priorities and market/platform awareness.
Mentor junior team members on BA ways of working, quality of user stories and stakeholder communication.
Expected to operate with limited supervision in a client-facing consultative BA role.
Own medium-complexity functional areas or workstreams and escalate risks with mitigation options.
Maintain clear communication rhythms with client stakeholders and internal teams.
Demonstrate strong analytical thinking, outcome orientation and ownership for BA deliverables.
Provide constructive challenge to requirements prioritization and help shape backlog value.
Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail pages, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility and order status.
Ability to map business journeys and identify functional gaps across B2B/B2C commerce, marketplace, omnichannel and customer-service-enabled commerce experiences.
Working knowledge of commerce platform concepts such as catalog, product information, pricing display, promotions, campaigns, search, merchandising, content, customer accounts and integrations.
Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation-ready backlog items.
Understanding of APIs, events, integrations, data flows and non-functional requirements relevant to commerce platforms.
Ability to independently own a commerce feature area such as product discovery, checkout, promotions, account management, order management, or content/merchandising.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skill
Business analysis and requirements analysis for digital products or commerce platforms.
Advanced user story writing, acceptance criteria definition and backlog refinement.
Jira and Confluence proficiency; ability to maintain product backlog, decisions, traceability and release documentation.
Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviews, process mapping and requirements elicitation.
Story mapping, customer journey mapping, as-is/to-be process modelling and gap analysis.
Scrum/Agile delivery experience across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release phases.
eCommerce domain knowledge across browse, search, PDP, cart, checkout, payments, promotions, order capture and order status.
Techno-functional understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics tagging, non-functional requirements and platform constraints.
Ability to work with product owners, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, release and client business stakeholders.
Excellent verbal and written communication for client presentations, demos, decisions and status reporting.
Draw.io, Miro, Visio, Lucidchart or similar modelling/diagramming tools.
CPQ & Pricing domain knowledge
Commerce platforms such as SAP Commerce/Hybris, commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento or similar.
Search, merchandising, CMS, CDP, web analytics, payments, OMS or customer service platform exposure.
PSPO I, PSPO II, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master or relevant commerce platform certifications.
Exposure to headless commerce, composable commerce, microservices, event-driven integrations or cloud-native delivery.
Experience with automation pipelines, version control, deployment strategies or DevOps collaboration
