At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline: Brand Marketing
Role Type: Marketing Automation
Role Rank: Marketing Automation Senior Associate
The opportunity
We are looking for Marketing Automation Senior Associate who will be responsible for performing the activities related to Brand Marketing and Communications. This individual will support projects involving tactical execution of campaigns end to end, process improvements and educating users on campaign best practices. Must have experience with supporting email marketing campaigns and using various digital marketing tools with a strong interest in data management and analytics.
Your key responsibilities
Tactical execution of Marketing Automation campaigns with varying complexities and sizes
Experience with supporting email marketing campaigns and using various digital marketing tools, Marketo knowledge is a must
Coordinate and liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure all relevant content, assets and target audience parameters are received for campaign execution
Provide project support to all MarTech team members throughout the various stages of the project, including testing use cases
Regular reporting to key stakeholders on the performance of marketing automation campaigns and suggest on improvement avenues that is backed by data
Support process improvements and educate users on campaign best practices
Standardization and documentation of technical processes using our internal systems
Able to define and document the functional and technical requirements for executing (developing, deploying, managing, tracking, and measuring) the automated campaigns
Act as a brand champion, ensuring that all external campaigns and online content support the firm s brand and business strategy and compliant to risk and quality safeguards set by EY
Work towards organizational objectives along with stakeholders project
Skills and attributes for success
Analytical thinking
Data-Driven Decision Making
Audience Segmentations and targeting
Stakeholder management
Troubleshooting
Familiarity with Agile planning and Agile project management skills
To qualify for the role, you must have
Any university degree or college diploma in Digital Marketing or a related field.
Understanding of Digital Marketing eco-system and marketing automation
Experience in Marketing Automation campaign configuration
Min. 5 years of experience, and min. 3 years with Marketo
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions in MA platform.
Adherence to data compliance policies (such as GDPR, CANSPAM) is a must. Specialist knows his customer journeys well-enough to identify every possible opportunity or data breach and the need for appropriate security and get measures in place to safeguard it.
Ideally, you ll also have
Strong interest in data management and analytics
Storytelling and consulting skills
Attention to detail
Organized, self-starter who can collaborate with the team, and excel in a fast-paced corporate environment. While being able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Having Marketo Engage Expert certification is plus
Technologies and Tools
Marketo or any other Marketing Automation platform
Workflow management tools e.g.: Jira/Azure boards/Wrike/Zendesk/Workfront etc
Microsoft Office
SharePoint
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and scripting
What we look for
Marketing Automation acumen
Strong team contributor
Ready to learn and adapt
Problem solving skills
Stakeholder management
Effective communication
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Senior Associate Data Analyst- Power Platform - EDS
Job purpose
As a Senior Associate, you will collaborate with business reporting and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, perform data analysis, and support project transitions. You will lead transition activities where required and manage post-transition development, enhancements, and modifications. You will work across multiple projects with back-end data architects and systems engineers to build data objects that support business needs. You will also apply specialized knowledge to advance the organization s vision and direction while serving as the team s subject matter expert.
Specific Role requirements
Ability to analyze large sets of data and determine patterns and rules for organizing and Prepare Visualization dashboards using Power BI.
Ability to work on database management and data modelling.
Working knowledge in developing low code solutions using power platform tools like Power Apps and Power Automate.
Sound knowledge in ETL concepts and tools like Data Factory/SSIS.
Design and support database and table structures for new and evolving sources of data
Experience in working with version control tools like Git/Github
Perform extensive and detailed data analysis necessary to ensure strict adherence to data quality.
Take on end-to-end ownership and perform different roles within analysis and development phases.
Set and manage expectations with clients while providing proactive communication and status updates; prioritize deliverables with client/requestor and follow/implement change control and release management processes.
Ability to handle multiple projects and coordinate between teams from different service lines.
Good problem solving skills and business acumen.
Adhere to general work requirements and perform other duties as assigned.
Clear understanding of Gen AI tools and their integrations.
Client Responsibilities:
Need to be curious and ask the right questions to frame problems and find right analytic solutions.
Need to work as a senior team member to contribute to various technical streams of Decision Sciences implementation project.
Provide product and design level with the best technical practices.
Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
Develop analytical strategies for business by leveraging the right analytical techniques and technologies.
Documenting and presenting work to the client. Proactively recommending and influencing changes in business decision-making.
Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the lead
Experience and Qualification:
More than 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst with strong expertise in SQL/T-SQL, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
Knowledge of ETL tools such as SSIS and Azure Data Factory will be an added advantage.
Experience with Python coding and Databricks will be beneficial.
Working knowledge of MS Excel macros will be an added advantage.
Experience working in an Agile environment.
Prior client-facing experience is preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Bachelor s or master s degree in a related field.

We are looking for Senior Managers with expertise in Workforce Management to join the GDS PC team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be a part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in the growth of the WFA team.


Your Key Responsibilities
Lead WFM capability and develop strong relations with global partners. Establish WFM pillar of expertise within the practice, grow and lead a team of WFM SMEs/experts
Liaison with regional member firms selling work in the WFM space to build project pipeline. Collaborate and build relationships with the Communities of Practice and Leaders in these regions to get visibility into their pipeline. Identify and build new capabilities in the team based on trends in various market regions
Lead WFM development efforts using leading market technologies and digital solutions. Provide advice and guidance as a subject matter expert and work effectively as part of a large, distributed program team
Working with senior leadership to create alignment to support program success
Developing holistic change management strategies that succinctly articulate how change will be managed in the context of a transformation program
Identifying and deploying leading edge communication and stakeholder engagement tools and techniques
Develop thought leadership, collateral, tools, techniques, methodologies to build and enhance the WFM offering within the practice
Ensure quality of delivery, manage engagement risk, project economics, escalations and ensure effective planning and budgeting
Perform role of counsellor and coach, define and set goals, conduct performance reviews and ensure ongoing learning and development of the team
Implement strong people practices and policies; provide counselling support to individuals in the team for their learning, performance management and career development

High integrity and commitment to work in a new and challenging environment
Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive
Strong communication and presentation skills
Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity
High energy levels, agility and adaptability
Open to travel nationally and internationally for client projects that are approved as per EY and country specific travel advisory guidelines

17 - 19 years of experience in WFM domain
Minimum 10 - 12 years of experience in implementing WFM products like UKG or Dayforce
Experience of working in a consulting environment on global client projects in areas of time attendance, work force management transformation and shared services advisory.
Experience in team management; providing advice and guidance on client projects related with Workforce management processes and systems


Ideally, you'll also have
Demonstrated technical proficiencies in Work Force Management; take a practical/business driven approach to solving complex global WFM client challenges
Led Work Force Management transformation project work streams from planning through to implementation - managing project resources and budgets effectively
Designed WFM delivery options (consolidation of multiple vendors, vendor advisory, shared service centre development, use of technology to generate efficiencies), and transition management
Supported other regions in client pursuit activities in the payroll and WFM space by developing proposals and presentations
Ability to review current processes to identify key metrics to evaluate operational performance compared to internal performance objectives and WFM industry leading practices benchmarks
Facilitate and support the client in movement of the payroll delivery to a 3rd party outsource provider - developing a strong governance model to drive the vendor performance and delivery of services
Project management experience
PMP certification

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Risk Consulting - MENA FS Risk - Credit Risk - Manager

Divisional Overview
EY GDS Risk Consulting is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge.
EY s MENA Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) team, part of the EY GDS Risk Consulting Practice, delivers tailored risk solutions to help clients identify, assess, manage, and monitor a range of financial and regulatory risks. These include market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks arising from trading, asset-liability management, capital management, and broader capital markets activities. The division is ideal for collaborative individuals who have strong ethics and attention to detail.
Within FSRM, the Credit Risk (CR) team focuses on supporting clients-ranging from large domestic banks to global financial institutions-in implementing strategic, functional, and regulatory transformations across credit risk management within their banking book portfolios.
You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams and play a key role in ensuring high quality outputs and service to our clients. The role involves developing knowledge and implementing new solutions to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients. We value intellectual curiosity and a passion for promoting solutions across organizational boundaries.
Key Responsibilities
Lead a team of 5-6 Senior consultants, analysts for engagement execution and delivery. You will also spend teaming up with industry professionals to develop and deliver a wide range of risk management strategies and solutions
Showcase exceptional project management abilities and foster a collaborative environment and accountability among team members on engagements
Demonstrate deep technical expertise and industry knowledge, particularly in financial products with a focus on lending solutions.
Design, assessment, and benchmarking of financial risk management policies, frameworks, methodologies covering a range of risk domains such as credit risk, market risk, operational risk, liquidity risk, climate risk, and integrated risk topics viz., capital adequacy and stress testing measurement methodologies in financial institutions (FI)
Stay abreast of market trends and challenges in the financial services sector to understand client needs and industry dynamics
Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess what the firm can deliver to serve clients
Monitor project progress, manage risks, and effectively communicate status, issues, and priorities to key stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes.
Review, analyze, and validate the work completed by junior team members to ensure accuracy and quality
Adapt to projects involving model audits, validation, and development, demonstrating flexibility and domain knowledge
Qualifications, Certifications, and Education
Must-have:
Graduate or Master s degree in a technical or quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or equivalent with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience
Excellent analytical and problem-solving expertise
Solid foundation in statistics and econometrics.
In-depth knowledge of Credit risk model development, validation, audit and/or implementation of the banking book portfolio
Solid understanding of Risk analytics methodologies.
Advanced technical skills, with proficiency in Python, SAS, SQL, R, and Excel.
Excellent Oral and written communication and presentation skills
Strong documentation skills, with the ability to quickly grasp complex concepts and present them clearly in documents or presentations.
Strong multi-tasking skills with demonstrated ability to manage expectations and deliver high quality results under tight deadlines and minimal supervision.
Preferred:
Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, PRM, or SCR.
Knowledge of regulatory modeling (BASEL, CCAR, IFRS9) is preferred
Exposure to regulatory stress testing processes around credit risk ICAAP
Experience in climatic risk space preferably in the areas of stress testing /scenario designing
Exposure to Interest Rate Risk in Banking Book (IRRBB)
Experience in data/business intelligence (BI) reporting.
Familiarity with machine learning models and their practical applications.
Prior project management experience

Job Title: Assistant Director - Business Change Manager (POD Lead)
Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support our 400,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and top-tier technology infrastructure.
Our aim is to create a superior customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business experts to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
The opportunity
As a Business Change Manager, you will play a pivotal role in leading and managing business change initiatives for large and complex projects. Your primary responsibility will be to enhance awareness, drive adoption, and maximize business value from company-facing technology platforms, including M365, security tools, AI, M365 Copilot and mobile applications.
You will design and oversee impactful campaigns aimed at implementing and promoting the adoption of technology products among all EY employees. This role offers you the opportunity to empower employees to embrace new ways of working by creating engaging change campaigns that resonate across all levels of the organization, thereby reinforcing EYs commitment to building a better working world.
This role requires experience in digital adoption strategies, focusing on user classification across the adoption curve to foster behavioral changes that enhance productivity.
This is a non-client facing role, with great flexibility to work from a home office with limited travel. This role is guided by the BRM Service Adoption Change Management Lead.
Your key responsibilities
Change Management Strategy
Develop holistic business change plans tailored to various factors such as product, audience, legal/regulatory practices, and digital adoption strategies.
Focus on user classification across the adoption curve to foster behavioural changes that enhance productivity.
Design and oversee impactful campaigns aimed at implementing and promoting the adoption of technology products among all EY employees
Tailor change plans for technology specific demands from the lens of both business and end-users.
Product Activation and Adoption
Execute product activation processes and practices, including change impact assessments, business cases for adoption, communication strategies, stakeholder management, and lessons learned.
Build and execute campaigns that reflect on success measures and optimize user engagement.
Create engaging narratives of the change user journey, utilizing imagery to convey complex data insights and the change story effectively.
Stakeholder Engagement
Collaborate with change, content, and engagement teams within the Service Adoption team to deliver complex, enterprise-wide technology adoption programs.
Present information effectively to key leaders and stakeholders, both individually and in group settings.
Maintain ongoing communication with all team members, management, and stakeholders.
Overall Management
Oversee weekly stakeholder reporting and the creation of impacted user lists, utilizing tools like PowerPoint and Excel for presentations and data analysis.
Identify potential points of contention for missed deliverables and implement strategies to mitigate risks in timelines and budgets.
Lead initiatives focused on continuous improvement within the function/experience theme, including personnel, processes, metrics, and collateral.
Skills and attributes for success
To qualify for the role you must have
8+ years of experience leading and managing complex business and end user change projects in a change management role
Proven experience in developing large-scale change management plans, including change readiness assessments, stakeholder analyses, success metrics, and communications activities.
Previous project / program work in the areas of end-user adoption, mobile, security and/or Microsoft M365 products and services.
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal for leaders (technology and business), suppliers and end users.
Strong delivery skills, including project scoping, team staffing, subject matter direction, and risk management.
Ideally, you ll also have
PROSCI certification is highly desirable
Strong active listening and communication skills for senior stakeholder engagement.
Advanced interpersonal and stakeholder management abilities, including consultative questioning and critical thinking.
Strong storytelling skills.
Familiarity with formal change management methodologies focused on end-user behavioral change.
Expertise in reporting, analytics, and data-driven decision-making.
Experience in playing a crucial part in the adoption of AI within the organization.
Ability to work effectively at all organizational levels and collaborate within teams.
Experience across the full project management lifecycle and managing multiple projects.
Problem-solving skills and root cause identification experience.
Background in content production and planning calendars.
Familiarity with gamification, leaderboards, and engagement tactics.
Experience of creating and using AI Agents and Power Automation.

As part of this role, youll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.

Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Gather and analyse business requirements related to LIMS functionality and enhancements.
Analyse laboratory workflows and processes to recommend and implement LIMS solutions.
Translate business needs into functional specifications and system configurations.
Configure, test, and validate LIMS functionalities to meet business needs.
Conduct impact analysis and risk assessments for LIMS changes and enhancements.
Serve as a liaison between business users and technical teams to ensure effective communication and system alignment.
Participate in business process mapping and workflow optimization to enhance LIMS utilization.
Provide input on LIMS enhancements and new feature development to improve system performance.
Assist in troubleshooting, identifying, and resolving LIMS-related issues.
Conduct user training sessions and provide end-user support.
Work with laboratory teams to ensure LIMS supports laboratory practices, procedures, and workflows effectively.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement within laboratory operations using LIMS.
Master Data Design Configuration
Analyse the Technical documents such as SOP/STP/Monograms/Pharmacopeial references and convert them into LIMS compatible data sets.
Configure master data elements such as test methods, sample types, specifications, workflows, and stability studies within LIMS.
Maintain data integrity, consistency, and version control across the system.
Implement changes and updates to LIMS master data in alignment with business and regulatory needs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate data migration and system integration.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to master data configuration and system functionality.
Work on optimizing data structures and database management within LIMS.
Application Support
Develop, customize, and implement LIMS applications to meet laboratory and business requirements.
Configure, extend, and support LabWare LIMS, LabVantage LIMS, and other LIMS platforms.
Integrate LIMS with other enterprise systems such as ERP, ELN, CDS, MES, and laboratory instrumentation software.
Design and optimize databases for efficient storage and retrieval of laboratory data.
Develop and maintain system interfaces, workflows, and automation scripts to streamline laboratory processes.
Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and bug fixes for LIMS applications, ensuring minimal downtime.
Collaborate with laboratory personnel, IT teams, and stakeholders to enhance system functionality and usability.
Create and maintain system documentation, including user guides, SOPs, validation protocols, and technical specifications.
Ensure compliance with industry standards such as CGxP, PICS, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11 etc.
Stay up to date with new LIMS technologies, trends, and best practices.
Ensure system security, access control, and compliance with IT policies.
Provide ongoing support and maintenance for LIMS applications.
Engage in change management processes and drive adoption of new system functionalities.
Work with vendors and third-party providers to Configure, implement upgrades and enhancements.
Demonstrate teamwork by working with cross functional teams across service lines in completing the deliverables within the timelines
Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the clients business.
Review status updates and prepare management presentations.
Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects internal initiatives.
Demonstrate a detailed knowledge of market trends, competitor activities, EY products and service lines.
Contribute to performance feedback for staff
Foster teamwork and a positive learning culture
Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
Training and mentoring of project resources
Cross skill and cross train the team members as per the business requirements
Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, sample lifecycle management, and data integrity principles.
Familiarity with analytical techniques, laboratory instrumentation, and regulatory standards.
Exposure to Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and ISO 17025 compliance.
Experience in working with scientific and analytical teams to align LIMS functionality with laboratory operations.
Understanding of quality control, stability studies, environmental monitoring, and batch release processes within laboratories.
Proficiency in LIMS software (e.g., LabWare, LabVantage, STARLIMS, SampleManager, or similar platforms).
Knowledge of system integration with ERP, MES, or other enterprise applications.
Previous experience as a Business Analyst or System Administrator or Master Data Manager working with LIMS.
Hands-on experience in master data configuration within LIMS platforms.
Experience in system validation, testing, and documentation.
Exposure to Enterprise IT applications like LIMS, SAP, ELN, MES, Documentum, TrackWise, Veeva Vault, ValGenesis, etc. in Pharmaceutical organization
Understanding of relational databases and SQL queries.
Experience with scripting or automation tools for LIMS is a plus.
Understanding of API integrations, web services, and middleware solutions for LIMS.
Ability to troubleshoot system and data issues efficiently.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.
Adaptability to dynamic business and regulatory environments.
Demonstrated track record in project management, governance, and reporting
Exposure to Data Integrity requirements and other applicable regulations
Knowledge of Incident Management, Change Management.
Prior experience of supporting Audits / Inspections
Demonstrate AI awareness and proficiency by leveraging approved AI tools to enhance productivity, improve decision-making, and drive innovation while ensuring responsible, ethical, and secure use of AI technologies.
Champion a growth mindset toward emerging technologies by continuously building AI capabilities, identifying opportunities for AI-driven transformation, and promoting AI adoption and best practices within teams and client engagements.
To qualify for the role, you must have
B.E/B.Tech (Comp. Science/ Life Sciences/Chemistry/Information Technology or a related field)/Postgraduate in Science (Preferably in Chemistry/Biochemistry) with 5-8 years of experience with Big 4 or Multi-National Regulatory Compliance companies or Leading Life sciences / Pharmaceutical Industries.
Good interpersonal skills; Good written, oral and presentation skills
Ideally, you ll also have
Information Security (ISO 27001) or Risk Management certifications
LIMS admin certification or Equivalent
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Equivalent (Preferred but not required).
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you

Job Title: GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst (APAC)
Job Span: APAC Alliances Enablement, Across Alliances
Function: GDS ES - GI - Alliances
Skill Level: High
Sub Function: Alliances Partner Operations COE
Job Summary:
The Alliances Partner Operations COE is a service delivery function, established with the goal of enabling EY s Global Alliance Ecosystem Program. The APAC Alliances Operations Lead Analyst will be responsible for owning and delivering operations support to the APAC Alliances leadership team. This role will ensure seamless service delivery for ongoing initiatives and will also be responsible for executing special projects that are assigned from time to time. The role will involve handling multiple responsibilities like project management, reporting analytics, strategic initiatives, stakeholder management, and facilitaing senior leadership meetings among other activities.
Essential Functions of the Job:
Leveraging existing global dashboards and financial reporting to provide updates on revenue, wins, and pipeline and ultimately deliver key business insights to stakeholders
Provide ad-hoc data reporting requests for Accounts / Alliances, summary executive reporting to the area senior management
Coordinating/facilitating Alliances revenue planning
Pre and post-meeting support (e.g. agenda formation, meeting deck collation, storyboarding, content curation / design, follow up with summary / actions); own meeting materials and coordinate preparation and finalization
Participate/facilitate executive leadership meetings and events on a need basis, other generic meeting and workshop content development and support
Support APAC Alliances team with contracts initiation and tracking by working closly with the Global Alliances team
Ensure all APAC Alliances related reference material is systematically reviewed and refreshed, facilitate and track access to these materials in Discover and other tools
Cordinate with Brand Marketing and Communication (BMC) team to develop and review relevant content (as required)
Evaluate current processes and procedures, suggest improvements and efficiencies
Partner with the APAC Alliance Operations contacts on strategic projects and initiatives as and when required
Work with Alliances leaders to activate and embed Alliances across APAC including internal awareness, campaigns, LD, setting up of networks, success stories etc
Knowledge and Skill Requirements:
Sales and pipeline exposure - understanding of concepts, opportunity life cycles and reporting
Ability to work with senior onshore stakeholders, excellent relationship and stakeholder management skills, should have the ability to develop trusted business advisor relationships with onshore stakeholders
Should have exposure to working in high pressure situations
Should have experience with virtual working preferable across multiple geographies, including cultural sensitivity, with a global mindset
Should be able to own initiatives, operate independently with limited guidance and oversight. Should have a strong ability to prioritize. Should have a good eye for detail and should have the perfectionist mindset for deliverables and timelines
Good at problem solving, should be capable of evaluation, root cause analysis and mitigation, good interpersonal skills, analytical thinking and research capabilities, comfortable interacting across multiple groups working with various other teams towards the appropriate solution or resolution
Good project management skills - project budgets, execution and tracking, reviews, strong time management skills including prioritizing, organizing and tracking details and meeting a series of aggressive deadlines of multiple projects or assignments with varying completion dates
Excellent communication skills (English) - written and oral, strong business writing skills is essential, with the ability to create content independently with limited initial input or guidance.
Exposure to continuous process improvement and automation initiatives (and technologies), experience with process mapping, process documentation, internal audit preparation, facing audits, etc.
Should be excellent with MS Excel, Powerpoint and Power Bi skills, especially with vizualization
Experience working with Alliance/Partner programs in a professional services or technology company
Knowledge of EY GDS operations, incl. org structure, operating model, management information systems, independence concepts, etc. (for internal candidates), Big 4 consultancy exposure with experience in leadership support/strategic environment (for external candidates)
Job Requirements:
Academics: MBA or Graduates/Post Graduates
Experience: 8+ Years of relevant work experience

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer to design, develop, test, and support scalable data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric. The role will focus on building reliable data ingestion and transformation pipelines, developing PySpark/SQL-based processing, implementing Lakehouse solutions, and supporting deployments through Azure DevOps.


Your Key Responsibilities
Monitor production workloads and provide support for data engineering solutions.
Provide regular updates to the stakeholder for the production incidents until resolution.
Willingness to work in multiple shifts as per the project needs.
Troubleshoot pipeline, notebook, data-quality, and performance issues.
Support SIT, UAT, production deployment, and post-production validation activities.
Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding and naming standards.
Use Azure DevOps for source control, work-item tracking, code reviews, and CI/CD/deployment activities.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, reporting teams, QA teams, and other engineering teams.
Design, develop, and maintain data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
Develop and manage Fabric Data Pipelines for ingestion, orchestration, and data movement.
Build Fabric Notebooks using PySpark and SQL for data transformation and processing.
Design and maintain Lakehouse architectures using Delta tables and OneLake.
Work with Lakehouse SQL Endpoint / Fabric SQL for downstream data consumption and reporting requirements.
Ingest data from different source systems, including ADLS, files, databases, APIs, and Microsoft 365/SharePoint sources, as applicable.
Implement incremental loads, full loads, data validation, reconciliation, and error-handling mechanisms.
Develop reusable and parameterized pipelines/notebooks to improve maintainability and scalability.
Implement configuration-driven solutions using parameters, environment-specific configurations, and variable libraries.
Securely manage application credentials, secrets, and connection information.
Perform unit testing and maintain appropriate UT evidence and technical documentation.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric.
Experience with:
Fabric Data Factory / Data Pipelines
Fabric Notebooks
PySpark
SQL
Fabric Lakehouse
OneLake
Delta tables
Lakehouse SQL Endpoint / Fabric SQL
Good understanding of ETL/ELT patterns and data integration concepts.
Experience with data ingestion, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Knowledge of dimensional/data modeling concepts.
Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS).
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git/repository management, pull requests, and deployment processes.
Understanding of CI/CD and environment promotion across Development, SIT/QA, UAT, and Production.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
Experience with Power BI integration with Microsoft Fabric.
Knowledge of Fabric Warehouses and Semantic Models.
Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID/service principals and secure authentication patterns.
Exposure to monitoring and alerting capabilities within Microsoft Fabric.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a seasoned and proactive Senior Data Platform Engineering Support Engineer to provide production and operational support for enterprise data platforms and engineering workloads, with a primary focus on Databricks, Python, PySpark, and ETL solutions. The role will combine hands-on troubleshooting of jobs, notebooks, clusters, pipelines, code, SQL, and data issues with Databricks platform administration, performance optimization, release support, and continuous service improvement. The engineer will act as an escalation point for complex incidents and collaborate with data engineering, cloud platform, security, database, DevOps, and business teams to maintain reliable, secure, and cost-effective data services.


Your key responsibilities
Provide day-to-day production and operational support for Databricks workspaces, jobs, notebooks, workflows, Delta Live Tables or Lakeflow pipelines, clusters, SQL warehouses, libraries, repositories, and related integrations.
Monitor scheduled and streaming workloads, identify failed, delayed, or degraded jobs, assess business impact, restore services, and coordinate recovery within agreed service levels.
Troubleshoot Python and PySpark code failures, dependency conflicts, serialization issues, memory errors, data-skew problems, schema changes, malformed records, and source-to-target transformation defects.
Investigate cluster start-up failures, driver and executor errors, autoscaling issues, pool and policy constraints, runtime incompatibilities, library installation failures, and workspace connectivity problems.
Support ETL and ELT pipelines across ingestion, transformation, validation, orchestration, and publishing layers, including batch and streaming processing.
Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement permanent corrective actions, preventive monitoring, code or configuration improvements, and operational controls.
Optimize Databricks workload performance through Spark UI analysis, execution-plan review, partitioning, file sizing, caching, broadcast joins, adaptive query execution, data skipping, clustering, and appropriate compute sizing.
Provide Databricks platform administration support covering workspace configuration, cluster policies, compute governance, runtime management, libraries, groups, permissions, service principals, secrets, tokens, and access troubleshooting.
Support Unity Catalog administration, including catalogs, schemas, tables, volumes, privileges, external locations, storage credentials, lineage, and controlled access to governed data assets.
Oversee production deployments and environment promotions for notebooks, jobs, pipelines, configurations, and infrastructure changes using Git and CI/CD practices, with validation and rollback planning.
Create and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, monitoring checks, known-error records, troubleshooting guides, reconciliation controls, and knowledge articles.
Collaborate with data engineers, platform administrators, DevOps teams, cloud infrastructure teams, database administrators, security teams, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and improve platform reliability.
Participate in platform health checks, capacity and cost reviews, disaster recovery exercises, release activities, and rotational on-call support.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong hands-on experience with Databricks jobs, notebooks, workflows, pipelines, clusters, SQL warehouses, Spark UI, Delta Lake, and production troubleshooting.
Strong Python and PySpark skills for code analysis, debugging, ETL development, data transformation, exception handling, logging, testing, and performance optimization.
Solid understanding of Spark architecture, drivers, executors, stages, tasks, shuffles, partitions, caching, memory management, adaptive query execution, and common performance bottlenecks.
Strong ETL and ELT knowledge, including ingestion patterns, orchestration, incremental processing, change data capture, data validation, error handling, restartability, and data reconciliation.
Good SQL skills for data analysis, source-to-target validation, reconciliation, query tuning, and incident diagnosis.
Working knowledge of Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server, including schemas, tables, views, stored procedures, indexes, privileges, connectivity, and execution plans.
Practical knowledge of Databricks platform administration, workspace security, identity and access management, secrets, cluster policies, runtime upgrades, and compute.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will supervise and guide your team members closely, ensuring the service sequence is flawless and goes beyond guest expectations. As an F&B Executive, you re not just creating unforgettable dining moments - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent; proven experience in a similar role.
Excellent communication, grooming, and interpersonal skills
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
Friendly, professional, and guest-focused
Able to work flexible shifts
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Operational Oversight: Support daily outlet operations to ensure smooth service and adherence to brand standards.
Team Leadership: Supervise, train, and motivate staff to deliver exceptional guest experiences and maintain high performance.
Guest Experience Management: Ensure personalized service, handle guest feedback, and resolve issues promptly to enhance satisfaction.
Inventory & Cost Control: Monitor stock levels, manage ordering, and control costs to optimize profitability.
Sales & Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
Compliance & Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
Coordination & Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.
Food Safety Regulations: Ensuring that all food safety standards are met.

Description:
Work with client and internal teams to design and deliver secure, reliable, and cost-effective cloud and hybrid infrastructure solutions. Lead technical discovery, architecture decisions, estimation, delivery planning, and quality assurance from concept through implementation. Manage team of technical resources and overlook project delivery.
Roles and Responsibilities

Connect with customers to understand the current environment, requirements, constraints, dependencies, and integration interfaces.
Pre sales support to sales team in understanding customer requirements and preparing scope of work.
Design and document production-ready infrastructure solutions for on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
Create proofs of concept where needed to validate designs, reduce technical risk, and improve estimate accuracy.
Prepare infrastructure cost and effort estimates, including cloud pricing calculations and resource or skill requirements.
Communicate with Solution Architects from AWS, Azure, GCP or other cloud OEM as and when needed based on customer projects.
Break solution designs into clear work packages with prerequisites, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and delivery estimates.
Define infrastructure security concepts and work with client security teams to meet security and compliance requirements to meet the cloud standards
Design monitoring, logging, and alerting for cloud, on-premises, monolithic, and microservices-based environments.
Lead technical and DevOps teams; delegate tasks, resolve technical issues, and act as the quality gate for deliverables.
Support internal initiatives and represent the company at relevant industry events.
Professional and Technical Skills

5-6 years of relevant infrastructure, cloud architecture, or technical consulting experience, with multiple completed projects and valid technical certifications
Successful delivery experience as a Cloud Architect / Pre sales on greenfield and migration projects.
Hands-on architecture experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform; multi-cloud experience is an advantage.
Strong technical consulting skills, including workshop facilitation, current-state assessment, requirements analysis, and practical client recommendations.
Ability to turn complex environments into clear cloud architecture designs, implementation plans, work packages, and estimates.
Strong leadership and communication skills, with experience guiding multidisciplinary technical teams and making architecture decisions.
Structured approach to priorities, deadlines, dependencies, risks, budget, and quality.
Working knowledge of security, networking, identity, compute, storage, backup, resilience, monitoring, and cloud cost optimisation.
Ability to produce architecture designs, migration concepts and plans, cost and effort estimates, pricing calculators, Architecture Decision Records, improvement and technical-debt backlogs, client requirements and constraints

Description:
Job Summary
Discipline: GDS Enablement Services Growth & Innovation
Role title: Quantum Senior Associate
The Quantum Senior Associate will play a hands-on delivery role across Quantum Technology initiatives, with stronger ownership for solution design, technical execution, stakeholder communication and delivery quality than an Associate role. The role requires practical experience in quantum-safe security and/or quantum computing, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
The role is expected to have a primary focus on quantum safety, including post-quantum cryptography readiness, and a secondary focus on quantum computing use cases such as optimization, machine learning and simulation.
Responsibilities
Support the development of quantum safety and quantum computing solutions, prototypes and demonstrations.
Contribute to post-quantum cryptography readiness assessments, including data gathering, analysis and documentation.
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms and workflows for selected optimization, machine learning and simulation use cases.
Build and maintain software tools, accelerators and proof-of-concept assets using established engineering practices.
Prepare technical documentation, assessment reports and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including cybersecurity, AI/ML, platform engineering and product teams.
Participate in testing, validation and benchmarking activities to assess solution performance and applicability.
Stay current on developments in quantum computing, post-quantum cryptography and related emerging technologies.
Quantum Specialist Responsibilities
Quantum Cyber / Safety:
Support quantum risk assessments and identify areas that may require future cryptographic modernization.
Assist in prototyping and benchmarking post-quantum cryptography algorithms within applications and services.
Contribute to analysis of quantum-safe and hybrid cryptographic approaches and document findings.
Support development of crypto-inventory and discovery capabilities to identify legacy cryptography dependencies.
Execute testing of hybrid key exchange mechanisms and document performance observations.
Assist with implementation and validation of crypto-agility patterns, certificate updates and key management enhancements.
Contribute to creation and maintenance of migration guides, standards documentation and operational runbooks.
Quantum Compute & Algorithms:
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms using industry-standard quantum development platforms.
Support experimentation and testing to assess the practicality of quantum use cases.
Build proof-of-concept solutions for optimization, simulation and emerging Quantum + AI use cases.
Perform basic resource estimation and analysis of quantum circuits and algorithm performance.
Compare classical and quantum approaches and document observations and recommendations.
Maintain reproducible experimentation environments using Python, Jupyter notebooks, containers and source control tools.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Foundational understanding of quantum computing concepts, including qubits, gates, quantum circuits and current hardware limitations.
Basic understanding of post-quantum cryptography concepts, key encapsulation mechanisms, digital signatures and emerging standards.
Familiarity with cryptographic concepts such as public-key cryptography, certificates and secure communication protocols.
Experience with at least one quantum development platform such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, Azure Quantum or AWS Braket.
Proficiency in Python programming and familiarity with commonly used scientific and data analysis libraries.
Working knowledge of software development fundamentals, including version control and testing practices.
Ability to design and execute experiments, analyse results and communicate findings effectively.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in global, cross-functional teams.
Interest in emerging technologies and willingness to continuously learn new concepts and tools.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
25+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
Software development or engineering
Applied cryptography or cybersecurity
Data science, machine learning or advanced analytics
Quantum computing research or development
High-performance or scientific computing
Experience developing prototypes, proof-of-concepts or technical solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks.
Familiarity with Python and scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas or similar tools.
Exposure to quantum computing concepts, quantum software development kits or post-quantum cryptography is preferred but not mandatory.
Understanding of cybersecurity and cryptography fundamentals is desirable.
Experience working in agile, research or innovation-focused environments is advantageous.
Ability to independently complete assigned deliverables while collaborating effectively with senior team members.
Publications, hackathons, certifications, research projects or open-source contributions related to quantum technologies are beneficial but not required.
Willingness to work with global teams and support overlap with US East Coast hours when needed.

Apprentice Trainee Resources (HR)
Company
Manappuram Finance Limited (MAFIL)
Location
Corporate Office, Valapad, Thrissur, Kerala
Position
Apprentice Trainee Human Resources
Department
Human Resources (HR)
Employment Type
Apprenticeship (NATS/Apprenticeship Program)
stipend: As per NATS Norms
Job Summary
The Apprentice Trainee will assist the Human Resources Department in recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation, HR operations, data management, and administrative activities. The trainee will gain practical exposure to HR processes and support day-to-day HR functions while ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
Key Responsibilities
Recruitment & Onboarding
Assist in sourcing and screening candidate profiles.
Coordinate interview schedules with candidates and department heads.
Follow up with selected candidates regarding joining formalities.
Support onboarding activities and document collection.
Maintain candidate and joining trackers.
HR Operations
Verify employee documents and ensure completeness of records.
Update employee information in HRMS and related databases.
Assist in maintaining employee personal files and HR records.
Support preparation of HR reports and MIS.
Apprentice & Internship Coordination
Assist in NATS Apprentice and PMIS Intern recruitment activities.
Coordinate with branches and candidates for document submission.
Monitor joining status and maintain compliance records.
Employee Engagement & Administration
Support employee communication initiatives.
Assist in organizing HR events, training programs, and engagement activities.
Provide administrative support to HR team members.
Compliance & Documentation
Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
Ensure proper filing and record management.
Assist in HR audits and compliance-related documentation.
Support preparation of HR letters, reports, and correspondence.
Eligibility Criteria
Educational Qualification:
Any Graduate (B.Com, BBA, BA, B.Sc, BBM, BCA, or equivalent).
Fresh graduates are preferred.
Candidates enrolled under the NATS Apprenticeship Program will be given preference.
Skills Required
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
Ability to maintain confidentiality.
Willingness to learn and work in a professional environment.
Desired Competencies
Teamwork and collaboration.
Time management.
Organizational skills.
Problem-solving ability.
Professional attitude and integrity.
Learning Outcomes
The Apprentice Trainee will gain practical exposure to:
Recruitment and Talent Acquisition
Employee Onboarding
HR Documentation and Compliance
HRMS Operations
Employee Engagement Activities
HR Reporting and MIS Management

Nandakumar, the current MD & CEO, its origins go back to 1949 when it was founded in the coastal village of Valapad (Thrissur District) by his late father Mr. V.C. Padmanabhan. Description:
Job Summary
Position: Project Coordinator - Project SAMBAL
Location: Bhatapara, Chattisgarh
Reporting To: State Programme Manager (in State) Senior Programme Manager - Livelihoods (Head Office)
Project Duration: As per project period (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
This role supports and coordinates field-level implementation of the project by mobilising rural elderly, strengthening Elder Self-Help Groups (eSHGs), promoting financial inclusion and livelihoods, and facilitating access to government entitlements. The role also includes monitoring project progress, maintaining records, and reporting outcomes to the Head Office.


Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day implementation of project activities at the field/project level.
Mobilise rural elderly and facilitate the formation and strengthening of Elder Self-Help Groups (eSHGs).
Supervise regular group meetings, savings, internal lending and maintenance of group records with support of mobiliser/ESHG leaders.
Support livelihood activities, financial literacy and access to government entitlements and social security schemes.
Coordinate with local government functionaries, banks and other stakeholders for project activities and service linkages.
Undertake regular field visits and provide support to ESHGs and community members.
Maintain project records, update MIS and submit periodic progress reports to the Head Office.


Requirements
Graduate in any discipline, preferably in Social Sciences or related fields.
2-3 years of relevant experience in rural development, community mobilisation, SHG promotion or livelihood programmes.
Preference will be given to candidates having experience in SHG formation, management and working with community-based institutions.
Basic understanding of rural livelihoods, financial inclusion and government welfare schemes.
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with rural communities.
Basic computer knowledge, particularly MS Office and data entry.
Willingness to undertake regular field visits and proficiency in the local language.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
SUMMARY
Job Description
Title : Field Sales Executive
Location: Raipur - (Bhatapara, korba and Raigarh)
Job Type: Contract (For more than 1 year)
Industry : Paint - Chemical
Summary :
This field sales role is pivotal in driving business growth by building strong relationships with key stakeholders such as painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets through proactive customer engagement, daily site visits, and active presence at assigned retail locations. By organizing regular shop meetings, maintaining accurate sales records, and leveraging a strong understanding of the market, the sales representative will play a critical role in expanding market reach and enhancing brand visibility. The position requires a self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
Responsibilities :
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
Develop and nurture long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key customers.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
Spend at least two hours daily at the assigned store to engage customers and support sales activities.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to drive product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports via the online portal.


Requirements
Requirements :
Valid two-wheeler is mandatory for field operations.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and driven by performance targets.
Minimum qualification:Graduation preferred.
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with sales aptitude are also encouraged to apply.
Other pointers regarding this job:
Age Criteria: 18years old to 30years old are eligible
Gender : Only Male can apply
Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with 1+ year experience in field sales, channel sales, banking, or insurance sales can apply.
Qualification: Graduate or Post Graduate (any year pass - out).
Work Details: Day shift role with third-party payroll (2coms).


Benefits
Benefits :
Net Take Home: 18K-22K (Negotiable)
MWA 5000/ -
Lucrative performance-driven incentives.
Absorption after 1 year on performance basis.
Travel allowance up to 2000- 5000 per month based on profile.

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary IRDA Regulation on IMF was released, where companies which are LLP / Pvt limited / cooperative societies were allowed to distribute financial products. IMFs are allowed to deal in Insurance of 6 companies (2LI, 2GI, 2HI), mutual funds, banking products, post etc. Max life spotted this opportunity to attract established financial distributors from the market to engage and distribute max life products - PEARL ACQUISITION. A dedicated team of 50 CDMs were recruited in two phases and trained to hire farm these relationships. Currently we have 95 licensed IMFs on board and expected to touch 150 which are work in progress. The pool of IMF s primarily comprises of top Agents in Insurance, Wealth Managers, Loan DSA, CA, Ex - employees from financial services with an existing customer base customer base. Present IMF carries avg. 2500 customers and big turnover book. As a later part of Pearl acquisition strategy, Insurance Managers is a career option provided to establish financial distributors who are not able to meet the requirements of forming an IMF. This has also proven to be an exciting opportunity. Insurance Manager is part time employee model which provides a platform to the pearl to associate with MLI and improve their earnings, flexible working hours and better choices to their customers. IM will be different from an ADM/APC as he will not be recruiting and mentoring Agents and will only source business by penetrating into his existing client base. Avg book size with them is also 750 customers.


Key Responsibilities
Understand the IM acquisition and IMF regulation, value proposition registration process
Acquisition of 6 - 7 IMs in a year independently.
Independently managing a pool of Insurance Managers mapped to them from existing pool in the beginning only.
Post successful completion of 1 year, the next level is CDM wherein the focus will be on IMF journey
Manage performance of IMs
Develop understanding of products coach IM staff on product USP s
Implement performance management and rewards system in IMs
Provide marketing, training and operational support to IMs
Manage attrition of IMs through revival or replacement
Drive quality of business sourced from IMs
Ensure right product mix and control key quality measures such as leakage and persistency.


Measures of Success
Minimum 6-8 IM Acquisition in a year
Achieving sales target through team of IMs
IM Activity Retention
Quality of Business
Create pipeline for IMF s


Qualifications and Experience
Educational Background: Minimum a graduate
Work Experience: At least 1-3 years of experience in recruiting business partners / Agents and achieving sales target through them.
Good communication skill.


Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Excellent Written, presentation communication skills
Exceptional consultative interpersonal skills
Stakeholder management
Influencing without authority
Full understanding / experience of handling entire life cycle of a deal from initiation to successful completion

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.
AboutCompany: 2COMS Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is a Recruitment and staffing solutions company established in 1999 in Kolkata with branches in Pune, Hyderabad & Bhubaneshwar. 2COMS focuses on verticals like KPO, BPO, IT, Insurance, Banking.

Description:
Job description
We are looking for a passionate and driven IT Head to join our dynamic team at Manipal Hospitals!

About Us:
As a pioneer in Healthcare, Manipal Hospitals is among the top healthcare providers in India serving over 5 million patients annually. Today we stand as an integrated network with a pan-India footprint of 50 hospitals across 19 cities with 10,500 beds, and a talented pool of over 7,200 doctors and an employee strength of over 20,000.

Location: Raipur, Chhatisgarh

What You'll Do:.
Role holder will be responsible for managing the complete IT Infrastructure & Applications of the Unit.
Responsible for Vendor coordination
Coordinate with Corporate IT Team on any concerns/issues wrt IT Infrastructure, Applications, Support etc.
Manage hardware backups & Infrastructure network management
Responsible for budget & financial adherence & control
Manage data, IT security & system configuration
Frequent Requirement Study(FRS) documentation in consultation with various stakeholders
Security level development and design and authorization
System and Inventory management and upgradation
Act as a single point of contact for senior management interaction
Mentor the local IT team and define their KRAs and review the same.
Managing existing applications at the unit and ensure policies are adhered to.
Extend cooperation to NABH and NABL Audits.
AboutCompany:
At Manipal Hospitals, we are devoted towards clinical excellence, patient centricity, and ethical practices. Our commitment to clinical excellence is palpable in the high calibre of our team of medical practitioners. Our nursing staff and paramedical professionals are highly competent and provide great support to our clinical team Our healthcare services are aligned towards our patients needs. Creating a compassionate and supportive environment for patients and their caregivers is of utmost importance to us. Our values have constantly supported us to be the best hospital in Mysore. We attach the highest importance to ethical practices which is evident in our professional conduct, honesty, trust, and confidentiality.

Description:
Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Key Responsibility
Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day
Demonstrate app search (by vehicle model and part name), part selection, payment, and delivery tracking
Facilitate the buyer's first online spare parts purchase stay with them through the transaction
Follow up within 7 days of first purchase to ensure delivery satisfaction and resolve any issues
Capture buyer feedback on platform gaps: parts not found, confusing UX, delivery complaints report weekly
Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD
Participate in platform training sessions when new features or categories are launched

Qualification & Experience

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Description:
Treebo Hospitality Ventures is Indias most loved brand and one of the largest chains in the budget segment of hospitality. With a network of 850+ hotels across 120+ cities, Treebo offers travellers the unprecedented value proposition of high-quality stays at affordable prices wherever they go. We are proud of putting dignity back into budget travel where earlier the traveller was forced to contend with poor quality and hygiene. Treebo Hospitality Ventures masterfully combines engineering prowess with deep hospitality expertise. Our operational ethos is clear and focused from Treebo Club, an innovative distribution platform and extremely rewarding loyalty programme to Hotel Superhero, a cutting-edge SaaS solution and a comprehensive hotel management software. With a strong technological foundation and a passion for hospitality, THV aims to deliver exceptional experiences across our diverse portfolio. Our range of brands—Itsy Hotels, Treebo,
Treebo Premium and Medalio—provides a symphony of choices that blend quality, comfort and affordability.
Treebo is a Great Places to Work certified organisation.We take immense pride in our culture which is built on a strong foundation of 7 values. Some of these values include - “Exhibit Owner Mindset” and “Have the humility and hunger to learn and help learn”, amongst others. We
strongly believe in offering our people - “Treebs”, as they are called - unmatched opportunities to learn and grow. If you’re looking to work at a place that is built on strong fundamentals of business and professional conduct, Treebo is the place for you.
About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the company’s strategic vision of democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing the operations and enabling
sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a
business development mindset.
Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association
What Are We Looking For -
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability.
CompanyAddress: Building H210, HustleHub Tch Park, 27th Main road, Sector 2, HSR layout, Vanganahalli Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka, 560102, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India
