Title: Assistant General Manager - Lead Tooling R&D
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, ToolingsTeam Handling, Tool DesignTool DevelopmentTool ManufacturingTool EngineeringTooling OperationstoolTeam LeadershipTeam Leading, About company
Description:
Role Purpose
Lead development, industrialization, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production tools, molds, dies, jigs, fixtures, and gauges. Ensure tooling readiness, reliability, quality, productivity, cost competitiveness, and minimum production downtime at the Gagret plant.

Key Responsibilities
Own tooling strategy and execution for NPI, capacity expansion, localization, and continuous improvement.
Lead design, development, trials, validation, and production release of injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and assembly/welding/testing fixtures.
Apply DFM/DFA, GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, MSA, and SPC during tooling development and industrialization.
Establish preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance covering tool-life monitoring, refurbishment, calibration, critical spares, and replacement planning.
Reduce defects, breakdowns, changeover time, and tooling-related downtime using RCA, TPM, Lean, and Kaizen.
Coordinate with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Industrial Engineering, Purchase, and Supply Chain for pilot builds, ramp-up, and stable production.
Develop toolmakers and machining/fixture vendors; manage RFQs, technical evaluation, trials, acceptance, cost, delivery, and localization.
Lead tooling engineers, designers, tool-room technicians, and external partners with safety, quality, delivery, and cost accountability.

Candidate Requirements

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, or Tool Engineering. PG Diploma/M.Tech in Tool Design or Manufacturing preferred.
12-18 years in tooling design/development, industrialization, and high-volume plant support.
At least 8 years leading tooling/tool-room teams and cross-functional projects.
Exposure in Injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tooling, jigs, fixtures, gauges, assembly/welding fixtures, and tool validation.
Desirable hands-on responsibility for preventive/predictive maintenance, refurbishment, spares planning, tool-life improvement, and downtime reduction.
Exposure in Battery, inverter/UPS, energy storage, automotive components, electrical/electronics, or comparable high-volume manufacturing.
GD&T, DFM/DFA, PFMEA, APQP/PPAP, MSA/SPC, RCA, Lean, TPM, and vendor development.
Working knowledge of SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX, or AutoCAD.
AboutCompany:
Luminous Power Technologies is a leading player in energy solutions, committed to driving Indias clean energy transition with a sharp focus on innovation and sustainability. With a legacy spanning over 38 Years, Luminous has built a robust presence in the energy and residential solar space. Its wide portfolio of innovative products, including inverters, batteries, and best-in-class solar solutions that is designed to provide the end-to-end energy management ecosystem with reliability, safety, and efficiency.
As the demand for reliable, clean, and efficient power growsespecially among home consumers, as a consumer energy fulfillment company, Luminous fulfils the evolving energy needs of millions of households and businesses across the world. The company operates seven state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, supported by an expansive network of over 28 sales offices and 100,000 channel partners across India. Today, Luminous powers over 100 million Indian homes and is expanding its reach globally, with a presence in more than 40 international markets.
Research and development, and continuous innovation, drive Luminous to constantly enhance the efficiency and lifespan of products, the convenience of consumers, and to stay ahead of technological trends. As an emerging Prosumer technology brand, the companys vision goes beyond just providing power; it's about empowering consumers. Through their flagship Connect-X app and integrated technologies, consumers get real-time insights and complete transparency over their energy ecosystems, through valuable information on energy consumption and monitoring, solar energy generation, and inverter performance.
The companys culture is a true representation of inclusion, allyship, and empowerment. Luminous remains committed to responsible business practices, demonstrated through extensive Corporate Social Responsibility programs supporting Education & Employment, Environmental conservation, and Electrification through Solar.
With a passionate team and a relentless drive to innovate, Luminous continues to set benchmarks in the energy sector. Its consistent recognition, such as five consecutive Consumer Superbrand Awards for residential power backup, underscores its trusted reputation in homes across India and beyond.
Luminous Power Technologies is more than an energy solutions company its a catalyst for a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

Description:
Position- Lab Technician
Location- Palampur

Qualification Required- DMLT, BMLT, CMLT, B.voc MLT
Experience- 1- 5 years

Role & responsibilities

To perform assigned analytical testing procedures in an accurate, precise, and timely manner in the assigned lab.
To perform routine and non-routine activities pertaining to laboratory testing and reporting and maintaining external and Internal Quality control
Maintain required records and documentation.
Follow the laboratory's procedures for specimen handling and processing, test analyses, reporting and maintaining records of patient test result.
Analyze specimens using approved testing procedures as per SOP's, review and release test results.
Adhere to the laboratory's quality control policies, instrument
and procedural calibrations and follow safety guidelines as per established organization protocols.

Preferred candidate profile:

Qualification: DMLT, BMLT, CMLT, Bvoc MLT
Experience: 1-5 Years
AboutCompany:
Established in 1949, Dr Lal PathLabs today is the largest and most respected diagnostic service provider in the country. It has a proven track record of over six decades for strict adherence to international standards and benchmarks. Dr Lal PathLabs offers widest test menu and has a pan India presence in all important cities and towns of India, in the form of state-of-the-art laboratories and patient service centres.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. Description:
We are hiring DECK CADET to join our shipping company on board ocean-going merchant vessels under the guidance of senior deck and engine officers

The role involves assisting with navigation watchkeeping, cargo operations, deck and engine room maintenance, and safety drills as part of onboard training

Candidates must hold the mandatory pre-sea training certificates, INDoS number, and a valid CDC/passport, and be medically fit as per DG Shipping norms

This is an excellent opportunity to build a long-term career at sea with structured onboard mentorship, sign-on support, and progression toward higher ranks

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Description Geotechnical Engineer
Position: Geotechnical Engineer
Project Location: Dehradun / Tehri
Project Duration: 5 Years
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Geotechnical Engineer to support the planning, design, and implementation of Tourism Infrastructure Projects. The incumbent will be responsible for undertaking and reviewing geotechnical investigations, soil and rock mechanics assessments, foundation design, slope stability analysis, and geotechnical calculations. The role will also involve preparing and reviewing geotechnical reports, design recommendations, sketches, and drawings indicating ground conditions, foundation requirements, and design intent for various components of Urban Development Projects.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct site visits to access geotechnical conditions.
Supervise soil and rock sampling, in-situ testing, and laboratory analysis.
Interpret geotechnical data to develop comprehensive site characterization.
Analyse soil- structure interaction and propose solutions for ground improvement if required.
Prepare geotechnical design reports and review contractors submission related to geotechnical aspects.
Identify potential geotechnical risks and recommend mitigations measures.
Ensure all geotechnical activities comply with Indian regulations, international standards and best practices.
Provide technical inputs during the review of design and construction plans.
Ensure timely delivery of design outputs while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and sustainability.

Essential
Graduate Degree in Civil Engineering.
Post Graduate Degree in Geotechnical Engineering,
Experience Requirements
Minimum 8 years of experience in geotechnical engineering, including site investigations, designs and construction support.
Proficiency in geotechnical software and analysis tools.
Knowledge of Indian and International geotechnical standard and codes.
Experience in infrastructure, building, slope stability and earthwork.
Strong project management skills with experience in overseeing multidisciplinary teams
Technical Skills
Proficiency in:
AutoCad
PLAXIS
Geostudio

Ensure designs comply with relevant BIS, IRC, IS, and international standards where applicable.
Strong capabilities in design optimization, and technical review.

Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills in geotechnical engineering.
Excellent coordination, communication, and technical reporting abilities.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, consultants, contractors, and government stakeholders.
Experience in managing multiple geotechnical design assignments, site investigations, and construction support activities within project timelines.
Strong understanding of soil mechanics, foundation engineering, slope stability, and ground improvement techniques.
Ability to interpret geotechnical investigation data, identify ground-related risks, and recommend appropriate engineering solutions.

Maximum age: 45 years as of the date of application.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way youd like, where youll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where youll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Integration Cloud (OICS) Consultant to design, develop, implement, and support enterprise-grade integrations across Oracle Cloud applications and third-party systems.
Design, develop, test, and deploy integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC/OICS).
Build and maintain real-time and batch integrations between Oracle Cloud applications and external systems.
Develop integrations using REST, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, Database, and File Adapters.
Design scalable integration architectures and reusable integration patterns.
Implement error handling, exception management, monitoring, and performance optimization.



Your Profile

Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC/OICS).
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, XML, JSON, XSLT, and XPath.
Experience with Oracle SaaS applications (ERP, HCM, SCM, CX).
Expertise in Oracle Cloud Adapters and Connectivity Agents.
Knowledge of integration patterns, API design, and event-driven architecture.
Experience with SQL and databases (Oracle preferred).
Understanding of security protocols including OAuth, JWT, SSL, and SSO.
Experience with troubleshooting, monitoring, and performance tuning of integrations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



What you''ll love about working with us

We value flexibility and support a healthy work-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.
We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise andstrong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Avenue E-commerce Limited (AEL) is an online extension of Avenue Supermarts Limited flagship brand. Dmart Ready is the mobile application through which our customers order grocery and other utility products. We seek to be a one - stop shopping destination for the entire family, meeting all their daily household needs offering value for money. A wide selection of home utility products is offered at an affordable price, including groceries, foods, toiletries, beauty products, garment, kitchenware, bed and bath linen, home appliances and much more. Currently we are present at Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad and Bangalore locations.

Job Description: Assistant Manager MIS & Business Analytics (Finance)

Role Objective:
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented professional to lead MIS reporting, financial data analysis, dashboard development, and business performance tracking. The primary responsibility will be to transform raw financial and operational data into meaningful insights that enable management to make informed business decisions.

Key Responsibilities:
1. MIS Reporting & Management Dashboards
Develop, manage, and enhance daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management.
Design interactive dashboards to track business performance, profitability, revenue, expenses, and other key performance indicators.
Consolidate data from multiple sources and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
Develop customised reports and dashboards based on management requirements.
Automate repetitive reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

2. Business Insights & Data Analytics
Analyse large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Develop new reports, analytical models, and performance metrics to provide deeper visibility into business performance.
Identify the reasons behind revenue fluctuations, cost increases, margin changes, and deviations from targets.

3. MIS Automation & Process Improvement
Build advanced Excel-based reports and dashboards using Pivot Tables, Power Query, advanced formulas, and data models.
Develop Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions wherever applicable.
Improve data collection, validation, reporting formats, and analytical processes.
Establish standardised KPI definitions and reporting practices across departments.
Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and reliability of management information.

Description:
Head Corporate Accounts

OUR BUSINESS:

Tribeca is the largest branded luxury developer in India! Established in 2012, we have grown to become the largest developer of Trump-branded properties in the world (after the Trump Organization). Our current employee strength comprises more than 250+ associates across Mumbai, Pune, Delhi-NCR, Kolkata, and Bangalore, and we have a team of incredibly talented, hungry, bright, and passionate folks, including IIT, IIM, Wharton, and SPA toppers and industry stalwarts.
At Tribeca, we are focused on creating world-class products and customer experiences. We pioneered the concept of branded residences in India and are developing over 6 million square feet of branded residential projects in India. We are also proud to be developing the world's largest rooftop terrace.
We believe in contributing towards a sustainable environment and are committed to developing responsible homes that are energy-efficient and use materials and resources that do not have a negative impact on the environment.
Join us in our mission to create world-class real estate and customer experiences. Be a part of the Tribeca team and help us shape the future of luxury real estate in India.

www.tribecadevelopers.com

Location: Lower Parel, Mumbai
Job Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: Chief Financial Officer

Job Summary:

The Head Corporate Accounts will lead the corporate accounts function and oversee financial reporting, management information systems (MIS), consolidation of accounts and audit-related activities. The role will be responsible for ensuring accuracy, consistency and timeliness of corporate financial information and strengthening accounting controls and reporting processes.
Key Responsibilities:

Accounting & Financial Reporting

Oversee corporate accounting activities and ensure accurate and timely maintenance of books of accounts across group entities.
Lead the preparation and review of periodic standalone financial statements under Ind AS and IGAAP, as applicable to each entity.
Ensure correct application of Accounting Standards and Ind AS, including revenue recognition (Ind AS 115), inventory, borrowing cost and project-cost accounting relevant to real estate.
Review account reconciliations, schedules and supporting documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy.

MIS & Monthly Closure

Drive monthly book closure within defined timelines, including monthly PAT and cash flow reporting.
Oversee preparation of MIS reports and provide meaningful financial insights to management, including variance analysis against budget.

Consolidation

Manage consolidation of accounts and ensure consistency of accounting policies and accuracy across subsidiaries, SPVs and joint arrangements.
Ensure timely reconciliation and elimination of inter-company transactions and balances.

Audit

Coordinate and oversee internal and statutory audit processes, including audit schedules, documentation and closure of observations.
Act as the primary point of contact for auditors on accounting and reporting matters.

RERA & Statutory Compliance

Oversee quarterly and annual RERA compliances, including CA certificates for withdrawals from designated project accounts and annual compliance reports, in coordination with project and legal teams.
Monitor accounting policies, internal controls and compliance with applicable accounting and statutory requirements.

Controls, Systems & Process Improvement

Ensure effective use of SAP / ERP for accounting, reporting and closure processes.
Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting systems and control mechanisms, including Internal Financial Controls (IFC).
Coordinate with business and finance stakeholders for timely closure of financial reporting requirements.

Team Leadership

Guide, develop and support the accounts team to ensure effective delivery of the function.
Qualifications & Experience:

Chartered Accountant (CA).
Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in financial reporting, MIS, consolidation of accounts and audit.
Experience in managing corporate accounts and coordinating audits.
Real estate or multi-entity business experience would be an advantage.

Key Competencies:

Sound knowledge of Accounting Standards and Ind AS, with hands-on experience in preparing financial statements under both IGAAP and Ind AS.Sound understanding of MIS, consolidation and audit processes.
Leadership, team management and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical ability and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple reporting deliverables and deadlines.

Description:
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Manager | Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune | Overall Relevant Exp: 7+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns the value story for the engagement - defines value metrics and KPIs, establishes the baseline, builds the business case, and tracks value realization.
Defines the agentic solution design - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Drives business development and pre-sales - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact


Qualification
Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

Description:
Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

Job Summary:
Accenture AI is seeking a talented and motivated Generative AI Data Scientist Consultant to join our Banking team. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Generative AI models, Machine Learning, Data Analysis, and Cloud Platforms to develop innovative solutions and enhance AI capabilities. This role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement generative AI solutions that meet our business needs.

Strong proficiency in Python programming and experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Expertise in API Development and deployment, with hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

Knowledge of security best practices and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and creative thinking skills to design and implement innovative solutions.
Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.


Additional Information:
Experience with large-scale data processing and expertise in NLP or computer vision.
Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.
Experience with cloud integrations, big data technologies, and performance optimization.
Familiarity with security standards and regulatory compliance in AI solutions.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. * Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.

* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.

Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..

Receptionist / Front Office Security Coordination Executive
Job Description
Position Summary
We are seeking a professional, customer-focused, and highly organized Receptionist
to serve as the first point of contact for employees, visitors, customers, and external
stakeholders. This role is responsible for managing front desk operations, visitor
management processes, communication channels, and supporting emergency
response communications. The successful candidate will work closely with the
Physical Security team, Global Workplace Services (GWS), and business leadership to
ensure a safe, secure, and welcoming workplace environment.
1) Front Desk Visitor Management
Serve as the primary point of contact for all visitors, guests, vendors, and contractors
entering the facility.
Manage visitor registration, badge issuance, access verification, and check-in/check-
out procedures.
Maintain accurate visitor logs and ensure compliance with company security
policies.
Coordinate VIP visits and executive guest arrivals.
2) Telephone Communication Management
Manage incoming telephone calls and route inquiries appropriately.
Respond professionally to employee, customer, and vendor inquiries.
Support office-wide communications and announcements as required.
3) Email Administrative Support

Coordinate meeting room bookings and visitor notifications.
Maintain records, reports, and workplace documentation.
4) Emergency Communication Response Support
Support emergency communications during incidents, evacuations, and business
continuity events.
Assist Security and Facilities teams during emergencies.
Participate in emergency drills and preparedness programs.
5) Security Team Collaboration
Act as an integral member of the Physical Security team.
Support access control, badge management, and workplace security initiatives.
Report security concerns and maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
6) Coordination with GWS and Business Leaders
Partner closely with GWS to support smooth workplace operations.
Coordinate workplace requirements with facilities and service providers.
Support business leaders with meetings, events, and visitor arrangements.

Qualifications
Bachelors degree or equivalent experience preferred.
2+ years of experience in reception, administration, workplace services, hospitality,
or similar roles.
Strong communication, customer service, and organizational skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams).

Customer Focus

Attention to Detail
Problem Solving
Integrity Confidentiality
Time Management
Crisis and Emergency Response Awareness
Stakeholder Management

Positive visitor and employee experience.
Accurate and compliant visitor management processes.
Effective emergency communication support.
Strong collaboration with Security, GWS, and business stakeholders.
Timely response to inquiries and workplace support requests.
Maintenance of a secure, professional, and welcoming office environment.

To provide exceptional front-office services while supporting workplace security,
employee safety, and business operations through effective visitor management,

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and results-oriented Senior Sales Executive to drive business growth by acquiring new clients and developing strong relationships with existing customers. The candidate will be responsible for promoting logistics and supply chain services, generating new business opportunities, achieving sales targets, and expanding the company's customer base.
The ideal candidate should have experience in B2B sales, logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, or supply chain services, along with strong communication, negotiation, and client acquisition skills.

Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience in selling logistics and transportation services.
Existing contacts with manufacturers, exporters, importers, and corporate clients.
Strong networking and business development abilities.
Ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Senior Developer
Capgemini development team • module owner • AI-native • C# / .NET
Role summary
A senior C# engineer who owns one or more delivery slices end to end design, build, tests, deployment to QA and Pre-Production, integration with third-party systems, and business review — and is accountable for the result working on integration, not merely passing in isolation. Works evaluation- and test-driven, uses agentic AI development tools as the default way of working, and holds the flow and quality disciplines of the team without exception. There is no testing team to hand quality to.
Working context
The team is small and senior by design. Where work is well-specified, AI-augmented engineers are expected to deliver materially more every two weeks than a conventional team; where work is ambiguous — interpreting a plan rule, judging a country's payment logic — the constraint is the engineer's judgment, and AI adds nothing.
Quality is not a phase and not a department. Each senior developer owns the entire range of work for a slice: the code, the tests that prove it, the integration behavior, the documentation, and the board that shows where it is. Nothing is handed off to a testing team in the traditional way; the Senior Quality Architect designs the quality system, but the developer is accountable for the outcome inside it.
Part of the work is inheriting and evaluating an existing codebase built by the previous team through the forfeiture stage. Not all of it will be kept.
Key responsibilities
• End-to-end slice ownership. Take a slice from acceptance criteria to a working, integrated increment in Pre-Production. 'Done' means it works against the real interfaces or their contract-verified stubs, its tests gate the pipeline, its documentation is current and the business has seen it in a demo window — not that it compiled.
• Evaluation- and test-driven development. Write the evaluation criteria and tests before or alongside the code, for every change: unit, contract (Pact) and end-to-end (Playwright). Use the same discipline for AI-generated code — define what correct looks like first, then generate, then verify.
• Accountable for integration. Own the behavior of your slice across the interfaces it touches — SAP H1P, PeopleConnect, Clarity, Zurich, ASC, Alight/Empower, the primary bank. Contract tests first, then joint test windows with the third party's technical contact. An integration defect in your slice is your defect.
• Trunk-based delivery. Merge to trunk many times a day behind feature flags; keep the pipeline green; deploy to QA on every merge and to UAT / Pre-Production several times a week. A red pipeline is the first priority for whoever broke it.
• Flow discipline. Maintain the Kanban board as the true state of your work — every day, without being asked. Respect WIP limits, keep items moving, flag blocked work immediately, and keep work documentation (design notes, decisions, test evidence) current as part of the slice, not after it.
• Programming standards and code quality. Apply the team's programming standards on every change and hold others to them in review. Keep SonarQube quality gates green — coverage, duplication, maintainability, reliability and security ratings — and treat a failed gate as a blocker, not a warning.
• Inherited code. Evaluate the existing IBIS 2.0 modules — through the forfeiture stage — against the target architecture, the SonarQube baseline and the quality bar; remediate, refactor or replace with a documented rationale.
• Multi-country rules. Implement plan rules and payment logic so that country-specific behavior is configuration rather than code branches, working with the Rules & Country Config Lead and the business SMEs.
• Business collaboration. Demonstrate working software to the Product Owner and business SMEs in the Tuesday and Thursday demo windows; turn their feedback into backlog items the same week.
• Review. Review other engineers' changes with the same rigor applied to your own; act as reviewer of record on every merge you approve. AI review is a second pass, never the gate.
Required skills and experience
• 7+ years professional software engineering with C# as the primary language; 3+ years building and operating .NET microservices in production.
• Very comfortable with agentic AI development tools as the default way of working — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot agent mode or equivalent — including context and prompt management for a large codebase.
• Evaluation-driven and test-driven design and development as an ingrained practice, not a preference: defines what correct looks like before writing or generating code.
• Highly quality-oriented: demonstrable history of owning the full range of work for a feature and being accountable for it working on integration, in a team with no separate test function.
• Strong flow discipline: keeps Kanban boards accurate daily, respects WIP limits, documents work as it happens, applies programming standards consistently — and expects the same of peers.
• Working proficiency with SonarQube (or equivalent) as part of the definition of done: reads and acts on quality-gate results, coverage, code smells and security hotspots.
• Automated testing across the pyramid: unit frameworks (xUnit / NUnit), consumer-driven contract testing (Pact), browser end-to-end (Playwright).
• Trunk-based development with feature flags and continuous delivery pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).
• Cloud-native delivery on GCP (or Azure / AWS with a willingness to work on GCP): containers, managed data services, secrets and identity.
• API design and enterprise integration patterns; experience integrating with SAP or another large ERP.
• Comfortable demonstrating working software to non-technical business users and taking direct feedback.
Agentic AI expectations
• Works AI-first on well-specified tasks: implementation from acceptance criteria, test generation, data mapping, migration scripts, documentation drafts — with the evaluation criteria defined before generation.
• Uses AI for comprehension of the inherited codebase and for refactoring proposals, and verifies every proposal against tests and SonarQube before merging it.
• Understands and applies the team's guardrails: AI never merges, AI never touches production data, AI-assisted changes are traceable, and business-rule interpretation is a human decision.
• Can explain to a business SME what was AI-generated and what was engineered, and why it does not change the quality bar.
Nice-to-have
• Pensions, benefits, payroll or payments domain experience — vesting, forfeiture, distribution, settlement.
• Rules-engine implementation experience.
• Exposure to SAP ECC / EhP8 interfaces (IDoc, BAPI, OData).
• Mutation testing, property-based testing or other techniques that test the tests.
Duration
Full-time from mobilization through cutover and hypercare. Candidates should expect to continue into the Capgemini managed-service team at reduced allocation.
Success measures
• First slice integrated, in Pre-Production and reviewed by the business by end of month 2.
• Every merged change carries its own tests and passes the SonarQube quality gate; pipeline pass rate on first attempt above 90% as steady state.
• Kanban board reflects true state at every daily check; no item ages past the team's limit without a documented reason.
• Integration defects attributable to owned slices found in joint test windows, not in Gate 4 or hypercare.
• Inherited modules evaluated with a written keep / remediate / replace decision by end of month 2.
• Zero Sev-1 or Sev-2 defects escaping to production from owned slices during hypercare.

Job Summary
Job Title: Risk Manager - Sustainability Risk
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
Location: Mumbai, India


Role Description
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures - but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That s why we are Investors for a new now .
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients financial future. And in return, we ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.
This is your chance to invest in your future.
Read more about DWS and who we are here.


Team / division overview
The DWS Chief Risk Office provides independent oversight across key risk types and supports effective risk decision-making.
The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) team coordinates cross-risk governance, risk reporting and risk appetite / legal entity risk management processes, and is responsible for independent review and challenge across areas including strategic, capital and sustainability risk.
The Sustainability Risk team, as part of ERM, integrates sustainability risks and adverse environmental and social impacts into DWS s risk management framework. It develops the ESG risk strategy and risk appetite, monitors risk levels, and supports second-line functions in developing ESG / sustainability-related control objectives.


Your key responsibilities
As a Risk manager you will (be)
Maintain and develop the integration of Sustainability Risks and Adverse Impacts in the DWS Group Risk Management Framework
Support the development and monitoring of appropriate qualitative and quantitative measures to enhance the DWS Risk Appetite Statement in relation to sustainability risk
Review and challenge 1LoD processes related to sustainability and ESG (controls, assessments etc.)
Support quantitative and qualitative external disclosures related to sustainability risk
Enhance the consideration of Sustainability Risks across key risk management framework components such as the Risk and Control Self-Assessment and the Risk Inventory
Regular review and challenge of the control framework to ensure alignment with evolving laws and regulations
Providing updates to senior stakeholders and forums on key ESG initiatives
Other tasks include analytical deep-dives, change initiatives, maintaining stakeholder dialogue and support for the team as projects arise.


Your skills and experience
University degree in Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Business Administration, Risk Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 years experience in sustainability / ESG risk management, ESG disclosures, or a comparable front-office role
Good understanding of European sustainability-related regulations, standards and industry developments
Working knowledge of the asset management industry and its regulatory environment.
Understanding of core risk management concepts, including risk identification, assessment, controls, risk drivers, scenario analysis and internal/external events.
Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and manage sustainability risks and impacts originating from or impacting ESG factors.
Understanding of the interaction between sustainability risks and traditional risk types, including operational, reputational and financial risks.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across a complex organization.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver effectively in a dynamic environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.


How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career.
Coaching and support from experts in your team.
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), MCP (Model Context Protocol), and AI Agent Frameworks. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous agents, and advanced retrieval systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop AI-powered applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build and deploy Agentic AI solutions capable of autonomous reasoning and task execution.
Implement RAG architectures using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
Develop integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI tool and data connectivity.
Build multi-agent systems using modern Agent Frameworks.
Fine-tune prompts and optimize LLM performance for business use cases.
Develop AI workflows for document processing, knowledge management, and conversational AI.
Integrate AI services with enterprise applications using APIs and microservices.
Collaborate with data scientists, product teams, and software engineers to deliver AI solutions.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend best practices.
Required Skills
2-6 years of software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models.
Experience building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Knowledge of Agentic AI architectures and autonomous AI agents.
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration and AI tooling.
Hands-on experience with AI Agent Frameworks such as:
LangGraph
LangChain
CrewAI
AutoGen
Semantic Kernel
LlamaIndex
Experience with Vector Databases:
Pinecone
ChromaDB
Weaviate
Milvus
FAISS
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Open Source LLMs.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI application development.
Experience with REST APIs and Microservices.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with AI Observability and Evaluation Tools.
Knowledge of Fine-Tuning and Model Optimization.
Experience with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Exposure to NLP, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning concepts.
Knowledge of CI/CD for AI deployments (LLMOps).
Experience building AI Chatbots, AI Assistants, and Enterprise Search solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Job Title: Relationship Manager - CAT - Elite
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


As a Relationship Manager in the CAT - Elite team, you will be responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with our high-value clients, ensuring that their financial needs are met effectively. Your main focus will be on developing comprehensive financial strategies that align with clients objectives, providing personalized service, and maximizing client satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with various internal teams to deliver exceptional service and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value clients, understanding their financial goals and needs.
- Provide tailored financial advice and solutions to meet client requirements, including insurance products and investment opportunities.
- Conduct regular client meetings to review portfolios, discuss market trends, and assess client satisfaction.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
- Identify new business opportunities and drive customer acquisition through referrals and networking.
- Monitor client portfolios and recommend adjustments to align with changing financial situations or goals.
- Stay updated on industry trends, product offerings, and regulatory changes to provide informed advice to clients.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Bachelors degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Proven experience in relationship management, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong understanding of insurance products, investment strategies, and financial planning.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Proficiency in using CRM systems and MS Office Suite.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a collaborative team.
- Initiative and proactive approach to managing client relationships and identifying opportunities.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software
- Financial modeling tools
- MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
- Market analysis tools and platforms
- Communication tools (email, video conferencing, etc.)

This position offers a unique opportunity for individuals who are passionate about building strong client relationships and helping clients achieve their financial objectives while being part of a dynamic team at Axis Max Life Insurance.

With a strong distribution network and customer-centric approach, Axis Max Life aims to deliver long-term value and security to individuals and families across India.

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
Responsible for availability of Raw Material & Components as per agreed delivery dates aligned to Production Schedule by effective vendor management and internal escalations.
To prepare the RM delivery schedule against Purchase Orders in alignment with the Production schedule based on supplier capacity in mind.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
Vendor Management & Expediting
Drive proactive vendor engagement with a go-getter attitude to ensure timely deliveries.
Prepare and monitor scheduling lines post-PO release; align supplier schedules with plant requirements.
Track delivery performance, escalate critical delays, and ensure adherence to monthly supply plans.
Utilize Vendor Portal for streamlined communication and grievance resolution.
Collaborate with planning and plant teams to maintain safety stock and optimize storage utilization.
Develop and maintain procurement dashboards for performance tracking and reporting.

Ensure the Long Lead Time parts are well planned based on Season requirement

Measure and report RM/component availability against production plans.
FSN Analysis & Aging Inventory Analysis
Indirect Purchase (Opex/Capex) Experience.

Governance & Compliance
Ensure adherence to government norms related to taxation, safety, and environmental regulations.
Apply 5S, QC tools, and process control charts to enhance procurement operations.
Support corporate SCM initiatives across logistics, planning, strategic sourcing, and supplier development.
Desired Skills & Experience
Strong analytical and communication skills.
Exposure to vendor negotiations, import/export regulations, and compliance frameworks.
SAP End user skill level important
Must have experience in relevant Consumer durable /Appliance industry, handled Metals/Plastics/Packaging/Fabrication item.
Indirect purchase experience

Job Description

Company Name :

SBICAP Securities Limited

Position Title & Department :

Home Loan Sales Executive

Home Loan Sales

Industry :

Dealing in Equities & Commodities Broking, Retail Assets and Distribution of Financial Product

Company Profile :

SBICAP Securities Ltd (SSL) is the broking & distribution arm of the State Bank Group and a wholly owned subsidiary of SBI Capital Markets Ltd. The Company currently has in its fold a wide segment of clients including Banks, Financial Institutions, FIIs, Mutual Funds, Corporate, High Net worth Individuals, Non-Resident Indians and Retail domestic investors. Its product range covers Institutional and Retail Equity, Derivatives, Depository Participant services, On-Line trading and a wide variety of Retail Assets & Third Party Distribution products.

Key Accountabilities :

Generate Home Loan leads from open market and through different channels.
Develop and maintain relationship with clients for repeat business and referral/s
Implement and develop sales activities to achieve target.
Arrange loan events
Handle product queries and service issues.
Meeting clients, verify documents, process file, co-ordinate for sanction / disbursement of loan, personalized service to clients.
Ensure the achievement of given business target.
Key Competencies :

1. A good team player
2. Co-ordination Skills
3. Result Oriented
4. Eye for details and completion of Documentation
Qualification :

MBA/Graduate
Experience :

Total Years of Experience : 1- 3 years

Upto 2.5 L+ Incentive
