Description:
Position: Regional Head Northeast: Manipur, Nagaland and Assam (Programmes, Partnerships & Business)

About Dharmalife
Dharmalife (www.dharmalife.in) is a social impact organization advancing inclusive progress across India through two core pillars — People and Planet. Working in over 40,000 villages across 15 states, it has built a rural network of 20,000+ women entrepreneurs, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), who drive sustainable community development.

The organization works alongside women by enhancing their economic power, agency, and leadership, while addressing key social and environmental challenges. Through this network of DLEs, Dharmalife promotes sustainable livelihoods, behaviour change, and solutions across key domains — Health, Well-being, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, and Circular Economy.

By 2030, Dharmalife aims to advance 1 million rural women through sustainable livelihoods and care support. Its group entities — Dharmalife Foundation, Gajam India Pvt. Ltd., Dharmalife Labs, and Dharmalife Society — work together to create lasting systemic change at scale.

Position Summary
The Regional Head – Northeast-Manipur, Nagaland and Assam is the senior leadership position in the region responsible for driving Dharmalife’s growth, programme delivery, partnerships, and operational excellence across the region.

The role combines four critical dimensions:
Business and Sales Growth through the Dharmalife Entrepreneur (DLE) network
DLE Group Development and Entrepreneur Ecosystem Strengthening
High-Quality Execution of Donor and CSR-Funded Programmes
Strategic Government and Institutional Partnership Development

The Regional Head serves as the primary representative of Dharmalife within the Northeast region, along with central office functions, and is responsible for achieving commercial, social impact, operational, and stakeholder engagement objectives across all assigned districts

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Revenue Generation
Drive state-level sales and revenue targets across region, across Dharmalife products, services, and programme-linked business opportunities.
Strengthen entrepreneur productivity, customer outreach, and market penetration.
Develop district-wise growth plans and sales strategies.
Monitor sales conversion, order fulfilment, collections, inventory movement, and business performance.
Identify new business opportunities and market expansion areas.
Improve DLE earnings and income-generating opportunities.
Drive sustainable business growth through community-based distribution models.

2. DLE (Dharmalife Entrepreneur) Network Development & Community Engagement
Lead recruitment, onboarding, activation, and retention of DLEs and DLTs.
Build and strengthen village-level DLE groups and entrepreneur collectives.
Increase active participation and engagement of women entrepreneurs.
Develop leadership capabilities among high-potential DLEs.
Ensure regular field engagement, group meetings, and entrepreneur support.
Improve entrepreneur retention and productivity.

3. Programme & Project Execution
Lead implementation of donor-funded and CSR-supported programmes across the Northeast.
Ensure achievement of programme deliverables, timelines, budgets, and impact indicators.
Monitor beneficiary outreach, training completion, adoption metrics, and community engagement.
Ensure high-quality implementation across Health, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, Circular Economy, and future programmes.
Maintain programme documentation, field evidence, case studies, and reporting standards.
Support surveys, assessments, research activities, audits, and donor visits.
Ensure safeguarding, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.

4. Government & Strategic Partnerships
Develop strategic relationships with: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs); Women & Child Development Department; Labour Department; Education Department; Tribal Development Department; Skill Development Missions; Renewable Energy Agencies; District Administration; and Panchayati Raj Institutions
Build partnerships with CSR foundations, corporate partners, financial institutions, NGOs, development organizations, Academic and research institutions
Identify opportunities for programme convergence, co-funding, and scale-up.
Represent Dharmalife at state-level/ region level forums, consultations, and stakeholder meetings.
Facilitate approvals, coordination, and institutional support for programme implementation.

5. Team Leadership, Governance & Operations
Lead and mentor Territory Channel Managers, Cluster Heads, Enterprise Leaders, and other teams.
Drive performance management, coaching, and capability development.
Conduct regular reviews and field visits.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and operating procedures.
Monitor budgets, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality, reporting discipline, and governance standards.

Candidate Profile

Education
Graduate or Postgraduate in: Rural Management; Business Administration; Social Work; Development Studies and Related disciplines

Experience Required
8–12 years of relevant experience.
Experience in rural markets, social enterprises, development sector, livelihood promotion, microfinance, channel management, CSR, or large-scale field operations.
Proven experience managing multi-district or state-level teams across the region.
Demonstrated success in both programme delivery and business development.
Experience working with government stakeholders and donor-funded programmes will be preferred.

Competencies Required

Leadership Competencies: Strategic Thinking; Execution Excellence; Team Leadership; Ownership & Accountability

Functional Competencies: Rural Market Development; Programme Management; Sales & Business Development; Stakeholder Engagement; Partnership Development; Community Mobilisation; Data-Driven Decision Making;

Behavioural Competencies: Integrity; Collaboration; Resilience; Learning Agility; Entrepreneurial Mindset; Relationship Building

Travel Requirement
This position requires extensive travel across the Northeast, including regular visits to the Head office (Delhi), villages, DLE groups, programme sites, government offices, partner organizations, and district headquarters. Field immersion and direct stakeholder engagement are critical success factors for this role.

Why Join Dharmalife
This role is a chance to lead one of India's largest women-led rural entrepreneurship and impact ecosystems and to directly contribute to livelihoods, sustainability, community development, and social transformation at scale.

Job Summary
Digital Marketing Associate (1 Post): Manage and strengthen our online sales operations across e-commerce platforms, preferably Amazon. The role involves managing product listings, improving product visibility, driving online sales, and coordinating with entrepreneurs and internal teams to ensure smooth marketplace operations.


Requirements
Graduate in any discipline; a background in business, marketing, commerce, or a related field is desirable.
Prior experience in e-commerce operations or online marketplace management, preferably Amazon Seller Central.
Understanding of product listings, catalogue management, inventory, order fulfilment, and online sales.
Knowledge of e-commerce advertising, promotional campaigns, and sales analytics.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for sales tracking, reporting, and data analysis.
Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple products, stakeholders, and deadlines independently.
Experience working with food products, handloom, handicrafts, MSMEs, or rural enterprises will be an advantage.
Basic product photography, image editing, or Canva skills are desirable
Freshers with skills or knowledge in the above-mentioned requirements can also apply


Key Responsibilities
Manage product listings, catalogue updates, pricing, and inventory across e-commerce platforms, preferably Amazon Seller Central.
Oversee order processing, packaging, dispatch, returns, and customer enquiries to ensure smooth marketplace operations.
Plan, execute, and monitor e-commerce advertising and promotional campaigns to improve product visibility and drive online sales.
Monitor marketplace account health, resolve operational issues, and coordinate with platform support teams.
Track payments, reconcile settlements, and maintain accurate sales and financial records.
Analyse sales trends, SKU performance, advertising results, and conversion rates to identify opportunities for business growth.
Coordinate with entrepreneurs to collect product information, monitor stock availability, and ensure timely order fulfilment.
Facilitate the onboarding of new entrepreneurs, brands, and products onto e-commerce platforms.
Prepare regular sales, performance, and progress reports for internal reviews, donors, and programme partners.
Maintain accurate records of entrepreneur onboarding, product listings, sales, and market-access outcomes to support programme monitoring and donor reporting.
Coordinate with internal teams to collect data, document achievements, and ensure timely submission of programme and donor reports.


Functional Area
Chumoukedima


Employment Type
Full Time
Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Collect and analyse data and prepare timely donor reports, case studies, and success stories

Description:
Job Summary
The Employment Livelihood Supervisor will be responsible for supporting the implementation, supervision, and monitoring of employment, livelihood, skilling, entrepreneurship, and value-chain development initiatives across Nagaland.
The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
Coordinate with beneficiaries, entrepreneurs, producer groups, community institutions, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities and deliverables are implemented in accordance with approved plans and timelines.
Support beneficiary identification, mobilisation, training, enterprise development, monitoring, and reporting.
Maintain accurate project records and supporting documentation as required by partners and funding agencies.
Youth Mobilisation Employment Support: Mobilise youth for employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and livelihood opportunities.
Conduct outreach activities in communities, educational institutions, training centres, and other relevant locations.
Support career guidance, job-readiness, and employment-related activities.
Facilitate linkages between youth and relevant employers, training institutions, and livelihood opportunities.
Track employment and livelihood outcomes of programme participants.
Enterprise Entrepreneur Support: Provide field-level support to aspiring and existing entrepreneurs.
Assist entrepreneurs in identifying opportunities, challenges, and potential market linkages.
Support enterprise development activities, including business planning, capacity building, product development, and market access.
Coordinate with relevant technical experts, financial institutions, and market partners where required.
Field Supervision Stakeholder Coordination: Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme activities and beneficiary progress.
Supervise field staff, mobilisers, trainers, and other project personnel, as assigned.
Build and maintain relationships with government departments, financial institutions, employers, educational institutions, community organisations, producer groups, and other stakeholders.
Represent in field-level meetings, workshops, consultations, exhibitions, and other programme events.
Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data and supporting documentation.
Prepare regular field visit reports, progress reports, case studies, success stories, and other project documentation.
Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.
Support the preparation of reports and updates required by YouthNet s partners and funding agencies.
Market Linkages Promotion: Support market linkage initiatives for products developed through livelihood value chains.
Assist in identifying potential buyers, institutional markets, retailers, distributors, and other market opportunities.
Support exhibitions, fairs, product showcases, buyer-seller meets, and promotional activities.
Coordinate with relevant teams on branding, packaging, marketing, and product promotion.
Key Deliverables
Timely and effective implementation of assigned Employment Livelihood projects.
Achievement of beneficiary, training, employment, enterprise, and livelihood targets.
Effective field-level implementation of financial institution-supported initiatives.
Strengthened livelihood value chains.
Increased participation of youth and communities in sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.
Improved market and institutional linkages for livelihood enterprises.
Accurate and timely programme data, documentation, and reporting.
Regular field monitoring and follow-up with beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Documentation of programme outcomes, success stories, and lessons learned.
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Development Studies, Social Work, Rural Development, Management, Economics, Sociology, Agriculture, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in livelihood development, employment, entrepreneurship, skill development, value-chain development, community development, or programme implementation.
Experience working with development organisations, government programmes, financial institutions, NGOs, CSR programmes, or donor-funded projects will be an advantage.
Experience in livelihood value chains, enterprise development, market linkages, or community-based programmes will be preferred.
Familiarity with the socio-economic and livelihood context of Nagaland will be an advantage.
Key Skills Competencies
Employment and livelihood programme implementation
Value-chain and enterprise development
Field supervision and community mobilisation
Youth engagement and employment facilitation
Stakeholder and partner coordination
Market linkage and business development
Monitoring, data collection, and reporting
Team coordination and problem-solving
Strong written and verbal communication
MS Office/Google Workspace proficiency
Willingness to undertake frequent field travel across Nagaland
Personal Attributes
Strong ownership and accountability
Proactive and solution-oriented approach
Good interpersonal and community engagement skills
Ability to work with diverse stakeholders
Strong organisational and coordination skills
Adaptability to field-based working environments
Commitment to youth development, employment generation, and sustainable livelihoods
Employment type
Full Time
Notes
For Queries - Working Hours: Monday to Friday (10:00 am to 4:30 pm)
Or you can upload your resume via WhatsApp and one of our YouthNet Job Centre Representatives will call you back

Description:
Department: Mission SOAR Nagaland
Reports To: Academic Lead
Location: Kohima


Purpose of the Position
Academic Manager will support the Academic Lead in coordinating academic design and capacity-building activities under Mission SOAR Nagaland. The role ensures timely consolidation of inputs from ecosystem partners, government stakeholders, and field educators into actionable frameworks, materials, and training resources. The Academic Manager will provide critical operational and project management support to enable the Academic Lead to focus on pedagogical quality and stakeholder alignment.


Organisational Unit Function
Support the Academic Lead in consolidating frameworks, lesson plans, assessments, and training resources.
Coordinate with SCERT, DIETs, and other state institutions for feedback and approvals.
Track design timelines and milestones, ensuring timely delivery of academic outputs.
Manage quality control documentation and review cycles across partners.
Support facilitation of co-design workshops and training sessions.
Organize academic content for dissemination through DIKSHA or other platforms.
Maintain records of academic interventions, iterations, and evidence of impact.
Prepare inputs and updates for governance and reporting processes.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports to the Academic Lead (with dotted-line coordination with the Programs Lead).


Selection Criteria

Essential
Postgraduate degree with 7 years of program/academic coordination experience.
Familiarity with curriculum design, training programs, or education reform.
Strong project management and organisational skills.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination abilities.
Ability to manage timelines and quality assurance processes.
Experience with educational technology platforms is desirable.

Description:
Job Summary
The Senior People Officer is the experienced HR generalist within NagaEd, responsible for managing the applicant tracking system (ATS) pipeline, maintaining HR documentation and policies, administering compliance filings, and supporting the full employee lifecycle with growing independence. This role bridges the gap between administrative HR execution and strategic people operations handling complex HR processes that require judgement, accuracy, and a working knowledge of Indian employment practice. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Senior People Officer takes ownership of HR processes rather than simply executing them. Where the People Officer handles coordination and data entry, this role manages the ATS pipeline end-to-end, drafts and maintains HR policy documents, prepares compliance filings, conducts initial screening of candidates, supports performance review administration, and serves as a knowledgeable resource on HR processes for the wider team. The Senior People Officer also provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate on shared workflows. Success in this role is measured by the quality and currency of HR documentation, the integrity of recruitment and employee data, the timeliness of compliance filings, and the ability to manage HR processes independently while knowing when to escalate.


Job Details
Department: Operations
Direct Reports: None (provides task-level guidance to People Officer / People Associate)
Manager: Operations Manager
Mentor/support: Operations Manager
Location: Kohima


Organisational Unit Function
ATS Pipeline Recruitment Management: Manage the applicant tracking system maintaining pipeline stages, updating candidate statuses, and ensuring data integrity throughout the recruitment cycle. Conduct initial CV screening and shortlisting against position description criteria, preparing shortlist recommendations for the hiring manager and Operations Manager. Coordinate and support interview processes scheduling panels, preparing assessment materials, collecting interviewer scorecards, and compiling evaluation summaries. Draft offer letters, employment contracts, and pre-employment correspondence for the Operations Manager s review and approval. Maintain recruitment analytics time-to-fill, pipeline conversion rates, and source effectiveness and surface insights to the Operations Manager. Ensure a professional, timely, and consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints.
HR Documentation Policy Administration: Maintain, update, and version-control NagaEd s HR policy documents, SOPs, the Employee Handbook, and associated templates. Draft new HR policies and SOP updates as directed by the Operations Manager researching best practice and ensuring alignment with Indian employment law requirements. Ensure all employees have signed and acknowledged current versions of key HR documents employment contracts, NDAs, handbook acknowledgements, and code-of-conduct agreements. Manage the HR documentation lifecycle drafting, review routing, approval tracking, distribution, and archiving maintaining a clear audit trail. Prepare HR correspondence confirmation letters, role change notifications, warning letters, and other employee communications for the Operations Manager s review.
Compliance Filing Statutory Administration: Prepare and coordinate statutory compliance filings POSH annual returns, Shops and Establishments Act returns, Professional Tax, and other applicable filings in coordination with the Operations Manager and external advisors. Maintain compliance calendars and trackers, ensuring all filing deadlines are surfaced to the Operations Manager at least two weeks in advance. Support POSH compliance administration maintaining the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) register, scheduling mandatory awareness training, and tracking completion. Coordinate with the Senior Finance Officer on employee-related statutory matters EPF, ESIC, and TDS records ensuring consistency between HR and finance records. Prepare documentation for labour inspections, audits, and regulatory queries as required.
Employee Lifecycle Records Management: Manage the HRIS (Zoho People or equivalent) employee master data, employment history, contract records, probation dates, and lifecycle milestones. Administer the probation review cycle tracking probation end dates, sending reminders to reviewing managers, compiling review documentation, and preparing confirmation or extension letters. Process employee changes promotions, transfers, reporting line updates, and salary revisions ensuring all changes are documented, filed, and reflected in HR systems. Maintain accurate and complete personnel files for all employees, ensuring audit readiness at all times. Administer the offboarding process exit checklists, knowledge transfer coordination, access revocation, final settlement documentation, and exit interview scheduling.
Performance Management Engagement Support: Support performance review cycles distributing review templates, tracking submission deadlines, compiling completed reviews, and maintaining performance records. Administer the goal-setting and OKR/KPI tracking process, ensuring all employees have current documented goals and that review cadences are maintained. Support the Operations Manager in running engagement initiatives pulse surveys, recognition programmes, team events, and feedback mechanisms. Compile and analyse HR data for engagement reporting participation rates, survey results, and trend tracking presenting summaries to the Operations Manager.
Leave, Attendance Payroll Coordination: Oversee leave and attendance management reviewing leave records for accuracy, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining up-to-date leave balances. Prepare monthly payroll inputs attendance summaries, leave adjustments, new joiner and leaver details, and variable components for handoff to the finance function. Respond to employee queries on leave policy, entitlements, and attendance with accuracy and in a timely manner.
Team Coordination Task Guidance: Provide day-to-day task-level guidance and quality checks to the People Officer and People Associate on recruitment coordination, data entry, filing, and onboarding logistics. Serve as the first escalation point for HR process queries from NagaEd staff before matters reach the Operations Manager. Ensure continuity of people operations during the Operations Manager s absence by maintaining standing HR processes and escalation protocols.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Operations Manager. The Senior People Officer works with all NagaEd staff and managers on HR processes, coordinates with external advisors on compliance matters, and collaborates with the finance function on payroll and statutory employee contributions. The role does not hold formal line-management authority but provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate.


Selection Criteria
This role requires an experienced HR generalist who can manage multiple HR processes with accuracy and growing independence. The Senior People Officer must have a working knowledge of Indian employment practice, be comfortable drafting HR documents, and be able to exercise judgement on routine HR matters while knowing when to escalate.


Essential
Minimum 2 3 years of experience in HR generalist, HR administration, or people operations roles.
Working knowledge of Indian employment law fundamentals leave entitlements, POSH obligations, statutory filings, employment contract requirements.
Experience managing an ATS or structured recruitment pipeline.
Strong documentation and writing skills able to draft policies, SOPs, employment letters.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:-
Inspection & Testing: Examine incoming raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), and finished products using precision measuring tools, visual checks, and non-destructive testing (NDT).
Process & System Monitoring: Verify that manufacturing, fabrication, or construction workflows comply with quality management frameworks like ISO 9001 or industry standards.
Defect & Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate product failures, run root-cause investigations (such as 5 Whys, Ishikawa/fishbone diagrams, or 8D reports), and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA/NCR).
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain detailed inspection logs, calibration records, test certificates, and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for audits and traceability.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise with production teams, design engineers, suppliers, and external clients to resolve quality disputes and optimize standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Continuous Improvement: Promote quality methodologies such as Six Sigma, Poka-Yoke (error-proofing), and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

Strong leadership, strategic planning, negotiation, and analytical skills.

Description:
Network Engineer (1Post): Qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications, BCA, or a related field.
Equivalent qualifications and relevant networking experience may also apply.
CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA A+, or preferred equivalent certifications.
Requirements & Key Skills:
Minimum 3-5 years of experience
Knowledge of FTTH/GPON technologies and fiber network architecture.
Familiarity with RADIUS/AAA systems, subscriber authentication, and billing integration.
Experience managing upstream BGP connectivity, peering, and traffic engineering.
Experience with network monitoring platforms such as PRTG, Zabbix, or similar NMS tools.
Basic scripting knowledge (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or MikroTik scripting) for automation and operational efficiency.
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, IPv4/IPv6, VLANs, NAT, and network troubleshooting.
Experience with routing and switching technologies, including OSPF and BGP.
Hands-on experience with MikroTik RouterOS and enterprise networking equipment.
Knowledge of network security, firewalls, access control management.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve network, connectivity, and hardware-related issues.
Experience in network design, implementation, optimization, capacity planning, and performance tuning.
Functional Area:
Dimapur
Employment type:
Full-time
Salary Package:
Negotiable
For Queries, Working Hours: Monday to Friday (10:00 am to 4:30 pm)

Description:
Bada Business Pvt Ltd is looking for Business Counselors to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Must have good listening skills and be passionate about sales, with a keen interest in understanding and addressing client needs.
Ability to respond to sales queries promptly and effectively, demonstrating strong communication skills both over the phone and in person.
Engage with potential clients to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions.

Collaborate with the sales team to develop effective strategies for acquiring new clients and retaining existing ones.

Keep abreast of industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for business growth.
Utilize CRM systems to track and manage client interactions and sales activities.
Meet or exceed sales targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Conduct follow-up calls and meetings to ensure customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Description:
The Educator, Art Labs will lead and facilitate impactful, art-based learning sessions in classrooms, promoting creative expression and social-emotional development among children. This role will involve regular observation and documentation of classroom dynamics and student engagement. This role will shape the holistic growth of the children by driving a community-building movement in our model school, thereby creating strong evidence on art and SEL in classrooms.


Roles and Responsibilities

1. School Scouting and Art Lab Development
Identify and visit potential schools where Art Labs can be set up.
Assess schools based on available space, infrastructure, student strength, school leadership, and readiness to support an Art Lab.
Meet principals and teachers to understand the schools needs and assess the feasibility of setting up and sustaining an Art Lab.
Document school visits and share findings to support school selection and planning for Art Lab setup.
Coordinate with selected schools to support the setup of Art Labs and their integration into regular school activities.


2. Government Engagement and Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain relationships with relevant state and district government officials, including the Education Department, SCERT, DIET, and other relevant institutions.
Share SArCs approach and work with government stakeholders and explore opportunities to establish and strengthen Art Labs in schools.
Coordinate with government officials, funders, and school leadership to facilitate school visits, address implementation needs, and support program delivery.
Work with artists, volunteers, and creative professionals to bring additional art experiences to children.


3. Art Facilitation and Classroom Engagement
Facilitate joyful and inclusive art sessions for children from Grades 1 to 8 throughout the academic year.
Adapt existing art lesson plans to suit childrens needs, interests, and classroom contexts while keeping the intended learning outcomes in mind.
Create a classroom environment where children feel comfortable expressing themselves, sharing ideas and exploring their creativity.
Guide children through reflection and discussion to help them express their thoughts, listen to others, and develop self-awareness.
Design visual teaching aids and lead school-wide art projects, exhibitions and installations that give children opportunities to explore relevant social and community themes through art.


4. Field Observations and Research
Conduct school visits and structured classroom observations to understand how art education is practised, and the challenges schools and teachers face.
Collect information through classroom observations, interviews with teachers and school leaders, and other research tools as required.
Support research studies on art education, teaching practices, student engagement and the implementation of Art Labs.
Prepare field visit reports, case studies and summaries of findings, highlighting challenges, patterns and practices that can inform program decisions.
Work with the Research and Impact team to plan school visits, collect data and maintain accurate records.


5. Curriculum and Monitoring and Evaluation (ME)
Work closely with the Curriculum and ME teams to share feedback from classrooms and schools on the relevance, suitability, and implementation of art activities.
Identify gaps in lesson plans, teaching resources and facilitation approaches based on classroom experiences, teacher feedback and student participation.
Share specific recommendations on what needs to change in the curriculum, activities or teaching resources to meet childrens needs better and address classroom realities.
Support the Curriculum team in reviewing and testing revised activities and resources, and share feedback on their effectiveness.
Work with the ME team to document classroom observations, track student progress, and assess whether sessions are meeting their intended outcomes.
Maintain relevant program records, including classroom dashboards, field notes, and documentation of childrens work, to support program review and improvement.


Qualifications and Experience
A graduate degree in Education, Arts, Child Development, or a related field is required. A postgraduate degree is an added advantage.
3-4 years of experience in teaching and classroom facilitation, preferably in creative learning or arts-integrated settings.
Experience working with low-income or underserved school communities will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of child-centred pedagogy, experiential learning and childrens social-emotional development.
Experience in classroom observation, documentation and using feedback or data to improve teaching and learning.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work with children, teachers, school leaders, government stakeholders and internal teams.
Alignment with Saturday Art Classs vision of making arts education an integral part of public school education.
Skills and Mindset
Facilitation and empathy: Creates inclusive spaces where children feel safe to express themselves and explore their creativity.
Curriculum adaptation: Can work with art-based curricula and adapt activities and lesson plans to suit childrens needs, abilities and classroom contexts while keeping learning objectives in mind.
Ownership and organisation: Takes responsibility for tasks and outcomes, manages multiple priorities and meets deadlines with minimal supervision.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Location: Kohima
Hours: Full-time

Purpose of the Position
The Software Developer is a member of the IT Team and is responsible for building, and maintaining core components of our Learning Management System (LMS). To be successful in this role, you will need extensive knowledge of programming languages and the software development life-cycle. The ideal candidate will have robust experience (and interest) in different languages and frameworks to uplift NagaEd's capabilities for delivering digital education to schools and institutions. This role will contribute to the organization's overall strategic digital initiatives.
Organisational Unit Function
AWS support and cloud infrastructure management
Server maintenance and monitoring to ensure system reliability and uptime
Maintain and upgrade internal projects including payroll systems and other business tools
Development of new products aligned with NagaEd's strategic goals
Write testable, performant code that can scale to lakhs of requests per day
Mentor and teach other juniors, encouraging best practices with a focus on quality production
Work with a mature technology stack that includes Linux, bash (scripting), SQL, Python, JavaScript, REST, APIs
Use React to write key features to improve teaching and learning
Documentation development
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities, or status
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve software bugs/issues
Training other team members on troubleshooting and diagnosing problems

This role reports directly to the Founder

Communications (Internal/External)
Founder: Report to and collaborate with; Guidance, support and mentoring
NagaEd Team: Consult, Collaborate, Project work
Partners, Clients and affiliates: Consult, Collaborate, Project work
Selection Criteria
You enjoy working in a team environment with multiple stakeholders. You are able to think outside the box and provide novel and adaptive solutions to challenges. You have skills in multiple domains including your expertise in software development. You are driven to deliver projects on time with a high attention to detail and a focus on quality outputs.
Essential
Experience (and interest) in different coding languages and frameworks
Skilled full-stack developer, or an expert back-end developer open to growing towards full-stack
Ability to solve complex problems requiring in-depth analysis
3-5 years of professional software development experience
Capable Communicator
Passionate about sharing knowledge and solving problems
Knowledge of, and adherence to coding best practices
Ability and desire to work in an open and team-oriented environment
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related degree preferred
Knowledge of the software development life-cycle
The desire to work in a fast-paced environment
Ability to develop unit testing of code components or complete applications
Desirable
Knowledge of Learning Management Systems
Coding skills, Python, JavaScript, React
Knowledge of Agile best practices

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:
Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.
AboutCompany: About OYO: OYO is one of the leading global travel and hospitality brands, offering a wide range of accommodations through its extensive network of hotels and homes. With a strong presence in over 80 countries, we are transforming the way people experience travel and stay. We are looking for passionate, dynamic, and result-driven individuals to join our team and help drive growth in our B2B Travel and Corporate Sales domain.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Job Title
Area Manager-Mortgage and Liabilities


Department
Legal


Location
Regional Office (Bangalore, Noida, Kolkata and Pune)


Type of Position
Full-time


Reports To
Regional Legal Head (South/North/East/West)


Role Purpose Objective
Drafting/vetting/review of all kinds of credit documentation for MSE and Housing, including security documents and all transaction documents for various kinds of fund based and non-fund based as well as secured and unsecured facilities.
To represent bank before SRO while registration and cancellation of mortgage documents.
Vetting of Title Scrutiny Reports (TSR) submitted by panel Advocates to confirm that the TSR satisfies the business requirements of the Bank.
Assist the business/Credit in registering Mortgages wherever necessary.
Managing legal issues pertaining to creation/registration of Mortgages, Hypothecation, Pledge etc.
To prepare and vet underwriting documents for loan creation and security perfection.
To empanel requisite number of panel advocates and ensure prompt handling of cases by panel Advocates.
Liaise with Courts, Commercial Courts, Arbitration Tribunals, DRTs, Legal Services Authorities, panel Advocates, empaneled Recovery Agents, Consumer Fora etc. and ensure their good relationship with the Bank
Track changes relating to Stamp duty payable for the different states in the Region and update the stake holders
Track changes in State specific Laws relating to the Region and update the stake holders.
Monitor and track cases filed against bank until closure.
Furnish advisory to Branch Banking, Service Quality, Admin, Vigilance, HR and other departments.
Drafting and vetting of Police complaints, reverts to notices received from Statutory Authorities, replies to be filed in Court of Law, Banking Ombudsman, etc.,
To maintain Notice tracker and report them periodically.
To conduct Legal Audit for eligible Accounts and report to the concerned stake Holders.
To represent on behalf of bank before Court of Law, Statutory Authorities, etc.,
To handle any specific issues specially assigned by the Regional Legal Manager.


Key Duties and Responsibilities of the Role

Business
To ensure proper execution of loan and security documents at the time of lending by the business and credit teams.
To ensure legal reports are furnished on time by external counsels.
To co-ordinate with HUB officials and cluster managers on a regular basis.
Taking proactive measures in all litigation matters, to ensure earliest closure as also to bring the opponents for negotiating table.


Customer
Assist the respective regional legal teams in end to end management of advisory on lending related security creation and documentation as well as collection and other litigation.
Communicate/interact with Regulators, Statutory Authorities, District Magistrates, First Class magistrates, consumer courts, Law enforcement Agencies, for resolution of legal issues/ensuring compliance.
Support the secured lending departments during loan documentation and security creation.
Co-ordinate with the Advocates and Enforcement Agencies in extending support to Authorised Officers/ Signatories under various provisions of law.

Sales and Customer Engagement:
Warmly welcome and assist customers, understanding their preferences.
Showcase jewellery collections and guide customers in their purchase decisions.
Learn and apply sales techniques, product knowledge, and customer engagement strategies.

Observe and support senior sales representatives in customer interactions and sales management.

Achieve section-wise sales targets and suggest improvements for store profitability.

Maintain a high level of integrity, professionalism, and customer trust.
Address customer queries and escalate unresolved concerns to senior staff.

Age Requirement 21-27 years
Experience Freshers are welcome; prior experience in retail or jewellery sales is a plus.

Description:
About us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team:
QR & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us:
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our peoples collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification:
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. The role involves wearing and showcasing jewellery collections, demonstrating their features, and interacting with online audiences in real-time. The ideal candidate should be confident, well-spoken, and have a passion for fashion, jewellery, and customer engagement.
  Primary Responsibilities
  Live Anchoring & Jewellery Demonstration:
Host Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions, presenting and explaining jewellery collections.
Wear and model various jewellery pieces to enhance their appeal.
Provide detailed descriptions of gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including design, craftsmanship, weight, pricing, and customization options.
Answer real-time customer queries related to jewellery products and offers.
Engage with viewers, encouraging them to interact, comment, and share.
Maintain high energy levels and professional on-screen presence.
Customer Engagement & Query Handling:
Respond to customer queries, comments, and messages during and after live sessions.
Share updates on ongoing offers, collections, and new arrivals.
Maintain a friendly and persuasive tone to encourage sales and brand loyalty.
Content Creation & Social Media Growth:
Plan and coordinate live session schedules to maximize reach and engagement.
Collaborate with the social media team to strategize content and themes for Live sessions.
Assist in short video content creation (Reels & YouTube Shorts) for additional promotions.
Ensure content aligns with brand tone, aesthetics, and audience expectations.
Event Coverage & Brand Representation:
Host store events, jewellery exhibitions, and festive launches through live sessions.
Be the digital face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers, building brand recognition and trust.

Strong communication & presentation skills in Bengali, Kokborok and Hindi.
Confident and charismatic on-camera presence.
Ability to engage with online audiences and answer queries professionally.
Basic knowledge of social media trends, audience interaction, and marketing strategies.
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and YouTube Live management.
Location Agartala, Tripura

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Manage and oversee day-to-day accounting operations related to construction and engineering projects.
Prepare, review, and maintain project-wise financial statements, cost reports, and accounting records.
Monitor project budgets, actual expenditures, and cost variances to ensure effective cost control.
Verify and process contractor, subcontractor, supplier, and vendor invoices.
Ensure timely recording of project expenses, material purchases, labour costs, and equipment expenses.
Monitor project cash flows, payments, and outstanding receivables.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for management.
Reconcile project accounts, bank accounts, vendor accounts, and customer accounts.
Monitor work-in-progress (WIP) and ensure proper accounting of ongoing construction projects.
Review BOQ (Bill of Quantities), work orders, purchase orders, and contract values from an accounting perspective.
Track project-wise revenue, expenses, profitability, and financial performance.
Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, procurement, and commercial departments regarding project costs and financial matters.
Ensure proper accounting of construction materials, machinery, tools, and equipment.
Monitor advances paid to contractors, suppliers, and employees and ensure timely adjustment.
Verify running account (RA) bills, measurement bills, and contractor payment certificates before processing payments.
Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, GST, TDS, income tax, and other statutory requirements.
Assist in internal audits, statutory audits, tax audits, and financial reviews.
Maintain proper documentation of invoices, vouchers, contracts, bills, and supporting financial records.
Identify unnecessary expenditures, cost overruns, and financial discrepancies and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare annual budgets and financial forecasts for construction and engineering projects.
Ensure timely closing of monthly accounts and preparation of management reports.
Supervise and guide junior accountants and accounting staff.
Develop and maintain effective internal financial controls to prevent errors, fraud, and misappropriation.
Coordinate with banks, auditors, tax consultants, and financial institutions whenever required.
Ensure accurate financial reporting and provide financial insights to senior management for decision-making.

Services:
Comprehensive development of Gas Gathering Stations (GGS, GCS, EPS) for hydrocarbon processing
Management of processing plants and gas terminal stations
City Gas Distribution (CGD) for safe natural gas supply to homes, businesses, and industries
Installation and maintenance of PNG networks
Forecourt management for fuel stations
CNG station development for sustainable mobility
Civil construction and infrastructure solutions
Brownfield modifications and retrofit projects
Technical consulting and feasibility studies
Manpower outsourcing solutions
Commitment: Prioritizes safety, quality, and excellence in execution, adhering to global safety and environmental regulations.

Valid medical registration with NMC/State GasMedical Council.
Relevant clinical experience in Gastroenterology.
Expertise in diagnosing and managing gastrointestinal and liver disorders.
Good communication and patient-management skills.

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.


Required Skills
Academic Counselling
Admission Guidance
Admission Counselling
Student Counselling
Higher Education
College Admissions
University Admissions
Student Support
Educational Consultancy
Client Handling
Communication Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Documentation
Application Processing
Online Research
MS Office
Email Communication
CRM
Follow-Up Management
Record Keeping


Language Skills
Good communication skills in English are required.
Ability to communicate effectively in Bengali and/or Hindi will be an advantage for counselling students and parents.


Experience
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.

Description:
About the role
We are looking for a Manager to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across education, skilling, vocational education and others. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.


Key Responsibilities
1. Government engagement strategic partnerships
Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.
2. Strategy, policy program design
Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
Drive evidence-backed policy advocacy and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.
3. Data, research evidence
Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.
4. Program execution impact
Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.
5. Field engagement implementation intelligence
Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.
6. Communication thought leadership
Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.
7. Growth ecosystem development
Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.
Qualifications Experience
8+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
MBA, Master s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field preferred.
Demonstrated experience working with government stakeholders, with government engagement experience being essential.
Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government.
Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
Experience leveraging technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure for social impact is highly desirable.
Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.
What we are looking for
Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias - able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
High ownership and initiative - comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
Strong government orientation - able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills - able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
Strong communication skills - able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
Collaborative leader who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
Data-driven and impact-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Why this role
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and to contribute to reforms that can influence education and skilling outcomes at scale. The role offers significant ownership in shaping government partnerships, translating evidence into policy and program decisions, and taking high-impact interventions from strategy to implementation to scale.
Required Skills
Impact Results Orientation Ownership Accountability stakeholder management Government Data Systems (UDISE+) Consulting project management Advanced MS Excel strategic thinking Problem-Solving Decision Making

Description:
Job Summary
The Front Office Executive is responsible for managing patient registration, appointments, billing, queries, and report dispatch while ensuring a seamless patient experience and efficient front office operations. The role acts as the first point of contact for patients, doctors, and visitors.

Key Responsibilities
Manage front office operations, patient registration, appointments, and billing activities.
Welcome patients and visitors, address enquiries, and provide prompt support for patient-related concerns.
Coordinate with doctors, technicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure smooth patient flow and service delivery.
Handle incoming calls, emails, messages, and appointment requests professionally while maintaining confidentiality.
Maintain accurate records of patient registrations, appointments, billing information, and report dispatch in the designated systems.
Ensure timely collection of payments, documentation of corporate cases, and daily cash reconciliation.
Assist patients with test appointments, doctor consultations, report collection, and emergency requirements.
Ensure compliance with company policies, operational SOPs, and patient data confidentiality standards.
Maintain a professional, customer-centric environment at the reception and waiting area.

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline.
2-4 years of experience in front office, patient relations, customer service, or healthcare operations.
Strong understanding of healthcare processes, medical terminology, and patient handling practices.
Good knowledge of billing, appointment management, and hospital/diagnostic centre operations.
Proficient in MS Office and hospital/diagnostic management systems.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
Ability to multitask, resolve patient concerns, and work effectively under pressure with attention to detail.

Key Competencies
Customer Service Excellence
Communication & Interpersonal Skills
Patient Relationship Management
Attention to Detail
Multitasking & Time Management
Problem Solving
Professionalism & Confidentiality
Team Collaboration
