Description:
Position Overview
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based in Tripura and will report to the Program Lead.


Responsibilities
Own the implementation and outcomes of the program
Provide leadership and managerial support to the field team, mainly to the Block professionals.
Manage Block professionals to ensure quality implementation on the ground through regular meetings and field visits
Develop process and system for onboarding and capacity building of Block professionals
Develop process and system for regular monitoring and cont. feedback
Work closely with The/Nudge's financial unit to develop budgets and ensure timely and effective of such budget
Work closely with the SRLM in developing the annual budget and preparing financial plans
Support TRLM in the research and development of a strategy and program design to target the extremely vulnerable families through the graduation approach built on top of community institutions enabled by the DAY-NRLM
Support TRLM in the implementation of action research of the graduation approach through a special project based on the strategy and design developed in consultation with key stakeholders
Enable convergence of various state initiatives (social security, livelihood promotion, financial inclusion, social empowerment) and programs towards the end goal of graduating women and their households living in extreme poverty.
Support TRLM to review the progress of the program periodically in order to iterate and scale
Support the mission on the use of data and technology to ensure continuous flow of data from the field
Build relationships with key government stakeholders in Tripura such that the special project is successful
Build relationships with key government departments and support the successful adoption of strategies targeting the extremely vulnerable


What's in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

Description:
Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, and monitor solar EPC projects, including rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations, from project initiation to commissioning and handover.
Prepare project schedules, execution plans, resource allocation plans, and deployment strategies to ensure timely project completion.
Supervise site execution activities, including civil, structural, electrical, module mounting, inverter installation, cabling, and earthing works.
Coordinate with engineering, procurement, vendors, contractors, and site teams to ensure the timely availability of materials and resources.
Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets, technical specifications, and quality standards.
Manage project costs, control expenses, and ensure optimum utilization of manpower, materials, machinery, and other resources.
Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety standards, statutory requirements, quality procedures, and project specifications.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, government authorities, DISCOMs, and other stakeholders for approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, and project-related clearances.
Monitor installation, testing, commissioning, and performance verification of solar PV systems.
Identify project risks, resolve site-level technical and operational issues, and implement corrective actions to avoid delays and cost overruns.
Conduct regular site visits and review contractor performance, work progress, safety practices, and quality of execution.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports, MIS, budget updates, and management review reports.
Ensure proper documentation of drawings, material records, inspection reports, commissioning certificates, and project handover documents.
Coordinate with the operations and maintenance team for smooth project handover and resolution of pending issues.
Lead and manage project engineers, supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors to achieve project delivery targets.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of solar PV systems, solar EPC execution, and project management.
Experience in project planning, site execution, commissioning, and contractor management.
Knowledge of electrical systems, solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, DC/AC cabling, and grid connectivity.
Proficiency in MS Excel, project scheduling, cost estimation, and project reporting.
Strong leadership, client coordination, problem-solving, and team management skills.
AboutCompany:
Company Profile:
Surya International Enterprise Pvt Ltd, the CRISIL BBB rated flagship company of Surya Group, is a multifaceted conglomerate operating in diverse fields such as Solar Energy, Manufacturing, Water Industry, Plastic Recycling, and Fintech. Our core mission is to provide sustainable and affordable green energy and water solutions through cutting-edge technology.
Surya Group has been on an exceptional growth trajectory for over a decade, achieving remarkable operational and financial milestones. With a net worth exceeding 125 Crores and an annual turnover of 325 Crores in the last financial year, our growth story is a testament to our unwavering commitment to excellence.
Over the past 10 years, we have successfully installed more than 100MW of on-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar power plants, solidifying our position as a leader in the renewable energy sector. Additionally, we have made significant strides in improving access to clean water by installing over 40,000 solar streetlights, 5,000 solar-powered water pumping systems, and 300 MLD of iron, fluoride, and arsenic water treatment plants, benefiting more than 10 lakh rural households.
Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Gurgaon, Coimbatore, Katihar, and Gaya produce high-quality products such as Lithium-Ion batteries, HDPE Tanks, HDPE & PVC Pipes, FRP vessels, Recycled Plastic Granules, and LLDP powder, among others. Furthermore, we have established a Mega Factory in the heart of Infovalley-2 EMC Park in Bhubaneswar, dedicated to the production of high-quality solar modules. Additionally, we have another mega factory in the Ghiloth Industrial Area, Rajasthan, further expanding our manufacturing capabilities.
At Surya Group, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment that encourages innovation and growth. As an equal opportunity employer, we value the diverse perspectives and experiences of our skilled workforce, which spans around 500 employees across India, with 170 employees based at our Head Office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Our geographical presence extends to various states, including Odisha, Delhi, Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam, Tripura, Mizoram, Kolkata, and Kerala, among others.
We invite talented individuals to join our dynamic and purpose-driven team, where they can contribute to our mission of creating a sustainable future while advancing their careers in a supportive and inclusive environment.
For more information, please visit www.groupsurya.co.in and www.solar2roof.com.

We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.

CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.

Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).

Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.

Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features
Job Category: Consultant, DScholar Web
Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

Job Summary
CBM India Trust is committed to improving the quality of life of persons with disabilities and members of other marginalized communities. We work in partnership with local, national, and international actors with the aim of creating a more equal society for all. Our vision is to have an inclusive world in which all persons with disabilities enjoy their human rights and achieve their full potential. To ensure smooth field implementation, coordination with schools and communities, and quality delivery of inclusive education and accessibility interventions at the grassroots level.


Responsibilities
Field Operations Activity Planning
Lead planning and scheduling of field activities across program components and outcomes.
Coordinate day-to-day implementation of project activities in schools and communities.
Ensure timely execution of field plans and support the Project Manager with progress updates.
Coordinate with school authorities, block officials, and contractors for the renovation of
Oversee installation of accessibility features such as ramps, accessible toilets, railings, and
Ensure all modifications meet disability-inclusive accessibility standards.
Training Capacity - Building Coordination
Organize and coordinate training for teachers, special educators, and school staff.
Manage training logistics, including scheduling, venue coordination, materials, and
Support implementation of inclusive education practices promoted under Samagra Shiksha.
Community Field Team Supervision
Supervise Community Mobilizers and ensure effective outreach and engagement across all
Guide field teams in community awareness, school engagement, and inclusion activities.
Ensure consistent program coverage and quality implementation at the grassroots level.
Therapy Services Child Support
Coordinate with therapy centers to facilitate services for children with disabilities.
Arrange transport and support mechanisms to ensure regular access to therapy services.
Track participation and follow-up of children receiving therapy and educational support.
Monitor field progress and document implementation challenges.
Prepare regular updates and structured field reports for the Project Manager.
Support data collection and reporting for program monitoring and donor reporting
Ensure adherence to disability-inclusive standards in all school-level interventions.


Professional profile and requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Work, Disability Studies, or a related field, or a B.Ed. in Special Education, or a Diploma in Special Education
2-3 years of experience in field coordination or program implementation in education, rehabilitation, or community development projects.
Prior experience working on inclusive education or programs for children with disabilities under initiatives such as Samagra Shiksha will be preferred.
Experience coordinating with schools, community stakeholders, and local government officials in


Skills
Strong coordination and communication skills for effective stakeholder engagement, including school interactions, home visits, and community sensitization on disability inclusion.
Proficiency in basic digital tools for monitoring and reporting, including Excel and mobile-based applications for IEP tracking and program data management.
Willingness to travel extensively across districts in Tripura, with strong cultural sensitivity to disability inclusion and community norms.


Other requirements
The future job holder is expected to adhere to CBM India\'s policies and procedures, commit to CBM India\'s Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct, and follow CBM India\'s safety security.
Eight hours per day

Description:
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across education, skilling, vocational education and others. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships
Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.
2. Strategy, policy & program design
Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
Drive evidence-backed policy advocacy and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.
3. Data, research & evidence
Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.
4. Program execution & impact
Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.
5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence
Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.
6. Communication & thought leadership
Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.
7. Growth & ecosystem development
Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.
Qualifications & Experience
8+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
MBA, Master s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field preferred.
Demonstrated experience working with government stakeholders, with government engagement experience being essential.
Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government.
Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
Experience leveraging technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure for social impact is highly desirable.
Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.
What we are looking for
Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias - able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
High ownership and initiative - comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
Strong government orientation - able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills - able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
Strong communication skills - able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
Collaborative leader who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
Data-driven and impact-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Why this role
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and to contribute to reforms that can influence education and skilling outcomes at scale. The role offers significant ownership in shaping government partnerships, translating evidence into policy and program decisions, and taking high-impact interventions from strategy to implementation to scale.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

Our clients are leading MNC & Industrial Conglomerates (AUTOMOBILES, FMCG, CONSUMER DURABLES, MANAUFACTURING, RETAIL, EPC, INFRASTRUCTURE (POWER, ENERGY, OIL & GAS, PORTS), INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, BPO, PHARMA & TELECOM with a Turnover of US $ 1 Bn to US $ 100 Bn with exponential growth potential. PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

Business Head - Commodity Sales Chemicals
Leads commercial growth, market expansion, and P&L accountability for industrial and bulk chemical product lines.
Driving top-line revenue growth, margin optimization, key account management, and strategic distribution networks across domestic and international markets for commodity/industrial chemicals.
Key Responsibilities:
Sales Strategy & Business Development:
F Design and execute 3-year strategic roadmaps and Annual Business Plans aligned with organizational revenue and profitability targets.
F Identify and scale new business opportunities across domestic and export markets, targeting manufacturers, traders, and industrial end-users.
F Lead end-to-end sales cycles from lead generation and volume allocation to order execution and payment realization.
Product and Market Leadership:
F Lead product management for Specialty Chemicals, Derivatives, and Performance Chemicals on a global basis.
F Build and strengthen market intelligence to support strategic decisions.
F Work closely with domestic and international customers to understand technical requirements and align with R&D for product development.
F Support commercialization of new product development initiatives.
F Oversee technical service activities for all product segments.

The Vertical Lead Internal Audit (MFG)
You will lead the Internal Audit function across Co’s manufacturing operations, providing independent assurance on risk management, internal controls, compliance, and operational effectiveness across all plants, mines, power units, and manufacturing support functions.
The role drives a risk-based audit approach to identify control gaps, improve operational efficiency, mitigate risks, strengthen governance, and support management in achieving business objectives through continuous process improvement and data-driven insights.
The role acts as a key partner to manufacturing leadership in strengthening controls, driving process excellence, safeguarding assets, mitigating fraud risks, and enhancing overall business performance through a risk-based audit approach.
Major Challenges:
Providing effective audit oversight across a large, geographically dispersed manufacturing network with diverse operational risks.
Identifying emerging risks related to operations, maintenance, projects, procurement, inventory, energy management, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
Balancing independent assurance with business partnership while driving timely closure of audit observations.
Leveraging data analytics and digital audit tools to enhance audit coverage, efficiency, and real-time risk monitoring.
Ensuring consistent control standards and governance practices across plants while adapting to evolving business, regulatory, and technology risks.
Detecting and mitigating fraud, leakages, process inefficiencies, and control gaps without disrupting manufacturing continuity.
KRAs
Risk-Based Audit Planning & Coverage:
F Develop and execute annual risk-based audit plans across plants, mines, power units, logistics, and manufacturing support functions.
F Ensure comprehensive coverage of key operational and strategic risks.
Operational Excellence & Control Effectiveness:
F Assess adequacy and effectiveness of controls across production, maintenance, procurement, inventory, quality, projects, and energy management.
F Identify opportunities for process optimization and productivity improvement.
Governance, Compliance & Risk Management:
F Evaluate compliance with internal policies, statutory requirements, EHS norms, and corporate governance standards.
Strengthen risk mitigation and control frameworks across manufacturing operations.
Audit Analytics & Insight Generation:
F Leverage data analytics to identify anomalies, control gaps, leakages, and emerging risks.
F Provide actionable insights to management for improved decision-making.
Stakeholder Management & Closure Governance:
F Drive timely closure of audit observations and sustainable implementation of corrective actions.
Partner with manufacturing leadership to strengthen governance and accountability.
Audit Transformation & Risk Monitoring:
F Partner with the Value Creation Vertical to drive digitization, automation of audit processes, and continuous control monitoring across assigned functions.
F Conduct thematic reviews and trend analysis of key risk areas to strengthen controls and establish accountability at the user level.
Governance, Standardization & Best Practices:
F Drive unified implementation of audit best practices, controls, and governance standards across units, plants, zones, clusters, and functions.
F Ensure consistent adoption of recommendations and ownership of corrective actions to enhance risk management and compliance effectiveness.

Preferred candidate profile
1. CA or CWA or CPA with 8-12 years in internal audit, risk, or assurance, including manufacturing/ industrial experience and field/plant audit exposure.
2. Experience auditing multiple business functions and manufacturing operations.
3. Strong exposure to field audits and plant/site visits, not limited to back-office or shared services audits.
4. Proven experience in Audit Committee presentations, stakeholder management and audit remediation.
5. Familiarity with ERP systems (such as SAP), data analytics tools, audit management software, and risk/control frameworks.
6. Strong stakeholder influence, executive communication, and problem-solving skills.
7. Strong leadership, communication and team management skills.
8. Demonstrated career stability and the ability to drive audit initiatives end to end.

Our clients are leading MNC & Industrial Conglomerates (AUTOMOBILES, FMCG, CONSUMER DURABLES, MANAUFACTURING, RETAIL, EPC, INFRASTRUCTURE (POWER, ENERGY, OIL & GAS, PORTS), INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, BPO, PHARMA & TELECOM with a Turnover of US $ 1 Bn to US $ 100 Bn with exponential growth potential. Our client’s reach span across several countries across the globe.

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

Regional Sales Manager North (Commodity Chemical Sales)
You will be responsible for driving volume, revenue, and margin growth across bulk and commodity chemical product lines with a strong focus on direct sales to industrial end users.
The role includes managing existing accounts, acquiring new customers, increasing product volumes, negotiating commercial terms and ensuring profitable business growth.
The incumbent will also guide sales-support activities, monitor customer and commercial follow-ups, and coordinate with internal teams for timely execution of customer requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Sales & Business Development
F Drive sales of assigned commodities / industrial chemical products across identified markets and customer segments.
F Focus primarily on direct business development with end users and industrial customers.
F Identify and develop new customers, applications, geographies, and market opportunities.
F Build a strong sales pipeline and systematically convert opportunities into sustainable business.
F Increase sales volumes and market penetration for existing and newly assigned products.
F Develop business with both existing and prospective customers.
End-User & Key Account Management
F Build and maintain long-term relationships with key end-user customers.
F Understand customers' product requirements, consumption patterns, applications, pricing expectations, and procurement cycles.
F Regularly engage with purchase, commercial, technical, production, and other relevant customer stakeholders.
F Identify opportunities for increasing wallet share and introducing additional products to existing customers.
F Ensure timely resolution of customer queries and commercial matters.
Customer & Channel Management
F Manage existing customers and develop long-term relationships with key accounts.
F Understand customer applications, consumption patterns, procurement cycles and pricing expectations.
F Identify opportunities to increase business and introduce additional products.
F Manage distributors and channel partners wherever commercially appropriate.
F Ensure timely resolution of customer queries and commercial issues.
Commercial & Pricing Management
F Prepare and negotiate quotations, pricing, commercial terms, contracts, and supply arrangements.
F Monitor market prices, competition, imports, supply-demand conditions, and customer buying trends.
F Work closely with the SBU Head – Sales on pricing strategy and major commercial negotiations.
F Ensure business is developed with appropriate consideration for volume, margin, payment terms, logistics costs, credit exposure, and profitability.
F Support timely collection of receivables and resolution of outstanding commercial issues.
Managerial & Sales Coordination
F Guide junior sales and sales-support team members in customer follow-ups, quotations, order tracking and documentation.
F Review pending enquiries, quotations, orders, deliveries and payment follow-ups.
F Ensure timely and accurate execution of sales-support activities.
F Monitor team activities and provide day-to-day guidance as required.
F Support the SBU Head – Sales in implementing sales plans and business priorities.
Market Intelligence & Internal Coordination
F Monitor competitor activities, market prices, alternate suppliers, customer expansions and new projects.
F Identify potential new products, applications and market opportunities.
F Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Manufacturing, R&D and Customer Service.
F Support customer trials, product evaluations, demand forecasting and dispatch planning.
F Provide regular customer, market and competitor updates to management.
Sales Planning & Reporting
F Prepare periodic sales forecasts, customer plans, pipeline updates, and market reports.
F Track sales against agreed volume, revenue, margin, collection, and customer-development objectives.
F Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, pricing, and sales information.
F Provide regular business updates to the SBU Head – Sales.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering (B.E./B.Tech), Chemistry, or a related technical discipline with 7-10 years of relevant experience in sales, business development, key account management, or commercial roles within the Commodity Chemical industry.
2. Strong experience in commodity chemicals, industrial chemicals, specialty chemicals, performance chemicals, or chemical raw materials.
3. Proven experience in direct end-user sales is essential.
4. Experience handling both end users and channel/distribution partners, with greater emphasis on direct customer development.
5. Demonstrated ability to identify and acquire new customers and grow business from existing accounts.
6. Good understanding of chemical pricing, commercial negotiations, payment terms, credit management, receivables, and market dynamics.
7. Experience in preparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and closing B2B sales.
8. Experience in new product development/commercialization or developing new applications/ customers would be preferred.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Senior Manager (Corporate HR, M&A, Payroll Operations & Compliance)
Role Summary
You will oversee workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, compensation and benefits, employee relations, and legal compliance.
Manage end-to-end payroll processing, HR operations, and statutory compliance across the organization. Ensure accurate and timely salary disbursements, maintain employee data integrity, and keep company policies and filings aligned with applicable labor and tax laws.
Responsible for leading people-related activities across the acquisition lifecycle, from due diligence and pre-close planning through employee transition, integration, and post-close stabilization.
Key Responsibilities
1. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding:
F Partner with department heads on manpower planning, manage hiring pipelines, and run structured onboarding programs.
F Employee Relations & Culture:
F Handle grievances, resolve workplace conflicts, support employee engagement, and uphold company policies.
2. Performance & Learning:
F Coordinate appraisal cycles, support career development, and roll out training initiatives.
F Compensation, Benefits & Payroll:
F Administer salaries, benefits, and statutory/payroll processes (such as PF, ESI, and TDS in India).
3. Compliance & HR Operations:
F Maintain accurate HRIS/employee records, track people metrics, and ensure adherence to labor laws and internal policies (including POSH compliance).
4. Pre-Merger: Due Diligence & Risk Assessment
A. Talent & Leadership Audit:
F Identify key personnel, critical revenue-generators, and flight risks.
F Liability & Compliance Review:
F Audit employment contracts, change-of-control clauses, severance agreements, ongoing grievances, and underfunded pension or benefit plans.
B. Cultural Compatibility:
F Evaluate values, leadership styles, and engagement levels to spot major friction points early.
F Deal Negotiation & Valuation
C. Retention & Incentives:
F Help structure stays bonuses, equity rollovers, and compensation packages to lock in key talent.
D. Synergy Validation:
Test assumptions around headcount reductions, restructuring, and organizational design to ensure cost/revenue targets are realistic.
5. Post-Merger Integration (PMI) & Day 1 Execution:
A. Operational Continuity:
F Ensure payroll, medical benefits, HRIS systems, and data flow seamlessly from Day 1 so employees get paid accurately and on time.
B. Organizational Design:
F Redefine reporting lines, eliminate redundancies humanely (with outplacement/counseling support), and align job tiers.
C. Cultural Integration:
F Build a blended corporate culture through active change management and transparent leadership.
D. Communication:
F Over-communicate through multi-channel updates to counter uncertainty, build trust, and keep morale stable
6. Payroll Operations
F Process monthly payroll accurately and on schedule, including salaries, bonuses, reimbursements, overtime, and full-and-final (F&F) settlements.
F Collect, verify, and reconcile attendance, leave, and compensation change inputs with HR and Finance teams.
F Manage statutory and voluntary deductions (such as PF, ESIC, TDS, Professional Tax, LWF, NPS, or benefits contributions), tax declarations, and payslip generation.
F Resolve employee payroll queries and grievances promptly and maintain audit-ready payroll records.
7. Corporate HR Operations:
F Oversee employee lifecycle administration from onboarding and transfers to promotions, policy updates, and offboarding.
F Maintain accurate employee master data, digital records, and HRIS/payroll system workflows.
F Prepare regular MIS reports, headcount/payroll analytics, and leadership updates.
8. Statutory & HR Compliance:
F Ensure timely filings, challan payments, and annual returns under applicable labor, wage, and tax laws.
F Support internal, statutory, and vendor audits by providing required documentation and reconciliations.
F Keep employee handbooks, workplace policies, and employment records aligned with current regulations.

Preferred candidate profile
I. MBA in HR with 10+ years in corporate HR, talent/org design, Payroll Operations & Compliance with proven hands-on M&A lifecycle experience.
II. Strong grasp of payroll accounting, labor laws, statutory deductions, and tax compliance.
III. Strong understanding of HR disciplines and their interdependencies, including compensation, benefits, HR operations, talent acquisition, talent management, employee relations, payroll, mobility, HR technology, and HR business partnering.
IV. Strong business and financial acumen to evaluate cost drivers, financial exposure, and workforce costs, and balance transaction objectives with employee experience, compliance, and operational readiness.
V. Deep understanding of the HR M&A lifecycle, including due diligence, pre-close planning, employee transition, integration, stabilization, and transition to steady-state operations.
VI. High attention to detail, strict confidentiality, deadline ownership, problem-solving, and clear stakeholder communication.
VII. Proficiency in HRMS/payroll software and advanced Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data validation).

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

About the Role:

We are looking for a high-energy, target-driven Manager Sales (Business Development) to spearhead new B2B client acquisition across Delhi/NCR. This is an individual-contributor field sales role focused on hunting and onboarding mid-market and core corporate accounts (monthly billing up to 5 Lakhs/month) across assigned territories.

Key Responsibilities:

New Business Origination & Hunting:
Identify, prospect, and onboard new corporate and institutional B2B clients (under 5 Lakhs/month ticket size) through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Execute business development strategies by pitching our service offerings and value propositions to key decision-makers.
Undertake structured account planning using market intelligence and existing client data to penetrate high-potential customer segments.
Bid Management & Deal Closure:
Lead end-to-end bid and proposal processes, including RFQ/RFP responses, commercial structuring, pricing negotiations, proposal submissions, and contract finalization.
Sales Execution & Pipeline Management:
Consistently achieve monthly and quarterly new account acquisition and revenue targets.
Maintain strict discipline on CRM / Sales Force Automation (SFA) tools to log leads, track pipelines, and monitor sales velocity.
Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting:
Collaborate closely with Operations Managers, Cluster Heads, and the Sales Head to ensure smooth client onboarding and service delivery.
Track performance against budgets and present periodic pipeline updates during leadership reviews.

Candidate Requirements:

Experience: 5 to 10 years of proven B2B, Corporate, and Field Sales experience.
Industry Background: Mandatory experience in a large distributed service industryspecifically Facility Management (IFM / Soft Services / Hard Services), Security Services, Staffing / Recruitment, or B2B Logistics / Supply Chain.

Core Skills:
Strong "hunter" mindset with a verifiable track record of new client acquisition and quota attainment.
Hands-on familiarity with B2B bid processes, commercial negotiations, and contract closures.
Proficiency in CRM tools, pipeline reporting, and MS Excel.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

Qualification: Graduation / Diploma in any discipline (MBA / PGDM in Marketing or Sales specialization preferred).

Department: Supply Chain Finance Counter-party Team.

Role Summary

Own endtoend onboarding of vendors, dealers and other counterparties under anchorled Supply Chain Finance programs. Ensure fast, compliant onboarding, smooth activation and strong earlystage engagement to drive utilization and portfolio hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

Engage with vendors/dealers to explain SCF products, benefits and onboarding process.
Manage complete onboarding workflow: KYC, documentation, risk checks, approvals and limit setup.
Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Ops, Legal and Tech for frictionless onboarding and compliance.

Resolve operational issues, documentation gaps and onboarding bottlenecks.

Counterparties onboarded
Onboarding TAT (Pre-sanction documentation Approval post-sanction documentation Golive)

Firstdrawdown % and utilization support

Experience: 4 to 10 years in SCF, Working Capital, Trade Finance, MSME lending or onboarding roles.
Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.

Description:
Broad roles and responsibilities

Research and identify potential institute partners in the assigned territory across upskilling, test prep, affordable degrees, and K12 school segments.
Cold-call, network, and arrange meetings with institute management founders, heads of finance, business development leads, and admissions teams.
Pitch the Credila Digital Loans product subvention model, zero-cost EMI proposition, counsellor origination workflow, and business value to the institute.
Negotiate subvention rates, commercial terms, and data-sharing arrangements with institute partners.
Coordinate institute onboarding with the Credit team — provide all institute-level documents required for PRIME evaluation.
Facilitate institute counsellor training sessions in coordination with the RM team post-onboarding.
Build and maintain strong relationships with onboarded institute partners to maximise monthly loan origination volumes.
Monitor institute-level origination performance; identify underperforming partners and develop re-activation plans.
Maintain accurate pipeline records in the CRM — prospect status, meeting notes, commercial terms, and onboarding milestones.
Gather competitive intelligence on institute partnerships with peers (Propelld, Avanse, Auxilo) and share with the Sales Head.
Ensure all institute agreements and commercial terms comply with internal policy and legal requirements.
Required Skills

Strong B2B sales and business development skills — ability to generate leads, manage pipelines, and close complex institutional deals
Consultative selling approach — ability to identify institute pain points and position Credila’s loan product as a business solution
Confident presentation skills — ability to present to senior institute stakeholders including founders and finance heads
Negotiation skills — ability to structure subvention deals and align commercial interests
CRM proficiency for pipeline management and reporting
Understanding of education lending products, subvention economics, and B2B2C channel models
Self-motivated, disciplined, and able to manage a large prospect pipeline independently
Qualifications & Experience

Graduate in any discipline; MBA with a specialisation in Sales or Marketing is an advantage
1–4 years of experience in B2B sales — edtech, SaaS, fintech, or financial services preferred
Prior experience in education loan distribution, edtech partnerships, or NBFC channel development is a strong advantage

Complete responsibility from start to close out of the project
Responsible for resolving all issues and relationships with the client for the collection and exchange of all information and data and communication of all decisions through minutes of meetings internally to the team and to the client for records.
Management of all issues at site offices.

To develop a healthy, cordial, transparent relationship/machine between management and the team for the overall benefit of the project and the organisation

Must have a degree in civil engineering

Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
Ability to work within a culturally diverse organisation, recognising and respecting differences.

Self-motivated individual with outstanding leadership skills and the ability to influence without authority

Ceasefire Industries Private Limited
Role Title:
Sales Executive/Area manager/ Cluster manager
Company Details: Direct Sales, Pan India

Ceasefire Headquartered in India, Ceasefire is a fast-emerging global fire safety brand, known for manufacturing
globally-certified (BRE LPCB, BSI Kite Mark, VDS), firefighting solutions that are built at the very forefront of
technology.
https://www.ceasefire.in/about-us
Ceasefire today is a leading manufacturer of a 360 degree-unified firefighting product portfolio and a fast-emerging
global name that protects millions across the globe. The company has set its foot in the UK with an aim to fulfill the
market gap by offering a holistic fire safety range to the customers, all under one banner. With massive investment in
terms of offices, product demonstration facilities, warehouses and stocking points; Ceasefire is equipped to give
world-class services to the customers in India and abroad.
One Brand, 360 Degree Fire Fighting Solutions
With its globally certified, holistically integrated range of firefighting solutions, the company is amongst the rarest in
the world to have such a diverse product portfolio. The range includes a complete spectrum of solutions including Fire
Extinguishers powder, water, foam, CO2 and clean gases-based extinguishers, the specialized extinguishers for
metal fires, and a range dedicated to the revolutionary Watermist technology to name a few. In-panel systems for
cabinet protection that include LPCB approved CQRS and suppression solutions for extremely small spaces called
Mini. Powder, Watermist or Gaseous Agent based Room Systems and specialized Kitchen Suppression Systems
including Commercial and Domestic systems based on Watermist or Wet Chemical technology, and other Specialised
Fire Fighting Systems, as part of a single eco-system.
Demand Fulfiller as Well as a Demand Generator
In addition to the all-encompassing product range, Ceasefire offers some unique solutions that are trendsetters in the
industry like the Ceasefire Launcher that is an extinguisher + suppression system or a Mini that is worlds smallest
suppression system to an Atom X which is worlds first retrofittable fire suppression system.
Our Manufacturing Edge
Ceasefires competitive edge & the quality promise stems from the companys state-of-the-art production facility with
cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities. This production facility is one of the most advanced in the world and is fully
compliant to the Factory Production Control (FPC) requirements of the highest global standards including EN3,
EN1866, LPCB, BSI, MED, PED, VDS, ISO and OHSAS.
Sales Management
The day-to-day working is fully supported by a robust yet user friendly CCRM that allows a salesperson to record
every transaction he has in his role as a recruiter and as a salesperson.
The CCRM follows the SPANCO process and allows our sales manager or CBA to follow through a sale from the
very start, i.e. from creating a customer profile sheet to making a prospect, sending him a proposal and executing
the order received. It also acts as an archive of marketing materials such as brochures, videos, manuals which can
be sent to many customers at the same time.

Role Context:
The person will be responsible to generate business in the assigned market using listed accounts
provided to him/ her or through her/ his market intelligence

Skill and Responsibilities :-
Skills Required
1. Minimum 0-4 Years of experience in sales/direct sales/field sales
Good Communication skills
2. Should be able to work in a fast- paced & target-driven environment
3. Should have own conveyance and laptop
Qualification
1.Graduation
2.Basic Knowledge of Computer Application

Job responsibilities :-
1.Promote and sell firefighting and security products to clients within the assigned territory.
2.Build, develop, and maintain strong relationships with prospective
customers to generate new business opportunities.
3.Handle lead generation, conduct proactive follow-ups, and drive lead
conversion through effective communication and persuasion.
Ensure strict adherence to the organizations defined sales processes and protocols.
4. Schedule and conduct a minimum of 4-7 client meetings daily to present solutions and generate sales.
5. Deliver engaging sales presentations and demonstrate strong closing
skills to finalize deals.
6.Maintain accurate and up-to-date daily sales activity reports and
performance tracking.
7. Regular upskilling through online training program to generate customer need instead of just selling as per customer requirement
MIS / Reports management details .

Regularly update inputs through CRM/SMP
Regular updating of activities of DMS
AboutCompany: Ceasefire Industries Pvt Ltd is a global fire safety company based in India that manufactures and supplies a wide range of fire protection and suppression solutions, including extinguishers, alarm systems, and total flooding systems. With over 25 years of experience, the company is considered a leading brand in the Indian subcontinent and protects numerous facilities such as airports, factories, and hospitals. Ceasefire is known for its integrated product portfolio, from design and manufacturing to commissioning and maintenance.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Human Development, Human Resources Management, Organizational Behavior Studies, Organizational Management, Sociology, Psychology

Description:
Job description
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
Job Description
Internal Audit (UK Territory)
Level: Senior Associate
Line of Service: Risk Advisory
Service Area: Internal Audit UK (C&G/ FS)
Location: Acceleration Centre (India), supporting UK onshore teams
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Role Overview (Clear Differentiation)
This role sits within UK Internal Audit and the Senior Associate will perform judgement-led Internal Audit work, including risk assessment, control design evaluation, audit issue formulation, and report drafting, aligned to UK Internal Audit standards and practices.
The role requires individuals who can think like internal auditors, not testers, with the ability to assess end-to-end processes, identify root causes, and articulate meaningful audit insights to UK stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Internal Audit Delivery
Deliver UK Internal Audit engagements across planning, fieldwork, and reporting phases, in line with PwC Internal Audit methodology.
Develop Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs), based on process walkthroughs and risk assessment.
Evaluate control design adequacy and operational effectiveness using professional judgement, not tick-box testing.
Perform targeted substantive testing where required to support audit conclusions.
Independently draft audit observations, issues, and root-cause analyses, clearly articulating:
What is wrong
Why it matters (risk and impact)
Why it occurred
What should be done to remediate
Draft high-quality Internal Audit reports suitable for senior management and Audit Committee consumption.
Ensure issues and recommendations are risk-focused, proportionate, and pragmatic, aligned to the clients UK regulatory environment.
Lead client walkthroughs and deep-dive process discussions, demonstrating strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, risks, and controls.
Act as a key offshore point of contact for UK engagement teams and clients, engaging confidently with stakeholders beyond evidence collection.
Challenge management appropriately and constructively where control weaknesses or design gaps are identified.
Quality, Standards & Methodology
Ensure audit documentation, RCMs, and reports comply with Internal Audit Standards (IIA) and PwC quality requirements.
Support or perform quality reviews of audit work, focusing on audit judgement, clarity of conclusions, and linkage between risks, controls, testing, and findings.
Other Responsibilities
Take ownership of allocated audit areas or workstreams, managing timelines and deliverables independently.
Review and coach junior team members, helping them move beyond testing to risk-based Internal Audit thinking.
Support UK Managers and Senior Managers in managing predominantly offshore or hybrid engagements.

Skills & Experience Required
4 to 8 years experience in Internal Audit (3rd line of defense), preferably supporting UK or similar mature IA environments.
Demonstrable experience in:
Risk assessment and RCM development (beyond testing)
Audit report and issue drafting
Leading client walkthroughs and audit discussions
Strong understanding of Internal Audit concepts, audit lifecycle, and risk-based assurance.
Prior experience in Financial Services (Banking or Insurance) preferred. (Only for FS Recruitment)

Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Commerce, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or equivalent.
CA / ACCA / CIA preferred.
