Description:
Job Title: Loan Officer Gold Loan Sales
Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.

Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany: Keertana is a fast growing Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) operating in JLG , Gold & MSME Loans Lending. As part of the business activities, the company is predominantly focused into Asset Financing and Lending business.

Description:
Job Title: Talent Acquisition Specialist / US IT Recruiter
Location: Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India
Job Type: Full-Time.
Work Schedule: Night Shift (US EST Hours)
Working Hours: 6:30 PM IST to 3:30 AM IST (aligned with 9:00 AM EST to 6:00 PM EST)
Who We Are:
Since our inception back in 2006, Navitas has grown to be an industry leader in the digital transformation space, and weve served as trusted advisors supporting our client base within the commercial, federal, and state and local markets.
What We Do:
At our very core, we’re a group of problem solvers providing our award-winning technology solutions to drive digital acceleration for our customers! With proven solutions, award-winning technologies, and a team of expert problem solvers, Navitas has consistently empowered customers to use technology as a competitive advantage and deliver cutting-edge transformative solutions.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Talent Acquisition Specialist / US IT Recruiter to join our growing recruitment team in Vijayawada. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening and managing end-to-end recruitment activities for US-based clients across various technologies and industries.
The recruiter will work directly with hiring managers, account managers, vendors, and candidates to ensure timely delivery of high-quality talent for contract, contract-to-hire, and full-time opportunities.
Key Responsibilities
Manage the complete recruitment life cycle for US IT requirements.
Source candidates through Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Monster, CareerBuilder, Job Boards, ATS, referrals, and social media platforms.
Screen and evaluate candidate qualifications, technical skills, communication skills, work authorization, and project experience.
Conduct initial HR and technical screening interviews.
Coordinate interviews with clients and candidates.
Negotiate compensation rates and employment terms.
Maintain candidate activity and documentation within ATS systems.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Develop relationships with consultants, vendors, and industry contacts.
Ensure compliance with client requirements, submission guidelines, and hiring processes.
Track recruitment metrics and provide status updates to management.
Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process and maintain a positive candidate experience.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in US IT Recruitment.
Strong understanding of US staffing processes and recruitment lifecycle.
Experience recruiting for technologies such as:
Java
.NET
Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Data Engineering
Data Analytics
DevOps
Cybersecurity
SAP
Salesforce
Infrastructure & Network Engineering
Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dice, Indeed, and other sourcing platforms.
Strong knowledge of US Citizenship and Federal Government clearance requirements, including experience recruiting candidates for Federal, State, DoD, DHS, IRS, and other Government projects.
Experience screening cleared and clearance-eligible candidates for government contracting opportunities.
Thorough understanding of US work authorizations, including US Citizen, Green Card, H1B, TN, EAD, OPT, and CPT.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting State, Federal, DoD, IRS, DHS, or Government contracting requirements.
Experience with VMS platforms such as Fieldglass, Beeline, VectorVMS, and PeopleFluent.
Experience working with direct clients, implementation partners, and managed service providers (MSPs).

Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Telesales Representative to join our sales team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for reaching out to potential customers, presenting our products or services, and closing sales over the phone. This position requires excellent communication skills, a persuasive demeanour, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. If you are passionate about sales and enjoy building relationships with customers, we invite you to apply.
Responsibilities:
Outbound Calling: Initiate outbound calls to potential customers with the aim of introducing our products or services.
Lead Generation: Identify and qualify leads through effective questioning and active listening.
Product Knowledge: Develop a deep understanding of our products or services to effectively communicate their features and benefits to potential customers.
Pitching and Closing: Present our products or services persuasively and close sales over the phone. Address any concerns or objections raised by potential customers.
Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and quotas.
Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the sales team to share insights, strategies, and best practices.
Qualifications:
Experience: 0-3 years of experience in telesales or a similar role.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal communication skills with a clear and confident speaking voice.
Goal-Oriented: Results-driven with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Team Player: Capable of working collaboratively within a team-oriented environment.
Working Conditions:
This role is primarily office-based, involving extensive telephone communication.
If you are a motivated and energetic individual with a passion for sales, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience.

Resolve escalations on both the sides of the market place [for booking offices and truckers] and ensuring smooth operations
Execute centrally defined collections framework and processes at the city/state/Zone level to drive collections
Hiring, mentoring and managing a team of high performing branch operations teams

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.

Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.

Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).

Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Executive Indirect Taxation (Bhiwadi & Bangalore location)

The Executive Indirect Taxation will support the tax function by ensuring accurate GST compliance, audit readiness, strategic liaison and effective stakeholder communication within a dynamic environment. This role focuses on the timely filing of returns, accurate reconciliation of tax ledgers, data analysis, process Improvement and supporting the teams during statutory audits and assessments.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare, review, and file periodic GST returns ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Conduct GST audit activities, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Interpret and apply GST rules, acts, and notifications to business transactions.
Timely coordinate with internal stakeholders and external tax authorities for dispute resolution and clarifications.
Generate management information system (MIS) reports to aid decisionmaking and highlight compliance risks.
Communicate tax implications and solutions to crossfunctional teams, facilitating problem identification and resolution.

Required Skills & Experience
58 years of handson experience in indirect taxation, predominantly GST, within the manufacturing sector who has handle huge volumes of data.
Proven ability to file GST returns and perform GST audits with minimal supervision.
Strong knowledge of GST Acts, rules, and recent amendments.
Excellent liaisoning and networking skills to interact with tax authorities, auditors, and internal departments.
Proficient in tax compliance software and advanced Excel, Power Point for MIS reporting.
Effective written and verbal communication, have ability to understand and act quickly, hard-working, proactive.

Preferred Qualifications
Professional certification such as B.Com, CMA (Inter) or CA (Inter),
Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) for tax data extraction.

Fosroc is a leading global manufacturer of construction chemicals and performance solutions for the construction industry. Established in 1934 in the UK, the company has built a strong international presence across India, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and Africa.

Global Presence

Strong market leadership in India and the Middle East
Approximately 3,000 employees worldwide

Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive & ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by tracking& controlling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking & Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments



Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
AboutCompany:
IIFL (India Infoline Finance Limited) is a diversified financial services company offering solutions in wealth management, loans, insurance, and investment advisory. The firm provides retail and institutional clients with access to products such as home loans, business loans, mutual funds, and securities trading. With a strong presence across India, IIFL emphasizes trust, transparency, and customer-centric financial planning. Its career opportunities highlight roles in advisory, sales, technology, and operations, reflecting its commitment to growth and innovation in the financial sector.

IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by trackingcontrolling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

CTC Upto 2

37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2

8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Key Accountabilities
Own the programme Non-Functional Test Approach, defining the scope, objectives and delivery approach across applicable NFR areas.
Analyse and validate non-functional requirements (NFRs) and acceptance criteria.
Lead Non-Functional testing including performance, resilience, security, accessibility, operability, compatibility, scalability and recoverability.
Own the integrated non-functional test plan, aligning specialist activities with programme releases, environments and deployment milestones.
Coordinate delivery across specialist test leads, engineers, technology teams, Guidewire and third-party suppliers.
Define non-functional entry, exit and assurance criteria, ensuring results are supported by appropriate evidence.
Identify, manage and escalate non-functional testing risks, issues, dependencies, constraints and coverage gaps.
Desirable Professional Qualifications
ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or relevant specialist testing certification.
Performance testing qualifications or practical expertise using tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad or k6.
Security testing knowledge aligned with OWASP or relevant CREST practices. Accessibility knowledge aligned with WCAG 2.2.
Cloud certification such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or relevant Guidewire Cloud training.
Project Test Delivery Management Certifications e.g. PRINCE2 Practitioner/ Association of Project Management (APM)/ Agile Project Management (APMG)
Organisation Level
Workstream Leadership
Essential Skills Experience Lead and own non-functional testing
NFR Strategy and Planning: Proven experience developing and implementing non-functional test approaches for complex enterprise programmes.
Coverage and Prioritisation: Ability to translate business, technical and operational risks into a proportionate NFR test scope.
Specialist Leadership Experience: Proven experience coordinating performance, security, resilience, accessibility and operational-readiness disciplines through specialists leads and engineers.
Drive non-functional testing excellence
Innovation and Best Practices: Experience in fostering a culture of testing innovation and adopting industry best practices.
Specialist Knowledge: Strong understanding of performance, resilience, security, accessibility, operability and compatibility testing.
Shift-left Approach: Ability to embed early non-functional testing into programme lifecycle.
Problem Solving: Strong problem-solving skills to address testing challenges and provide effective solutions.
Assure requirements and deliverables
NFR Assurance Experience: Experience establishing traceability between NFRs, technical risks, test coverage, evidence and acceptance.
Test Risk Management: Ability to identify and mitigate testing risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Test Review and Standards: Experience in conducting test reviews and ensuring adherence to standards and guidelines.
Readiness Assurance: Experience assessing specialist test approaches, environments, tooling, test data, monitoring and execution prerequisites.
Support and Test Readiness
NFR Readiness: Ensure NFRs, acceptance criteria and test scope are sufficiently defined before test execution.
Environment Tooling Readiness: Coordinate readiness of environments, tooling, monitoring and observability required across NFR disciplines.
Test Data Dependencies: Ensure required test data, interfaces, integrations and external dependencies are identified and available.
Readiness Assessment: Identify and escalate readiness gaps, risks and constraints that could impact NFR delivery or release milestones.
Collaborate and communicate
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex technical findings into clear business impacts, risks and decision points.
Clear Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate testing concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Accountability and Governance: Proven ability to establish ownership boundaries across specialist leads, engineers, delivery teams and suppliers.
NFR Assurance and Reporting
Performance Monitoring: Proficiency in defining, tracking, and reporting on key test performance indicators (KPIs).
Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to analyse testing metrics and make informed decisions based on data.
Progress Reporting: Experience in providing regular updates on test progress, challenges, and solutions to senior management and stakeholders.
NFR Test Report: Own the consolidated Non-Functional Test Report, summarising test outcomes, risks, residual issues and overall NFR quality assessment.

Description:
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
- Own the technical data test approach, covering data migration, transformation, reconciliation and downstream data flows.
- Lead data testing across Data Migration, Policy Migration, Pricing, DataHub/InfoCenter, Cloud Data Access and SDP.
- Coordinate SQL/database-level validation/reconciliation, ETLs, interface/file validation and automated data comparison where appropriate.
- Own technical data risks, defects and exceptions, ensuring material discrepancies are quantified, resolved or formally accepted.
- Identifying environments, test data, resources, business SMEs and cross-workstream dependencies and related risks and mitigations.
- Provide consolidated technical data assurance to support migration readiness and go-live decisions.
DESIRABLE PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
- ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or relevant specialist testing certification.
- Project Test Delivery Management Certifications e.g. PRINCE2 Practitioner / APM / APMG.
- Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals or equivalent cloud-data qualification.
- Relevant SQL, database or data-engineering certification.
ORGANISATION LEVEL
- Workstream Leadership
- Client Confidential
ESSENTIAL SKILLS EXPERIENCE
Lead and own testing activities
- Data Test Leadership: Proven experience defining and implementing technical data test approaches for complex migration and transformation programmes.
- Data Test Planning: Experience of leading and coordinating data test cycles through programme milestones.
- Technical Data Testing: Extensive hands-on experience of complex data migration testing, ETL/ELT validation, SQL, source-to-target reconciliation and data-quality assurance.
Drive Testing Excellence
- Data Quality: Establish consistent validation across completeness, accuracy, integrity, consistency, uniqueness and referential integrity.
- Automation: Drive automated data comparison and reconciliation where this provides repeatability, scale and earlier feedback.
- Shift Left: Engage early with data mapping, transformation rules and migration design to identify defects before formal migration test cycles.
Assure test deliverables
- Test Deliverable Assurance: Assure data test plans, scenarios, reconciliation rules, scripts, expected results and evidence.
- Traceability: Ensure technical data requirements, mappings and key migration risks are traceable to appropriate validation.
- Reconciliation Assurance: Ensure appropriate record-level, aggregate and control-total reconciliation is performed and evidenced.
Support and Test Readiness
- Data Test Readiness: Ensure mappings, transformation rules, data requirements and acceptance criteria are sufficiently defined before execution.
- Environment Tooling: Ensure source/target environments, database access, reconciliation tooling and required test utilities are available.
- Test Data Readiness: Ensure representative datasets, expected results and baseline/reference data are available and controlled.
Collaborate and Communicate
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with stakeholders, including product owners, scrum masters, and other leads.
- Clear Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate testing concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Team Coordination: Experience in coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive and aligned testing efforts.
Manage and report test metrics
- Data Test Report: Own the consolidated Technical Data Test Report, summarising coverage across source systems, reconciliation outcomes, exceptions, defects and residual data risks.
- Reconciliation: Track migrated, reconciled, rejected, failed and exception records, including reconciliation percentages and agreed tolerances.
- Data Quality: Report trends across completeness, accuracy, integrity, consistency and other applicable data-quality dimensions.
- Defect Risk Management: Lead management and escalation of data quality issues, migration defects, exceptions and residual risks.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Location : Jaipur City-Walled City, Ajmer

Responsibilities:
Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets consistently.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.
Dedicate at least two hours daily to on-site presence at assigned retail stores to drive sales and customer engagement.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to promote product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.


Requirements

Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.
Benefits:
Net Take Home: 18k to 22k (Negotiable)
MWA: 4,000/-
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 2,000 4,000 per month, depending on profile

Title: Technical Head

Description:
Job Description Technical Head
Company: OfBusiness
Department: Plant Operations / Technical / R&D

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Technical Plant Head to oversee production planning and execution, laboratory testing, quality assurance, and technical operations for grease and lubricant manufacturing. The role will primarily focus on R&D, formulation development, product improvement, and ensuring consistent product quality while coordinating production activities to achieve operational targets.

Key Responsibilities
1. Production Planning & Execution
Develop and manage production plans and schedules based on customer orders, inventory, and business requirements.
Ensure timely execution of production plans for grease and lubricant manufacturing.
Monitor production processes, batch execution, raw material consumption, and production yields.
Coordinate with procurement, stores, maintenance, and dispatch teams to ensure smooth plant operations.
Identify process improvements to enhance productivity, reduce wastage, and optimise manufacturing costs.

2. Research & Development (R&D) and Formulation
Lead R&D activities for the development of new grease and lubricant formulations.
Develop, modify, and optimise formulations based on customer requirements, performance specifications, and industry standards.
Work on base oils, thickeners, additives, and other raw materials used in grease and lubricant manufacturing.
Conduct formulation trials, pilot batches, and product performance evaluations before commercial production.
Support new product development, product customisation, and cost optimisation initiatives.
Troubleshoot formulation-related issues and improve product performance, stability, and consistency.

3. Laboratory Testing & Quality Control
Oversee laboratory testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products.
Ensure products meet defined specifications and applicable industry standards.
Supervise testing of grease and lubricants, including viscosity, penetration, dropping point, consistency, and other relevant performance parameters, as applicable to the product portfolio.
Establish and maintain quality control procedures, testing protocols, and laboratory documentation.
Investigate quality deviations, customer complaints, and batch failures, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure calibration and proper maintenance of laboratory instruments and testing equipment.

4. Quality Assurance & Process Improvement
Maintain consistent product quality across all production batches.
Develop and implement SOPs, quality standards, and process control procedures.
Ensure compliance with applicable safety, environmental, and quality requirements.
Conduct root-cause analysis for production and quality-related issues.
Work closely with production and R&D teams to ensure successful transfer of formulations from laboratory trials to commercial manufacturing.

5. Team Management & Cross-Functional Coordination
Lead and guide production, laboratory, quality, and technical teams.
Coordinate with management on production performance, product development, and quality improvement initiatives.
Maintain technical records, production reports, batch documentation, and formulation data.
Provide technical support to sales and customer-facing teams for product specifications and application-related queries.

Required Qualifications
B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Lubrication Technology, or an equivalent related field.
Relevant experience in grease and lubricant manufacturing, particularly in formulation development, R&D, production, and quality control.
Experience managing plant-level technical operations and production execution.

Key Skills
Grease and lubricant formulation development
Research & Development and product innovation
Production planning and execution
Laboratory testing and quality control
Raw material and additive selection
Process optimisation and troubleshooting
Quality assurance and root-cause analysis
Team management and cross-functional coordination

Preferred Industry Experience
Candidates from grease manufacturing, industrial lubricants, automotive lubricants, speciality lubricants, or related chemical manufacturing industries will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A technically strong professional who can independently manage plant-level production and quality activities, with a primary focus on R&D, formulation development, laboratory testing, and successful commercialisation of grease and lubricant products.

In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

As a Venue Manager, you will drive sales and revenue across assigned venues while managing customer, owner, vendor and internal stakeholder relationships. The role combines inside sales, field engagement, venue operations and event execution.
1. Ensure all incoming customer leads are connected with through the calling app (average 80+ customer calls daily) and drive lead conversion, sales maximization, sales targets and profitability.
2. Revenue management ensure healthy revenue flow through customer and owner relationships and execution of marketing solutions launched from time to time.
3. Ensure target achievement through effective revenue generation and collection across assigned venues and products/packages.
4. Ensure smooth venue operations through effective stakeholder management, both internal and external.
5. Supervise and ensure smooth event execution to deliver an excellent customer experience.
6. Act as the signing authority for entering into customer contracts for sales bookings on behalf of the company.
7. Drive vendor optimization by identifying vendors, negotiating rates and signing/approving contracts in line with central-team guidance

Preferred candidate profile

1. At least 1 year of work experience in B2C / inside sales.
2. Prior experience in hotel, events or hospitality sectors is preferred, but not mandatory.
3. Fluency in English and the respective local language.
4. Willingness to travel to assigned venues; travel reimbursement will be applicable.
5. Own smartphone required (Android 7 or above with call-recording facility) to run the calling app; phone reimbursement applicable.
6. Own Windows 11 Pro laptop required; monthly device allowance will be provided.
7. Willingness to work 6 days a week, including weekends; weekly off will be on Monday.

Job Summary
The Debt Management Specialist will be responsible for managing and coordinating the recovery of overdue payments on loans or credit accounts.
Responsibilities
Achieve collections target by visiting customers/agency.

Ensure legal guidelines are complied with while repossessing products.

Daily DRR (Daily Risk Report) management.
Develop and implement strategies to improve collection rates.
Case to Case tracking.
Resolution at per AOP within agreed timelines.
Portfolio management.
Debt collection strategy.
Target achievement.
Regulatory compliance.
Reporting and analysis.
Risk management.
Team leadership.
Vendor management.
Co-ordinating with internal and external clients.

Description:
Job Summary
Relationship Associate plays a pivotal role in driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers. The role involves lead conversion, ensuring process adherence, and supporting operational excellence. The incumbent will be responsible for meeting business targets and maintaining customer satisfaction. This position requires consistent coordination with stakeholders and adherence to company guidelines.


Key Responsibilities
Managing relationships with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting targets through Bank's FOS.
Responsible for managing the leads generated from the branch and thereby converting them into quality business.
Must adhere to the process and coordinate in a timely manner with the Cluster Manager and Operations HUB, ensuring minimal customer complaints.
Shall adhere to agreed TATs on first customer contact and follow-ups from the date the lead is registered.
Ensure 15-month persistency on track and thereby maintain a robust follow-up mechanism with customers.
Coordinating with Cluster Training Manager to ensure bank staff stay regularly updated on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.
Shall be responsible for activating branch banking sellers and thereby achieving the activation target.
Ensuring LMS usage as a tracking mechanism online and follow-up calls.


Key Competencies / Skills
Excellent Relationship Skill
Managing Various level of Bank Management
Adherence to Process


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate in any discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved college and university.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales; experience in Insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of life insurance sales management, retail bank distribution, and channel management and/or DSA relationship.

Description:
Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies.

Monitor dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of guests. Complete work orders for maintece repairs.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job Summary
Function SummaryRelationship Associate plays a pivotal role in driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers. The role involves lead conversion, ensuring process adherence, and supporting operational excellence. The incumbent will be responsible for meeting business targets and maintaining customer satisfaction. This position requires consistent coordination with stakeholders and adherence to company guidelines.
Job SummaryManages branches, collaborates with the objective to support and contribute to Axis bank strategy, achieve operations excellence, ensure systems are deployed and help build the channel WITHIN the company guidelines and the achieve business targets.


Key Responsibilities
Managing relationship with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting target through Bank s FOS
Responsible for managing the leads generated from Branch and thereby convert into quality business.
Must adhere to the process set and timely coordinate with Cluster Manager and Operations HUB. Ensuring minimal customer complain.
Shall adhere to agree TATs on first customer contact and follow-ups from the date of the lead being registered.
Ensuring 15month persistency on track and thereby ensure a robust follow up mechanism with the customers.
Coordinating with Cluster Training manager to ensure bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Shall be responsible for making active the branch banking sellers and thereby achieving the activation target
Ensuring LMS usage as Tracking Mechanism on line and follow up Calls


Key Competencies / Skills
Excellent Relationship Skill, Managing Various level of Bank Management , Adherence to Process


Qualifications / Experience
Graduate in Any Discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved College and University.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales, experience in Insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Associate Agency Development Manager to join our team at Axis Max Life Insurance Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in agency development and management, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


Roles and Responsibility
Develop and implement effective agency development strategies to drive business growth.
Build and maintain strong relationships with agents, providing guidance and support to ensure their success.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback to improve agent productivity.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new business opportunities and expand existing partnerships.
Analyze market trends and competitor activity to stay ahead of the competition.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with agency development, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.


Job Requirements
Proven experience in agency development and management within the insurance industry.
Strong understanding of the insurance product lifecycle and sales process.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a focus on results-driven performance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
Experience working with CRM software and other sales tools is an advantage.

Description:
Install, maintain, perform preventative maintece on, and recommend replacement of tools, appliances, and equipment. Calibrate all controls, gauges, meters, etc. Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves. Order, mark, and stock parts and supplies as needed. Maintain inventory and purchase orders log. Inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Operate power lift. Complete the life safety checklist, including the fire-pump run test and generator run test. Inspect fire sprinkler valves and alarm systems. Assist in development of disaster response protocols.

Respond and attend to guest repair requests.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; and complete safety training and certifications.

Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, and assist individuals with disabilities. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.

Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 2 years of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job Summary
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customers in a) Resolving policy service needs; b) Renewal collection to resolve policy holder's service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects
Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s)
Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success
Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience
At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Associate Sales Manager to drive business growth through Bancassurance partnerships. The ideal candidate will have 2 to 7 years of experience in sales management, preferably in the insurance industry.


Roles and Responsibility
Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve business objectives.
Build strong relationships with Axis Bank branch sellers to increase sales revenue.
Conduct market research and analyze competitor activity to identify new business opportunities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution of sales plans.
Provide coaching and training to sales team members to enhance their skills and performance.
Monitor and report on sales performance metrics to senior management.


Job Requirements
Minimum 2 years of experience in sales management, preferably in the insurance industry.
Strong understanding of Bancassurance partnerships and sales strategies.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet sales targets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Experience working with Axis Bank or similar financial institutions is an advantage.


About Company
Axis Max Life Insurance Limited is a leading life insurance company committed to providing innovative products and services to its customers. We are seeking a motivated and results-driven individual to join our team as an Associate Sales Manager - Bancassurance.

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Ensure all incoming customer leads are connected with through the calling app (average 80+ customer calls daily) and drive lead conversion, sales maximization, sales targets and profitability.
2. Revenue management ensure healthy revenue flow through customer and owner relationships and execution of marketing solutions launched from time to time.
3. Ensure target achievement through effective revenue generation and collection across assigned venues and products/packages.
4. Ensure smooth venue operations through effective stakeholder management, both internal and external.
5. Supervise and ensure smooth event execution to deliver an excellent customer experience.
6. Act as the signing authority for entering into customer contracts for sales bookings on behalf of the company.
7. Drive vendor optimization by identifying vendors, negotiating rates and signing/approving contracts in line with central-team guidance.

Preferred candidate profile

1. At least 1 year of work experience in B2C / inside sales.
2. Prior experience in hotel, events or hospitality sectors is preferred, but not mandatory.
3. Fluency in English and the respective local language.
4. Willingness to travel to assigned venues; travel reimbursement will be applicable.
5. Own smartphone required (Android 7 or above with call-recording facility) to run the calling app; phone reimbursement applicable.
6. Own Windows 11 Pro laptop required; monthly device allowance will be provided.
7. Willingness to work 6 days a week, including weekends; weekly off will be on Monday.

Description:
Position- Lab Technician
Location- Jaipur


Role & responsibilities :

To perform assigned analytical testing procedures in an accurate, precise, and timely manner in the assigned lab.
To perform routine and non-routine activities pertaining to laboratory testing and reporting and maintaining external and Internal Quality control.
Maintain required records and documentation.
Follow the laboratory's procedures for specimen handling and processing, test analyses, reporting and maintaining records of patient test result.
Analyze specimens using approved testing procedures as per SOP's, review and release test results.
Adhere to the laboratory's quality control policies, instrument and procedural calibrations and follow safety guidelines as per established organization protocols.


Preferred candidate profile:
Qualification: DMLT, BMLT
Immediate joiners preferred
AboutCompany:
Established in 1949, Dr Lal PathLabs today is the largest and most respected diagnostic service provider in the country. It has a proven track record of over six decades for strict adherence to international standards and benchmarks. Dr Lal PathLabs offers widest test menu and has a pan India presence in all important cities and towns of India, in the form of state-of-the-art laboratories and patient service centres.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

Description:
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand.

Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach
AboutCompany: NoBroker is Indias first and only PropTech Unicorn, transforming the real estate ecosystem with cutting-edge, tech-driven, and capital-efficient solutions. Through NoBrokerHood, our smart society and community management platform, we empower over 21,000+ societies across 15 major cities—offering seamless visitor management, billing, and engagement experiences.

Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe.

Manager – Learning & Development (Manufacturing & Sales)
You will be leading end-to-end capability building across manufacturing operations and commercial sales teams. This role aligns technical, operational, and sales training programs with business goals to improve shop-floor safety and productivity as well as field sales effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities
F Training Needs Analysis (TNA): Partner with plant heads, production leads, and sales leaders to identify skill gaps, operational bottlenecks, and revenue enablement needs.
F Manufacturing & Technical Capability: Design and oversee programs covering SOPs, machinery/process operations, quality standards, EHS/safety compliance, lean/operational excellence, and new-hire plant induction.
F Sales Enablement & Capability: Build and deliver training on product knowledge, consultative selling, objection handling, territory/channel management, CRM adoption, and sales onboarding.
F Program Design & Delivery: Develop blended learning solutions—including hands-on shop-floor coaching, workshops, field ride-alongs, and LMS/e-learning modules—using internal SMEs and external trainers.
F LMS & Governance: Manage the Learning Management System (LMS), training calendars, compliance tracking, vendor contracts, and the L&D budget.
F Impact & ROI Measurement: Track completion, assessments, on-the-job transfer, safety/quality metrics, and sales KPIs to evaluate and refine programs.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Should have 6–10+ years in L&D or corporate training, with demonstrated exposure to both manufacturing/industrial environments and sales/commercial teams. Hindi Speaking is a must.
2. Instructional design, facilitation and coaching, stakeholder management with plant and sales leaders, LMS/analytics proficiency, and willingness to travel to plants and sales territories.
3. Prior experience working as a learning and development manager

8. Organizational Development
9. Talent Management

12. Project Management

16. Ability to bring innovative Learning & Development ideas and proposals to the team that can improve associate career development.

Description:
Third Party Pay Roll
Officer - Costing & Budgeting
Location: Bangalore RO
Experience Required
Minimum 4 years of experience in Costing & Budgeting.
Mandatory experience in handling Real Estate Projects (Residential, Commercial, Mixed-use developments).
Job Purpose
The objective of this position is to prepare and monitor construction budgets, estimate quantities, perform cost analysis, and support effective cost control for real estate projects. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate cost estimation, budget monitoring, rate analysis, and timely reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Cost Estimation
Preparation of BOQs and quantity estimation based on construction drawings.
Analysis and interpretation of drawings received from Structural Consultants, Architects, and MEP Consultants.
Preparation of project cost estimates for residential and commercial real estate developments.
Assist in budget planning during project feasibility and execution stages.
Cost & Budget Monitoring
Preparation of detailed project budgets and periodic budget revisions.
Monitor project costs against approved budgets and identify variances.
Track budget vs. actual expenditures and provide recommendations for cost optimization.
Prepare and submit monthly cost monitoring reports to management.
Rate Analysis
Conduct rate analysis for various construction activities and materials.
Maintain and update cost databases considering location-wise and project-specific parameters.
Evaluate vendor quotations and support procurement teams in cost comparison exercises.
Develop benchmarking data for residential and commercial projects.
Reporting & Coordination
Prepare MIS reports related to project costs, budgets, and forecasts.
Coordinate with Project, Procurement, Contracts, and Finance teams for cost tracking and control.
Support management in decision-making through cost analysis and reporting.
Key Competencies
Strong knowledge of construction costing, budgeting, and estimation.
Ability to read and analyze architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
Proficiency in MS Excel and cost estimation tools.
Good analytical and reporting skills.
Attention to detail and ability to work within timelines.
Key Deliverables
Timely and accurate cost estimation.
Effective project budget preparation and monitoring.
Accurate rate analysis and cost benchmarking.
Monthly budget variance and cost monitoring reports.
Cost optimization recommendations for real estate projects.
This version aligns the role to an Officer level and emphasizes the requirement of 4+ years of experience in real estate project costing and budgeting.

Description:
Job Summary
Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy. To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement: As a Tender/Quotation Specialist for Distribution Transformer Factory - Egypt, you will be part of Indian Operation Center in India (INOPC), aiming to develop a global value chain, where key business activities, resources and expertise are shared across geographic boundaries to optimize value for Hitachi Energy customers across market.
You will support tendering activities of Distribution Transformer Factory in Egypt play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless bid submission and order booking. Work location will be based out of Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
Your Responsibilities
Product Marketing Management: Supports the product marketing organization/customer in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions. Formulates competitive bids/estimates/quotations, taking into account best available oil/ dry type transformer product mix and appropriate technical and commercial considerations for each individual situation. Ensures tenders are well documented in a timely manner and with appropriate level of detail, including full and accurate costs.
Offer Preparation - Manages the preparation of all technical (e.g. defining the most suitable technology and product type(s)), financial (e.g. total price sheet, cash flow analysis) and if necessary project management (e.g. quantifies hours of engineering and commissioning) aspects of the bid/estimate/quotation, indicating prices and trading conditions.
Order booking and SFDC Support: Customer creation/Change, Customer credit request, Order booking basing on ERP work as well as SFDC data input/configuration
Risk - Identifies potential risks in the bids, quotations and estimates, and in any related contract agreements across customers/channels. Provides information and/or participates in the Risk Review process in accordance with policy.
Documentation - Collects and archives documentation regarding the offer/order and records assumptions and decisions taken during the development process. Regularly reports the status of the bids/estimates/quotations using defined tools and collects and analyses the reasons for tenders being lost and won.
Health, safety and environment (HSE) - Ensures the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies


Your Background
Bachelor's degree in engineering, with 2 plus years of professional experience in Distribution Transformer Tendering or Front End Sales.
Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, Word
Prociency in English language.
Preferred who have worked in sizable and well-structured organization

Operating Model: Manage the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of the Operating Model by analyzing processes, roles, governance, and performance metrics to enable efficient service delivery
Cost Analysis and Value Realization: Lead analysis and detailed cost model development covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GBS and transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit and savings delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers

Capability Maturity Assessment: Conduct structured maturity assessments across functions and processes against leading-practice benchmarks; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
Governance, RACI and Interaction Model Design: Design governance frameworks (councils, decision rights, escalation paths), RACI matrices, and interaction models defining roles and collaboration patterns between the GBS, retained organization, business units, and third-party providers
Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations
Gen AI in Functions: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on Gen AI and intelligent automation use cases across functional processes - such as AP invoice processing, reconciliations, close acceleration, and management reporting

Experience designing KPI and SLA frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
