Description:
About the Role:
Hurix Digital is looking for an accomplished business and operations leader to lead the next phase of growth across our Content, Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This is a senior enterprise leadership role with responsibility for business operations, delivery, revenue realization, profitability, customer success, people leadership and organizational capability. The EVP will work closely with the CEO and the leadership team to build a predictable,profitable and scalable operating organizationone that delivers consistently for customers,develops strong leaders and enables sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Business & P&L Leadership
Own operational performance across Content, Technology and AI Data Services.
Drive revenue realization, gross margin, EBITDA, productivity, utilization and cost optimization.
Lead annual operating plans, forecasting, capacity planning and business reviews.
Partner closely with Finance, Sales and business leaders to make informed decisions on growth, investments, costs and profitability.
Ensure that signed business translates into successful, profitable and sustainable delivery. The role should carry genuine business accountability; the earlier EVP framework similarly linked the position directly to growth, profitability, revenue and margin outcomes.

Delivery & Operational Excellence
Build a strong operating rhythm through dashboards, metrics, forecasting, reviews and early-warning mechanisms.
Strengthen delivery governance and establish a high-performing PMO Excellence capability.
Improve predictability across quality, timelines, capacity, productivity and margins.
Build systems and processes that reduce dependence on firefighting and individual heroics.
Drive continuous improvement through technology, automation and AI-enabled workflows.

Customer Leadership
Act as a senior executive sponsor for strategic customers.
Build strong relationships with customer leadership teams and participate actively in QBRs, reviews and critical engagements.
Lead major escalations and ensure strong recovery and closure.
Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales on solutioning, commercials, feasibility and transition of new opportunities.
Identify opportunities for account expansion and deeper customer partnerships.

People & Leadership
Build and develop a strong second line of leaders across operations and delivery.
Assess leadership capability, identify talent risks early and take decisive action where the organization needs stronger talent.
Coach high-potential leaders and create clear succession and development plans.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and high performance.
Be a visible and accessible leader, especially during critical business and delivery situations.
Ensure that business growth is achieved without compromising team health,leadership quality or organizational sustainability.
People and customer outcomes were already explicit components of the prior EVP incentive framework through Client Happiness, Team Happiness and People/Customer/Revenue Impact.

AI Data Services & Technology
Play a key role in scaling Hurixs emerging AI Data Services business.
Bring strong business understanding of data operations, human-in-the-loop models,expert talent ecosystems, quality, throughput, productivity and margin.
Strengthen the Technology business by connecting technology capability with customer needs, solutions and profitable delivery.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across operations to improve speed,quality and business economics.

Enterprise Leadership
Operate as a trusted partner to the CEO and leadership team.
Provide clear visibility into business performance, risks, customer concerns and people issues.
Surface problems early, bring data-backed recommendations and take ownership for execution.
Work effectively across Sales, Finance, HR, Solutions and other functions to drive enterprise outcomes.
Act as a strong leadership presence on the ground and help translate strategy into execution.

Experience & Background:
We are looking for a leader with approximately 20+ years of experience, including significant responsibility for large-scale operations, delivery or business-unit leadership.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Meaningful P&L and business ownership, beyond project or delivery management.
Experience leading large, complex and multi-disciplinary teams.
Strong track record of driving revenue realization, profitability, productivity and operational predictability.
Executive-level customer management and experience handling strategic accounts.
Demonstrated ability to build strong leadership teams and second-line capability.
Strong numerical and analytical orientation with experience using dashboards,forecasting and operating metrics.
Experience in solutioning, pre-sales, commercials and transition from Sales to Delivery.
Exposure to AI/Data Services, technology services, digital services, learning/content services or adjacent knowledge-intensive businesses.
Strong partnership experience with Finance on business planning, revenue, cost and profitability.
Experience working with global customers and distributed teams.
Prior experience in digital learning or content services is valuable but not mandatory.
We are equally interested in leaders from technology, data and digital services who bring the right combination of business, customer, people and operating leadership.

Leadership Traits We Value
We are looking for someone who can combine:
Structure without bureaucracy.
Speed without chaos.
Customer obsession without organizational burnout.
Commercial ambition with delivery discipline.
High standards with strong people leadership.
Data-driven thinking with sound judgement.


Values:
Get stuff done
Move fast with purpose
Win with ideas
Sweat the details
Deliver great customer experiences
Make your teammate successful


Perks:
Health Insurance
Kwench Library (Klib)
Employee Assistance Program (Free Counseling Service)
Hybrid Work Model
Flexi Reimbursement Basket
Paid Time off
Level up your skills with company-based sponsorship.
Tech reimbursement.

Why Join Hurix Digital?
Hurix Digital is building on its established strength in global content and digital learning while expanding its Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This role offers the opportunity to influence not just how work is delivered, but how businesses scale, how leaders are built, how customers experience Hurix and how the operating model evolves in an AI-first environment. For the right leader, this is a high-impact enterprise role with significant autonomy, visibility and the opportunity to shape Hurixs next phase of growth.

Description:
Job Description Senior DevSecOps Engineer
Company: Hurix Digital
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Mumbai , Pune, Chennai (Hybrid)
Experience: 4-6 Years

Role Overview
Hurix Digital is seeking an experienced Senior DevSecOps Engineer to strengthen security across AWS cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production environments. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in cloud security, security automation, vulnerability management, and incident response, ensuring secure and efficient software delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Design and implement AWS security controls, including IAM, SCPs, KMS, VPC, and multi-account governance.
Integrate security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security using Terraform and policy-as-code tools.
Secure containerized environments using Docker, ECS, and Kubernetes security practices.
Implement secrets management, identity federation, and access controls.
Lead vulnerability assessments, risk-based remediation, security monitoring, and incident response.
Automate security compliance processes aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
Conduct threat modeling, strengthen software supply chain security, and mentor engineering teams.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud security, including IAM, Organizations, Control Tower, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, and CloudTrail.
Expertise in CI/CD security, preferably GitHub Actions, with tools such as Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, and Dependabot.
Proficiency in Terraform and security tools such as Checkov, tfsec, OPA, or Sentinel.
Experience securing ECS/Kubernetes environments, container images, and runtime workloads.
Knowledge of AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, OIDC, and SSO.
Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Bash.
Experience in vulnerability management, SIEM integration, threat modeling, and incident response.
Understanding of security compliance frameworks and software supply chain security, including SBOMs and artifact signing.

Preferred Skills
Experience implementing automated compliance and security governance.
Familiarity with STRIDE, SLSA, and Sigstore.
Strong security architecture, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to mentor developers and drive security best practices across engineering teams.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on DevSecOps professional who can independently manage cloud security initiatives, automate security controls, collaborate with engineering teams, and balance security requirements with business and delivery priorities.

Values:
Get stuff done
Move fast with purpose
Win with ideas
Sweat the details
Deliver great customer experiences
Make your teammate successful

Perks:
Health Insurance
Kwench Library (Klib)
Employee Assistance Program (Free Counseling Service)
Hybrid Work Model
Flexi Reimbursement Basket
Paid Time off
Level up your skills with company-based sponsorship.
Tech reimbursement.

Why Join Hurix Digital?
Hurix is scaling its AI Data Services vertical, and this role is at the center of that growth engine. Youll be backed by strong delivery capabilities, a motivated leadership team, and the autonomy to shape your own market strategy. We reward results with generous commissions and long-term growth opportunities.

Description:
As a Digital Transformation Specialist, you will lead a high-impact portfolio, connecting technology and business needs and delivering concrete results. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and executing IT capabilities within this area of expertise, planning and building IT solutions from business functions. You will work in a multinational team, conducting one or more projects/programs, and be the single focal point (SPOC) between IT Technology and the business for these transformation projects/programs. They will also be responsible for interacting with functional leaders and business units to monitor and execute projects/programs.
How you'll make an impact
Execute the PLM strategy, aligning it with digital transformation objectives and driving business value in the engineering and manufacturing areas
Integrate PLM with ERP, MES, and downstream systems, ensuring seamless data flow and process integration
Act as a promoter of the Digital Thread and configuration management, expanding traceability, collaboration and decision-making along the value chain
Optimize cross-functional processes using Lean and Six Sigma, with a focus on BOMs, process plans, roadmaps, and supply chain integration
Engage business and IT stakeholders, capturing complex requirements and facilitating global collaboration
Drive PLM governance and change management, supporting the adoption of new tools and continuous improvement initiatives
Act as a reference expert in PLM, guiding teams and supporting training on platforms such as Windchill or Teamcenter
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable internal and external standards, procedures and guidelines.
Your background
Relevant experience in IT and digital transformation, with a strong background in Computer Science or Engineering and deep knowledge in PLM systems and strategy
Experience in leading global PLM transformation programs in engineering and manufacturing, with hands-on experience in Windchill, Teamcenter or similar platforms
Advanced knowledge of the processes that connect PLM to manufacturing, including mBOMs, process plans, routings, and integration with ERP and MES
Proven ability to manage third-party vendors and virtual delivery teams on a global scale, ensuring alignment across distributed stakeholders
Application of Lean, Six Sigma and Industry 4.0 concepts for optimization of cross-functional processes in engineering, supply chain, quality and procurement
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English and proven experience in multicultural and multinational environments
Travel availability of up to 30%, supporting deployments at global engineering plants and sites, as well as stakeholder relationships
More about us
We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.
We can provide more information during the recruitment process.

Private medical care and life insurance
Access to fitness and wellness programs
Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
Company events and team-building activities
Psychological support program
Free parking available
You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.
Location
Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)
Employment Type
Full-time

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced API Automation Tester with 5-10 years of experience in API Testing, Automation Testing, and Selenium Automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in designing and implementing automation frameworks, validating REST/SOAP APIs, and ensuring end-to-end quality of web applications through robust test automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain API automation test frameworks and scripts.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Validate RESTful and SOAP APIs using automation tools and frameworks.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Selenium for web applications.
Create test plans, test cases, and test data for API and UI testing.
Analyze automation test results, identify defects, and track issues through resolution.
Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure automation coverage and improve testing efficiency.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous quality improvement.
Required Skills
API Testing
Strong hands-on experience in API Testing.
Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs.
API validation using Postman, Swagger, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of JSON, XML, and API authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, Basic Auth).
Experience with API automation using Java/Python frameworks.
Automation Testing
Experience in designing and developing automation frameworks.
Strong understanding of Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Keyword-Driven Frameworks.
Experience with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar frameworks.
Test execution, reporting, and defect management expertise.
Selenium Automation
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver.
Page Object Model (POM) Framework implementation.
Cross-browser automation testing.
Handling dynamic web elements and synchronization techniques.
Programming Skills
Java or Python programming experience.
Strong OOP concepts.
Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading knowledge.
CI/CD & Version Control
Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Database Testing
SQL Queries.
Database validation and backend testing.
Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Preferred Skills
Rest Assured.
Karate Framework.
Playwright automation.
Docker and Kubernetes basics.
Performance testing exposure using JMeter.
Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure).
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

About IKS Health
IKS Health enables the enhanced delivery of exceptional healthcare for todays practicing clinicians, medical
groups and health systems. Supporting healthcare providers through every function of the patient visit, IKS
Health is a go-to resource for organizations looking to effectively scale, improve quality and achieve cost
savings through integrated technology and forward-thinking solutions. Founded in 2007, we have grown a
global workforce of 14,000 employees serving over 150,000 clinicians in many of the largest hospitals, health systems, and specialty groups in the United States.
IKS Health revitalizes the clinician-patient relationship while empowering healthcare organizations to thrive. We take on the chores of healthcare spanning administrative, clinical, and operational burdens
so that clinicians can focus on their core purpose: delivering great care.

What We Do

Revenue Optimizations Services:Our purpose built Revenue Optimization Services reduces administrative
burden, maximizes revenue and enables growth at scale while using a variable cost model. Delivered using a technology led platform we transform revenue cycle management, prevent denials, facilitate the
patient-provider care journey and maximize contract utilization.

Clinical Support Solutions:
Our Clinical Support Solutions help providers deliver better clinical outcomes, more efficient care, reduce clinician burnout and lower medical costs, resulting in improved physician and patient satisfaction as well as increased enterprise value. All of this while restoring the primacy of the physician-patient relationship in the exam room & beyond.

Value Based Care:
As insurance reimbursement models move towards paying for outcomes, managing population health holistically becomes more important for provider enterprises. Our value-based care solutions allow provider enterprises to succeed across the spectrum of risk by building a patient-centric, provider-led delivery model that coordinates care across the continuum and delivers better clinical, operational and financial outcomes.

Digital Health Solutions:
Our Digital Health Solutions are a robust platform that delivers data-driven value and expertise across the care continuum. It enables provider enterprises to leverage the full potential of their technology assets by helping them build, enhance, maintain and support these critical parts of their IT infrastructure. From a Unified Data Platform to Robotic Process Automation and creating bespoke technology solutions

managing building engagement and motivation in the team.

Financials
Own achieving profitability/ Operating Efficiency targets for account / assigned function(s)

document, only deviating with written approval via client, post creation.

Align & execute Org level initiatives for operational / process efficiency.

Driven sustained margin growth on year on year basis
Experienced in measuring target achievements, skills at people management, P&L / EBITDA / Customer
Satisfaction / Leadership

What distinguish IKS Health from others are our healthcare expertise; understanding of customers' business requirements; technology expertise; and our analytics/business intelligence capabilities. Our team includes medical doctors, healthcare professionals who have managed clinical practices, management consultants, revenue cycle professionals, and technology practitioners. We are a privately held company that is funded and supported by one of Asia's leading investors.

The IKS Health Mission
Our mission is to enable healthcare providers to succeed financially, operate efficiently, and provide excellent care to patients and populations. IKS Health services allow our clients to grow effectively and navigate industry changes successfully.

Description:
Additional Job Description
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Experienced Associate in Treasury Management System Implementation within our Finance Solutions practice, you will engage directly with clients to enhance their financial operations. You will leverage your skills to contribute to the successful implementation of treasury management systems, helping clients optimize their financial processes and achieve operational efficiency. Within our Finance practice, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on delivering impactful solutions that drive business transformation.
As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagements while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources. You will embrace ambiguity, ask questions, and use these challenges as opportunities for growth.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will participate in project tasks, develop basic skills and knowledge, and respond effectively to diverse perspectives and needs. You will use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, contributing to the broader objectives of your projects and the overall strategy.
Responsibilities
- Assisting in the implementation of treasury management systems to enhance financial operations
- Supporting client engagements by contributing to financial strategy and forecasting initiatives
- Conducting financial statement analysis to provide insights for decision-making
- Preparing and reviewing financial statements to validate accuracy and compliance
- Developing financial models to support strategic planning and financial management
- Collaborating with teams to optimize financial reporting processes and improve efficiency
- Engaging in financial transactions and accounting practices to support client needs
- Utilizing financial management skills to address complex client challenges and deliver solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 1 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Demonstrating proficiency in financial statement analysis
- Utilizing financial modeling to support decision-making
- Engaging in financial forecasting for strategic planning
- Applying accounting practices in diverse financial scenarios
- Excelling in financial reporting and communication
- Supporting financial management initiatives with innovative solutions
- Contributing to financial strategy development and execution
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the worlds mostinnovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as theyprovide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days arethe same.
Job Description
Your Role
Creation, modification, and revision of AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual) content for Airbus aircraft programs.
Develop and update maintenance procedures in accordance with Airbus documentation standards and guidelines.
Airbus tool experience is mandatory.
Good understanding of Airbus standards, tools, processes, and technical publication guidelines.
Analyze engineering source data, drawings, specifications, and change requests to develop accurate AMM content.
Perform impact analysis and incorporate technical changes into the relevant maintenance procedures.
Ensure technical content meets quality, accuracy, consistency, and compliance requirements.
Coordinate with engineering teams, illustrators, reviewers, and other stakeholders for technical clarifications.
Guide and mentor Junior Authors/Preparators/Proofreaders when required.
Your Profile
6+ Years of experience in AMM Authoring for Airbus aircraft programs.
Strong knowledge of Aircraft Maintenance Manual structure, maintenance procedures, and technical documentation.
Hands-on experience working with Airbus technical publication processes and authoring environment.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, source data, and other engineering documents.
Experience in source data analysis, technical analysis, and impact analysis.
Good understanding of engineering changes and their impact on technical publications.
Experience in XML/SGML-based technical documentation and authoring tools will be an advantage.
Strong attention to detail with good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while maintaining high levels of accuracy and quality.
Experience mentoring team members and supporting process improvement initiatives will be an added advantage.
What You'll Love About Working Here
We value flexibility and support our employees with hybrid work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.
At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in technology and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

Job Description: Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer
Experience: 4 to 7 Years

Core Technologies: Google BigQuery (GBQ), dbt, Python, Informatica IICS, SQL
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer with 47 years of experience in building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data engineering and data warehousing solutions. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, Google BigQuery, dbt, and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS), along with a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL/ELT development.
The candidate will develop robust data pipelines, implement complex transformations, automate data engineering processes using Python, optimize BigQuery workloads, and deliver high-quality, analytics-ready datasets to support business intelligence and analytical use cases.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformation workflows using BigQuery, dbt, Informatica IICS, Python, and SQL.
Develop complex SQL queries and reusable transformation logic to process large volumes of data efficiently.
Build and maintain dbt models, including incremental models, data tests, documentation, and dependency management.
Develop Python scripts and utilities for data processing, pipeline automation, validation, reconciliation, and operational monitoring.
Use Python libraries and APIs to integrate data sources, automate repetitive tasks, and streamline data engineering workflows.
Develop and support ETL/ELT integrations using Informatica IICS, including mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, scheduling, and error handling.
Apply data warehousing principles to design dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions.
Optimize BigQuery query performance and cost through efficient SQL, partitioning, clustering, and execution-plan analysis.
Implement data quality checks, automated validations, reconciliation processes, and exception handling.
Troubleshoot pipeline failures, investigate data discrepancies, and resolve production issues.
Use Git and established CI/CD practices for source control, code reviews, testing, and deployments.
Collaborate with business analysts, BI developers, architects, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, business-ready data products.
Maintain technical documentation and follow engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, and maintainability.
Required Technical Skills
1. Python
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
Proficiency in writing reusable, modular, and maintainable Python code, including functions, classes, exception handling, and logging.
Experience with data manipulation and processing using libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.
Ability to develop scripts for data validation, reconciliation, file processing, automation, and operational support.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, CSV, and other common data formats.
Understanding of Python package management, virtual environments, dependency management, and debugging.
Ability to write efficient code, handle large datasets, and implement robust error handling and logging.
2. Google BigQuery (GBQ)
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing complex SQL queries in BigQuery.
Strong understanding of datasets, tables, views, materialized views, and BigQuery architecture.
Experience with partitioning, clustering, query execution analysis, and cost optimization.
Ability to design scalable data models and efficiently process large datasets.
Familiarity with integrating BigQuery workloads with Python-based applications or automation.
3. dbt (Data Build Tool)
Hands-on experience developing and maintaining dbt models using SQL and Jinja.
Understanding of dbt project structure, model dependencies, materializations, and incremental models.
Experience implementing dbt tests, source definitions, documentation, and lineage.
Familiarity with Git integration, automated testing, and CI/CD-based deployments.
4. Informatica IICS
Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services for data integration and transformation.
Experience developing mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and data integration workflows.
Understanding of source-to-target mapping, scheduling, error handling, and operational monitoring.
Ability to troubleshoot and optimize ETL workflows.
5. Data Warehousing and SQL
Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture and ETL/ELT design patterns.
Expertise in dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and SCD Types 1 and 2.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, subqueries, and query optimization.
Understanding of staging, curated, and business-ready data layers, incremental loading, CDC concepts, and data quality management.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Functions.
Experience automating cloud operations and data workflows using Python and APIs.
Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux/Unix environments.
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Power BI.
Exposure to Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and reusable data products.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4–7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or ETL/ELT development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Description:
Job Title: React Native Mobile Developer

Required:
4+ years of experience in mobile application development, with at least 3+ years of hands-on React Native app development.
Required Skills & Experience:
Strong expertise in React Native, including developing UI components, navigation, and using state management libraries like Redux (Redux Toolkit) or MobX.
Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), including core concepts such as closures, hoisting, Promises, Arrow functions, and Rest/Spread operators.
Deep understanding of TypeScript, with hands-on experience in writing scalable and maintainable applications.
Solid experience in mobile app development, particularly in integrating RESTful APIs and handling asynchronous data flows.
Familiarity with mobile development best practices, including responsive design, app performance optimization, and front-end testing tools.
Proven experience in debugging and troubleshooting mobile apps for both Android and iOS environments.
Proficiency with Git or other version control systems for code collaboration.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, build processes, and deployment strategies for mobile apps.
Strong understanding of mobile app security, including data encryption, secure authentication, and safe data storage.
Experience with modern development tools such as React Navigation, push notifications, and unit testing frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead the development of React Native applications, ensuring best practices and high-quality code are followed.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build robust, scalable mobile solutions.
Act as a technical point of contact for the team, offering guidance on design, architecture, and implementation decisions.
Integrate APIs effectively and manage state using libraries like Redux (Redux Toolkit) or MobX.
Optimize mobile apps for performance, ensuring fast load times, responsiveness, and efficient resource usage across Android and iOS platforms.
Implement best practices in app security, including encryption, secure authentication, and safe data storage.
Actively contribute to hands-on coding, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex issues alongside the team.
Ensure continuous improvement in SDLC processes, fostering a culture of quality and efficiency within the development team.
Conduct thorough code reviews, ensuring adherence to SOLID principles, DRY principles, and design patterns to maintain a clean, maintainable codebase.
Troubleshoot and debug issues across Android and iOS environments using advanced debugging tools.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure timely delivery of features.

Advantage:
Experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK for iOS & Android, including Soup integration and data synchronization.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Consumer Goods Cloud.
Proficiency with Salesforce developer tools like Developer Console or Workbench.

Description:
As a Databricks + Agentic AI Manager you will lead client support work within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, focused on data engineering solutions that turn raw data into usable insights and support data pipelines, integration, and transformation efforts. As a Manager you will lead teams, coach junior professionals, manage performance, and guide delivery across multiple workstreams while bringing judgment, business knowledge, and a practical approach to technology and innovation. In this role at PwC, you will help shape work around Databricks and agentic AI, coordinate deliverables, support client needs, and contribute to solutions that strengthen data infrastructure and analytics capabilities within PwC Acceleration Center Bangalore.
Responsibilities
- Leading data engineering workstreams that design and build Databricks and Azure-based data pipelines for client solutions
- Managing project planning, prioritization, and delivery across data integration, transformation, and validation efforts
- Guiding teams through development of data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse architectures that support analytics use cases
- Reviewing solution designs for data modeling, performance tuning, query optimization, and database reliability
- Coaching team members on Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, and Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform implementation methods
- Translating business requirements into scalable data infrastructure and pipeline designs that support AI-enabled workflows
- Coordinating delivery across technical stakeholders to address data quality, security, and operational issues
- Applying analytical thinking to identify dependencies, risks, and opportunities across complex data environments
- Supporting client-facing engagements by communicating technical progress, design choices, and delivery milestones
- Promoting responsible use of agentic AI, automation, and cloud data tooling in modern data engineering solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
- Demonstrating Databricks platform delivery across data modernization initiatives
- Applying Agentic AI concepts to client-facing data engineering solutions
- Managing project planning, budgeting, execution, and delivery
- Mentoring teams through complex data architecture decisions
- Translating business needs into scalable analytics design
- Navigating ambiguity while advancing quality and timelines

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Salesforce LwC, Senior Associate-AES Operate, you will engage with clients to analyze their needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Salesforce applications. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your broad range of consulting skills to help clients optimize operational efficiency and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing increased ambiguity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will use a broad range of tools, methodologies, and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts. Your ability to interpret data will inform insights and recommendations, reinforcing professional and technical standards. This position offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and contribute to the success of our clients and the firm.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement Salesforce solutions that optimize operational efficiency
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Salesforce applications
- Collaborating with clients to understand their strategic objectives and align solutions accordingly
- Utilizing Salesforce Lightning and Salesforce Sales Cloud to enhance client business processes
- Developing and maintaining project architecture and budgeting for Salesforce implementations
- Engaging in business process modeling to improve client workflows and system integration
- Applying analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
- Supporting enterprise integration and technology implementation projects
- Creating and delivering training materials to facilitate client understanding and adoption of new technologies
- Embracing change and emerging technologies to drive innovation in client solutions
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune and Gurugram

Description:
As an AES Guidewire ClaimCenter Business Analyst Senior Associate you will help shape and support Guidewire ClaimCenter work within our Advisory practice, focusing on business analysis, client support, and the delivery of enhancements that improve insurance operations and user experience. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client relationships, mentor junior team members, and apply critical thinking to navigate ambiguity while strengthening your personal brand and technical skills. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will contribute to Application Evolution Services for Guidewire by gathering requirements, interpreting feedback, evaluating process impacts, and supporting solution development for deployed ClaimCenter environments.
Responsibilities
Demonstrates expert abilities managing ITIL Processes; Tracking SLAs, and contracting;
- Demonstrates advanced abilities providing solution strategy and Application Evolution Services (AES, formerly AMS) delivery as a Guidewire Functional Lead. Employees in the Functional Lead position should think of themselves and be regarded by the client as a trusted advisor and think strategically about how to create value using the Guidewire Suite of products;
- Demonstrates expert abilities with ITIL Incident and Problem management for the Guidewire Suite of applications as it will be critical that Senior Business Analyst in this position are capable of navigating both business processes as well as enterprise solution perspectives at high level and holistic view;
- Demonstrates expert abilities and/or a proven record of success in leading proposal development efforts; Senior Business Analyst in these positions should be capable of delivering Advisory-level work and be able to discuss future enhancements in Guidewire roadmap discussions with the client;
- With a focus on AES, demonstrates expert organization skills and abilities assisting clients in the support of Guidewire Suite solutions and improving business processes; and taking a proactive approach to quality;
- Analyzing Guidewire ClaimCenter business needs and translating them into functional requirements for insurance operations
- Supporting client service workstreams across enhancements, defect resolution, and production support for deployed Guidewire solutions
- Configuring and validating Guidewire ClaimCenter functionality while coordinating with technical teams on integrations and system changes
- Reviewing user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria to clarify scope and identify implementation impacts
- Interpreting business feedback and data points to recommend process improvements and application adjustments
- Mentoring junior team members on Guidewire concepts, delivery methods, and issue resolution approaches
- Collaborating across application, testing, and support teams to track work progress and address dependencies
- Applying problem-solving skills to diagnose system issues, evaluate options, and support timely resolution of incidents and enhancements
- Contributing to continuous improvement efforts by identifying automation, tooling, and process opportunities within application support
What You Must Have
- Expertise in ClaimCenter and working knowledge on Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ContactManager - leading requirement gathering sessions, conduct analysis, develop functional specifications and perform business walkthroughs;
- User story creation/updation, developing process flows, UI mock ups, and developing data mapping in the standard Guidewire recommended user stories;
- Familiarity with Use case, SWOT analysis, Mindmapping, PESTLE analysis; Product Designer
- Usage of Tools JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, Splunk and familiarity with SQL
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4-9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions
- Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, to meet client expectations
- Encouraging innovation and the use of technology to enhance delivery and inspire team development
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders to maintain project alignment
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python for production-grade application or service development.
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised service deployment.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning.
- Proficiency with Git-based collaborative development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, automated testing, design patterns, and maintainability.
- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience setting technical direction, reviewing code, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.
- Experience with asynchronous APIs, messaging platforms, or event-streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Exposure to agentic development using frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI SDK, or Google ADK.
- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions

We are seeking experienced Treasury Transformation professionals to support global client engagements focused on Treasury Management System (TMS) implementations, treasury process optimization, and finance transformation initiatives. The role involves working closely with CFO organizations, treasury teams, banking partners, and business stakeholders to enhance treasury operations using leading TMS platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Treasury Transformation & Consulting
Collaborate with CFOs and treasury leadership teams to improve finance and treasury functions.
Analyze treasury operations and identify opportunities for process optimization and automation.
Advise global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness across treasury processes.
Support strategic planning initiatives and treasury transformation programs.
Foster strong relationships with senior executives and stakeholders.
Treasury Management System (TMS) Implementation
Lead/support end-to-end implementation and reimplementation of Treasury Management Systems:
Kyriba
FIS Quantum
FIS Integrity
GTreasury
Gather and document business requirements.
Participate in solution design and system configuration.
Perform unit testing, UAT support, and test execution.
Develop test cases, scripts, and document testing results.
Support data migration, reconciliation, hypercare, and production support activities.

Description:
The Opportunity
When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, youll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. Youll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
As part of the Customer Link team you will apply data analytics and machine learning techniques to solve real-world client problems. As a Senior Associate you will build analytical models, derive insights from complex datasets, and leverage AI to enhance problem-solving while developing a deeper understanding of business contexts. This role emphasizes critical thinking and structured problem-solving, providing a platform to collaborate with cross-functional teams and engage with stakeholders effectively.
Responsibilities
Apply data analytics and machine learning techniques to client challenges
Build analytical models to derive insights from diverse datasets
Leverage AI tools to enhance problem-solving capabilities
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success
Develop a deeper understanding of business contexts and needs
Engage effectively with stakeholders to gather requirements
Utilize critical thinking for structured problem-solving
Maintain rigorous standards in analytical deliverables
What You Must Have
Bachelor's or Master Degree
4 years of experience in data science or analytics
Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Statistics, or a related field
4+ years of experience in Python for data analysis and machine learning.
Familiarity with AI techniques and prompt engineering
Solid understanding of machine learning techniques and statistical analysis
Exposure to PySpark and large-scale data environments
Curiosity to explore new AI techniques
Ability to think structurally and approach problems clearly
Demonstrating ownership in fast-paced environments
Excelling in collaboration and stakeholder management skills

Knowledge Preferred: The candidate is expected to have good knowledge of OneStream, Regulatory
reporting and Financial Close Process.
Good knowledge in OneStream
Good implementation experience on Multi GAAP and Multi currency applications Responsible
for building best practices within planning, forecasting and reporting processes and implementing
new performance reporting, planning and forecasting processes within the OneStream Good
understanding of intercompany elimination, consolidation adjustments, ownership accounting

Smart View and Reporting

Description: We are looking for a Billing Platform Techno-Functional Consultant with hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, customizing, and supporting Billing Platform solutions for enterprise Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation programs. The ideal candidate will possess a balanced blend of functional and technical expertise across the end-to-end billing lifecycle, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, and revenue processes. The candidate will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, conducting fit-gap analysis, preparing functional and technical designs, configuring the Billing Platform application, developing customizations, integrations, workflows, reports, and data migration solutions, and supporting unit, system, and user acceptance testing. The role also involves troubleshooting production issues, performing root cause analysis, and ensuring high-quality solution delivery aligned with industry best practices. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, functional consultants, technical teams, integration teams, and client stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions. The role requires strong consulting, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to contribute across the full project lifecyclefrom requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Years of Experience: 5 - 8 Years Position Requirements: Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct fit-gap analysis, prepare functional and technical specifications, and recommend scalable Billing Platform solutions aligned with Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) business processes and industry best practices Configure Billing Platform features including subscription management, pricing, billing, invoicing, payments, collections, and revenue processes. Develop customizations, workflows, reports, integrations, and data migration components to meet business requirements. Perform unit testing, support system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), resolve defects, validate solution quality, and support deployment, cutover, and post-production stabilization activities. Work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, technical teams, QA, integration teams, and client stakeholders to ensure successful solution delivery, timely issue resolution, and adherence to project milestones. Prepare technical and functional documentation, support knowledge transfer and user training, troubleshoot production issues, contribute to reusable assets and accelerators, and continuously improve delivery quality, productivity, and client satisfaction. Develop technical solutions using Billing Platform scripting, APIs, and configuration capabilities. Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes. Configure product catalog, pricing, subscriptions, usage billing, Tax configuration and billing schedules. Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses Develop REST/SOAP API integrations. Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation. Working knowledge of SQL and reporting tools. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution Must be a strong team player with excellent communication skills at the business and technical level, able to collaborate as part of a team to deliver exceptional customer results in a rapid paced implementation environment Nice to have skills on Zuora Billing, Oracle ORMB, SAP BRIM, or other similar billing applications.

Description:
PwC US CONSULTING SOLUTIONS - MANAGEMENT CONSULTING Our Management Consulting team works with our global clients to design and implement growth, operational and customer focused strategies for sustainable competitive advantage. Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. Additionally, our extensive expertise in various industries allows us to serve clients with consulting services with a focus on the most profitable elements of the value chain to create scalable businesses that will deliver increased sustainable profits.  Our Management Consultants work with the client and project teams to support global engagements from India through activities that are driven toward delivering results - conduct analyses and develop insights, prepare excel models, analyze large sets of data, capture as-is processes, prepare work plans, design to-be processes. In addition, consultants also support project lead, work directly with client teams, and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business development, thought leadership and firm building activities. PRACTICE OVERVIEW: WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS
At PwC, this team of consultants works with their US counterparts to develop both short and long-term Workforce Solutions for our clients. Our practitioners facilitate transformation by conducting strategic change initiatives, assisting transformative leadership initiatives, designing HR processes, developing, and implementing learning interventions that align with the clients business strategy. Some of our key capabilities include: 
HR Strategy & Operations 
NextGen Change  
Organization & Talent  
Rewards & Benefits 
Workforce Technology – Enabling Apps 
POSITION REQUIREMENTS: Key Responsibilities: As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growthAs such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to): Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies: 
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Bloom’s taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery – spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training. 
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 1–3 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements: 
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.
What skill does it take? Must-have
An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work. 
Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity. 
Self-motivated with a passion for client work and teamwork. 
Strong project management skills. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels. 
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs. 
Ability to develop and present new, innovative ideas and conceptualize new approaches and solutions. 
Will to learn, adopt and lead new ways of doing things (e.g., personas, journey mapping, gamification, etc.). 
Proficiency in leveraging GenAI tools to enhance productivity, analysis, and delivery quality. 
Ability to work with data to transform information into actionable insights. 
Foster an efficient, innovative, and team-oriented work environment.  
Strong work ethics, proactive, and professional behavior. 
Good-to-have
Effective storytelling and communication skills to various audiences (written and verbal). 
Strategic, creative thinker and problem solver. 
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to assess training effectiveness. 
Supports engagement managers in delivering engagements by identifying and addressing client needs. 
Exhibits strong ability to work independently as well as in a highly collaborative team environment. 
Demonstrated experience supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring junior team members. 
Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools and capabilities such as prompt engineering, AI-assisted analysis, and creating workforce-specific solutions.

Role & responsibilities

HCM Technical consultant BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI/(FDI)

Job Description
HCM BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI Technical consultant Manager (10-15 Years of experience)
As an BIP Sr. Associate, you will work with technical and projects teams to deliver cutting edge reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new Oracle cloud solutions; migrating applications to co-exist in the hybrid cloud (On-Premise and Cloud); deploying a global cloud application across multiple countries. Our teams have a diverse range of skills and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. Primary focus on developing custom solutions using BIP/ OTBI reports
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze reporting requirements from HR and business stakeholders
Design and develop reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher (BIP)
Build custom data models using SQL, and create RTF, Excel templates
Create and configure OTBI analyses, subject area queries, and dashboards
Develop reports for HCM areas such as Core HR, Absence, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot data and logic issues
Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production issues
Prepare technical specifications, test cases, and user documentation
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in BI Publisher (BIP): data models, templates, bursting, and scheduling
Strong hands-on experience in OTBI: subject areas, analyses, and dashboards
Good knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM data model and tables
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
Experience with HCM Extracts
Understanding of Fusion security, roles, and data access
Good communication and documentation skills
Good to have
Knowledge of Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) or Oracle Analytics
Knowledge on OCI, REST/SOAP APIs and APEX/ VBCS application would be added advantage
Exposure to multiple end-to-end Fusion HCM implementations
Oracle HCM Cloud certification
Consulting Requirements
5-8 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
Proven knowledge of Oracle Cloud platform and tools
Excellent team player
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong communicator
Willingness to travel up in case of project requirement
Strong knowledge of software implementation best practices
Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment and learn new concepts and software
Self-motivated, independent, detail oriented, responsible team player and exhibit exceptional relationship management skills
Passionate about building high-quality systems with software implementation
Professionalism and integrity
Strong interpersonal and written communication skills
Ability to work in fast paced environment

The principal objectives will be to ensure that consistent and high-quality service is provided by the team by taking end-to-end project ownership and accomplishing the define goals. Transformation Business Process Reengineering, Business Process
Optimization

Scrum Product Owner or Scrum Master Certifications

Develop strong relationship with onshore stakeholders (Areas leadership and champion network) and manage their expectations on service delivery
Building Centralized Data storage system
Building Data Strategies for the team
Built good understanding of Sources and Target sources by understanding the GDS Assurance Business.
Responsible for identifying and creating new service offerings/Solutions

Experience in coordinating projects and interdependencies between various projects within the program

Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility and self-discipline.

Proactive, organized and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.

A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way thats right for you

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore
