If you thrive in industrial automation or high-velocity B2B sales and want to partner with leading manufacturers across the Food, Pharma, Beverage, Dairy, and Electronics sectors, we want to hear from you!

Locations: Kolkata | Delhi | Pune | Mumbai | Hyderabad | Chennai | Bangalore | Punjab

Openings: 15 Positions

Compensation: Competitive & Negotiable (Based on experience, location & industry standards)

What You’ll Do:
Drive Growth: Develop new business within your assigned territory and crush sales targets.

Pitch & Demonstrate: Conduct on-site client visits, technical presentations, and live product demos.

Nurture Accounts: Build strong, long-term relationships with existing clients to maximize retention.

Collaborate: Work alongside our service engineers to ensure smooth installation and after-sales support.

Represent & Report: Attend industry trade shows/exhibitions, track market intelligence, and share weekly/monthly pipeline reports with management.

What We’re Looking For:
Education: B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics preferred) OR MBA in Sales & Marketing.

Experience: 3–7 years in B2B field sales across Industrial Machinery, Automation, Packaging Solutions, or Banking/Financial Sales. (Prior experience in coding & marking equipment is a strong advantage!)

Skills: Solid technical aptitude for machinery, strong negotiation skills, and a self-starter attitude.

Mobility: Extensive regional travel is mandatory; owning a 2-wheeler or 4-wheeler is an added advantage.
AboutCompany: BT Print is built upon the philosophy that business is about positively impacting social ecosystem including lives of people and enhancing value of business activities. All aspects of a business should benefit society at large thus every service we offer is not developed with the intent aimlessly increase market share; rather, our focus is on providing a valuable service. We are a highly energetic team passionate about supporting business by providing high quality products and services which helps in reducing overheads and costs.

Job Summary
We are looking for talented MLOps with 5-9 years of experience to design, automate, deploy, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications and machine learning platforms. Monitor cloud resources, performance, cost, and availability.
Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues.
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Implement infrastructure-as-code and cloud governance standards.

Description:
Role & responsibilities :

Lead global or domestic client service teams to execute the following FAAS solutions:
Accounting and PMO support for transactions such as purchase price accounting, divestiture/carve-out accounting, IPOs, SPACs and/or Fresh start (Bankruptcy) accounting
Preparation of financial statements/MD&A
GAAP conversion
Accounting policy and governance
Technical accounting research and advisory
Remediation and readiness
Organizing and providing technical training
Addressing service delivery quality issues
Manage and develop people
Lead a team of Assistant Managers and Seniors and make sure the team delivers high - quality work, as per EY Global methodology, on time and to budget
Conduct FAAS team performance reviews, serve as a positive leader and mentor, and contribute to the team performance
Identify development opportunities and training needs for high performing Assistant Managers, Seniors or Staff.
Manage business and clients
Actively support the Americas or EMEIA FAAS leadership both in terms of growth as well as quality initiatives
Enhance relationships with global teams and leverage connections to identify opportunities for work at the GDS
Apply independent and objective professional judgment in applying accounting standards to meet engagement expectations, including regulatory requirements.
Demonstrate a good understanding of accounting concepts; stay informed of professional standards and firm policies (e.g., guidelines of the EY FAAS Policy Manual); and effectively apply this knowledge to moderately difficult and/or complex client situations
Undertaking practice development activities including contributing to thought leadership pieces, running industry events, delivering training, or managing team communications
Contributing to business development activities to help identify and research opportunities on new/existing clients
Skills and attributes for success
Expert knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP and International accounting standards
Extensive hands-on experience in the following areas:
- Transaction accounting and reporting IPO's, SPACs, Carve Outs, PPA etc
- GAAP conversions and implementation of new accounting standards
- Drafting and designing accounting policies
- Technical accounting research and advisory
- Consolidation and compilation support
- Financial statement close process support
Flexibility and willingness to travel on short notice, as necessary
Strong written and verba communication, presentation and technical writing skills
Ideally, youll also
Have experience of working with international clients (preferred)
Have a track record with a leading consulting firm
What we look for
Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US) or ACCA (UK)
5 - 10 years of post-qualification experience in assurance or finance controllership roles, including 2+ years of Financial Accounting and Advisory experience
Candidates with prior Big 10 experience would be an added advantage
Exposure to data analytics and visualization tools (an added advantage)


Preferred candidate profile:
Technical Accounting, IFRS, US GAAP, Financial Reporting with accounting experience, GAAP Conversion, and hands-on exposure to accounting standards such as Business Combinations, Consolidation, and Leases.

Description:
Role: GIS Performance Tester
Experience: 5-6 years
Staff Level: Senior Associate
Education: BE/BTECH or equivalent
Key responsibilities:
Define GIS performance testing strategy covering web, desktop, and servicelevel workloads (ArcGIS Server, Utility Network, Feature Services).
Identify performancecritical GIS workflows (pan/zoom, tracing, edits, large spatial queries, batch jobs).
Create realistic GIS workload models based on editor, viewer, integration, and batch processing usage patterns.
Design test scenarios for: 
Map rendering and symbology scaling
Feature service queries (attribute + spatial)
Utility Network traces and validations
Web GIS Load Test scenarios
Concurrent editing and versioned data access 
Load and Stress Simulation:Execute load, endurance, and stress tests to determine how GIS (likeArcGIS Server) perform under high user traffic, specifically testing 2D/3D map rendering and data querying.
Bottleneck Analysis: Monitor system KPIssuch as CPU utilization, memory, response times, and throughput—to identify bottlenecks related to spatial analysis or database queries.
Result Reporting: Create detailed performance analysis reports that highlight the system's performance, identifying areas for improvement or potential downtime.
Collaborate with Functional Analysts to map business flows into performance test cases.
Prior experience in GIS Testing assignments will be an advantage.
Collaboration & Optimization:Work with GIS developers and architects to suggest infrastructure changes, database tuning, or code optimizations to resolve issues.
Perform RCA on performance issues and recommend improvement opportunities.
Essential Qualifications:
Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.
Understanding of ArcGIS Pro concepts: Maps, Projects, Layout templates, Editing Templates, Tasks etc.
Understanding of Esri geoprocessing tools: model Builder
Understanding of Geodatabases: Versioning and Spatial data Types

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an AI Engineer – Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving software and product innovation within our Technology Consulting practice. You will focus on developing innovative software solutions that enhance business performance and drive digital transformation for our clients. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards, motivating and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will leverage your growing business knowledge to identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm, leading with integrity and authenticity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. Your responsibilities will include analyzing and identifying the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system, effectively mentoring others, and addressing conflicts or issues with clients and team members. You will uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values in a meaningful way.
Responsibilities
- Leading software engineering projects to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance
- Designing, coding, and testing applications using Python, React Native, and Flutter to deliver exceptional user experiences
- Managing application development and lifecycle management to optimize software solutions
- Implementing microservices architecture to improve system scalability and reliability
- Developing solution architecture and system software to support innovative product development
- Overseeing software project management to confirm successful planning, budgeting, and execution
- Mentoring team members to leverage their strengths and improve performance
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in difficult conversations with stakeholders to resolve issues
- Validating professional and technical standards, including adherence to the firm's code of conduct
- Encouraging the use of innovative technologies and methodologies to enhance delivery and inspire teams
-Proven delivery of production full-stack systems (React + Python) and AI/ML or GenAI solutions
-Strong architectural judgment across front-end, back-end, and LLM/agent orchestration
-Deep familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, ReAct) and LLM orchestration
-Experience with enterprise integrations, distributed systems, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP), containers/Kubernetes, and security best practices
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Excelling in application development and software design
- Utilizing Python and scripting languages for innovative solutions
- Managing software project lifecycles with Agile methodologies
- Leading teams in microservices architecture and system development
- Developing solutions with React Native and Flutter frameworks
- Troubleshooting complex issues in software engineering environments

Description:
We are the makers of possible
BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.
Why Join Us?
A career at BD means learning and working alongside inspirational leaders and colleagues who are equally passionate and committed to fostering an inclusive, growth-centered, and rewarding culture. You will have the opportunity to help shape the trajectory of BD while leaving a legacy at the same time.
To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of health. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. And find satisfaction in doing your part to make the world a better place.
Become a maker of possible with us!
Responsibilities:
1. Conduct CME's, seminars , promotional events and In service programs in the respective region In order to improve BD Specimen Management value proposition amongst both clinical and economic buyers towards business outcome and achieve Regional business objectives.
2. Clinical capability building amongst regional Specimen Management direct selling organisation and amongst channel partners ( administering trainings, continuous evaluation) in line with the country clinical objectives In order to enhance their ability to adequately differentiate the brands in the market and thus achieve targeted business outcomes.
3. Creating and implementing the regional calendar of engagements with potential/existing customers In order to create strong brand awareness and creating door openers at the relevant levels
4. Support / assist sales organisation with product evaluations and 'critical to business' technical challenges (including but not limited to troubleshooting and product applications) In order to attain high levels of product penetration, query resolution and trouble free product application.
5. Leading edge key customer relationship management and creation of regional KOL network In order to ensure usage of full array of BD Specimen Management products by leading client organisations and using these customer relationships to drive the conversions.
6. Coordinate timely completion of clinical/economic studies initiated in the region . In order to ensure that the clinical/ economic studies planned for the year are completed with in the stipulated timelines.

Description:
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance expert with solution design experience across the full FI stack, preferably with an accounts and finance background.
Lead a team of Finance specialists; facilitate and guide the implementation and support teams.
Ability to lead and facilitate design workshops, assessments, and planning sessions, demonstrating leadership experience in project management.
Lead dynamic, interactive requirements-gathering sessions with stakeholders throughout the enterprise.
Strong, hands-on expertise across core SAP FI modules:
FI-GL (General Ledger) New GL, document splitting, parallel ledgers/accounting principles, chart of accounts design, financial statement versions, and period-end closing activities.
FI-AR (Accounts Receivable) — customer master data, credit management, dunning, incoming payments, down payments, and customer-side intercompany processes.
FI-AP (Accounts Payable) — vendor master data, payment runs, payment terms, down payments, automatic/electronic payments, and vendor reconciliation.
Asset Accounting (FI-AA) — asset classes, depreciation areas, parallel valuation, asset acquisitions/retirements/transfers, and integration with GL and CO, including regulated utility plant and FERC asset classification where applicable.
Bank Accounting / Treasury integration — bank master data, electronic bank statement processing, cash management, and bank reconciliation.
Taxation — tax procedures, tax codes, withholding tax, and statutory/compliance reporting requirements.
Basic, working knowledge of Controlling — Cost Center Accounting (CO-CCA), Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA), and Internal Orders — sufficient to support FI-CO integration points and cross-module postings; deep Product Costing or Material Ledger specialization is not required for this role.
Strong knowledge of FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) regulatory reporting for the utilities/energy industry, including FERC Form 1/2/6 preparation, regulatory chart of accounts mapping, and FERC account classification within SAP.
Hands-on experience configuring FERC-compliant Asset Accounting structures — Continuing Property Records (CPR), Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC, both debt and equity components), Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) capitalization, retirement units, and regulatory versus book depreciation.
Understanding of the regulatory ledger/parallel ledger approach (New GL document splitting, or FI-SL) to maintain FERC regulatory books alongside US GAAP/IFRS books, including regulatory asset/liability (ASC 980) accounting.
Exposure to Public Utility industry-specific functionality, Work Order management integration (PM/PS) for capital project accounting, and minor/major retirement processing relevant to utility plant.
Experience supporting FERC audits and regulatory filings, including variance analysis between book and regulatory basis of accounting.
Mentor, coach and manage multiple teams and projects.
Proven experience in configuring, testing and supporting SAP Finance solutions across GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting and Taxation.
Participate in design discussions, providing expertise on the SAP S/4HANA Finance platform.
Work with business users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions across FI processes.
Develop a collaborative and cohesive team, working with a culture of a One Team mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance and accounts, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop and customize solutions, including integration with other modules like MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly how procurement, sales, and production postings flow into FI.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable transactional-level matching in real time.
Understanding of AIF and field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Working familiarity with the S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR) tool, as well as a solid accounting and finance background.
Knowledge and experience in implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.

Job Title: Admission Counsellor / Business Development Executive / Senior Learning Consultant EdTech

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a dynamic and target-driven Senior Manager SME Inside Sales to lead a large sales organization and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and account expansion. The role involves managing 2 Assistant Managers and 50–60 associates, building a high-performance culture, and delivering business targets through data-driven sales strategies and effective people leadership.

Key Responsibilities
* Own revenue, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the function.
* Lead and mentor 2 Assistant Managers and drive performance across 50–60 associates.
* Drive account growth through upselling, cross-selling, share-of-wallet gains, and increased order frequency.
* Improve customer retention, reduce churn, and strengthen long-term account relationships.
* Monitor sales funnel performance, conversion rates, revenue per associate, and key business KPIs.
* Drive forecasting, business reviews, performance management, and continuous process improvement.
* Collaborate with Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to enhance customer experience and business outcomes.
* Leverage customer insights and analytics to identify growth opportunities and improve platform stickiness.
Requirements
* 7+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Account Management, or Customer Retention.
* Proven experience managing large sales teams and delivering revenue and growth targets.
* Strong expertise in sales funnel management, customer retention, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Experience: 5-9 Years
Location: PAN India

Job Summary
We are looking for talented MLOps with 5-9 years of experience to design, automate, deploy, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications and machine learning platforms. The ideal candidate should have expertise in cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, containerization, monitoring, and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments.

Automate machine learning workflows using MLOps best practices.
Deploy and manage ML models in production environments.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Platform teams.
Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, and drift detection mechanisms.
DevOps

Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
Manage code repositories, branching strategies, and release processes.
Implement DevSecOps practices and security controls.
Improve deployment efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
CloudOps
Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Monitor cloud resources, performance, cost, and availability.
Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues.
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Implement infrastructure-as-code and cloud governance standards.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job Summary
The opportunity: Project Analyst-National-Forensics-ASU - Forensics - Discovery - Chandigarh
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.


Your key responsibilities
Hands-on experience in cyber incident responses.
Proficiency in legal document review, applying coding protocols and relevance criteria consistently and accurately.
Working knowledge of digital forensic processes, including evidence collection, preservation, and chain-of-custody management.
Experience using e-discovery tools to process, filter, and review large volumes of electronic data.
Ability to apply structured consulting frameworks to organize investigations, analyze findings, and deliver clear project outputs.


To qualify for the role you must have
LLB


Experience
CIR and DR (6-12 months)


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Directs and motivates team while personally assisting in providing high quality service based on requirements and standards. Monitors and controls ficial and administrative responsibilities including asset protection. Provides clear and concise communications to everyone having ownership in the success of the event. Identifies training opportunities and plans a strategy to accomplish goals.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the event management, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Banquet Operations
- Projects supply needs for the department, (e.g., china, glass, silver, buffet presentations, props).
- Applies knowledge of all laws, as they relate to an event.
- Understands the impact of Banquet operations on the overall success of an event and manages activities to maximize customer satisfaction.
- Adheres to and reinforces all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Maintains established sanitation levels.
- Manages departmental inventories and maintains equipment.
- Uses banquet beverage records to control liquor costs and manage the banquet beverage perpetual inventory.
- Schedules banquet service staff to forecast and service standards, while maximizing profits.
- Assists team in developing lasting relationships with groups to retain business and increase growth.
Participating in and Leading Banquet Teams
- Sets goals and delegates tasks to improve departmental performance.
- Conducts monthly department meetings with the Banquet team.
- Applies and continually broadens knowledge of food and wine pairings and cutting edge cuisine with emphasis on current event trends.
- Acts as a liaison to the kitchen staff.
- Leads shifts and actively participates in the servicing of events.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Communicates and executes departmental and property emergency procedures and ensures staff are trained in safety procedures.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Monitors progress and leads discussion with staff each period.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Reviews quarterly Meeting Planner Survey results and participates in the development and implementation of corrective action to address service challenges; focuses on continuous improvement of guest satisfaction.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

Description:
Our Spa Specialists play an important role in support of a number of vital Spa functions. At our hotels these associates work to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with Spa services on the side. Our Spa Specialists take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their experience.

Whether promoting Spa services or retail, scheduling reservations and confirming appointments, providing answers about services, checking in guests, or processing payments, the Spa Specialist makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.

Spa Specialists will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing reservation software (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance and 25 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Spa Specialists - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Job Description Associate, Network
Operations Center (NOC L1)
Department: IT Network Operations
Designation: Associate NOC L1
Experience: 02 Years
Qualification: BE/B.Tech preferred
Certification: CCNA preferred
Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Monitor network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access
points, and ISP links, to ensure network availability.
2. Perform basic network troubleshooting using tools such as Ping, Traceroute, and
network monitoring dashboards.
3. Understand basic networking concepts, including TCP/IP, OSI Model, VLANs, DHCP,
DNS, LAN, WAN, and packet flow.
4. Identify and perform initial troubleshooting of network connectivity issues, link failures,
port errors, and basic Layer 2 problems.
5. Have a basic understanding of VLAN configuration, switch port settings, trunking, and
Spanning Tree Protocol (STP).
6. Monitor network alerts, bandwidth utilization, device availability, and performance
through network monitoring tools.
7. Create, update, and track network incidents in the ticketing system, ensuring timely
escalation and resolution within defined SLAs.
8. Coordinate with ISPs and internal IT teams for connectivity issues, outages, and service
restoration.
9. Perform initial troubleshooting of wireless connectivity issues and escalate complex
problems to the NOC L2 team.
10. Assist senior engineers in network maintenance activities, switch replacements, firmware
upgrades, and configuration changes.
11. Follow established SOPs, incident management processes, escalation matrices, and
shift handover procedures.
12. Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting logs, and daily network health
reports.
Required Technical Skills
Networking Fundamentals: Basic understanding of TCP/IP, OSI Model, IP addressing,
subnetting, VLANs, LAN/WAN, DNS, DHCP, and routing concepts.
Basic Troubleshooting: Knowledge of Ping, Traceroute, packet flow, and identifying
common network connectivity issues.
Switching Knowledge: Basic understanding of Layer 2 switches, access/trunk ports,
VLANs, STP, and port status.
Network Monitoring: Familiarity with monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or
similar NMS platforms.
Incident Management: Understanding of ticket handling, incident prioritization, SLA
tracking, and escalation procedures.
ISP Coordination: Ability to perform basic ISP link checks and coordinate with service
providers for issue resolution.
Documentation: Ability to maintain troubleshooting records, incident updates, and shift
handover reports.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications
BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related discipline preferred.
CCNA certification or CCNA-level networking knowledge preferred.
Basic knowledge of Fortinet FortiGate firewalls will be an added advantage.
Basic understanding of wireless networking, Wi-Fi access points, and SSID
troubleshooting preferred.
Familiarity with Cisco switches and enterprise networking environments.
Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to work in 247 rotational shifts as per NOC operational requirements.
Role Expectations
The Associate NOC L1 will be responsible for proactive network monitoring, initial
troubleshooting, incident logging, ISP coordination, and timely escalation of complex network
issues to L2/L3 teams. The role focuses on maintaining network availability, following
operational SOPs, and supporting day-to-day network operations under senior engineers'
guidance.

Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Gen AI | Infosys | 2-5yrs | Pan India

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Description:
Greetings from Stylam Industries Limited !!!

Below is the Job Description:-

Department: Export Sales Support / International Business
Industry Preference: Building Materials / Laminates / Plywood / Tiles / Manufacturing / Export Industry

1. Job Purpose
To lead and manage the complete backend operations of the Export Sales function, ensuring seamless coordination between international customers, export sales teams, production, logistics, finance and other internal departments. The role will focus on order management, export documentation, shipment coordination, customer service, process efficiency and timely execution of export orders.
2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
Export Order Management: Oversee export orders from order receipt to final shipment, ensuring timely processing and execution.
Sales Coordination: Lead the backend export sales support team and ensure effective coordination with international sales teams and customers.
Export Documentation: Supervise preparation and verification of Proforma Invoices, Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Shipping Bills, Bills of Lading, COO and other export documents.
Logistics & Shipment: Coordinate with CHA, freight forwarders, shipping lines and internal dispatch teams for timely shipment execution.
Production Coordination: Monitor order status, production planning, material readiness and dispatch schedules to meet committed delivery timelines.
Customer Management: Ensure timely responses to international customer queries, order updates, documentation requirements and shipment-related concerns.
Payment Coordination: Coordinate with Finance for advance payments, LC documentation, bank realization, overdue payments and export-related financial documentation.
Team Management: Lead, train and monitor the export backend team, ensuring accountability and operational efficiency.
MIS & Reporting: Develop and monitor reports related to order booking, pending orders, shipment status, order execution, delivery performance and outstanding payments.
Process Improvement: Establish SOPs, internal controls and standardized workflows to improve export operations and minimize errors.
3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Export Order Processing TAT.
On-time Shipment and Dispatch Performance.
Accuracy of Export Documentation.
Pending Order and Backlog Management.
Customer Query Resolution TAT.
Export Order Execution Efficiency.
Payment Documentation and Coordination.
Team Productivity and Process Compliance.
4. Required Qualifications & Skills
MBA / Graduate in International Business, Commerce or related discipline.
15+ years of experience in Export Sales Coordination / Export Backend Operations.
Strong knowledge of export documentation, Incoterms, LC, customs procedures and international logistics.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred).
Excellent coordination, communication and leadership skills.
Strong analytical, MIS and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple international customer accounts and export orders.
5. Key Competencies
Leadership & Team Management
Export Documentation & Compliance
Order-to-Dispatch Management
Cross-functional Coordination
Customer Relationship Management
Process Excellence & Operational Control
AboutCompany:
Stylam Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality laminates, exterior claddings, and adhesives. The company has a strong presence in the construction and interior design industry and is known for its innovative and durable products.
Established in 1991, Stylam Industries has grown to become a trusted name in the laminate and cladding industry. The company is committed to using cutting-edge technology and sustainable practices to produce a wide range of decorative laminates, compact laminates, door skins, and exterior claddings, catering to the diverse needs of architects, interior designers, and builders.
Stylam Industries emphasizes quality and design, offering a variety of surface finishes, textures, and patterns to meet the aesthetic and functional requirements of residential, commercial, and industrial projects. The company's adherence to international quality standards and continuous product innovation has earned it a strong reputation in domestic and international markets.
In addition to its product offerings, Stylam Industries Limited is known for its customer-centric approach, providing comprehensive support, technical expertise, and customized solutions to its clients. The company's commitment to sustainability is reflected in its environmentally responsible manufacturing processes and eco-friendly product options.
Overall, Stylam Industries Limited continues to be a frontrunner in the laminate and cladding industry, known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

Description:
Designation: Senior Associate NOC L2
Experience: 25 Years
Qualification: BE/B.Tech/MCA preferred
Certification: CCNA/CCNP preferred

Key Roles & Responsibilities
Monitor and manage network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, and ISP links, to ensure high network availability and performance.
Perform advanced network troubleshooting using tools such as Ping, Traceroute, packet analysis, and network monitoring dashboards.
Diagnose and resolve complex Layer 2 network issues, including VLAN misconfigurations, Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) problems, port errors, and trunking issues.
Investigate and resolve network connectivity problems, including network loops, broadcast storms, link failures, packet loss, and high latency.
Configure and manage network switches, VLANs, access/trunk ports, and other Layer 2 network configurations as per operational requirements.
Implement and maintain network segmentation through VLAN configurations and ensure proper traffic isolation and network security.
Monitor network performance, bandwidth utilization, device health, and network alerts to proactively identify and resolve service degradation.
Act as an escalation point for NOC L1 engineers, providing technical guidance and resolving issues beyond L1 troubleshooting capabilities.
Coordinate with ISPs, internal IT teams, and OEM support teams for troubleshooting, incident resolution, and service restoration.
Assist in network maintenance activities, firmware upgrades, switch replacements, firewall changes, and planned network change activities.
Support network redundancy, failover testing, and high-availability (HA) configurations to ensure business continuity.
Manage network incidents, maintain accurate ticket updates, perform initial root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure incident resolution within defined SLAs.
Collaborate with senior network engineers and architects for network optimization, infrastructure improvements, and capacity planning.
Follow established SOPs, change management procedures, incident escalation matrices, and shift handover processes.
Maintain network documentation, troubleshooting records, configuration backups, incident reports, and daily network health reports.

Required Technical Skills
Advanced Networking Fundamentals: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI Model, IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, LAN/WAN, DNS, DHCP, and routing concepts.
Layer 2 Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience in troubleshooting VLAN misconfigurations, STP issues, broadcast storms, network loops, trunking problems, and switch port errors.
Network Troubleshooting Tools: Proficiency in Ping, Traceroute, packet flow analysis, and basic packet capture tools such as Wireshark.
Switching & Routing: Working knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, VLAN configuration, access/trunk ports, STP, inter-VLAN routing, and basic routing protocols.
Network Monitoring & Performance: Experience with monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or similar NMS platforms for device availability, bandwidth utilization, and performance analysis.
Network Security & Segmentation: Understanding of VLAN-based network segmentation, firewall policies, access control, and secure network configurations.
High Availability & Redundancy: Basic understanding of network redundancy, link failover, HA configurations, and network availability management.
Incident & Escalation Management: Ability to handle L1 escalations, troubleshoot critical incidents, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure SLA compliance.
ISP & Vendor Coordination: Experience in troubleshooting ISP connectivity, packet loss, latency, and link instability while coordinating with service providers and OEMs.
Technical Documentation: Ability to prepare incident reports, RCA documentation, network diagrams, configuration records, and shift handover reports.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications
BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related discipline preferred.
CCNA certification or equivalent hands-on networking knowledge preferred.
2-5 years of experience in enterprise network operations, NOC L2 support, or network infrastructure management.
Hands-on experience with Cisco Layer 2/Layer 3 switches and enterprise networking environments.
Knowledge of Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, including basic firewall policies, routing, interfaces, and troubleshooting, will be an added advantage.
Understanding of wireless networking, including Wi-Fi access points, SSID configurations, VLAN mapping, and wireless connectivity troubleshooting.
Familiarity with network monitoring tools, incident management systems, and change management processes.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to handle critical network incidents and guide junior NOC engineers.
Willingness to work in 247 rotational shifts as per NOC operational requirements.

Role Expectations
The Senior Associate NOC L2 will be responsible for advanced network troubleshooting, proactive infrastructure monitoring, Layer 2 network configuration, incident resolution, and technical escalation support for NOC L1 engineers.
The role requires strong hands-on networking knowledge, the ability to independently troubleshoot complex connectivity issues, coordinate with ISPs and OEMs, and ensure timely incident resolution within defined SLAs.
The candidate will also support network maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, high-availability testing, and continuous improvement of network stability and operational efficiency.

Description:
Greetings from Stylam Industries Limited !

Business Development Executive (Export Sales)
Department: Export Sales / International Business

Industry Preference: Laminates / Plywood / HPL / Building Materials / Manufacturing / Export Industry

1. Job Purpose
To develop international business opportunities, generate export sales leads, identify potential overseas distributors and customers, and drive revenue growth by promoting the company's laminate, HPL and allied product portfolio across international markets.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
Identify and develop new international customers, distributors, dealers, importers and project-based business opportunities.
Generate export sales leads through online platforms, trade portals, LinkedIn, exhibitions and international business networks.
Promote the company's product portfolio, including Decorative Laminates, HPL and other allied products in overseas markets.
Prepare quotations, commercial proposals, Proforma Invoices and follow up with international customers for order closures.
Coordinate with existing international customers to develop long-term business relationships and achieve repeat orders.
Conduct market research to identify new geographical markets, competitors, pricing trends and business opportunities.
Coordinate with internal teams for product samples, pricing approvals, order processing and shipment schedules.
Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery conditions and other commercial requirements with international customers.
Follow up on enquiries, quotations, customer requirements and pending orders to ensure business conversion.
Achieve assigned export sales targets, customer acquisition targets and revenue objectives.

3. Key Skills Required
International Business Development
Export Sales & Lead Generation
International Customer Acquisition
Distributor & Dealer Development
Export Documentation Knowledge
International Market Research
Negotiation & Commercial Skills
CRM & Sales Pipeline Management
Communication & Presentation Skills
Sales Target Achievement

4. Educational Qualifications
MBA in International Business / Marketing or Graduate in Commerce / Business Administration.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Knowledge of international trade practices and export procedures.

5. Preferred Candidate Profile
3+ years of experience in export sales or international business development.
Experience in building materials, laminates, plywood, HPL or related manufacturing industries preferred.
Exposure to international markets, distributors, importers and overseas customer handling.
Knowledge of export pricing, Incoterms, international payments and basic export documentation.
Willingness to travel internationally, wherever required.

Stylam Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality laminates, exterior claddings, and adhesives. The company has a strong presence in the construction and interior design industry and is known for its innovative and durable products.

The company is committed to using cutting-edge technology and sustainable practices to produce a wide range of decorative laminates, compact laminates, door skins, and exterior claddings, catering to the diverse needs of architects, interior designers, and builders.

Overall, Stylam Industries Limited continues to be a frontrunner in the laminate and cladding industry, known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
