Description:
SASE Network Security Engineer
Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)

Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled SASE Network Security Engineer to design, implement, operate, and continuously improve our enterprise Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Security Service Edge (SSE) platform. This role is critical to enabling secure, high-performance connectivity for distributed users, devices, and applications while advancing our Zero Trust security strategy.

The ideal candidate combines deep networking expertise with modern cloud-delivered security capabilities and will play a key role in migrating legacy remote-access and web-proxy solutions to a converged SASE architecture.

Key Responsibilities
Design, deploy, and manage SASE/SSE solutions including Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), and threat protection.
Configure and optimize traffic steering, SSL/TLS inspection, client deployment, policy enforcement, and high-availability designs.
Lead migration of legacy VPN, web proxy, and remote-access technologies to cloud-delivered SASE services.
Monitor platform performance, analyze logs and telemetry, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive continuous optimization of security posture and user experience.
Develop automation scripts, infrastructure-as-code approaches, and maintain high-quality technical documentation.
Collaborate with Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Identity, and Operations teams to ensure alignment with Zero Trust principles and enterprise standards.

Required Qualifications
2+ years of experience in network engineering, network security, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating enterprise SASE/SSE platforms (e.g., Zscaler, Netskope,Cisco Secure Access, or equivalent).
Strong understanding of SASE and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architectures and principles.
Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, Routing and Switching, VPNs (IPsec, SSL/TLS), proxy technologies, and traffic engineering.
Experience with identity federation and authentication (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and major IdPs (Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Okta, etc.).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid connectivity patterns.
Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Vendor certifications (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Netskope, Cisco) related to SASE/SSE or network security.
Experience with SD-WAN technologies and integration with SASE.
Knowledge of DLP, CASB advanced features, Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), and threat protection capabilities.
Scripting/automation experience (Python, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
Experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring workflows.
Prior experience in large-scale enterprise or regulated environments.

Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Entry level management position that focuses on successfully accomplishing the daily objectives in the kitchen. Assists in leading staff while personally assisting in all areas of the kitchen, including food production; purchasing and kitchen sanitation. Position contributes to ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Maintains food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of Culinary and related kitchen area employees in high demand times.
- Oversees production and preparation of culinary items.
- Ensures employees keep their work areas clean and sanitary.
- Works with Restaurant and Banquet departments to coordinate service and timing of events and meals.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates areas in need of attention to staff and follows up to ensure follow through.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Supporting Culinary Team Activities
- Supervises daily shift operations.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Ensures completion of assigned duties.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, giving feedback as needed.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Monitors employees progress towards meeting performance expectations.
Maintaining Culinary Goals
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
- Supports and assists with new menus, concepts and promotions for the Restaurant outlets and Banquets.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
Additional Responsibilities
- Reports malfunctions in department equipment.
- Purchases appropriate supplies and manages food and supply inventories according to budget.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT :
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government & Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EYs Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social & Health care, Education, Urban & Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste & Sanitation, Power & Utilities and Public Finance & Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Work closely with clients to understand their business challenges and provide practical, data-driven solutions.
Support government, public sector, and private sector projects from planning through implementation.
Conduct market research, policy analysis, stakeholder consultations, surveys, and interviews to generate actionable insights.
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, opportunities, and recommendations.
Develop reports, presentations, concept notes, business cases, strategy documents, and client deliverables.
Prepare financial and operational assessments, forecasts, and impact analyses to support decision-making.
Collaborate with internal teams and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality project outcomes.
Build and maintain strong client relationships and contribute to business development initiatives.
Support proposal preparation, opportunity identification, and pursuit of new assignments.
Ensure timely delivery of projects while maintaining high standards of quality and professionalism.
4+ years of experience in consulting, advisory, research, policy, strategy, analytics, or project management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex information.
Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and data analysis.
Excellent report writing, presentation development, and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and work effectively in a team-based environment.
Strong client management and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools.
Self-driven, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
Exposure to government advisory, public sector consulting, economic development, policy, or transformation projects will be an advantage.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and engage with senior stakeholders.


Skills and attributes

Qualification
Bachelor of Engineering
Master of Business Administration


Experience
4+ years of Experience


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:

Oil & Gas. This team is directly responsible for growth of Oil and Gas offline transactions & users at Paytm.

About the role:

Team Lead KAM - To work with the business to understand and manage Programs being run for the Clients/Brands. And for accelerating the core growth metrics focusing on sales & distribution. Provides guidance and instruction to a working group about a project or portfolio of projects. These leads are responsible for monitoring the efforts of the team members and getting the work done effectively and efficiently with the proper utilization of resources.

Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

2+ yrs. of experience in Distribution sales in fintech, Banking/ Sales, EDC Sales.
Develop plans and strategies for developing business and achieving the company's sales goals.

Create a culture of success and ongoing business and goal achievement.
Hire and build a new team to support our growing needs and future projects.
Define optimal sales force structure.

Define and coordinate sales training programs that enable staff to achieve their potential and support company sales objectives.

Manage customer expectations and contribute to a high level of customer satisfaction.

Define sales processes that drive desired sales outcomes and identify improvements.

Going to the Merchant and educating him/her about the benefits of the Swipe machine (EDC) converting them and managing their accounts.

Exceptional communication, presentation skills and relationship building skills.

Ability to aggressively manage the successful execution of a sales strategy.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree

Should have a strong understanding of the local language.

Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

Education: Applicants must possess bachelors degree or above

Why join us:

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that is how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India

Description:
Job Description-

The Associate IT Security Operations will support the IT Security team in day-to-day security
operations, monitoring, alert handling, ticket management, and coordination with IT teams for
security-related activities.
The role requires a basic understanding of EDR/XDR, DLP, vulnerability and patch
management, along with a strong willingness to learn and work with new cybersecurity
technologies.
Experience
13 years of experience in IT Security, Cybersecurity, SOC, IT Operations, or a related field.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and support day-to-day IT Security Operations activities.
Monitor and perform initial triage of security alerts from EDR/XDR and DLP platforms.
Have a basic understanding of EDR/XDR concepts, endpoint security alerts, malware
detections, and security incidents.
Support DLP alert monitoring, investigation, and incident closure.
Monitor vulnerability and patch management status and coordinate with IT teams for
remediation.
Track security issues and incidents through the organization's ticketing/ITSM tool such
as ServiceNow or equivalent.
Ensure security tickets and alerts are investigated and updated within defined SLAs.
Support endpoint security activities and identify devices with security-agent or
compliance issues.
Assist senior team members with security incident investigations and remediation
activities.
Prepare basic security operations reports and maintain operational trackers.
Follow defined security SOPs, processes, and escalation procedures.
Work closely with IT Infrastructure, Network, Endpoint, IAM, and other teams for
security remediation.
Stay updated with cybersecurity concepts and demonstrate eagerness to learn and work
with new security technologies and tools.
Technical Understanding
The candidate should have a basic understanding of:
EDR/XDR: CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, Microsoft Defender, or similar
platforms.
DLP: Microsoft Purview, Forcepoint, Symantec/Broadcom, or similar solutions.
Vulnerability Management: Qualys, Tenable/Nessus, Rapid7, or similar tools.
Patch Management: Intune, ManageEngine Endpoint Central, SCCM/MECM, or
equivalent.
Ticketing/ITSM: ServiceNow, Jira, ManageEngine ServiceDesk, or equivalent.
Basic understanding of Windows endpoints, networking, malware, phishing,vulnerabilities, and cybersecurity incidents.

Qualifications & Skills
1–3 years of relevant IT/Security Operations experience.
Basic understanding of cybersecurity and endpoint security concepts.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good written and verbal communication.
Ability to follow processes and work within defined SLAs.
Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively with multiple IT and Security teams.
Key Focus
IT Security Operations | EDR/XDR | DLP | Vulnerability & Patch Management | Security Alert
Monitoring | Ticket Management | Incident Support

Description:
Travel: Willingness to travel to offices, warehouses, and other business locations across India
.
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Sr. Associate Network Engineer (L2) to
manage, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. The
candidate must have hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, Cisco
switches, Cisco Meraki wireless access points, and FortiAP wireless solutions.
The role involves handling L2 network incidents, troubleshooting complex connectivity
and performance issues, supporting network deployments, coordinating with ISPs and
OEM vendors, and ensuring network availability across corporate offices and
warehouse locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Firewall Management – Fortinet
Configure, manage, and troubleshoot FortiGate firewalls.
Manage firewall policies, NAT, routing, VLANs, IPsec VPNs, and SSL VPNs.
Monitor firewall health, traffic logs, security events, and resource utilization.
Troubleshoot connectivity, VPN, and policy-related issues.
Support firmware upgrades, configuration backups, and security patching.
Work with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralized management and log
analysis, where deployed.
2. Switching and Routing – Cisco
Configure and troubleshoot Cisco Layer 2 and Layer 3 switches.

Manage VLANs, trunk ports, access ports, STP, EtherChannel, and inter-VLAN
routing.
Troubleshoot DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, and network connectivity
issues.
Diagnose switching loops, packet drops, port errors, and network latency.
Support switch installation, configuration, replacement, and firmware upgrades.
Maintain network diagrams, IP address records, and configuration backups.
3. Wireless Network Management – Cisco Meraki and FortiAP
Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco Meraki wireless access points and
FortiAPs.
Manage SSIDs, VLAN mapping, authentication, RF settings, channel allocation,
and transmit power.
Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connectivity, authentication failures, roaming issues,
interference, and high latency.
Analyze wireless client connectivity, signal strength, channel utilization, and
access point performance.
Manage wireless configurations through the Meraki Dashboard and
FortiGate/FortiAP management interfaces, as applicable.
Support wireless surveys, AP installations, coverage validation, and Wi-Fi
optimization at offices and warehouse sites.
4. Network Monitoring and Incident Management
Monitor network infrastructure using tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, Nagios, or
equivalent platforms.
Investigate alerts, identify root causes, and resolve L2 network incidents within
defined SLAs.
Perform systematic troubleshooting of LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, firewall, and internet
connectivity issues.
Escalate L3 or OEM-dependent issues with detailed troubleshooting evidence.
Prepare incident reports, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventive action plans.
Participate in change management, maintenance windows, and major incident
resolution.
5. Site Deployment and Vendor Coordination
Travel to corporate offices, warehouses, and other business sites for network
deployment and troubleshooting.

Support installation, commissioning, migration, and replacement of firewalls,
switches, and wireless access points.
Coordinate with ISPs, OEMs, and field support teams for fault resolution and
service restoration.
Validate network connectivity, wireless coverage, and infrastructure readiness at
new sites.
Maintain site inventory, network documentation, standard configurations, and
operational checklists.
Required Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls.
Practical experience with Cisco Layer 2/Layer 3 switches.
Mandatory experience with Cisco Meraki Wi-Fi access points and FortiAPs.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, subnetting, routing, NAT,
and VPN technologies.
Experience with wireless troubleshooting, RF fundamentals, roaming, and Wi-Fi
performance optimization.
Familiarity with network monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or Nagios.
Working knowledge of incident management, change management, and ticketing
systems.
Ability to use troubleshooting tools such as ping, traceroute, nslookup/dig, packet
captures, and firewall logs.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Ability to handle critical incidents in a fast-paced environment.
Strong documentation, ownership, and follow-up skills.
Working Conditions
Willingness to travel across India as per business requirements.
Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and public
holidays, if required.
Availability for on-call support during critical network outages and business-
impacting incidents.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology,
Electronics, or a related field.
Fortinet NSE/FCP, Cisco CCNA, or relevant networking certifications are an
advantage.
Experience supporting distributed enterprise networks, warehouses, branch
offices, or multi-site infrastructure is preferred.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description:
The following would be your role and responsibilities.
1. Undertake physical site visits of various properties being valued by the company and share
construction details as per the local bye-laws, standards and observations from physical site
visits.
2. Fill the site visit format provided by the office in a detailed and thorough manner for each
visit being undertaken. Make sure all visits allotted are executed on time and regular updates
are provided to the Client Coordinator.
3. Have a good understanding of various geographies / parts of Mumbai MR and best ways to
commute to places within the city.
4. Have a good understanding on the prevailing real estate prices in various geographies being
covered by the engineer (Western Line / Central Line)
5. Conduct regular market surveys to understand the current rate of real estate prices in a
given area. Appropriately document the same in the form of a Location Wise Rate List in the
office.
6. Work closely with the Valuations Team in the office and Client Coordination team on a daily
basis. Reporting formats and guidelines are shared during the induction period.
7. Work as per the values and policies of the organisation and at no point compromise on
them. The company takes its values and policies extremely seriously and can take strict
action in case not adhered to.
Requirements:
Mandatory: Basic understanding of the Mumbais geography for swift commute for cases. Fluent
reading and writing skills.
Preferred: 0-3 years of work experience in related fields. Civil engineering degree / diploma will
be preferred. Prior experience in the field of property valuations in the Mumbai MR region is
going to be beneficial.
The above roles and responsibilities are subject to change by the Lead Valuations & Engineering
Services or the management as and when required. The above mentioned responsibilities will be
used as a guide to evaluate the performance of the joinee at the time of appraisal.
Location-Mumbai,Pune & Chandigarh

Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Dr Lal PathLabs offers widest test menu and has a pan India presence in all important cities and towns of India, in the form of state-of-the-art laboratories and patient service centres.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

KeyDeliverables (Essential functions &Responsibilities of the Job) :
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer,your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn thebasics of store operations. Your key responsibilities include:
1. Customer Service:
Greet & Assist Customers: Welcomecustomers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listento customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.
2. Store Standards:
Support Visual Merchandising: Helpmaintain the stores appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling: Ensureproducts are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.
3. Basic Operations:
Learn Store Procedures: Followcompany guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering: Whenneeded, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.
4. Growth & Learning:
On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve yourskills and grow within the role

Description:
Job description

Senior Executive Relationship Management

Job Title: Senior Executive Relationship Management
Department: Sales
Industry: Interior Design / Home Interiors
Experience: 1-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Working Days: 6 Days a Week
Fixed Weekly Off: Tuesday

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic and customer-focused Senior Executive Relationship Management to drive sales, build strong customer relationships, and deliver an exceptional customer experience. The ideal candidate should have strong communication and negotiation skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to achieve sales targets in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Generate new business opportunities by proactively engaging with prospective customers and building a strong sales pipeline.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to understand their requirements and provide suitable solutions.
Drive sales and achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in coordination with the interior design team.
Ensure an excellent customer experience throughout the sales journey, from the initial enquiry to deal closure.
Understand customer needs, address concerns, and provide effective solutions to improve customer satisfaction.
Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and proactively resolve customer and business challenges.
Explore alternate sales channels, including residential visits, apartment activities, design consultations, and showroom engagements.
Coordinate with internal teams, including interior designers, to ensure smooth customer interactions and timely follow-ups.
Analyse sales performance and customer feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
Demonstrate flexibility, accountability, and a results-oriented approach in a fast-paced work environment.
Communicate effectively with customers, colleagues, business partners, and other stakeholders.
Take the initiative to implement new ideas and contribute to business growth.

Required Skills and Qualifications

1-5 years of experience in sales, business development, or relationship management.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong customer relationship management and negotiation skills.
Good listening, presentation, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to multitask, prioritise tasks, and manage time effectively.
Target-oriented mindset with a proven ability to drive sales and achieve business goals.
Strong ownership, initiative, and willingness to work in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in B2C sales, customer relationship management, real estate, home interiors, or other customer-facing sales roles will be preferred.
Candidates with strong customer-handling skills and a passion for delivering excellent service are encouraged to apply.
Candidates should be comfortable with customer visits, apartment activities, and showroom-based sales engagements.Role & responsibilities
AboutCompany: Homevista Decor and Furnishings Private Limited, widely known as HomeLane, is a Bengaluru-based private company, incorporated in March 2014, specializing in manufacturing and interior design services. It operates actively, with over 2,000 employees, substantial capital investment, multiple directors, and offices in Indiranagar. The flagship HomeLane brand has seen strong expansion and market presence in India.

Description:
Responsibilities
OE shall be owner of his / her service area in terms of all operations related actions and shall Execute daily service operations with a team of assigned Technicians within a given service areas
Ensure quality of service delivery by effective supervision on technicians - on the job as per company SOPs
Ensure technicians carry out treatment within a given Time on Site (ToS) in a competent manner. (OE to engage technician via route riding, training on the job).
Plan execute 02 TPAs (Technicians Performance Assessment) per assigned technician with 2 development programs per year. Coach train assigned technicians in order to improve the service quality
Convey special instructions, if any, to technicians to execute the job as per Service Docket (liaison with Sales colleagues)
Carry out pest management audits of customer sites as per agreed schedule by i or R auditor.
Complete close customer audit non-conformities (external / internal). Follow up implement CAPA at customer site
On Site Documentation: Implementation of SOP, Compliance and closure of audits non-conformities (Internal / External). Send service dockets of completed services to NKA for invoicing on time.
Handle assigned customer complaints in his / her service areas, within 24 hours resolve complaint at earliest, as per the customers convenience and update the Root Cause in iCABS to ensure proper ticket closure
Identify resolve service delivery issues in coordination with the Branch Manager
Conduct daily 10 min stand up meeting monthly operations meeting
Be conversant with STP (Service Track Pest) and monitor, analyze visit extraction notes for all high infestation related service visits on a daily basis; take action.
Digital Initiative: Be conversant with all in house systems.
Maintain Material consumption, Overtime Hrs. schedule at an agreed targeted level for the assigned service area and for technician
Approval of conveyance amount for assigned technicians
Monitor report to ABM/BM on input costs at all major sites as per gross margin agreed discuss action plans to bring it within limits
Actively drive Service Product Leads for assigned technician group within service area by implementing STA (See, Tell, Ask) and T.I.M.E. (Train, Incentivise, Monitor, Engage) on the job coaching to create density of customers.
Innovation: conduct trials and report findings as per the guidelines, implement new service lines as per the SOPs.
Minimum 18 customer visits per week for Resi SA (Residential Small Accounts segment heavy branch), includes, Customer complaints. For Specific Site based OEs -Number shall not be applicable but Retention of customer/s at site would be main KPI with all scheduled services completed efficiently and effectively.
Inventory: Help ABM/BM to manage Inventory - coordinate with other Ops colleagues
to manage Stock Levels of branches forecasting, Indenting receipt of material for branch (as an assigned function within branch by BM).
Ensure APL (Approved Preparations List) is followed by all assigned technicians all chemical containers have original labels
Ensure proper schedule of maintenance repairs of equipment is established followed (via JOC).
Promote highest grooming standards (uniform, Safety shoes, PPEs)
Encourage technicians to plan their leaves in advance to curb absenteeism
Help Resolve any Grievances IR issues of Technicians bring to the notice of ABM/BM on day today basis
Report any deviation that could impact service quality or productivity of technicians like- over commitments, recommendation regarding night service (if it is not needed), covered area mismatch, etc


Requirements
Minimum B. Sc. (Chemistry / Zoology / Agriculture). Any prior experience in operations of pest management or service industry is desirable.
Proficient in use of computer applications systems with Excel, Word, PowerPoint (or its equivalent)
Should get well versed with various internal company systems such as iCABS, STP, iAuditor, SRA, SQA, SQS, TPA, myRentokilPCI, Service Leads App, U+ etc

Description:
Job Summary
Agilent is looking for passionate and motivated young scientists to join our team as Field Application Engineers (FAE) supporting our LCMS (Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) and GCMS (Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) business. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work closely with leading pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, food, environmental, and research laboratories across India. As a Field Application Engineer, you will serve as a technical expert, helping customers develop analytical workflows, optimize methods, and maximize the value of Agilent's advanced analytical instrumentation. You will collaborate with sales, product specialists, application scientists, and customers to drive technology adoption and business growth.


Responsibilities
Develop and optimize LCMS and GCMS analytical methods and workflows for applications including pharmaceuticals, pesticides, antibiotics, food safety, and other emerging markets
Design and execute experiments to support development of new applications and workflow solutions.
Generate scientific data and contribute to application notes, technical publications, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborate with leading researchers, industry experts, and key opinion leaders to drive innovative analytical solutions
Deliver customer demonstrations, technical seminars, and product trainings.
Support customer onboarding, workflow implementation, and application troubleshooting.
Participate in scientific conferences, workshops, and industry events to showcase Agilent technologies.
Work closely with commercial and technical teams to support strategic business growth in LCMS and GCMS.


Qualifications
M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
Strong academic understanding of chromatography and mass spectrometry techniques.
Hands-on laboratory experience through coursework, research projects, internships, or thesis work is preferred.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and scientific communication skills.
Passion for customer engagement and scientific consulting.


Desired Skills
Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact confidently with customers and internal stakeholders.
Curiosity to learn new technologies and applications.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel extensively (up to 75%) across assigned territories.


Additional Details
Full-time weekly schedule.
Travel Required: 50% of the Time
Shift: Day
Duration: No End Date
Job Function: Sales
